explain_en: Article 106 forbids arbitrary refilling, colour changes and test welding on containers.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 搬運高壓氣體容器時，溫度應保持在攝氏幾度以下？
a_zh: 二十五度
b_zh: 四十度
c_zh: 三十度
d_zh: 六十度
q_en: When transporting high-pressure gas cylinders, the temperature shall be kept below:
explain_zh: 第107條第1款：溫度保持在攝氏四十度以下。另容器吊起搬運不得直接用電磁鐵、吊鏈、繩子等直接吊運；裝卸車應確知護蓋旋緊。
explain_en: Article 107(1): keep below 40°C; cylinders must not be lifted directly with electromagnets, chains or ropes; caps must be tightened before loading/unloading.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 高壓氣體貯存場所周圍幾公尺內不得放置煙火及著火性、引火性物品？
a_zh: 十公尺
b_zh: 五公尺
c_zh: 二公尺
d_zh: 一公尺
q_en: Within how many meters of a high-pressure gas storage area are fire, ignitable and flammable items prohibited?
b_en: 5 m
c_en: 2 m
d_en: 1 m
explain_zh: 第108條第2款：貯存周圍二公尺內不得放置有煙火及著火性、引火性物品。另可燃性、毒性及氧氣鋼瓶應分開貯存；通路面積以貯存處面積百分之二十以上為原則。
explain_en: Article 108(2): within 2 m. Flammable, toxic and oxygen cylinders shall be stored separately; aisles should be at least 20% of the storage area.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 高壓氣體貯存，可燃性氣體、有毒性氣體及氧氣之鋼瓶應如何處理？
a_zh: 放在同一鐵籠內即可
b_zh: 應分開貯存
c_zh: 僅需標示即可混放
d_zh: 可混合貯存以節省空間
q_en: Cylinders of flammable gas, toxic gas and oxygen shall be:
a_en: Kept in the same cage
b_en: Stored separately
c_en: Mixed as long as labeled
d_en: Stored together to save space
explain_zh: 第108條第4款：可燃性氣體、有毒性氣體及氧氣之鋼瓶，應分開貯存；盛裝容器和空容器亦應分區放置。
explain_en: Article 108(4): flammable, toxic and oxygen cylinders shall be stored separately; full and empty cylinders shall also be placed in separate zones.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 高壓可燃性氣體之貯存，除一般貯存規定外，另有何特別要求？
a_zh: 貯存處周圍五公尺內應設置圍籬，並由警衛人員全日看守之
b_zh: 貯存處應置備吸收劑、中和劑及適用之防毒面罩或呼吸防護具
c_zh: 電氣設備應採防爆型，不得帶用防爆型攜帶式電筒以外之燈火
d_zh: 電氣設備得採一般型，惟應加裝漏電斷路器並每月檢點一次
q_en: What extra rule applies to storing flammable high pressure gas?
a_en: A fence within five metres of the store guarded around the clock by security
b_en: Absorbents, neutralisers and suitable respirators must be kept at the store
c_en: Explosion proof electrical equipment; no lamps except explosion proof torches
d_en: Ordinary electrical equipment with a leakage breaker checked once a month
explain_zh: 第109條：高壓可燃性氣體之貯存，除第108條規定外，電氣設備應採用防爆型，不得帶用防爆型攜帶式電筒以外之其他燈火，並應有適當之滅火機具。吸收劑、中和劑係第110條毒性高壓氣體之規定。
explain_en: Article 109 requires explosion proof equipment and suitable fire extinguishers.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於毒性高壓氣體之儲存，下列辦理方式何者符合本規則規定？
a_zh: 具腐蝕性之毒性氣體應密閉存放，並儘量減少換氣以避免擴散
b_zh: 貯存處應置備吸收劑、中和劑及適用之防毒面罩或呼吸用防護具
c_zh: 貯存處得設於腐蝕性化學藥品或煙囪附近，以集中管理危險物
d_zh: 容器溫度得保持在攝氏六十度以下，並每週測定溫度一次以上
q_en: Which practice complies with the rule on storing toxic high pressure gas?
a_en: Corrosive toxic gases must be sealed with ventilation kept to a minimum
b_en: Absorbents, neutralisers and suitable respirators must be kept at the store
c_en: The store may sit near corrosive chemicals or chimneys to centralise risk
d_en: Containers may be kept below 60 degrees Celsius with weekly temperature checks
explain_zh: 第110條：毒性高壓氣體之儲存，應於貯存處置備吸收劑、中和劑及適用之防毒面罩或呼吸用防護具；具腐蝕性之毒性氣體應充分換氣保持通風良好；不得在腐蝕化學藥品或煙囪附近貯藏；並預防異物混入。
explain_en: Article 110 requires absorbents, neutralisers and respiratory protection at the store.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於毒性高壓氣體之使用，下列規定何者正確？
a_zh: 工作場所空氣中毒性氣體濃度得為容許濃度之二倍以下使用
b_zh: 經現場作業主管同意者，未受訓練人員亦得單獨進入使用場所
c_zh: 使用場所得採密閉方式操作，不必保持通風良好之作業環境
d_zh: 非對該氣體有實地瞭解之人員不准進入，空氣中濃度不得超過容許濃度
q_en: Which rule governs the use of toxic high pressure gas?
a_en: Airborne concentration may reach up to twice the permissible exposure limit
b_en: With the site supervisors consent, untrained persons may enter the area alone
c_en: The area may be operated fully closed without maintaining good ventilation
d_en: Only persons with practical knowledge may enter; concentration must stay below the limit
explain_zh: 第111條：非對該氣體有實地瞭解之人員不准進入；工作場所空氣中之毒性氣體濃度不得超過容許濃度；應置備充分及適用之防護具；並保持通風良好。
explain_en: Article 111 restricts entry and caps airborne concentration at the permissible limit.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於高壓氣體之廢棄，本規則規定雇主應防止何種危害？
a_zh: 墜落及倒塌之危害者
b_zh: 火災爆炸或中毒之危害
c_zh: 感電及被夾捲之危害
d_zh: 高溫灼燙及凍傷危害
q_en: What hazards must be prevented when disposing of high pressure gas?
a_en: Falling and structural collapse hazards
b_en: Fire, explosion or poisoning hazards
c_en: Electric shock and entanglement hazards
d_en: High temperature burn and frostbite risks
explain_zh: 第112條：雇主對於高壓氣體之廢棄，應防止火災爆炸或中毒之危害。第109條至第111條並就可燃性與毒性高壓氣體之貯存使用另有規定。
explain_en: Article 112 targets fire, explosion and poisoning.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 有關高壓氣體設備及必要措施，除本節規定外尚應依何者辦理？
a_zh: 事業單位報請備查之內部作業標準
b_zh: 其他相關職業安全衛生法規之規定
c_zh: 當地消防機關核定之防火管理計畫
d_zh: 高壓氣體容器製造廠商建議事項
q_en: Besides this section, what else applies to high pressure gas equipment?
a_en: Internal standards filed by the enterprise for the record
b_en: Other relevant occupational safety and health regulations
c_en: A fire management plan approved by the local fire agency
d_en: Recommendations given by the container manufacturer
explain_zh: 第113條：有關高壓氣體設備及必要措施，除本節之規定外，並應依其他相關職業安全衛生法規規定辦理，與第103條起重升降機具之規定體例相同。

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 職業安全衛生設施規則第114條之現行條文內容為何？
a_zh: 規定堆高機非置備後扶架者不得使用之
b_zh: 規定車輛機械應裝置名牌指出額定荷重
c_zh: 本條業經刪除，現行規則並無規定內容
d_zh: 規定自設道路應能承受車輛機械之荷重
q_en: What does Article 114 of the Rules currently provide?
a_en: It bars use of forklifts without a load backrest fitted
b_en: It requires vehicles to carry a plate showing rated load
c_en: The article has been deleted and states no requirement
d_en: It requires site roads to bear the load of the vehicles
explain_zh: 第114條業經刪除。車輛機械之名牌標示規定見第115條，自設道路規定見第118條，堆高機後扶架規定見第124條。

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於車輛機械，本規則就馬力、強度及標示有何規定？
a_zh: 應有足夠馬力及強度承受規定荷重，並裝置名牌指出空重、載重、額定荷重
b_zh: 應有足夠馬力及強度承受規定荷重，惟得免標示空重與額定荷重
c_zh: 應由製造廠商出具強度計算書，並免於機體上為任何之標示
d_zh: 應每半年測定其馬力一次，並將測定紀錄保存一年以上備查
q_en: What does the rule require of vehicle type machines?
a_en: Enough power and strength for the load, plus a plate showing dead and rated loads
b_en: Enough power and strength for the load, but dead and rated loads need no marking
c_en: A strength calculation from the maker, with no marking required on the machine
d_en: Power output measured twice a year with records kept for at least one year
explain_zh: 第115條：雇主對於車輛機械應有足夠之馬力及強度，承受其規定之荷重；並應裝置名牌或相等之標示指出空重、載重、額定荷重等。
explain_en: Article 115 requires a name plate showing dead weight, load and rated load.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 車輛系營建機械及堆高機，除乘坐席位外，於作業時是否得搭載勞工？
a_zh: 不得搭載
b_zh: 可搭載二人
c_zh: 可搭載一人
d_zh: 視現場需要
q_en: May workers ride on vehicle-type construction machinery or forklifts other than in seats?
a_en: No
b_en: Two persons allowed
c_en: One person allowed
d_en: Depends on site needs
explain_zh: 第116條第2款：車輛系營建機械及堆高機，除乘坐席位外，於作業時不得搭載勞工。第10款並禁止勞工搭載於堆高機貨叉之托板等部分。
explain_en: Article 116(2): apart from seats, no workers may ride during operation; item 10 also prohibits riding on forklift pallets or forks.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 堆高機駕駛者離開其位置時，應採取何種措施？
a_zh: 將貨叉等放置於地面，並將原動機熄火、制動
b_zh: 將鑰匙拔出交由現場主管保管，其餘不必處理
c_zh: 將貨叉升至最高位置，以免人員絆倒或碰撞
d_zh: 將貨叉等留置於原高度，並保持原動機運轉待命
q_en: When a forklift driver leaves the seat, the driver shall:
a_en: Lower the forks to the ground, shut off the engine and apply the brake
b_en: Remove the key and hand it to the site supervisor for safekeeping
c_en: Raise the forks to the highest position so no one trips over them
d_en: Leave the forks at their current height and keep the engine running
explain_zh: 第116條第12款：堆高機於駕駛者離開其位置時，應採將貨叉等放置於地面，並將原動機熄火、制動。第11款車輛機械亦應將吊斗等作業裝置放置於地面、熄火、制動。
explain_en: Article 116(12): lower the forks to the ground, shut off the engine and apply the brake; item 11 requires the same for other vehicle machines (buckets to the ground).

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 使用座式操作之配衡型堆高機及側舉型堆高機，駕駛勞工應確實使用何種裝備？
a_zh: 防音用耳塞
b_zh: 防護用安全帽
c_zh: 防塵用護目鏡
d_zh: 駕駛座安全帶
q_en: Drivers of seated counterbalance or side-loading forklifts shall use:
a_en: Noise earplugs
b_en: A safety helmet
c_en: Dust goggles
d_en: The seat belt
explain_zh: 第116條第14款：使用座式操作之配衡型堆高機及側舉型堆高機，應使擔任駕駛之勞工確實使用駕駛座安全帶。但駕駛座配置有防止翻倒壓傷之護欄或其他防護設施者，不在此限。
explain_en: Article 116(14): drivers of seated counterbalance and side-loader forklifts shall wear the seat belt, unless the seat has a guard rail or other protection against being crushed in a tip-over.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 最大速率超過每小時多少公里之車輛系營建機械，應事前依地質地形規定行駛速率？
a_zh: 二十公里
b_zh: 三十公里
c_zh: 十公里
d_zh: 五公里
q_en: For vehicle-type construction machinery with a maximum speed exceeding what, must the employer set travel speeds in advance based on terrain?
a_en: 20 km/h
b_en: 30 km/h
c_en: 10 km/h
d_en: 5 km/h
explain_zh: 第117條：最大速率超過每小時十公里之車輛系營建機械，應於事前依相關作業場所之地質、地形等狀況，規定車輛行駛速率，並使勞工依該速率進行作業。
explain_en: Article 117: for machines with maximum speed over 10 km/h, travel speed shall be prescribed in advance based on the geology and terrain of the site.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於勞工工作場所之自設道路，下列辦理方式何者符合本規則規定？
a_zh: 道路之邊緣及開口部分，應設置足以防止車輛機械翻落之設施
b_zh: 危險區域僅需於地面漆設標線，不必設標誌杆或防禦物者
c_zh: 橋梁及涵洞非屬道路範圍，得免納入定期檢查之項目辦理
d_zh: 道路坡度得依現地條件放寬，縱有滑下可能亦得先行使用之
q_en: Which practice complies with the rule on employer built site roads?
a_en: Road edges and openings must have facilities preventing vehicles from falling off
b_en: Danger zones need only painted floor lines, not posts or protective barriers
c_en: Bridges and culverts are outside the road and need no periodic inspection
d_en: Gradients may be relaxed on site even where machines might slide down them
explain_zh: 第118條：自設道路應能承受車輛機械之荷重；危險區應設標誌杆或防禦物；道路包括橋梁及涵洞應定期檢查；坡度須適當不得有滑下可能之斜度；應設行車安全設備；邊緣及開口部分應設防止翻落設施。
explain_en: Article 118 lists six requirements including fall prevention at edges and openings.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 使用於作業場所之車輛系營建機械，應設置何種裝置以防止物體掉落之危害？
a_zh: 防水帆布
b_zh: 閃光警示燈
c_zh: 活動遮陽傘
d_zh: 堅固頂蓬
q_en: Vehicle-type construction machinery used on site shall be equipped with what to protect against falling objects?
a_en: A waterproof tarp
b_en: A flashing light
c_en: A movable sunshade
d_en: A sturdy canopy
explain_zh: 第119條：駕駛棚須有良好視線與通風、裝置前照燈、設置堅固頂蓬、制動裝置、裝設倒車或旋轉之警報裝置或人員偵測警示設備。
explain_en: Article 119: good cab visibility and ventilation, headlights, a sturdy canopy, brakes, and reversing/rotation alarms or personnel-detection warning equipment.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 車輛系營建機械作業有翻落、表土崩塌之虞者，雇主事先決定之事項中，應告知作業勞工者為何？
a_zh: 機械之購買價格及租金
b_zh: 駕駛之薪資及工作年資
c_zh: 行經路線及作業方法
d_zh: 機械之品牌及出廠年份
q_en: When vehicle-type construction machinery may overturn or cause surface collapse, which pre-decided items must be told to workers?
a_en: The purchase price and rental cost
b_en: The driver's salary and seniority
c_en: Travel routes and work methods
d_en: The brand and year of manufacture
explain_zh: 第120條：應事先調查地質、地形，決定機械種類及性能、行經路線、作業方法、整理工作場所，並將第二款（行經路線）及第三款（作業方法）告知作業勞工。
explain_en: Article 120: after surveying geology and terrain, decide machine type/performance, travel routes, work methods and site preparation; routes and methods shall be told to workers.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 車輛系營建機械之修理或附屬裝置安裝、拆卸作業，應指定專人負責何事項？
a_zh: 決定作業順序並指揮作業，惟安全支柱之使用由勞工自行判斷
b_zh: 申請勞動檢查機構派員到場監督，並於作業後函報檢查結果
c_zh: 代為保管機械鑰匙，並於作業完成後填具自動檢查紀錄表件
d_zh: 決定作業順序並指揮作業，監視安全支柱、絞車等之使用狀況
q_en: What must the designated person do during repair of construction vehicles?
a_en: Decide the sequence and direct work, leaving prop use to the workers judgement
b_en: Ask the inspection agency to send an officer and report the result afterwards
c_en: Keep the machine key and fill in the self inspection form once work is done
d_en: Decide the work sequence, direct the work, and watch safety props and winches
explain_zh: 第121條：雇主對於車輛系營建機械之修理或附屬裝置之安裝、拆卸等作業時，應就該作業指定專人負責決定作業順序並指揮作業，及監視於機臂、突樑下作業之勞工所使用安全支柱、絞車等之狀況。
explain_en: Article 121 requires sequencing, direction and monitoring of safety props.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 以自行行駛或牽引拖曳方式將車輛系營建機械裝卸於貨車時，應採何措施？
a_zh: 應以起重機吊掛方式裝卸，不得使用道板、填土或臨時架台方式
b_zh: 應於任何空地為之，道板僅需具足夠長度，斜度由駕駛人自行斟酌
c_zh: 應於平坦堅固地點為之，道板須具足夠長寬強度並穩固固定於適當斜度
d_zh: 應先卸除機械之制動裝置以利滑行，並由二人於兩側徒手扶持之
q_en: What measures apply when loading construction vehicles onto a truck?
a_en: Loading must use a crane; ramps, earth fill and temporary stands are barred
b_en: Any open ground will do; only ramp length matters and the driver judges slope
c_en: Choose flat firm ground; ramps must be long, wide, strong and firmly fixed
d_en: Release the brakes first to help it slide, with two people steadying by hand
explain_zh: 第122條：裝卸時應選擇平坦堅固地點；使用道板應具足夠長度、寬度及強度，並穩固固定於適當之斜度；使用填土或臨時架台時，應確認具足夠寬度、強度並保持適當斜度。
explain_en: Article 122 requires flat firm ground and properly fixed ramps.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 職業安全衛生設施規則第123條之現行條文內容為何？
a_zh: 本條已刪除，目前並無任何規定之內容
b_zh: 規定荷重一公噸以上堆高機應由受訓者操作
c_zh: 規定堆高機托板應無顯著損傷或腐蝕者
d_zh: 規定車輛系營建機械應裝置前照燈具設備
q_en: What does Article 123 of the Rules currently provide?
a_en: The article is deleted and holds no provision at present
b_en: It requires trained operators for forklifts of one tonne or more
c_en: It requires forklift pallets to be free of damage or decay
d_en: It requires construction vehicles to be fitted with headlights
explain_zh: 第123條業經刪除。堆高機托板規定見第125條，一公噸以上堆高機操作人員資格見第126條，前照燈具規定見第119條。

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 堆高機非置備何種裝置者不得使用？
a_zh: 冷氣
b_zh: 音響
c_zh: 倒車雷達
d_zh: 後扶架
q_en: A forklift must not be used unless it is equipped with a:
a_en: Air conditioner
b_en: Sound system
c_en: Reversing radar
d_en: Load backrest
explain_zh: 第124條：堆高機非置備有後扶架者，不得使用。但將桅桿後傾之際，雖有貨物之掉落亦不致危害勞工者，不在此限。
explain_en: Article 124: forklifts without a load backrest shall not be used, unless load falling during mast tilt-back poses no hazard.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 雇主使用堆高機之托板或撬板時，本規則規定應符合何種條件？
a_zh: 具有充分能承受積載貨物重量之強度，且無顯著損傷、變形或腐蝕
b_zh: 應標示製造日期並於使用滿三年後一律汰換，不得繼續使用
c_zh: 應為金屬材質製造，木質托板一律不得使用於任何堆高作業
d_zh: 具有承受積載貨物重量二分之一之強度，輕微變形者仍得使用
q_en: What conditions must forklift pallets or skids meet?
a_en: Strength enough to bear the loaded goods, with no marked damage or decay
b_en: They must show a date of manufacture and be scrapped after three years
c_en: They must be metal; wooden pallets may never be used for stacking work
d_en: Strength of half the loaded weight, and slight deformation is acceptable
explain_zh: 第125條：雇主使用堆高機之托板或撬板時，應具有充分能承受積載之貨物重量之強度，且無顯著之損傷、變形或腐蝕者。第126條並規定一公噸以上堆高機應由受特殊作業安全衛生教育訓練人員操作。
explain_en: Article 125 requires adequate strength and freedom from notable damage.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 荷重在多少公噸以上之堆高機，應指派經特殊作業安全衛生教育訓練人員操作？
a_zh: ○．五公噸
b_zh: 五公噸
c_zh: 三公噸
d_zh: 一公噸
q_en: Forklifts with a load capacity of at least how much must be operated by persons who completed special operation safety training?
a_en: 0.5 tonne
b_en: 5 tonnes
c_en: 3 tonnes
d_en: 1 tonne
explain_zh: 第126條：雇主對於荷重在一公噸以上之堆高機，應指派經特殊作業安全衛生教育訓練人員操作。
explain_en: Article 126: forklifts with a load of 1 tonne or more shall be operated by personnel trained in special operation safety and health.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於堆高機之操作，本規則就荷重與貨物狀態有何規定？
a_zh: 得於短時間內超過最大荷重，惟應由二名勞工在旁協助扶持貨物
b_zh: 不得超過該機械所能承受之最大荷重，且載運貨物應保持穩固防止翻倒
c_zh: 不得超過最大荷重之一點二倍，載運貨物得視現場狀況酌予傾斜
d_zh: 荷重限制由駕駛人員依經驗自行判斷，並於作業後填具紀錄表
q_en: What does the rule require when operating a forklift?
a_en: The load may be exceeded briefly if two workers steady the goods by hand
b_en: Never exceed the maximum load, and keep the goods stable against overturning
c_en: The maximum load may be exceeded by 1.2 times if the goods are tilted
d_en: The driver judges the load limit by experience and records it afterwards
explain_zh: 第127條：雇主對於堆高機之操作，不得超過該機械所能承受之最大荷重，且其載運之貨物應保持穩固狀態，防止翻倒。第125條並就托板與撬板之強度有規定。
explain_en: Article 127 bars exceeding the maximum load and requires stable carriage.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 於危險物存在場所使用堆高機時，本規則規定應如何辦理？
a_zh: 應改以人力搬運方式取代堆高機
b_zh: 應僅限於日間有自然採光時間使用
c_zh: 應先報請勞動檢查機構核准後使用
d_zh: 應有必要之安全衛生設備及措施
q_en: What is required when using a forklift where dangerous substances exist?
a_en: Manual handling must be used instead of a forklift at such places
b_en: Use is limited to daytime hours when natural light is available
c_en: Prior approval from the labor inspection agency must be obtained
d_en: Necessary safety and health equipment and measures must be provided
explain_zh: 第128條：雇主於危險物存在場所使用堆高機時，應有必要之安全衛生設備措施。危險物之種類見第11條至第15條。
explain_en: Article 128 requires necessary safety and health equipment and measures.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 使用高空工作車從事作業時，工作台上之勞工應佩戴何種防護具？
a_zh: 安全帽及全身背負式安全帶
b_zh: 防護面罩及耐衝擊防護手套
c_zh: 安全帽及一般腰帶式安全帶
d_zh: 反光背心及具防滑功能安全鞋
q_en: Workers on the platform of an aerial work platform vehicle shall wear:
a_en: A helmet and a full-body harness
b_en: A face shield and impact-proof gloves
c_en: A helmet and a waist-belt harness
d_en: A reflective vest and non-slip shoes
explain_zh: 第128條之1第7款：應使工作台上之勞工佩戴安全帽及符合CNS 14253-1同等以上規定之全身背負式安全帶。另應訂定作業計畫、外伸撐座完全伸出、不得超過積載荷重。
explain_en: Article 128-1(7): a helmet and a full-body harness meeting CNS 14253-1; also a work plan, fully extended outriggers, and no overloading.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 為防止高空工作車翻倒或翻落，除行駛於道路上外，其外伸撐座應如何？
a_zh: 完全收起，以節省作業所需之空間
b_zh: 伸出二分之一，並以木板墊高支撐
c_zh: 完全伸出，並防止地盤不均勻沉陷
d_zh: 依駕駛人員之習慣及現場狀況調整
q_en: To prevent an aerial work platform vehicle from overturning (other than when driving on roads), its outriggers shall be:
a_en: Fully retracted, to save the space needed for the work
b_en: Extended halfway, with wooden planks used as packing blocks
c_en: Fully extended, with measures against uneven ground settlement
d_en: Adjusted to suit the driver's habits and site conditions
explain_zh: 第128條之1第2款：應將其外伸撐座完全伸出，並採取防止地盤不均勻沉陷、路肩崩塌等必要措施。但具有多段伸出之外伸撐座者，得依原廠設計之允許外伸長度作業。
explain_en: Article 128-1(2): outriggers shall be fully extended with measures against uneven settlement or shoulder collapse; multi-stage outriggers may follow the manufacturer's allowed extension.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 高空工作車之駕駛離開駕駛座時（工作台無人作業），應採取何種措施？
a_zh: 使原動機保持高轉速運轉，以維持油壓穩定
b_zh: 將工作台保持於原作業高度，以利後續作業
c_zh: 將工作台下降至最低位置，並採取預防逸走措施
d_zh: 僅需拔出鑰匙離開，其餘不須採取任何措施
q_en: When the driver of an aerial work platform vehicle leaves the seat (no one on the platform), the driver shall:
a_en: Keep the engine running at high speed to maintain stable hydraulic oil pressure
b_en: Keep the platform at the working height so the next task can continue smoothly
c_en: Lower the platform to its lowest position and prevent runaway (engine off, brake applied)
d_en: Simply take out the ignition key and leave; no other measures are required at all
explain_zh: 第128條之2：駕駛離開駕駛座時應將工作台下降至最低位置，並採取停止原動機、確實使用制動裝置等預防逸走措施。但有勞工在工作台作業時不在此限。
explain_en: Article 128-2: lower the platform to the lowest position, stop the engine and apply the brake to prevent runaway, except when workers are on the platform.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 以自行行駛或牽引拖曳方式運送高空工作車並裝卸於貨車時，應採何措施？
a_zh: 應選擇任何空曠地點，道板僅需具足夠寬度，斜度由駕駛人自行決定
b_zh: 應一律以起重機吊掛裝卸，不得使用道板、填土或臨時架台等方式
c_zh: 應先將工作台升至最高位置以減輕前軸荷重，再緩慢駛上貨車車台
d_zh: 應選擇平坦堅固地點，道板須具足夠長度、寬度及強度並穩固固定於適當斜度
q_en: What measures apply when loading a mobile elevating work platform onto a truck?
a_en: Choose any open ground; only ramp width matters and the driver decides the slope
b_en: Always load by crane; ramps, earth fill and temporary stands are prohibited
c_en: Raise the work platform to its highest position first and then drive slowly on
d_en: Choose flat firm ground; ramps must have enough length, width and strength and be fixed
explain_zh: 第128條之3：裝卸時應選擇平坦堅固地點；使用道板應具足夠長度、寬度及強度，並穩固固定於適當之斜度；使用填土或臨時架台時應確認具足夠寬度、強度並保持適當斜度。
explain_en: Article 128-3 mirrors Article 122 for construction vehicles.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 使勞工從事高空工作車之修理、工作台之裝設或拆卸作業時，應如何辦理？
a_zh: 應報請原製造廠商派員到場監督，事業單位人員不得自行執行作業
b_zh: 應由駕駛人員兼任監督，並於作業完成後填具自動檢查紀錄表備查
c_zh: 應指定專人監督，惟安全支柱與安全塊之使用由勞工自行決定是否採用
d_zh: 應指定專人監督，決定作業步驟並指揮作業，監視安全支柱、安全塊之使用狀況
q_en: What applies to repairing or fitting the platform of an aerial work vehicle?
a_en: The original maker must send staff; the enterprise may not do the work itself
b_en: The driver may double as supervisor and file a self inspection record after
c_en: A designated supervisor is needed, but workers decide whether to use props
d_en: A designated supervisor decides the steps, directs work and watches props and blocks
explain_zh: 第128條之4：雇主使勞工從事高空工作車之修理、工作台之裝設或拆卸作業時，應指定專人監督該項作業，並執行決定作業步驟並指揮作業、監視作業中安全支柱與安全塊使用狀況等事項。
explain_en: Article 128-4 requires a designated supervisor to direct work and monitor safety props.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 使勞工於高空工作車升起之伸臂等下方從事修理、檢點作業時，應如何辦理？
a_zh: 應指派勞工二人一組，其中一人於駕駛座持續按住操作桿固定
b_zh: 應使勞工佩戴安全帽及全身背負式安全帶，即得於伸臂下方作業
c_zh: 應將伸臂維持於升起狀態並以繩索綁縛於鄰近之固定結構物上
d_zh: 應使從事該作業之勞工使用安全支柱、安全塊等，防止伸臂意外落下
q_en: What is required for work under the raised boom of an aerial work vehicle?
a_en: Two workers must work as a pair, one holding the control lever down
b_en: Workers wearing a helmet and full body harness may work under the boom
c_en: The boom is kept raised and tied with rope to a nearby fixed structure
d_en: Workers must use safety props or safety blocks to stop the boom falling
explain_zh: 第128條之5：雇主使勞工於高空工作車升起之伸臂等下方從事修理、檢點等作業時，應使從事該作業勞工使用安全支柱、安全塊等，以防止伸臂等之意外落下致危害勞工。
explain_en: Article 128-5 requires safety props or blocks against accidental boom descent.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 無工作台操作行駛構造之高空工作車行駛時，勞工搭載於工作台上之限制為何？
a_zh: 原則不得搭載；於平坦堅固場所並規定信號、指定引導人員及適當速率者除外
b_zh: 得於行駛速率每小時五公里以下時搭載，並免設引導人員及信號
c_zh: 原則不得搭載；惟經現場作業主管口頭同意並在旁監督者即得搭載
d_zh: 得自由搭載，惟應使勞工佩戴安全帶並將另一端固定於工作台上
q_en: May workers ride on the platform while such a vehicle travels?
a_en: Not in principle; allowed on flat firm ground with signals, a guide and set speed
b_en: Allowed below five kilometres an hour, with no guide or signals needed
c_en: Not in principle; allowed once the site supervisor verbally agrees and watches
d_en: Freely allowed provided a harness is worn and anchored to the work platform
explain_zh: 第128條之6：除有工作台可操作行駛構造之高空工作車外，不得使勞工搭載於工作台上；但使其行駛於平坦堅固之場所，並規定一定信號、指定引導人員依信號引導，及事先規定適當速率並使駕駛依速率行駛者，不在此限。
explain_en: Article 128-6 permits riding only on flat firm ground with signals, a guide and a set speed.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 有工作台可操作行駛構造之高空工作車，於平坦堅固場所以外行駛時應採何措施？
a_zh: 應規定一定信號並指定引導人員，且事先依工作台高度、地盤狀態規定適當速率
b_zh: 應先將工作台下降至最低位置，即得免設引導人員及信號等措施
c_zh: 應規定一定信號並指定引導人員，速率則由工作台上之勞工隨時指示
d_zh: 應僅由駕駛人員於駕駛座操作行駛，工作台上不得有任何之操作
q_en: What applies when a platform driven vehicle travels off flat firm ground?
a_en: Set signals, assign a guide, and fix a speed from platform height and ground state
b_en: Lower the platform fully, after which signals and a guide are not needed
c_en: Set signals and assign a guide, with the platform worker calling the speed
d_en: Only the driver in the cab may drive; the platform controls may not be used
explain_zh: 第128條之7：有工作台可操作行駛構造者，於平坦堅固場所以外行駛時，應規定一定之信號並指定引導人員依信號引導；並於作業前依工作台高度、伸臂長度、作業場所地形及地盤狀態等規定適當速率，使駕駛人員依該速率行駛。
explain_en: Article 128-7 requires signals, a guide and a pre set travel speed.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 高空工作車之構造所應符合之標準，如國家標準與國際標準不一致時，以何者為準？
a_zh: 以國家標準CNS16368、CNS16653系列、CNS18893規定為準
b_zh: 以原製造廠商設計規範及使用說明書所載規定內容為準者
c_zh: 以國際標準ISO16368、ISO16653系列、ISO18893之規定為準
d_zh: 以中央主管機關個案指定或事業單位自行選擇者為準者
q_en: Where national and international standards differ, which prevails?
a_en: The national standards CNS 16368, CNS 16653 series and CNS 18893 prevail
b_en: The makers own design specification and operating manual prevail instead
c_en: The international standards ISO 16368, ISO 16653 series and ISO 18893 prevail
d_en: Case by case designation by the authority or the employers own choice
explain_zh: 第128條之8：高空工作車構造應符合CNS 14965、CNS 16368、CNS 16653系列、CNS 18893及ISO 16368、ISO 16653系列、ISO 18893等標準；國家標準與國際標準有不一致者，以國際標準ISO之規定為準。
explain_en: Article 128-8: the ISO standards prevail over the CNS versions.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 高空工作車應指派何種人員操作？
a_zh: 由承攬商依現場需要任意指派之人員
b_zh: 經特殊作業安全衛生教育訓練人員
c_zh: 領有小型車以上汽車駕駛執照之人員
d_zh: 在該公司服務三年以上之資深員工
q_en: Aerial work platform vehicles shall be operated by:
a_en: Anyone the contractor assigns as the site requires
b_en: Personnel trained in special operation safety and health
c_en: Anyone holding a valid car driver's licence or above
d_en: Senior employees with three or more years of service
explain_zh: 第128條之9：雇主對於高空工作車，應指派經特殊作業安全衛生教育訓練人員操作。
explain_en: Article 128-9: the employer shall assign personnel who completed special operation safety and health training.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於軌道機械，本規則就信號有何規定？
a_zh: 應設置號誌燈並每三個月委外檢測其亮度一次以上
b_zh: 應設有適當信號裝置，並於事先通知有關勞工週知
c_zh: 應由駕駛人員以手勢示意，得免設置任何信號裝置
d_zh: 應設有適當信號裝置，惟得於事後再通知有關勞工
q_en: What does the rule require for signals on track machines?
a_en: Signal lamps must be installed and their brightness tested quarterly
b_en: Suitable signal devices must be provided and workers told of them beforehand
c_en: The driver may use hand gestures and no signal device is then needed
d_en: Suitable signal devices are required, and workers may be told afterwards
explain_zh: 第129條：雇主對於軌道機械，應設有適當信號裝置，並於事先通知有關勞工週知。第130條並規定連結軌道機械車輛應使用適當連結裝置。
explain_en: Article 129 requires signal devices and prior notification to workers.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於連結軌道機械車輛時，本規則規定應如何辦理？
a_zh: 應先斷電並派專人監視
b_zh: 應由二名勞工在旁扶持
c_zh: 應以鋼索捆綁二圈以上
d_zh: 應使用適當之連結裝置
q_en: What is required when coupling track machine vehicles?
a_en: Power must be cut and a watcher assigned
b_en: Two workers must steady it by hand
c_en: Wire rope wound at least twice is enough
d_en: A suitable coupling device must be used
explain_zh: 第130條：雇主對於連結軌道機械車輛時，應使用適當連結裝置。第144條並規定車輛與車輛之連結應有確實之連接裝置。
explain_en: Article 130 requires a suitable coupling device.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 動力車車輛重量在十五公噸以上者，其鋼軌每公尺重量應在多少以上？
a_zh: 二十二公斤
b_zh: 三十公斤者
c_zh: 十二公斤者
d_zh: 十五公斤者
q_en: For a power car of 15 tonnes or more, what rail weight per metre applies?
a_en: 22 kilograms or more
b_en: 30 kilograms or more
c_en: 12 kilograms or more
d_en: 15 kilograms or more
explain_zh: 第131條附表：車輛未滿五公噸者鋼軌每公尺九公斤以上；五至未滿十公噸者十二公斤以上；十至未滿十五公噸者十五公斤以上；十五公噸以上者二十二公斤以上。
explain_en: Article 131: 22 kg per metre for vehicles of 15 tonnes and above.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 動力車鋼軌之舖設，就軌道坡度本規則規定為何？
a_zh: 應保持在千分之五十以下，且不得因任何設備而放寬其坡度之限制
b_zh: 應保持在千分之六十五以下；備有自動空氣煞車者得放寬至千分之八十
c_zh: 應保持在千分之三十以下；備有自動空氣煞車者得放寬至千分之五十
d_zh: 應保持在千分之五十以下；備有自動空氣煞車者得放寬至千分之六十五以下
q_en: What gradient limit applies to power car track?
a_en: 50 per thousand or less, with no relaxation permitted by any equipment
b_en: 65 per thousand or less; up to 80 per thousand with automatic air brakes
c_en: 30 per thousand or less; up to 50 per thousand with automatic air brakes
d_en: 50 per thousand or less; up to 65 per thousand with automatic air brakes
explain_zh: 第132條：鋼軌接頭應使用魚尾板或採熔接固定；舖設應以道釘、金屬固定具固定於枕木或水泥路基；軌道坡度應保持在千分之五十以下，但動力車備有自動空氣煞車之軌道得放寬至千分之六十五以下。
explain_en: Article 132: 50 per thousand, relaxed to 65 where automatic air brakes exist.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 動力車軌道路基，於車輛重量在五公噸以上者應如何構築？
a_zh: 應由砂土回填構成，並每年辦理一次路基沉陷量之測量
b_zh: 應由夯實黏土構成，並於表面鋪設瀝青以避免雨水入滲
c_zh: 應由礫石、碎石等構成，並應有充分之保固與良好排水系統
d_zh: 應由混凝土整體澆置構成，並免設任何排水系統之設施
q_en: How must the track bed be built where vehicles weigh five tonnes or more?
a_en: Of backfilled sand, with settlement measured once every year
b_en: Of compacted clay surfaced with asphalt to keep rainwater from soaking in
c_en: Of gravel or crushed stone, with ample consolidation and good drainage
d_en: Of monolithic poured concrete, with no drainage system being required
explain_zh: 第133條：車輛在五公噸以上者，其軌道路基除應由礫石、碎石等構成外，並應有充分之保固與良好排水系統；其他軌道路基則應注意鋼軌舖設及車輛行駛安全狀況。
explain_en: Article 133 requires gravel or crushed stone with drainage for heavier vehicles.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 動力車軌道之曲線部分，本規則規定為何？
a_zh: 曲率半徑應在五公尺以上，保持適度之軌道超高，並免裝置任何護軌
b_zh: 曲率半徑應在十公尺以上，保持適度之軌道超高及加寬，並裝置適當護軌
c_zh: 曲率半徑應在二十公尺以上，且不得為軌道之超高或加寬等處理
d_zh: 曲率半徑由現場依地形決定，僅需於曲線起點設置警告標誌即可
q_en: What applies to curved sections of power car track?
a_en: Radius of 5 metres or more with suitable cant, and no guard rails needed
b_en: Radius of 10 metres or more, suitable cant and widening, and proper guard rails
c_en: Radius of 20 metres or more, with no cant or widening being permitted
d_en: The radius is set on site by terrain, needing only a sign at the curve
explain_zh: 第134條：動力車軌道之曲線部分，曲率半徑應在十公尺以上；保持適度之軌道超高及加寬；並裝置適當之護軌。手推車輛軌道之曲率半徑則為五公尺以上（第138條）。
explain_en: Article 134: minimum radius ten metres, with cant, widening and guard rails.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於動力車軌道之岔道部分及軌道終端，本規則規定應設置何者？
a_zh: 岔道應設置號誌燈及監視人員，軌道終端應設置緩衝用之砂堆者
b_zh: 岔道應設轉轍器及轍鎖，軌道終端則以標誌杆或警告標示替代即可
c_zh: 岔道應設具充分效能之轉轍器及轍鎖，終端應設充分效能之擋車裝置
d_zh: 岔道與終端均由駕駛人員以人工操作，得免設任何固定安全裝置
q_en: What must be provided at track turnouts and at the track end?
a_en: Signal lamps and a watcher at turnouts, and a sand mound at the track end
b_en: Switches and locks at turnouts, with a post or warning sign at the track end
c_en: Effective point switches and point locks at turnouts, and an effective buffer stop
d_en: Manual operation by the driver, with no fixed safety devices required
explain_zh: 第135條：雇主對於動力車軌道岔道部分，應設置具有充分效能之轉轍器及轍鎖；軌道之終端應設置充分效能之擋車裝置。
explain_en: Article 135 requires switches with locks and an effective stop block.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 車輛於軌道上有滑走之虞時，本規則規定應如何辦理？
a_zh: 應於每次停車後拆除車輪
b_zh: 應派專人於車旁全程監視
c_zh: 應設置防止滑走之裝置
d_zh: 應於軌道兩側鋪設止滑砂
q_en: What is required where vehicles may run away on the track?
a_en: The wheels must be removed after stopping
b_en: A watcher must stand beside the vehicle
c_en: An anti runaway device must be installed
d_en: Anti slip sand must be laid along the rails
explain_zh: 第136條：雇主對於車輛於軌道上有滑走之虞時，應設置防止滑走之裝置。第149條並規定駕駛離開駕駛位置時應採煞車等措施防止車輛逸走。
explain_en: Article 136 requires a device preventing the vehicle from sliding away.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 隧道坑井內部裝置軌道時，其側壁與行走之車輛應保持多少以上淨距？
a_zh: 九十公分
b_zh: 三十公分
c_zh: 六十公分
d_zh: 一百公分
q_en: What clearance is required between tunnel walls and passing vehicles?
a_en: 90 centimetres or more
b_en: 30 centimetres or more
c_en: 60 centimetres or more
d_en: 100 centimetres or more
explain_zh: 第137條：隧道坑井內部裝置軌道時，側壁與行走之車輛應保持六十公分以上淨距；但於適當間隔設置相當寬度之避車設備並有顯明標示，或設置信號裝置或配置監視人員者，不在此限。
explain_en: Article 137: sixty centimetres, subject to the listed exceptions.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於手推車輛之軌道，下列規定何者正確？
a_zh: 曲率半徑應在十公尺以上，傾斜應在十分之一以下，鋼軌每公尺九公斤以上
b_zh: 曲率半徑應在五公尺以上，傾斜應在十五分之一以下，鋼軌每公尺六公斤以上
c_zh: 曲率半徑應在三公尺以上，傾斜應在五分之一以下，鋼軌每公尺四公斤以上
d_zh: 曲率半徑不予限制，傾斜應在十五分之一以下，鋼軌每公尺十公斤以上
q_en: Which requirement applies to handcart tracks?
a_en: Radius 10 m or more, gradient 1 in 10 or less, rail at least 9 kg per metre
b_en: Radius 5 m or more, gradient 1 in 15 or less, rail at least 6 kg per metre
c_en: Radius 3 m or more, gradient 1 in 5 or less, rail at least 4 kg per metre
d_en: No radius limit, gradient 1 in 15 or less, rail at least 10 kg per metre
explain_zh: 第138條：手推車輛軌道之曲率半徑應在五公尺以上；傾斜應在十五分之一以下；鋼軌每公尺重量應在六公斤以上；置直徑九公分以上之枕木並適當間隔配置；鋼軌接頭應使用魚尾板或熔接固定。
explain_en: Article 138 sets radius, gradient, rail weight and sleeper requirements.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於軌道沿線應採取之措施，下列何者符合本規則規定？
a_zh: 軌道兩旁之危險立木得予保留，僅需於樹幹漆設反光標記即可
b_zh: 工作人員經常出入之橋梁，應另行設置行人安全道，橋梁過長時應設置平台
c_zh: 軌道附近得任意堆放施工物品，惟應與軌道保持三十公分距離
d_zh: 橋梁長度不予限制，且無須就行人與車輛之通行加以區隔設置
q_en: Which measure along the track line complies with the rule?
a_en: Dangerous standing trees may remain if their trunks carry reflective marks
b_en: Bridges used often by workers need a separate walkway; long bridges need platforms
c_en: Materials may be stacked near the track if kept thirty centimetres away
d_en: Bridge length is unrestricted and pedestrians need not be separated
explain_zh: 第139條：軌道兩旁之危險立木應予清除；軌道上方及兩旁與鄰近建築物應留適當距離；軌道附近不得任意堆放物品，邊坑上不得有危石；橋梁過長時應設置平台等；工作人員經常出入之橋梁，應另行設置行人安全道。
explain_en: Article 139 requires clearing dangerous trees and a separate pedestrian way on bridges.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 下列何者屬本規則第140條所定軌道沿線環境應實施之保養事項？
a_zh: 清除路肩及橋梁附近之叢草，並清除妨害視距之草木
b_zh: 於每年汛期前後各實施一次軌道之全線非破壞性檢測
c_zh: 於軌道兩旁每五十公尺設置一處消防栓及滅火器材
d_zh: 於軌道沿線裝設監視攝影機並保存影像紀錄三年以上
q_en: Which item is listed as maintenance along the track line?
a_en: Clearing weeds on shoulders and near bridges, and brush blocking sight lines
b_en: Non destructive testing of the whole line before and after each flood season
c_en: Placing a hydrant and fire equipment every fifty metres along the track
d_en: Fitting cameras along the line and keeping the footage for three years
explain_zh: 第140條列舉十款保養事項，包括清除路肩及橋梁附近叢草、清除妨害視距之草木、維護橋梁及隧道支架結構、清掃坍方與邊坡危石、維護鋼軌接頭道釘、號誌標示、軌距、排水系統及枕木狀況良好。
explain_en: Article 140 lists ten maintenance items including weed and brush clearance.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對行駛於軌道之動力車，下列設備規定何者正確？
a_zh: 使用內燃機者應設避雷器；使用電動機者應設潤滑油壓力之指示器者
b_zh: 汽笛、警鈴等信號裝備得以駕駛人員之口哨或手勢示意代替設置
c_zh: 於夜間或地下使用者得免設前照燈，惟應由引導人員持手電筒引導
d_zh: 使用內燃機者應設標示潤滑油壓力之指示器；使用電動機者應置備自動遮斷器
q_en: Which equipment rule applies to power cars running on tracks?
a_en: Combustion engines need lightning arresters; electric ones need oil gauges
b_en: Whistles and bells may be replaced by the drivers own whistle or gestures
c_en: Headlights may be omitted at night if a guide carries a hand torch instead
d_en: Combustion engines need an oil pressure gauge; electric ones need auto breakers
explain_zh: 第141條：行駛於軌道之動力車應設置汽笛、警鈴等信號裝備；夜間或地下使用者應設前照燈及駕駛室照明；使用內燃機者應設標示潤滑油壓力之指示器；使用電動機者應置備自動遮斷器，高架式者並應增置避雷器。
explain_en: Article 141 lists signalling, lighting, oil pressure gauge and automatic breaker.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對行駛於軌道之動力車車輪，下列規定何者正確？
a_zh: 輪緣厚度得低於原設計之半數，惟應每月測量其磨耗量一次
b_zh: 輪緣高度得低於脫軌高度，惟應搭配設置防止脫軌之護輪軌
c_zh: 車輪踏面寬度於輪緣最大磨耗狀態下，仍能通過最大軌間之寬度
d_zh: 車輪踏面寬度於輪緣全新狀態下能通過最小軌間即為已足者
q_en: Which requirement applies to the wheels of a track power car?
a_en: The flange may wear to half its design thickness if measured every month
b_en: The flange may sit below derailment height if guard rails are also fitted
c_en: The tread width must pass the widest gauge even at maximum flange wear
d_en: The tread width need only pass the narrowest gauge when the flange is new
explain_zh: 第142條：車輪之踏面寬度於輪緣最大磨耗狀態下，仍能通過最大軌間；輪緣之厚度於最大磨耗狀態下仍具充分強度且不阻礙通過岔道；輪緣應保持不脫軌以上之高度，且不致觸及魚尾板。
explain_en: Article 142 sets tread width, flange thickness and flange height requirements.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對行駛於軌道之載人車輛，下列規定何者正確？
a_zh: 使用於傾斜度超過十五度之軌道者，始應設預防脫軌裝置
b_zh: 載人車輛得與載貨車輛共用，不以設置載人專車為原則者
c_zh: 藉捲揚裝置於傾斜軌道使用者，得免設與操作者連繫設備
d_zh: 使用於傾斜度超過三十度之軌道者，應設有預防脫軌之裝置
q_en: Which requirement applies to passenger carrying track vehicles?
a_en: Vehicles used on gradients over fifteen degrees need such devices instead
b_en: Passenger and goods vehicles may be shared, with no dedicated car needed
c_en: Winch hauled cars on inclines need no link with the winch operator
d_en: Vehicles used on gradients over thirty degrees need anti derailment devices
explain_zh: 第143條：載人車輛以設置載人專車為原則；應設座位、把手、上下車門及安全門、限制乘坐人數標示與防止摔落設施；藉捲揚裝置於傾斜軌道使用者應設搭乘人員與捲揚機操作者連繫之設備；傾斜度超過三十度者應設預防脫軌裝置；並應設緊急停車裝置。
explain_en: Article 143 lists nine requirements including anti derailment above thirty degrees.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 藉捲揚裝置行駛之軌道車輛，其捲揚鋼索安全係數，載貨者與載人者分別應在多少以上？
a_zh: 載貨四、載人六
b_zh: 載貨六、載人十
c_zh: 載貨十、載人十五
d_zh: 載貨三、載人五
q_en: For rail vehicles hauled by a winch, the wire rope safety factor for cargo and for passengers shall be at least:
a_en: 4 for cargo, 6 for passengers
b_en: 6 for cargo, 10 for passengers
c_en: 10 for cargo, 15 for passengers
d_en: 3 for cargo, 5 for passengers
explain_zh: 第144條第2款：捲揚鋼索之斷裂荷重與所承受最大荷重比之安全係數，載貨者應在六以上，載人者應在十以上。
explain_en: Article 144(2): safety factor at least 6 for cargo vehicles and at least 10 for passenger vehicles.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對行駛於軌道之動力車，本規則就煞車設備有何規定？
a_zh: 應設置手煞車，十公噸以上者應增設動力煞車
b_zh: 應設置手煞車，五公噸以上者增設動力煞車者
c_zh: 應設置動力煞車，十公噸以下者得僅設手煞車
d_zh: 應設置手煞車或動力煞車其中之一即為已足者
q_en: What braking is required on track power cars?
a_en: A hand brake; those of ten tonnes or more also need a power brake
b_en: A hand brake; those of five tonnes or more also need a power brake
c_en: A power brake; those under ten tonnes may have a hand brake only
d_en: Either a hand brake or a power brake alone is sufficient
explain_zh: 第145條：雇主對行駛於軌道之動力車，應設置手煞車，十公噸以上者，應增設動力煞車。第146條並規定制輪壓力比之要求。
explain_en: Article 145: hand brake always, plus power brake from ten tonnes.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 軌道車輛煞車制輪之壓力與制動車輪施予軌道壓力之比，本規則規定為何？
a_zh: 動力煞車者應為百分之二十以上、百分之五十以下；手煞車者百分之十以上
b_zh: 動力煞車與手煞車均應為百分之五十以上、百分之七十五以下者為原則
c_zh: 動力煞車者應為百分之五十以上、百分之七十五以下；手煞車者百分之二十以上
d_zh: 動力煞車者應為百分之七十五以上、百分之九十以下；手煞車者百分之五十
q_en: What brake shoe pressure ratio does the rule require?
a_en: Power brakes 20 to 50 percent; hand brakes 10 percent or more
b_en: Both power and hand brakes are to be 50 to 75 percent as a rule
c_en: Power brakes 50 to 75 percent; hand brakes 20 percent or more
d_en: Power brakes 75 to 90 percent; hand brakes 50 percent or more
explain_zh: 第146條：煞車制輪之壓力與制動車輪施予軌道壓力之比，在動力煞車者應為百分之五十以上、百分之七十五以下；手煞車者應為百分之二十以上。
explain_en: Article 146: 50 to 75 percent for power brakes, at least 20 percent for hand brakes.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對行駛於軌道之動力車駕駛座，本規則規定為何？
a_zh: 應設置空調設備與隔音玻璃，並標示最高行駛速率限制
b_zh: 應具良好視野之構造，並為防止駕駛者跌落設置護圍等
c_zh: 應設置行車紀錄器並保存行車紀錄一年以上以供查核用
d_zh: 應具良好視野之構造，惟得免設任何防止跌落之設施者
q_en: What does the rule require of a track power car driving position?
a_en: Air conditioning and sound proof glass, with the speed limit displayed
b_en: Good visibility for safe driving, plus guarding to stop the driver falling
c_en: A journey recorder whose records are kept for at least one year
d_en: Good visibility for safe driving, with no fall protection being required
explain_zh: 第147條：動力車駕駛座應具備使駕駛者能安全駕駛之良好視野之構造；為防止駕駛者之跌落，應設置護圍等。
explain_en: Article 147 requires good visibility and fall protection guarding.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於軌道車輛之行駛速率限制，本規則規定應依何者決定？
a_zh: 應依車輛之出廠年份與累計行駛里程數決定並公告週知
b_zh: 應依駕駛人員之年資與訓練時數分級決定其得行駛速率
c_zh: 應由勞動檢查機構於檢查時個案核定並記載於檢查結果
d_zh: 應依鋼軌、軌距、傾斜、曲率半徑等決定，並規定駕駛者遵守
q_en: How must speed limits for track vehicles be determined?
a_en: From the year of manufacture and the accumulated mileage of the vehicle
b_en: By grading drivers according to their seniority and training hours
c_en: By case approval of the labor inspection agency during an inspection
d_en: From the rail, gauge, gradient and curve radius, and drivers must comply
explain_zh: 第148條：雇主對於軌道車輛之行駛，應依鋼軌、軌距、傾斜、曲率半徑等決定速率限制，並規定駕駛者遵守之。第150條並就軌道手推車之下坡速率定為每小時十五公里。
explain_en: Article 148 bases the limit on track conditions.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於駕駛動力車者及操作捲揚裝置者，本規則分別有何規定？
a_zh: 駕駛離開位置時應採煞車等措施防止逸走；操作捲揚裝置者操作時不得離開位置
b_zh: 駕駛離開位置時應採煞車等措施防止逸走；操作捲揚裝置者得短暫離開位置
c_zh: 駕駛與操作捲揚裝置者均得於作業中暫離，惟應指定他人在旁看守機具
d_zh: 駕駛離開位置時得僅將原動機熄火；操作捲揚裝置者應全程留在操作位置
q_en: What applies to power car drivers and to winch operators?
a_en: Drivers must brake against runaway when leaving; winch operators may not leave
b_en: Drivers must brake against runaway; winch operators may leave for a short time
c_en: Both may leave briefly during work if another person watches the machine
d_en: Drivers need only switch off the engine; winch operators must stay throughout
explain_zh: 第149條：對於駕駛動力車者，應規定其離開駕駛位置時採取煞車等措施，以防止車輛逸走；對於操作捲揚裝置者，應規定其於操作時不得離開操作位置。
explain_en: Article 149 bars winch operators from leaving the operating position.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 軌道手推車於下坡行駛時，車輛間應保持多少公尺以上間距？速率不得超過每小時幾公里？
a_zh: 六公尺；十公里
b_zh: 十公尺；二十公里
c_zh: 三十公尺；五公里
d_zh: 二十公尺；十五公里
q_en: Rail handcarts travelling downhill shall keep what spacing, and not exceed what speed?
a_en: 6 m; 10 km/h
b_en: 10 m; 20 km/h
c_en: 30 m; 5 km/h
d_en: 20 m; 15 km/h
explain_zh: 第150條：車輛於上坡或水平行駛時應保持六公尺以上間距，下坡行駛時應保持二十公尺以上間距；下坡速率不得超過每小時十五公里。
explain_en: Article 150: at least 6 m spacing on level or uphill, 20 m downhill; downhill speed not over 15 km/h.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於傾斜達多少以上之軌道區使用之手推車，應設置有效之煞車？
a_zh: 千分之二十
b_zh: 千分之十
c_zh: 千分之五十
d_zh: 千分之一百
q_en: From what gradient must handcarts on track have effective brakes?
a_en: 20 per thousand
b_en: 10 per thousand
c_en: 50 per thousand
d_en: 100 per thousand
explain_zh: 第151條：雇主對於傾斜在千分之十以上之軌道區使用之手推車，應設置有效之煞車。第150條並規定下坡行駛間距二十公尺以上、速率每小時十五公里以下。
explain_en: Article 151: brakes are required from a gradient of 10 per thousand.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 物料搬運、處置如以車輛機械作業時，本規則規定應如何事先辦理？
a_zh: 應事先實施勞工體能檢測，並依檢測結果分配搬運工作
b_zh: 應事先清除其通道、碼頭等之阻礙物，並採取必要措施
c_zh: 應事先報請勞動檢查機構備查，並於現場張貼核准文件
d_zh: 應事先量測物料之重量與體積，並填具搬運計畫書備查
q_en: What must be done first when handling materials with vehicle machines?
a_en: Workers must be fitness tested and assigned work by the test results
b_en: Obstacles on passages and wharves must be cleared and measures taken
c_en: The inspection agency must be notified and the approval posted on site
d_en: The weight and volume must be measured and a handling plan filed
explain_zh: 第152條：物料搬運、處置，如以車輛機械作業時，應事先清除其通道、碼頭等之阻礙物及採取必要措施。第153條並規定防止倒塌崩塌之必要設施。
explain_en: Article 152 requires clearing obstacles from passages and wharves in advance.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 為防止搬運、堆放或處置物料時之倒塌、崩塌或掉落，應採取何種措施？
a_zh: 應於物料周圍漆設警示標線並設置照明，即得免除其他之設施
b_zh: 應由現場作業主管每日檢點一次，並將檢點結果登載於紀錄表
c_zh: 繩索捆綁或護網擇一設置即可，並得由無關人員自由通行該場所
d_zh: 繩索捆綁、護網、擋樁、限制高度或變更堆積等必要設施，並禁止無關人員進入
q_en: What measures prevent stored materials from collapsing or falling?
a_en: Painted warning lines and lighting around the material are enough by themselves
b_en: A daily check by the site supervisor recorded on an inspection form
c_en: Either roping or nets alone suffices, and other persons may pass freely
d_en: Roping, nets, stop piles, height limits or restacking, and barring unrelated persons
explain_zh: 第153條：雇主對於搬運、堆放或處置物料，為防止倒塌、崩塌或掉落，應採取繩索捆綁、護網、擋樁、限制高度或變更堆積等必要設施，並禁止與作業無關人員進入該等場所。
explain_en: Article 153 lists the measures and bars entry by unrelated persons.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 使勞工進入供儲存大量物料之槽桶時，下列何者為正確作法？
a_zh: 為節省時間直接進入，作業完成後再測定濃度，並補填紀錄
b_zh: 事先測定確認無爆炸、中毒及缺氧危險，佩掛安全帶，進口處派人監視
c_zh: 僅佩戴防塵口罩即可進入，不必測定氣體濃度，也不需監視人員
d_zh: 由槽桶下方開口進入，測定後即可免佩安全帶，無須派人監視
q_en: When workers enter a tank storing large quantities of material, the correct practice is:
a_en: Enter directly to save time and measure the explosion and oxygen levels afterwards, then record the results
b_en: Test in advance for explosion, poisoning and oxygen deficiency, wear a harness, and post a watcher at the entrance
c_en: Wear a dust mask only, with no need to measure the gas concentration and no watcher posted at the entrance
d_en: Enter through the bottom opening after testing, with no harness required, and no watcher at the entrance
explain_zh: 第154條：應事先測定並確認無爆炸、中毒及缺氧等危險；使勞工佩掛安全帶及安全索；於進口處派人監視以備營救；規定以由槽桶上方進入為原則。
explain_en: Article 154: test and confirm no explosion, poisoning or oxygen-deficiency hazard; wear a harness and lifeline; station a watcher at the entrance; enter from the top as a rule.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 依設施規則第155條，多少公斤以上物品以人力車輛或工具搬運為原則？多少公斤以上以機動車輛或其他機械搬運為宜？
a_zh: 十公斤；五十公斤
b_zh: 六十公斤；一千公斤
c_zh: 四十公斤；五百公斤
d_zh: 二十公斤；一百公斤
q_en: Under Article 155, items of what weight should be moved with hand carts or tools, and what weight with powered vehicles or machinery?
a_en: 10 kg; 50 kg
c_en: 40 kg; 500 kg
d_en: 20 kg; 100 kg
explain_zh: 第155條：物料之搬運應儘量利用機械以代替人力，凡四十公斤以上物品以人力車輛或工具搬運為原則，五百公斤以上物品以機動車輛或其他機械搬運為宜。
explain_en: Article 155: items of 40 kg or more should be moved by hand carts or tools; 500 kg or more by powered vehicles or other machinery.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 以捲揚機等吊運物料時，下列何者正確？
a_zh: 得於電力線正下方吊運物料；由搭乘人員兼任指揮；無須專人監督
b_zh: 吊鉤無須防止脫落裝置；人員可於吊掛物下方通行；不需信號人員
c_zh: 人員得隨吊掛物搭乘上下；免設防止過捲裝置；由操作者自行判斷
d_zh: 不得供人員搭乘、吊升或降落；應設防止過捲裝置；設置信號指揮人員
q_en: When hoisting materials with a winch, which is correct?
a_en: Hoisting directly under power lines is allowed; the rider also signals; no supervision needed
b_en: Hooks need no anti-slip device; persons may pass under the load; no signal person is required
c_en: Persons may ride up and down with the load; no over-hoist prevention device; the operator decides
d_en: No riding, lifting or lowering of persons; an over-hoist prevention device; a signal person
explain_zh: 第155條之1：不得供人員搭乘、吊升或降落（臨時緊急處理經採防墜措施及專人監督者除外）；吊鉤應有防止脫落裝置；嚴禁人員進入吊掛物下方；應設防止過捲裝置；設置信號指揮聯絡人員；避免鄰近電力線作業。
explain_en: Article 155-1: no persons may ride or be hoisted (except emergencies with fall protection and supervision); hooks need anti-slip devices; no one under the load; over-hoist prevention; a signal person; avoid working near power lines.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於強酸、強鹼等有腐蝕性物質之搬運，本規則規定應如何辦理？
a_zh: 應由二名以上勞工共同以人力搬運
b_zh: 應使用特別設計之車輛或工具
c_zh: 應於夜間人員較少之時段內搬運
d_zh: 應先中和稀釋後再以一般車輛搬運
q_en: How must strong acids, alkalis and other corrosives be transported?
a_en: At least two workers must carry them manually
b_en: Specially designed vehicles or tools must be used
c_en: They must be moved at night when few people work
d_en: They must be neutralised first and then moved
explain_zh: 第156條：雇主對於強酸、強鹼等有腐蝕性物質之搬運，應使用特別設計之車輛或工具。
explain_en: Article 156 requires specially designed vehicles or tools.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於搭載勞工於行駛中之貨車、垃圾車或資源回收車，下列規定何者正確？
a_zh: 載貨台之物料高度超過駕駛室頂部者，勞工身體之高度亦得比照放寬
b_zh: 勞工身體之最高部分不得超過貨車駕駛室之頂部高度，且不得搭乘有墜落之虞位置
c_zh: 僅需使勞工佩戴安全帽及反光背心，即得搭乘於車輛之任何位置
d_zh: 勞工得站立於載貨台之後緣，惟應以手扶持車體並由他人在旁全程看護
q_en: Which rule applies to workers riding on moving trucks or refuse vehicles?
a_en: Where cargo rises above the cab roof, the body height limit is relaxed too
b_en: No part of the body may rise above the cab roof, and no riding where falls may occur
c_en: Wearing a helmet allows riding at any position on the moving vehicle
d_en: Workers may stand at the rear edge holding the body while another watches
explain_zh: 第157條：不得使勞工搭乘於因車輛搖動致有墜落之虞之位置；勞工身體之最高部分不得超過貨車駕駛室之頂部高度，載貨台之物料高度超過駕駛室頂部者，不得超過該物料之高度。
explain_en: Article 157 caps body height at the cab roof, or at the cargo height where higher.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 物料儲存為防止因氣候變化或自然發火發生危險者，應採何種措施？
a_zh: 應採取與外界隔離及溫濕控制等適當措施
b_zh: 應採取限制單一堆垛高度不得超過二公尺者
c_zh: 應採取加設避雷針及接地導線等防護措施者
d_zh: 應採取每日灑水降溫及定時翻堆等之措施
q_en: What measures guard stored materials against weather or spontaneous ignition?
a_en: Isolation from the outside plus temperature and humidity control
b_en: Limiting the height of any single stack to two metres or less
c_en: Installing lightning rods together with earthing conductors
d_en: Daily water spraying to cool them and periodic turning of the pile
explain_zh: 第158條：雇主對於物料儲存，為防止因氣候變化或自然發火發生危險者，應採取與外界隔離及溫濕控制等適當措施。
explain_en: Article 158 requires isolation and temperature and humidity control.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於物料之堆放，下列何者符合本規則第159條之規定？
a_zh: 得倚靠牆壁或結構支柱堆放，以節省空間並增加堆置之穩定度者
b_zh: 得暫時阻礙出入口，惟應於堆放處張貼繞道通行之指示標示牌
c_zh: 堆放高度不受堆放地安全負荷限制，僅需避免影響照明即為已足
d_zh: 不得減少自動灑水器及火警警報器之有效功用，並不得妨礙消防器具緊急使用
q_en: Which practice complies with the rule on stacking materials?
a_en: Stacks may lean on walls or columns to save space and gain stability
b_en: Exits may be blocked temporarily if a detour notice is posted nearby
c_en: Stack height is free of the floor load limit so long as lighting is fine
d_en: Sprinklers and fire alarms must stay effective and fire equipment reachable
explain_zh: 第159條：物料堆放不得超過堆放地最大安全負荷、不得影響照明、不得妨礙機械設備操作、不得阻礙交通或出入口、不得減少自動灑水器及火警警報器有效功用、不得妨礙消防器具緊急使用，並以不倚靠牆壁或結構支柱堆放為原則。
explain_en: Article 159 lists seven prohibitions on stacking.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 捆紮貨車物料之纖維纜索，有下列何種情形者不得使用？
a_zh: 已斷一股子索者
b_zh: 表面沾附油污者
c_zh: 未標示製造廠商者
d_zh: 使用逾一年以上者
q_en: Which fibre rope may not be used to lash truck loads?
a_en: One with a strand already broken
b_en: One with oil stains on its surface
c_en: One with no makers name marked
d_en: One used for more than one year
explain_zh: 第160條：捆紮貨車物料之纖維纜索，已斷一股子索者，或有顯著之損傷或腐蝕者，不得使用。第101條就吊掛用纖維索、帶亦有相同基準。
explain_en: Article 160: a broken strand or marked damage or decay bars use.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 物料積垛作業，作業地點高差在多少公尺以上時，應設置安全上下設備？高差在多少公尺以上時，應指定專人指揮？
a_zh: 二公尺；三公尺
b_zh: 一公尺；二公尺
c_zh: ○．五公尺；一．五公尺
d_zh: 一．五公尺；二．五公尺
q_en: In material stacking work, safe access equipment is required at a height difference of at least how much, and a designated supervisor at least how much?
a_en: 2 m; 3 m
b_en: 1 m; 2 m
explain_zh: 第161條：作業地點高差在一．五公尺以上時應設置使勞工能安全上下之設備；高差在二．五公尺以上時，並應指定專人決定作業方法、檢點工具、指示安全事項及監督作業。
explain_en: Article 161: safe means of access at 1.5 m or more; at 2.5 m or more a designated person shall decide methods, inspect tools, instruct on safety and supervise.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 袋裝容器構成之積垛高度在二公尺以上者，積垛與積垛間下端之距離應為多少以上？
a_zh: 三十公分
b_zh: 二十公分
c_zh: 十公分
d_zh: 五公分
q_en: For bagged stacks two metres or higher, what bottom spacing is required?
a_en: 30 centimetres or more
b_en: 20 centimetres or more
c_en: 10 centimetres or more
d_en: 5 centimetres or more
explain_zh: 第162條：草袋、麻袋、塑膠袋等袋裝容器構成之積垛，高度在二公尺以上者，應規定其積垛與積垛間下端之距離在十公分以上。第163條並規定拆垛應成階梯狀。
explain_en: Article 162: at least ten centimetres between stack bottoms.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 高度二公尺以上之袋裝容器積垛拆垛時，應使成階梯狀，除最底階外其餘各階高度應在多少以下？
a_zh: 一公尺
b_zh: 一．五公尺
c_zh: 二公尺
d_zh: 二．五公尺
q_en: When dismantling bagged-material stacks over 2 m high, they shall be stepped so that each step (except the bottom) is no higher than:
a_en: 1 m
c_en: 2 m
explain_zh: 第163條：不得自積垛物料中間抽出物料；拆除袋裝容器構成之積垛應使成階梯狀，除最底階外，其餘各階之高度應在一．五公尺以下。
explain_en: Article 163: do not pull materials from the middle; step the stack so each step except the bottom is 1.5 m or less.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 為防止載貨台物料之移動致有危害勞工之虞，本規則規定應如何辦理？
a_zh: 應由隨車人員於行駛中以人力扶持物料防止其發生移動
b_zh: 應提供勞工防止物料移動之適當設備，並規定勞工使用
c_zh: 應提供勞工防止物料移動之適當設備，是否使用由勞工決定
d_zh: 應限制車輛行駛速率於每小時二十公里以下並鳴笛示警
q_en: How must shifting of goods on a load bed be prevented?
a_en: A rider must hold the goods by hand while the vehicle is travelling
b_en: Suitable equipment must be provided and workers required to use it
c_en: Suitable equipment must be provided, with use left to the workers choice
d_en: The vehicle speed must be capped at twenty kilometres an hour with a horn
explain_zh: 第164條：雇主為防止載貨台物料之移動致有危害勞工之虞，除應提供勞工防止物料移動之適當設備外，並應規定勞工使用。
explain_en: Article 164 requires both provision and mandated use of the equipment.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 使勞工於掀舉傾卸車之載貨台下方從事修理或檢點作業時，應如何辦理？
a_zh: 應指派另一名勞工於駕駛座持續踩住操作踏板固定載貨台者
b_zh: 應由勞工先以木材墊高載貨台後，再進入下方進行修理作業
c_zh: 應提供安全擋塊或安全支柱並規定使用，已設防止驟然下落設備者除外
d_zh: 應提供安全擋塊或安全支柱並規定使用，且無任何例外之情形者
q_en: What applies to work under a raised tipper body?
a_en: Another worker must hold the control pedal down in the drivers seat
b_en: Workers may prop the body up with timber and then work underneath
c_en: Provide and require safety blocks or props, unless an anti drop device exists
d_en: Provide and require safety blocks or props, with no exception at all
explain_zh: 第165條：對於掀舉傾卸車之載貨台，使勞工在其下方從事修理或檢點作業時，除應提供安全擋塊或安全支柱外，並應規定勞工使用；但該傾卸車已設置有防止驟然下落之設備者，不在此限。
explain_en: Article 165 exempts tippers already fitted with an anti sudden drop device.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 勞工從事載貨台裝卸貨物，其高差達多少以上者應提供安全上下之設備？
a_zh: 一．五公尺
b_zh: 二．五公尺
c_zh: 三公尺整數
d_zh: 一公尺整數
q_en: From what height difference must safe access equipment be provided?
a_en: 1.5 metres or more
b_en: 2.5 metres or more
c_en: 3 metres or more
d_en: 1 metre or more
explain_zh: 第166條：雇主對於勞工從事載貨台裝卸貨物其高差在一．五公尺以上者，應提供勞工安全上下之設備。第161條就積垛作業之上下設備門檻亦為一．五公尺。
explain_en: Article 166: 1.5 metres, matching the stacking rule in Article 161.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 勞工於載貨台從事單一重量超過多少公斤之物料裝卸時，應指定專人指揮監督？
a_zh: 五百公斤
b_zh: 一百公斤
c_zh: 五十公斤
d_zh: 二百公斤
q_en: Loading or unloading single items heavier than what on a truck bed requires a designated supervisor?
a_en: 500 kg
b_en: 100 kg
c_en: 50 kg
d_en: 200 kg
explain_zh: 第167條：於載貨台從事單一之重量超越一百公斤以上物料裝卸時，應指定專人決定作業方法及順序、檢點工具、禁止無關人員進入、確認貨物無墜落危險、監督作業。
explain_en: Article 167: for single items over 100 kg, a designated person shall decide methods, inspect tools, keep others away, check for falling risk and supervise.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
category: 設施規則-爆炸火災防止
q_zh: 職業安全衛生設施規則第168條之現行條文內容為何？
a_zh: 本條業經刪除，現行規則已無規定內容
b_zh: 規定高煙囪應裝設適當之避雷裝置設備
c_zh: 規定易引起火災場所應標示嚴禁煙火者
d_zh: 規定停電有爆炸之虞者應裝置發電設備
q_en: What does Article 168 of the Rules currently provide?
a_en: The article has been deleted and sets out no requirement
b_en: It requires tall chimneys to be fitted with lightning rods
c_en: It requires no smoking notices at fire prone locations
d_en: It requires standby generators where outages risk blasts
explain_zh: 第168條業經刪除。避雷裝置規定見第170條，嚴禁煙火標示見第171條，緊急發電設備見第172條。

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
category: 設施規則-爆炸火災防止
q_zh: 對於火爐、煙囪、加熱裝置等易引起火災之高熱設備，本規則規定為何？
a_zh: 僅需於設備外表標示高溫警告標誌，並由專人每班次檢點一次
b_zh: 除應有必要之防火構造外，並應與建築物或可燃性物體間採取必要之隔離
c_zh: 除應有必要之防火構造外，得與建築物或可燃性物體緊鄰設置使用
d_zh: 僅需設置滅火器材於設備旁三公尺內，即得免除防火構造之要求
q_en: What applies to furnaces, chimneys and other high heat equipment?
a_en: A hot surface warning label plus a check by a designated person each shift
b_en: Fire resistant construction, plus necessary separation from buildings or combustibles
c_en: Fire resistant construction, while adjoining buildings or combustibles is allowed
d_en: Fire extinguishers within three metres suffice instead of fire resistant construction
explain_zh: 第169條：雇主對於火爐、煙囪、加熱裝置及其他易引起火災之高熱設備，除應有必要之防火構造外，並應於與建築物或可燃性物體間採取必要之隔離。
explain_en: Article 169 requires both fire resistant construction and separation.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 高煙囪及高度在幾公尺以上並作為危險物品倉庫使用之建築物，應裝設避雷裝置？
a_zh: 二十公尺
b_zh: 五公尺
c_zh: 十公尺
d_zh: 三公尺
q_en: Tall chimneys and buildings of at least what height used as hazardous-material warehouses require lightning protection?
b_en: 5 m
d_en: 3 m
explain_zh: 第170條：雇主對於高煙囪及高度在三公尺以上並作為危險物品倉庫使用之建築物，均應裝設適當避雷裝置。
explain_en: Article 170: tall chimneys and buildings 3 m or higher used as hazardous-material warehouses shall have suitable lightning protection.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
category: 設施規則-爆炸火災防止
q_zh: 對於易引起火災及爆炸危險之場所，下列規定何者正確？
a_zh: 僅需標示嚴禁煙火，無關人員仍得自由進出該危險場所作業
b_zh: 得設置具有火花之機械，惟應於作業前後各實施通風換氣一次
c_zh: 得由勞工使用明火，惟應先向現場作業主管以口頭報備後為之
d_zh: 不得設置有火花、電弧或高溫成為發火源之虞之機械、器具或設備
q_en: Which rule applies to places at risk of fire and explosion?
a_en: A no smoking sign suffices, and unrelated persons may still enter freely
b_en: Sparking machines are allowed if the area is ventilated before and after work
c_en: Workers may use open flames after verbally informing the site supervisor
d_en: Machines or equipment that may spark, arc or reach ignition heat are barred
explain_zh: 第171條：易引起火災及爆炸危險之場所，不得設置有火花、電弧或用高溫成為發火源之虞之機械、器具或設備等；並應標示嚴禁煙火及禁止無關人員進入，規定勞工不得使用明火。
explain_en: Article 171 bars ignition sources and requires notices and a ban on open flames.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
category: 設施規則-爆炸火災防止
q_zh: 工作中遇停電有導致超壓、爆炸或火災等危險之虞者，本規則規定應如何辦理？
a_zh: 應於停電時立即疏散全部勞工並停止一切作業
b_zh: 應裝置足夠容量並能於緊急時供電之發電設備
c_zh: 應與電力公司簽訂不斷電供電契約並留存備查用
d_zh: 應裝置蓄電池式緊急照明燈並每月測試一次以上
q_en: What is required where a power failure may cause overpressure or fire?
a_en: All workers must be evacuated at once and all operations must be stopped
b_en: Generating equipment of ample capacity able to supply power in an emergency
c_en: An uninterrupted supply contract with the power company kept on file
d_en: Battery powered emergency lights tested at least once every single month
explain_zh: 第172條：雇主對於工作中遇停電有導致超壓、爆炸或火災等危險之虞者，應裝置足夠容量並能於緊急時供電之發電設備。
explain_en: Article 172 requires standby generating equipment of sufficient capacity.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
category: 設施規則-爆炸火災防止
q_zh: 於有危險物或油類、可燃性粉塵存在之虞之配管、儲槽從事熔接等作業前，應如何辦理？
a_zh: 應事先充填氧氣以利通風換氣，並確認濃度後再作業
b_zh: 應事先報請勞動檢查機構派員到場監督後始得進行作業
c_zh: 應事先清除該等物質，並確認無危險之虞後始得作業
d_zh: 應事先以清水注滿容器並保持滿水狀態下進行熔接作業
q_en: What must be done before hot work on pipes or tanks holding dangerous substances?
a_en: Fill the vessel with oxygen for ventilation and check the level before work
b_en: Ask the labor inspection agency to send an officer to supervise the work
c_en: Remove those substances first and confirm that no danger remains before work
d_en: Fill the container with water and keep it full while the welding is done
explain_zh: 第173條：對於有危險物或有油類、可燃性粉塵等其他危險物存在之虞之配管、儲槽、油桶等容器，從事熔接、熔斷或使用明火之作業或有發生火花之虞之作業，應事先清除該等物質，並確認無危險之虞。第174條並禁止以氧氣供通風換氣之用。
explain_en: Article 173 requires prior removal and confirmation; Article 174 bars using oxygen for ventilation.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 從事熔接、熔斷等使用明火之作業時，不得以何種氣體供為通風或換氣之用？
a_zh: 氧氣
b_zh: 二氧化碳
c_zh: 空氣
d_zh: 氮氣
q_en: During welding, cutting or other open-flame work, which gas must NOT be used for ventilation?
a_en: Oxygen
b_en: Carbon dioxide
c_en: Air
d_en: Nitrogen
explain_zh: 第174條：從事熔接、熔斷、金屬之加熱及其他須使用明火之作業或有發生火花之虞之作業時，不得以氧氣供為通風或換氣之用。
explain_en: Article 174: oxygen shall not be used for ventilation during welding, cutting, metal heating or other open-flame or spark-producing work.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於有因靜電引起爆炸或火災之虞之設備，本規則規定應採取何種措施？
a_zh: 僅需於設備外殼張貼靜電警告標示，並由勞工穿著棉質工作服作業
b_zh: 僅需將作業場所相對濕度控制在百分之三十以下即可有效去除靜電
c_zh: 接地、使用除電劑、加濕、使用不致成為發火源之除電裝置或其他去除靜電裝置
d_zh: 應將設備完全密閉並抽成真空狀態，以避免靜電放電引起之火災
q_en: What measures counter static electricity at fire or explosion risk equipment?
a_en: Only a static warning label on the casing and cotton work clothes for workers
b_en: Only keeping the relative humidity of the workplace below thirty percent
c_en: Earthing, antistatic agents, humidifying, or static eliminators that cannot ignite
d_en: Sealing the equipment completely and holding it under a vacuum condition
explain_zh: 第175條列舉之設備包括灌注卸收危險物之設備、收存危險物之槽車儲槽、塗敷易燃液體塗料之設備、危險物乾燥設備、易燃粉狀固體輸送篩分設備等，應採接地、除電劑、加濕或除電裝置等去除靜電。
explain_en: Article 175 lists earthing, antistatic agents, humidification and eliminators.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於勞工吸菸、使用火爐或其他用火之場所，雇主應如何辦理？
a_zh: 應限制每日用火時間為二小時內
b_zh: 應報請當地消防機關核准後使用
c_zh: 應設置預防火災所需之設備
d_zh: 應一律禁止任何用火之行為
q_en: What applies to places where workers smoke or use stoves or fire?
a_en: Daily use of fire must be limited to two hours or less
b_en: Approval of the local fire agency must be obtained first
c_en: Equipment needed to prevent fire must be installed there
d_en: All use of fire must be prohibited without exception
explain_zh: 第176條：雇主對於勞工吸菸、使用火爐或其他用火之場所，應設置預防火災所需之設備。第171條則就易引起火災爆炸危險場所規定嚴禁煙火。
explain_en: Article 176 requires fire prevention equipment at such places.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 作業場所之易燃液體蒸氣或可燃性氣體濃度達爆炸下限值百分之多少以上時，應即刻使勞工退避並停止使用煙火？
a_zh: 百分之二十
b_zh: 百分之三十
c_zh: 百分之十
d_zh: 百分之五十
q_en: Workers must be evacuated and ignition sources stopped when flammable vapor or gas reaches what percentage of the lower explosive limit?
explain_zh: 第177條第1項第2款：蒸氣或氣體之濃度達爆炸下限值之百分之三十以上時，應即刻使勞工退避至安全場所，停止使用煙火及其他點火源，並加強通風。作業前應指定專人測定濃度。
explain_en: Article 177(1)(2): at 30% or more of the LEL, evacuate workers, stop fire and ignition sources and increase ventilation; a designated person shall measure concentrations before work.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於有爆燃性粉塵存在而有爆炸、火災之虞之場所，使用之電氣設備應如何？
a_zh: 應具有適合於其設置場所危險區域劃分使用之防爆性能構造
b_zh: 應設置於距粉塵發生源三公尺以外，即得使用一般型設備者
c_zh: 應具有防水防塵等級IP65以上之外殼，並每年檢測一次以上
d_zh: 應以絕緣膠帶包覆全部接線端子，並設置漏電斷路器保護之
q_en: What electrical equipment is required where explosive dust may be present?
a_en: Equipment with explosion proof construction suited to the hazardous area class
b_en: Ordinary equipment placed more than three metres from the dust source
c_en: Enclosures rated IP65 or better for water and dust, tested once every year
d_en: All terminals wrapped in insulating tape and protected by a leakage breaker
explain_zh: 第177條之1：對於有爆燃性粉塵存在而有爆炸、火災之虞之場所，使用之電氣機械、器具或設備，應具有適合於其設置場所危險區域劃分使用之防爆性能構造。第177條就蒸氣、氣體場所亦同。
explain_en: Article 177-1 requires explosion proof construction matched to the area classification.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 應有防爆性能構造之電氣設備，於中央主管機關公告後新安裝或換裝者，應使用何者？
a_zh: 符合中央主管機關指定之國家標準、國際標準或團體標準規定之合格品
b_zh: 經勞動檢查機構於現場檢查時個案認可之非防爆型電氣設備者
c_zh: 經事業單位自行檢驗合格並登載於檢驗紀錄表之各式電氣設備
d_zh: 符合原製造廠商內部檢驗規範並附具出廠證明書之產品即可使用
q_en: What must be used for newly installed explosion proof electrical equipment?
a_en: Qualified products meeting national, international or group standards designated
b_en: Non explosion proof equipment accepted case by case during an inspection
c_en: Equipment tested by the enterprise itself and entered in its own test record
d_en: Products meeting the makers own internal test rules with a works certificate
explain_zh: 第177條之2：於中央主管機關公告後新安裝或換裝者，應使用符合中央主管機關指定之國家標準、國際標準或團體標準規定之合格品；所稱合格品，指符合本法第七條規定並張貼安全標示者。
explain_en: Article 177-2 requires qualified products bearing the safety mark under Article 7 of the Act.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於具防爆性能構造之移動式或攜帶式電氣設備，本規則規定之檢查時機為何？
a_zh: 應於發現故障或勞工反映異常時始檢查，平時得免實施檢查者
b_zh: 應於每月月底檢查一次，並將檢查結果登載於自動檢查紀錄表
c_zh: 應於每年由原製造廠商派員檢查一次，事業單位不得自行檢查
d_zh: 應於每次使用前檢查外部結構、移動電線及防爆結構與電線連接狀態
q_en: When must portable explosion proof electrical equipment be checked?
a_en: Only when a fault appears or a worker reports something abnormal
b_en: At the end of each month, with results entered in the self inspection record
c_en: Once a year by the original maker, with no in house checking permitted
d_en: Before each use, covering the casing, the trailing cable and their connection
explain_zh: 第177條之3：對於具防爆性能構造之移動式或攜帶式電氣機械、器具、設備，應於每次使用前檢查外部結構狀況、連接之移動電線情況及防爆結構與移動電線連接狀態等；遇有損壞應即修復。
explain_en: Article 177-3 requires a check before every use and immediate repair of damage.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 以軟管動力輸送硫酸、鹽酸等對皮膚有腐蝕性之液體時，下列規定何者正確？
a_zh: 軟管得依製造廠商型錄所載壓力使用，免經水壓試驗及標示程序
b_zh: 軟管應經水壓試驗確定安全耐壓力並標示於該軟管，使用時不得超過該壓力
c_zh: 以表壓力每平方公分二公斤以上輸送時，連結用具得以膠帶纏繞固定
d_zh: 輸送腐蝕性物質之管線，僅需標示物質名稱，免標示輸送方向者
q_en: Which rule governs powered hose transfer of corrosive liquids?
a_en: Hoses may be used at the pressure in the makers catalogue without any testing
b_en: Hoses must be pressure tested, marked with the safe pressure, and never exceed it
c_en: Above 2 kg per square centimetre, couplings may be secured with adhesive tape
d_en: Corrosive lines need only the substance name, not the direction of flow
explain_zh: 第178條：軟管及連接用具應具耐腐蝕性、耐熱性及耐寒性；軟管應經水壓試驗確定安全耐壓力並標示，使用不得超過該壓力；以每平方公分二公斤以上壓力輸送時，連結用具應使用旋緊連接或鉤式結合等不致脫落之構造；管線應標示物質名稱、輸送方向及閥之開閉狀態。
explain_en: Article 178 requires hydrostatic testing, marking and secure couplings.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 使用壓縮氣體作為輸送腐蝕性液體之動力時，本規則原則上應使用何種氣體？
a_zh: 氮氣；作業終了能立即排出者，始得改用空氣為壓縮氣體使用之
b_zh: 氧氣；因其取得容易且不致造成勞工缺氧窒息之危險狀況發生
c_zh: 二氧化碳；並應於輸送完成後將氣體全數回收至專用之容器
d_zh: 空氣；作業終了能立即排出或已採標示等措施者，得使用二氧化碳或氮
q_en: Which compressed gas must power the transfer of corrosive liquids?
a_en: Nitrogen; air may be substituted only if the gas can be vented at the end
b_en: Oxygen; because it is easy to obtain and cannot cause oxygen deficiency
c_en: Carbon dioxide; and all of it must be recovered into a dedicated vessel
d_en: Air; carbon dioxide or nitrogen only if the gas can be vented or is marked
explain_zh: 第179條：使用壓縮氣體為輸送腐蝕性液體之動力時，應使用空氣；但作業終了時能將氣體立即排出，或已採取標示該氣體之存在等措施，勞工進入壓力輸送設備內部不致發生缺氧、窒息等危險時，得使用二氧化碳或氮。
explain_en: Article 179 requires air as the default motive gas.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 使用槽車從事灌注或卸收危險物作業前，應採取何種措施？
a_zh: 保持引擎運轉以便隨時移動
b_zh: 槽車引擎熄火並設置輪擋
c_zh: 打開所有閥門後開始灌注
d_zh: 僅拉起手煞車，不設輪擋
q_en: Before loading or unloading hazardous materials with a tank truck, the employer shall:
a_en: Keep the engine running to move quickly
b_en: Shut off the engine and place wheel chocks
c_en: Open all valves before starting the transfer
d_en: Set the parking brake only, with no chocks
explain_zh: 第179條之1第5款：使用槽車從事灌注或卸收作業前，槽車之引擎應熄火，且設置適當之輪擋，以防止作業時車輛移動；作業結束並確認安全後始得發動。
explain_en: Article 179-1(5): the tank truck engine shall be shut off and wheel chocks placed to prevent movement; restart only after confirming safety at the end.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 建築物中設有熔融高熱物之處理設備者，為避免水蒸汽爆炸，該建築物應有何構造？
a_zh: 牆壁應以透明材質建造，以利自外部觀察內部高熱物之處理狀況
b_zh: 屋頂應設置大面積採光罩，並於雨天時開啟以加速室內之散熱
c_zh: 地板面不積水，並可防止雨水由屋頂、牆壁、窗戶等滲入之構造
d_zh: 地板面應設置集水坑並保持積水，以利緊急時吸收高熱物之熱量
q_en: What construction is required for buildings handling molten hot substances?
a_en: Transparent walls so the handling of hot substances can be watched outside
b_en: A large roof skylight opened in rain to speed the cooling of the interior
c_en: A floor that holds no water and construction keeping rain out of roof and walls
d_en: A floor with a sump kept full of water to absorb heat in an emergency
explain_zh: 第180條：建築物中熔融高熱物之處理設備，為避免引起水蒸汽爆炸，該建築物應有地板面不積水及可以防止雨水由屋頂、牆壁、窗戶等滲入之構造。
explain_en: Article 180 targets steam explosions from water contact.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於以水處理高熱礦渣或廢棄高熱礦渣之場所，本規則規定為何？
a_zh: 應將高熱礦渣先以冷水浸泡二十四小時後，始得運至廢棄場所
b_zh: 應由專人於現場全程監視，即得免除排水設備及標示等要求
c_zh: 應有良好排水設備及防止水蒸汽爆炸之必要措施，廢棄場所並應標示高熱危險
d_zh: 應有良好之排水設備，惟廢棄高熱礦渣之場所得免為高熱危險之標示
q_en: What applies to places treating or dumping hot slag with water?
a_en: Hot slag must first be soaked in cold water for twenty four hours
b_en: On site supervision alone replaces drainage and marking requirements
c_en: Good drainage and steam explosion prevention, with hot hazard marking at dumps
d_en: Good drainage is needed, but dumping sites require no marking at all
explain_zh: 第181條：以水處理高熱礦渣或廢棄高熱礦渣之場所，應有良好之排水設備及其他足以防止水蒸汽爆炸之必要措施；於廢棄高熱礦渣之場所，應加以標示高熱危險。前項規定對水碎處理作業不適用。
explain_en: Article 181 requires drainage, explosion prevention and hazard marking.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 使勞工從事金屬之加熱熔融、熔鑄作業時，對於冷卻系統應如何配置？
a_zh: 應由操作人員每小時記錄冷卻水量一次，並免設任何自動之裝置
b_zh: 應配置進出口溫度監測裝置即可，警報裝置得以人員目視巡檢替代
c_zh: 應配置進出口溫度、壓力、流量監測及警報裝置，並設緊急排放與應急冷卻設施
d_zh: 應於停電時立即停止全部冷卻水供應，以避免高熱物遇水發生爆炸
q_en: What must the cooling system for metal melting operations have?
a_en: Hourly manual logging of the water volume, with no automatic devices
b_en: Only inlet and outlet temperature monitoring, with patrols replacing alarms
c_en: Inlet and outlet temperature, pressure and flow monitoring with alarms and backup
d_en: All cooling water must be cut off at once during a power failure
explain_zh: 第181條之1：對於冷卻系統應配置進出口溫度、壓力、流量監測及警報裝置；於停電或緊急狀況時，應設置緊急排放高熱熔融物之裝置及應急冷卻設施，確保冷卻效果。
explain_en: Article 181-1 also requires emergency discharge and standby cooling facilities.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 使勞工將金屬碎屑或碎片投入金屬熔爐作業時，為防止爆炸應事前確定何事項？
a_zh: 確定投料勞工均已佩戴防護眼鏡與防護手套後即得逕行投入
b_zh: 確定該金屬碎屑或碎片中未雜含水分、火藥類等危險物或密閉容器
c_zh: 確定該金屬碎屑之含鐵量在百分之九十以上並無其他之金屬
d_zh: 確定熔爐溫度已升至攝氏一千度以上，即無爆炸之任何疑慮
q_en: What must be confirmed before charging metal scrap into a melting furnace?
a_en: That the charging workers are wearing eye protection and gloves
b_en: That the scrap holds no moisture, explosives or other closed containers
c_en: That the scrap is at least ninety percent iron with no other metals
d_en: That the furnace has already reached one thousand degrees Celsius
explain_zh: 第182條：雇主使勞工從事將金屬碎屑或碎片投入金屬熔爐之作業時，為防止爆炸，應事前確定該金屬碎屑或碎片中未雜含水分、火藥類等危險物或密閉容器等，始得作業。
explain_en: Article 182 targets moisture, explosives and sealed containers in the scrap.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於鼓風爐、鑄鐵爐或玻璃熔解爐等處置大量高熱物之作業場所，應如何辦理？
a_zh: 應將作業場所溫度控制在攝氏三十度以下，即得免使用任何防護具
b_zh: 應於爐體周圍設置警戒線，並由監視人員每小時巡視一次以上者
c_zh: 應採取適當防範措施防止高熱物飛散，防護具是否使用由勞工自行決定
d_zh: 應採取適當防範措施防止高熱物飛散溢出，並使作業勞工佩戴適當之防護具
q_en: What applies to blast furnaces and other places handling much hot material?
a_en: Keeping the workplace below thirty degrees Celsius removes the need for gear
b_en: A cordon around the furnace with an hourly patrol by a designated watcher
c_en: Suitable measures against splashing, with protective gear left to the worker
d_en: Suitable measures against splashing and overflow, and workers must wear protection
explain_zh: 第183條：對於鼓風爐、鑄鐵爐或玻璃熔解爐或處置大量高熱物之作業場所，為防止該高熱物之飛散、溢出等引起之灼傷或其他危害，應採取適當之防範措施，並使作業勞工佩戴適當之防護具。
explain_en: Article 183 requires both preventive measures and personal protective equipment.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 危險物製造、處置之工作場所，對於爆炸性物質應如何處理？
a_zh: 與氧化性物質混合貯存，並置於發火源附近
b_zh: 置於高溫乾燥處，並得以加熱、摩擦方式乾燥
c_zh: 可隨意放置於作業區，並以衝擊方式分裝
d_zh: 遠離煙火或發火源，並不得加熱、摩擦、衝擊
q_en: In workplaces handling hazardous materials, explosive substances shall be:
a_en: Stored mixed with oxidizing substances and placed near ignition sources
b_en: Kept in hot dry places, and dried by heating or rubbing as needed
c_en: Left anywhere in the work area, and repackaged by striking the container
d_en: Kept away from fire and ignition sources, and not heated, rubbed or struck
explain_zh: 第184條第1款：爆炸性物質應遠離煙火或有發火源之虞之物，並不得加熱、摩擦、衝擊。氧化性物質不得接觸促進分解之物質；易燃液體未經許可不得灌注、蒸發或加熱。
explain_en: Article 184(1): explosives shall be kept away from fire and ignition sources and not heated, rubbed or struck; oxidizers must not contact decomposition promoters; flammable liquids must not be poured, evaporated or heated without permission.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 使勞工使用危險物從事作業前，本規則規定雇主應如何辦理？
a_zh: 應報請勞動檢查機構核准該危險物之使用種類數量
b_zh: 應為勞工投保額外之商業保險並留存保單影本備查
c_zh: 應確認所使用物質之危險性，並採取預防之必要措施
d_zh: 應僅指派年資滿三年以上之勞工擔任該危險物作業
q_en: What must be done before workers use dangerous substances?
a_en: Obtain approval from the inspection agency for the type and quantity used
b_en: Buy extra commercial insurance for workers and keep a copy of the policy
c_en: Confirm the hazards of the substance and take the necessary precautions
d_en: Assign only workers with at least three years of service to the work
explain_zh: 第184條之1：雇主使勞工使用危險物從事作業前，應確認所使用物質之危險性，採取預防之必要措施；對於化學製程所使用之原、物料及其反應產物，應分析評估其危害及反應特性，並採取必要措施。
explain_en: Article 184-1 also requires hazard and reactivity analysis of process materials.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於從事危險物製造或處置之作業，本規則規定應指定專人採取何種措施？
a_zh: 應由專人保管危險物倉庫鑰匙，並負責記錄每日之領用數量者
b_zh: 應由專人每日填具檢點表，設備異常時再通報原製造廠商處理者
c_zh: 設備及附屬設備有異常時即採必要措施，場所溫濕度遮光換氣異常時亦同
d_zh: 設備有異常時即採必要措施，惟場所之溫濕度異常得免採任何措施
q_en: What must the designated person do in dangerous substance operations?
a_en: Keep the store key and record the quantity issued out on each working day
b_en: File a daily checklist and report equipment faults to the original maker
c_en: Act on abnormalities in the equipment and in temperature, humidity, shading and air
d_en: Act on equipment abnormalities only; room condition abnormalities need no action
explain_zh: 第185條：雇主對於從事危險物製造或處置之作業，應指定專人於製造或處置危險物之設備及附屬設備有異常時即採取必要措施；於置有該等設備之場所內，其溫度、濕度、遮光及換氣狀況有異常時，亦應即採取必要之措施。
explain_en: Article 185 covers both equipment and ambient condition abnormalities.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 雇主對於常溫下具自燃性之四氫化矽（矽甲烷）之處理，除依高壓氣體及消防法規外，應於作業前辦理何事？其紀錄留存幾年？
a_zh: 僅依高壓氣體法規檢查鋼瓶並張貼標示；免留存紀錄
b_zh: 向當地消防機關申請書面使用許可後始得施工；五年
c_zh: 依中央主管機關指引實施風險評估並製作報告；三年
d_zh: 由勞工自行口頭告知作業內容並登記於工作日誌；一年
q_en: For handling silane (SiH4), which is pyrophoric at room temperature, what must the employer do before work, and how long are records kept?
a_en: Only inspect the cylinders and post labels under high-pressure gas rules; no records
b_en: Apply to the local fire authority for a written permit before starting work; 5 years
c_en: Conduct a risk assessment per the central authority's guidelines and prepare a report; 3 years
d_en: Have the worker give verbal notice of the operation and log it in the shift diary; 1 year
explain_zh: 第185條之1：作業前應依中央主管機關公告之指引，就製程危害、防止設備、維護方法、緊急應變實施風險評估並製作報告；設置氣體洩漏檢知警報系統、流率限制孔、氣瓶櫃、灑水設備等，並留存紀錄三年。硝酸銨、有機過氧化物、熱媒油亦有類似規定。
explain_en: Article 185-1: a pre-work risk assessment report (process hazards, prevention equipment, maintenance, emergency response), leak detection alarms, flow-restricting orifices, gas cabinets, sprinklers, with records kept 3 years. Similar rules cover ammonium nitrate, organic peroxides and heat-transfer oil.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於硝酸銨之處理，除依消防法規外，本規則規定之辦理事項為何？
a_zh: 應設置加熱保溫設備使溫度維持恆定，並免設冷卻用途灑水設備
b_zh: 應儲存於有效通風換氣場所，與易燃物、還原劑、金屬粉末等不相容物質分隔放置
c_zh: 應以堆疊方式存放以節省空間，搬運時容許輕微破損溢出之情形
d_zh: 應儲存於密閉不通風之場所，並得與燃油、金屬粉末等物質集中存放
q_en: Which requirement applies to handling ammonium nitrate?
a_en: Fit heating to hold a steady temperature, with no cooling sprinklers needed
b_en: Store where ventilation is effective and apart from fuels, reducers and metal powders
c_en: Stack it to save space, and slight breakage or spillage in transport is fine
d_en: Store in a sealed unventilated place, and it may sit with fuel oil and powders
explain_zh: 第185條之2：硝酸銨之處理應作業前實施風險評估並製作報告；儲存於有效通風換氣之場所；儲存場所應採不可燃材料或可防止滲入之塗覆包覆材料；與易燃物、還原劑、燃油、金屬粉末等不相容物質分隔放置；避免堆疊存放及搬運破損溢出；並設置冷卻用途之灑水設備。相關紀錄或文件應留存三年。
explain_en: Article 185-2 requires ventilation, segregation, no stacking and cooling sprinklers, with records kept three years.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於有機過氧化物之處理，本規則就儲存場所之偵測有何規定？
a_zh: 應設置一個以上獨立之溫度或溫度上升速率偵測警報系統，異常時發出警示
b_zh: 應設置一個以上之可燃性氣體濃度偵測器，並於每季校正一次以上
c_zh: 應設置壓力偵測系統，溫度變化則以人員目視方式加以判斷之
d_zh: 應由專人每二小時以手持式溫度計量測一次，免設自動偵測系統
q_en: What detection is required at organic peroxide storage places?
a_en: At least one independent temperature or rate of rise detection and alarm system
b_en: At least one flammable gas detector, calibrated once every three months
c_en: A pressure detection system, with temperature judged by visual observation
d_en: Manual readings with a hand thermometer every two hours, with no system
explain_zh: 第185條之3：有機過氧化物之儲存應採與外界隔離及溫濕控制等適當措施；儲存場所應設置一個以上獨立之溫度或溫度上升速率之偵測警報系統；操作設備應有去除靜電等必要措施；戶外容器應裝設避雷裝置；並設置冷卻用途之灑水設備。
explain_en: Article 185-3 requires temperature or rate of rise alarms, static removal and lightning protection.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 使用熱媒油之鍋爐及輸送管線，操作溫度在其閃火點以上時應如何辦理？
a_zh: 管線閥件應具防洩漏構造，惟溫度異常上升得由操作人員目視判斷
b_zh: 管線閥件泵浦應具防洩漏構造，並設溫度或壓力異常上升之監控及警報系統
c_zh: 操作溫度得超過熱媒油之最高使用溫度，惟應加強現場人員之巡檢
d_zh: 應於系統加裝旁通管線隨時洩壓，即得免設任何監控及警報系統
q_en: What applies to heat transfer oil systems run above the flash point?
a_en: Leak proof lines and valves, with abnormal temperature judged by eye on site
b_en: Leak proof lines, valves and pumps, plus monitoring and alarms for temperature rise
c_en: The oil may run above its maximum use temperature if patrols are increased
d_en: A bypass line for constant venting removes the need for any alarm system
explain_zh: 第185條之4：使用熱媒油之鍋爐本體與相關設備及輸送管線系統，操作溫度在閃火點以上時，應實施風險評估並製作報告；管線、閥件及泵浦應具防止洩漏之構造；設置溫度或壓力異常上升之監控及警報系統，確保不超過熱媒油最高使用溫度及系統設計壓力；並設置冷卻或滅火用途之必要設備。相關紀錄留存三年。
explain_en: Article 185-4 requires leak proof construction and abnormal rise alarms, with records kept three years.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 職業安全衛生設施規則第186條之現行條文內容為何？
a_zh: 規定異類物品接觸有危險之虞應單獨儲放
b_zh: 規定染有油污之破布應蓋藏於不燃性容器
c_zh: 本條業經刪除，現行規則已無規定內容
d_zh: 規定加油作業不得於內燃機發動中進行
q_en: What does Article 186 of the Rules currently provide?
a_en: It requires separate storage of mutually reactive goods
b_en: It requires oily rags to be kept in non combustible bins
c_en: The article has been deleted and holds no provision now
d_en: It bars refuelling while an internal combustion engine runs
explain_zh: 第186條業經刪除。加油作業規定見第187條，異類物品單獨儲放見第191條，染有油污破布之處置見第193條。

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 工作場所實施加油作業時，下列何者正確？
a_zh: 加油場所免設危險警告標示及滅火器材
b_zh: 以汽油為燃料之內燃機得於發動中加油
c_zh: 禁止以汽油為燃料之內燃機在發動中加油
d_zh: 油料溢濺於引擎或排氣管附近並無妨礙
q_en: During refueling in the workplace, which is correct?
a_en: No hazard warning signs or extinguishers are needed there
b_en: Gasoline-powered engines may be refueled while running
c_en: Gasoline-powered engines must not be refueled while running
d_en: Spilling fuel on the engine or exhaust pipe is acceptable
explain_zh: 第187條：禁止以汽油為燃料之內燃機等機械在發動中加油；設置顯著之危險警告標示；備置化學乾粉、泡沫或二氧化碳等適當之油類用滅火器材；避免油料溢濺於引擎、排氣管或電氣設備。
explain_en: Article 187: gasoline engines must not be refueled while running; post hazard warnings; provide dry chemical, foam or CO2 extinguishers; avoid spills on engines, exhausts or electrical equipment.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
category: 設施規則-爆炸火災防止
q_zh: 對於存有易燃液體蒸氣、可燃性氣體或粉塵而有爆炸火災之虞之工作場所，應如何辦理？
a_zh: 應有通風、換氣、除塵、去除靜電等必要設施，且不得使用會產生明火火花之設備
b_zh: 應以惰性氣體將場所完全充滿並禁止勞工進入該工作場所作業
c_zh: 應有通風換氣及除塵設施，惟仍得使用一般型之電氣設備及手工具從事作業
d_zh: 應僅於作業前後各實施通風換氣一次，作業中得關閉通風設備者
q_en: What applies to workplaces where flammable vapour or dust may accumulate?
a_en: Ventilation, dust removal and static removal, and no equipment producing flame or sparks
b_en: The place must be filled with inert gas and closed to workers altogether
c_en: Ventilation is required, but ordinary electrical tools may still be used there
d_en: Ventilation before and after work only, with the fans switched off during work
explain_zh: 第188條：對於存有易燃液體之蒸氣、可燃性氣體或可燃性粉塵，致有引起爆炸、火災之虞之工作場所，應有通風、換氣、除塵、去除靜電等必要設施；且所採設施不得裝置或使用有發生明火、電弧、火花及其他可能引起爆炸火災危險之機械、器具或設備。
explain_en: Article 188 pairs the required facilities with a ban on ignition producing equipment.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 於通風不充分場所使用可燃性氣體及氧氣從事熔接作業時，下列規定何者正確？
a_zh: 氣體軟管供氣口之閥或旋塞，得免設置標示使用者之名牌等識別
b_zh: 供氣前僅需以目視確認軟管外觀無破損，免確認吹管是否關閉狀態
c_zh: 作業中斷時得將軟管留置原處並保持供氣狀態，以利復工時立即使用
d_zh: 作業中斷或完工離開時，應關閉供氣口之閥或旋塞，並將軟管拆下或移至通風處
q_en: Which rule applies to gas welding in poorly ventilated places?
a_en: Supply valves and cocks need no name plate identifying the current user
b_en: A visual check of the hose suffices; the torch valve need not be verified
c_en: Hoses may be left in place still charged with gas so work can resume quickly
d_en: On stopping work, close the valve and remove the hose or move it to fresh air
explain_zh: 第189條：氣體軟管或吹管應使用不因損傷摩擦導致漏氣者；連接處應確實固定套牢；供氣前應確定吹管在關閉狀態或軟管確實止栓；供氣口之閥或旋塞應設標示使用者之名牌；作業中斷或完工離開時，應關閉閥或旋塞並將軟管拆下或移放於通風換氣良好之場所。
explain_en: Article 189 requires closing valves and removing hoses when work stops.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 熔接用可燃性氣體及氧氣之容器，使用時應留置何物於容器閥柄上，以備緊急時遮斷氣源？
a_zh: 警示標籤
b_zh: 安全頭盔
c_zh: 專用板手
d_zh: 滅火器材
q_en: When using welding gas or oxygen cylinders, what must be left on the cylinder valve for emergency shut-off?
a_en: A warning label
b_en: A safety helmet
c_en: A dedicated wrench
d_en: A fire extinguisher
explain_zh: 第190條第4款：容器使用時，應留置專用板手於容器閥柄上，以備緊急時遮斷氣源。另應保持四十度以下、直立穩妥放置、搬運時裝妥護蓋、不得接觸電焊器電路火源。
explain_en: Article 190(4): a dedicated wrench shall be kept on the valve stem for emergency shut-off; cylinders shall be kept below 40°C, upright, capped during transport, and away from welders, circuits and fire.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於異類物品接觸有引起爆炸、火災危險之虞者，本規則規定應如何辦理？
a_zh: 應單獨儲放，搬運時使用專用之運搬機械；已採防止接觸設施者除外
b_zh: 得混合儲放於同一倉庫，惟應以不同顏色之標籤加以區別識別
c_zh: 應單獨儲放，搬運時使用專用運搬機械，且無任何例外之情形
d_zh: 應於接觸前先以惰性氣體稀釋，即得共用同一運搬機械搬運之
q_en: What applies to goods that may explode or ignite on contact with each other?
a_en: Store them separately and move them with dedicated machines, unless contact is prevented
b_en: They may share one warehouse if labels of different colours identify them
c_en: Store them separately and use dedicated machines, with no exception at all allowed
d_en: Dilution with inert gas allows them to share the same handling machine
explain_zh: 第191條：雇主對於異類物品接觸有引起爆炸、火災、危險之虞者，應單獨儲放，搬運時應使用專用之運搬機械；但經採取防止接觸之設施者，不在此限。
explain_en: Article 191 exempts cases where contact prevention facilities are provided.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於起毛、反毛之操作場所或大量處理棉、羊毛、紙屑等可燃性物質之場所，應如何辦理？
a_zh: 應有防止火災之安全設施
b_zh: 應設置除濕機控制濕度
c_zh: 應限制勞工人數十人以下
d_zh: 應每日清運可燃物一次
q_en: What applies to places handling large amounts of combustible fibres?
a_en: Safety facilities preventing fire must be provided
b_en: Dehumidifiers must be installed to control humidity
c_en: The number of workers must be limited to ten or fewer
d_en: Combustibles must be removed once every working day
explain_zh: 第192條：雇主對於起毛、反毛之操作場所，或將棉、羊毛、碎屑、木棉、稻草、紙屑及其他可燃性物質大量處理之場所，應有防止火災之安全設施。
explain_en: Article 192 requires fire prevention safety facilities.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於染有油污之破布、紙屑等，本規則規定應如何處置？
a_zh: 應集中堆置於工作場所角落並覆蓋防水帆布者
b_zh: 應於每週末統一以露天焚燒方式加以清除處理
c_zh: 應蓋藏於不燃性之容器內，或採用其他適當處置
d_zh: 應以塑膠袋密封後放置於作業區內待清運處理
q_en: How must oily rags and paper scraps be handled?
a_en: Piled in a corner of the workplace and covered with a waterproof sheet
b_en: Burned in the open at the end of each week to clear them away
c_en: Kept covered in non combustible containers or otherwise suitably handled
d_en: Sealed in plastic bags and left in the work area awaiting collection
explain_zh: 第193條：雇主對於染有油污之破布、紙屑等應蓋藏於不燃性之容器內，或採用其他適當處置，以防止自然發火引起火災。
explain_en: Article 193 requires non combustible covered containers.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 建築物內設有反應器、蒸餾塔等化學設備時，其接近化學設備周圍之牆壁、樑柱應如何構築？
a_zh: 應使用具彈性之輕質材料構築，以吸收爆炸時產生之衝擊波
b_zh: 應使用不燃性材料構築，以防止因危險物及輻射熱產生火災之虞
c_zh: 應使用具吸音效果之隔音材料構築，以降低設備運轉之噪音
d_zh: 應使用透明強化玻璃構築，以利自外部觀察設備之運轉狀況
q_en: How must walls and columns near chemical equipment be built?
a_en: Of light elastic materials, so as to absorb the shock wave of an explosion
b_en: Of non combustible materials, to guard against fire from hazards and radiant heat
c_en: Of sound absorbing materials, so as to reduce the noise of the equipment
d_en: Of transparent toughened glass, so operation can be watched from outside
explain_zh: 第194條：建築物內設有化學設備如反應器、蒸餾塔、吸收塔、熱交換器、儲槽等及其閥、旋塞、配管等附屬設備時，該建築物之牆壁、柱、樓板、樑、樓梯等接近化學設備周圍部分，應使用不燃性材料構築。
explain_en: Article 194 requires non combustible construction around chemical equipment.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 化學設備或其配管存有腐蝕性危險物或閃火點在攝氏幾度以上之化學物質者，應使用不易腐蝕材料或裝設內襯？
a_zh: 六十五度
b_zh: 四十五度
c_zh: 八十五度
d_zh: 一百度整
q_en: Chemicals with a flash point at or above what temperature trigger this rule?
a_en: 65 degrees Celsius
b_en: 45 degrees Celsius
c_en: 85 degrees Celsius
d_en: 100 degrees Celsius
explain_zh: 第195條：化學設備或其配管存有腐蝕性之危險物或閃火點在攝氏六十五度以上之化學物質之部分，應依危險物、化學物質之種類、溫度、濃度、壓力等，使用不易腐蝕之材料製造或裝設內襯等。
explain_en: Article 195: flash point of 65 degrees Celsius or above.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 為防止化學設備或其配管因操作錯誤引起爆炸火災，下列規定何者正確？
a_zh: 蓋板、凸緣等接合部分得以矽利康填縫替代墊圈之使用與設置
b_zh: 閥、旋塞之開關方向得不予標示，僅需由專人於交接班時說明
c_zh: 應由操作人員憑經驗判斷供料對象，免於現場為任何標示或標記
d_zh: 應於勞工易見位置標示原料、材料、種類、供料對象等，以防止供料錯誤
q_en: Which rule guards against operating errors on chemical equipment?
a_en: Silicone sealant may replace gaskets at cover and flange joint surfaces
b_en: Valve opening directions need no marking if explained at shift handover
c_en: The operator judges the receiving unit by experience with no site marking
d_en: Mark the feedstock, its type and the receiving unit where workers can see them
explain_zh: 第196條：化學設備或其配管之蓋板、凸緣、閥、旋塞等接合部分應使用墊圈使其密接；操作用之閥、旋塞、控制開關、按鈕等應保持良好性能並標示開關方向，必要時以顏色、形狀標明使用狀態；並應於勞工易見位置標示原料、材料、種類、供料對象等，以防止供料錯誤。
explain_en: Article 196 requires gaskets, marked valve directions and feed marking.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
q_zh: 對於化學設備或其附屬設備，為防止爆炸、火災、洩漏應採取之措施，下列何者正確？
a_zh: 安全閥於平時應予鎖定關閉，僅於歲修期間開啟並測試其功能
b_zh: 保持安全閥、緊急遮斷裝置、自動警報裝置於異常狀態時之有效運轉
c_zh: 冷卻、加熱及攪拌裝置之操作，得由勞工依現場狀況隨意調整
d_zh: 溫度計與壓力計得於故障時暫不修復，改由人員以經驗研判之
q_en: Which measure applies to chemical equipment and its accessories?
a_en: Relief valves must stay locked shut and be opened only during annual overhaul
b_en: Relief valves, emergency shutoffs and alarms must work effectively in abnormal states
c_en: Cooling, heating and stirring devices may be adjusted freely by workers on site
d_en: Faulty thermometers and gauges may be left unrepaired and judged by experience
explain_zh: 第197條：應確定輸送原料及卸收產品之閥、旋塞正常操作；確定冷卻、加熱、攪拌及壓縮等裝置正常操作；保持溫度計、壓力計或其他計測裝置正常操作功能；保持安全閥、緊急遮斷裝置、自動警報裝置或其他安全裝置於異常狀態時之有效運轉。
explain_en: Article 197 requires the safety devices to remain effective under abnormal conditions.

law: 職業安全衛生設施規則
