d_zh: 採裂解處理者應設置活性碳吸附塔及排放口採樣孔，並具備廢水回收全量再利用設施；採能源利用者應設置飛灰穩定化設備並具備掩埋場或灰渣暫存區；處理作業得在露天場區進行但應設置防風網及碎石鋪面
q_en: What must pyrolysis or energy-use treatment of waste tyres provide, and what does the work area require?
a_en: Pyrolysis needs oil or liquid interception, collection, oil-water separation and related facilities plus dust collectors, oil refining equipment and leak prevention; energy use needs dust collectors plus a kiln, steam generation, steelmaking or cogeneration equipment; and work must occur in a walled plant on concrete paving
b_en: Pyrolysis needs vacuum pumps and nitrogen filling plus carbon black pelletizing and packing machines; energy use needs continuous automatic monitoring plus an incinerator or melting furnace; and work must occur in a sealed negative-pressure basement on epoxy paving
c_en: Pyrolysis needs condensation recovery towers and a flare stack plus oil storage tanks and bunding walls; energy use needs desulphurization equipment plus boilers, generator sets or thermal oil heaters; and work may occur under a roofed open-sided shed on asphalt paving that eases machinery movement around the plant area
d_en: Pyrolysis needs activated carbon towers and stack sampling ports plus full wastewater recovery and reuse; energy use needs fly ash stabilization plus a landfill or ash storage area; and work may occur outdoors behind windbreak netting on gravel paving
explain_zh: 第5條第1款至第3款、第5款、第6款：處理作業須在四周有圍牆之廠（場）區內進行；處理作業區應具有排水及污染物截流設施；處理作業區需為混凝土鋪面以防止污水油類滲入地下污染土壤或地下水體；採裂解處理者應設置油類或液體之截流、收集、油水分離及相關處理設施及集塵設備收集粉塵，並具備廢輪胎煉製油品之設備及防止油品洩漏措施；採能源利用者應設置集塵設備收集粉塵，並應具備窯爐、產生蒸氣設備、煉鋼設備或汽電共生設備。

law: 廢輪胎回收貯存清除處理方法及設施標準
q_zh: 依本法第十八條第五項向中央主管機關申請廢輪胎回收清除處理補貼者，應符合哪些規定？
a_zh: 應符合輸出國外處理之方式，並取得接受國政府同意輸入之文件及處理機構許可文件；應具備輸出至經濟合作暨發展組織會員國之能力；並提具運輸契約及財務保證文件與退運計畫
b_zh: 應符合原形利用、掩埋處理或翻修再生之處理方式，並作為消波塊、擋土設施、道路級配粒料、景觀造景材料或填地工程材料等用途；應具備處理特定單一規格尺寸廢輪胎之處理能力即可；並提具處理量統計表、委託人名冊及每月營運報表送請備查
c_zh: 應符合破碎處理、裂解處理或能源利用之處理方式，並作為橡膠製品、橡膠製品原料、橡膠瀝青原料、油品煉製原料或水泥窯、造紙業、煉鋼業、汽電共生廠等生產能源原料之用途；應具備處理公告應回收各種規格尺寸廢輪胎之能力；並提具質量平衡圖及試運轉報告
d_zh: 應符合翻修再生之處理方式，並取得經濟部標準檢驗局核發之商品驗證登錄證書；應具備翻修各種規格尺寸廢輪胎之能力；並提具品質管制計畫及產品保固說明書與銷售通路資料
q_en: What must an applicant satisfy to claim a recycling subsidy for waste tyres?
a_en: Use export for treatment abroad and obtain the receiving state's import consent and the facility's permit documents; be able to export to an OECD member country; and file the carriage contract, financial guarantee and return plan
b_en: Use whole-tyre application, landfill or retreading and direct the output to breakwaters, retaining works, road aggregate, landscaping materials or land reclamation fill; be able to treat one particular tyre size only; and file throughput statistics, a client roster and monthly operating returns to the central competent authority for the record
c_en: Use crushing, pyrolysis or energy recovery and direct the output to rubber products, rubber or rubberized asphalt feedstock, oil refining feedstock, or energy feedstock for cement kilns, paper mills, steelworks or cogeneration plants; be able to treat every announced tyre size; and file a mass balance diagram and trial run report
d_en: Use retreading and obtain a commodity verification registration certificate from the Bureau of Standards; be able to retread every tyre size; and file a quality control plan, warranty statement and distribution channel data
explain_zh: 第6條第1款至第3款：申請補貼者應符合第2條第6款至第8款規定廢輪胎之處理方式（破碎處理、裂解處理、能源利用），並作為橡膠製品、橡膠製品原料、橡膠瀝青原料、油品煉製原料或水泥窯、造紙業、煉鋼業、汽電共生廠等生產能源原料之用途；應具備處理依本法第15條第2項公告應回收各種規格尺寸廢輪胎之能力；並提具清除、處理之方法、設備、流程、質量平衡圖及處理設備之試運轉報告。

law: 廢輪胎回收貯存清除處理方法及設施標準
q_zh: 廢輪胎經回收、貯存、清除、處理後產生之廢棄物，應如何辦理？
a_zh: 應全數作為能源利用原料交由水泥窯或汽電共生廠使用，其屬事業廢棄物者免另依相關標準辦理；其輸出應依資源回收再利用法規定申請輸出許可後為之
b_zh: 應由原回收業者收回自行處置並留存流向紀錄備查，其屬有害事業廢棄物者始應依相關標準辦理；其輸出應經地方主管機關核准並副知中央主管機關後為之
c_zh: 應依本標準規定辦理，其屬事業廢棄物者除應依事業廢棄物貯存清除處理方法及設施標準規定貯存清除處理外，並應符合本法第二十八條規定之清理方式；其輸出應符合本法第三十八條規定
d_zh: 應依本標準規定辦理，其屬事業廢棄物者得比照一般廢棄物由執行機關清運處理而免依事業廢棄物相關標準辦理；其輸出僅需檢附成分分析報告向海關報備即得辦理
q_en: How must waste produced after the recovery, storage, clearance and treatment of tyres be handled?
a_en: All of it must go to cement kilns or cogeneration plants as energy feedstock, industrial waste needing no other standards; exports need an export permit under the Resource Recycling Act
b_en: The original recovery operator must take it back and handle it with flow records kept; only hazardous industrial waste follows the relevant standards; exports need local approval copied centrally
c_en: Under these Standards; if industrial waste, also under the industrial waste storage, clearance and treatment standards and the disposal methods in Article 28; exports must comply with Article 38
d_en: Under these Standards; if industrial waste, it may be cleared by the executing agency like general waste without the industrial waste standards; exports need only a composition report filed with customs
explain_zh: 第7條第1項：廢輪胎經回收、貯存、清除、處理後產生之廢棄物，應依本標準規定辦理，其屬事業廢棄物者，除應依事業廢棄物貯存清除處理方法及設施標準規定貯存、清除、處理外，並應符合本法第28條規定之清理方式。第2項：前項廢棄物之輸出，應符合本法第38條規定。

law: 廢輪胎回收貯存清除處理方法及設施標準
q_zh: 本標準修正施行前已從事回收、處理之回收、處理業，對於修正條文之規定應如何因應？
a_zh: 應自本標準修正施行之日起三個月內完成改善，逾期未改善者應即停止其回收處理業務
b_zh: 應自本標準修正施行之日起六個月內完成改善，以符合修正後之回收貯存清除處理規定
c_zh: 應自本標準修正發布之日起立即符合規定，僅設備改建部分得申請三個月之緩衝期間
d_zh: 應自本標準修正施行之日起二年內完成改善，並得檢具理由申請展延一年且期間免罰
q_en: How must recovery and treatment operators already in business respond to the amended provisions?
a_en: They must complete correction within three months from the day the amendment takes effect, and must cease recovery and treatment business if they fail to do so
b_en: They must complete correction within six months from the day the amendment takes effect, so as to meet the amended recovery, storage, clearance and treatment rules
c_en: They must comply from the day the amendment is promulgated, with only a three-month buffer available for the part involving equipment rebuilding work
d_en: They must complete correction within two years from the day the amendment takes effect, with a one-year extension available on stated grounds and no penalties meanwhile
explain_zh: 第8條：本標準修正施行前，已從事回收、處理之回收、處理業，對於本標準修正條文之規定，應自本標準修正施行之日起6個月內完成改善。廢容器回收貯存清除處理方法及設施標準第12條及廢鉛蓄電池回收貯存清除處理方法及設施標準第7條亦定有相同之6個月改善期規定。

law: 廢輪胎回收貯存清除處理方法及設施標準
q_zh: 廢輪胎回收貯存清除處理方法及設施標準之施行日期如何規定？
a_zh: 由中央主管機關另以命令定其施行日期，並得就貯存與處理規定分別定其施行日
b_zh: 自發布後一年施行，其中原形利用及補貼要件規定自發布日起先行施行並適用之
c_zh: 自發布日施行，另於第八條就修正施行前已從事回收處理之業者定有六個月改善期
d_zh: 自發布後六個月施行，並自施行日起同時廢止原有之廢輪胎回收清除處理相關規定
q_en: When do the Standards for Waste Tyres take effect?
a_en: On a date set by the central authority by order, which may differ for the storage and treatment provisions
b_en: One year after promulgation, except that the whole-tyre use and subsidy rules apply from the promulgation date
c_en: On the date of promulgation, with Article 8 giving existing recovery and treatment operators a six-month correction period
d_en: Six months after promulgation, at which point the earlier waste tyre recovery and treatment rules are all repealed
explain_zh: 第9條：本標準自發布日施行。本標準修正日期為民國103年5月20日，全文共9條，依廢棄物清理法第18條第1項授權訂定，並於第8條就修正施行前已從事回收、處理之業者定有自修正施行之日起6個月之改善期間。

law: 廢機動車輛回收貯存清除處理方法及設施標準
category: 廢機動車輛標準-授權依據
q_zh: 廢機動車輛回收貯存清除處理方法及設施標準之授權依據為何？本標準未規定者應如何適用？
a_zh: 依資源回收再利用法第十五條第四項訂定；本標準未規定者，得由業者自行訂定作業規範
b_zh: 依廢棄物清理法第二十八條第三項規定訂定；本標準未規定者，優先適用地方自治法規
c_zh: 依廢棄物清理法第十八條第一項規定訂定；本標準未規定者，適用其他法令之規定
d_zh: 依廢棄物清理法第十五條第二項規定訂定；本標準未規定者，一律報請中央主管機關核定
q_en: What is the legal basis of this Standard, and what applies to matters it does not cover?
a_en: Enacted under Article 15-4 of the Resource Recycling Act; operators may set their own rules
b_en: Enacted under Article 28-3 of the Waste Disposal Act; local ordinances apply with priority
c_en: Enacted under Article 18-1 of the Waste Disposal Act; matters not covered follow other laws
d_en: Enacted under Article 15-2 of the Waste Disposal Act; matters not covered need central approval
explain_zh: 第1條第1項：本標準依廢棄物清理法第十八條第一項規定訂定之。第1條第2項：廢機動車輛回收貯存清除處理方法及設施依本標準規定，本標準未規定者，適用其他法令之規定。第8條並定本標準自發布日施行。
explain_en: Article 1 cites Article 18, paragraph 1 of the Act.

law: 廢機動車輛回收貯存清除處理方法及設施標準
category: 廢機動車輛標準-名詞定義
q_zh: 本標準所稱回收與清除之定義分別為何？
a_zh: 回收指將廢車殼分類、破碎並篩選衍生廢棄物之行為；清除指經處理後再生料總和重量占其處理量之比例
b_zh: 回收指收集、分類，包括回收、拆卸、抽洩並將可回收再利用物品分類之回收拆解行為；清除指收集、運輸之行為
c_zh: 回收指以物理或化學方法改變其特性達成純化精煉之行為；清除指放置於特定地點或貯存容器、設施內之行為
d_zh: 回收指廢機動車輛於處理前放置於特定地點之行為；清除指將可回收再利用物品加以純化、精煉之行為
q_en: How does this Standard define recovery (huishou) and clearance (qingchu)?
a_en: Recovery is sorting and crushing scrap car shells; clearance is the ratio of recycled material to throughput
b_en: Recovery is collecting and sorting, including dismantling and draining; clearance is collection and transport
c_en: Recovery is changing properties by physical or chemical means; clearance is placing waste in a designated site
d_en: Recovery is placing vehicles at a designated site before disposal; clearance is purifying recyclable items
explain_zh: 第2條第2款：回收指將廢機動車輛收集、分類之行為，包括回收、拆卸、抽洩廢機動車輛，將可回收再利用物品分類之回收拆解行為。第4款：清除指廢機動車輛之收集、運輸行為。第3款貯存則指清除、處理前放置於特定地點或容器設施之行為。

law: 廢機動車輛回收貯存清除處理方法及設施標準
category: 廢機動車輛標準-資源回收再利用比例
q_zh: 本標準所稱資源回收再利用比例，其定義為何？
a_zh: 指廢機動車輛經處理後，再生料之總和重量占其處理量之比例
b_zh: 指廢機動車輛經破碎後，金屬再生料重量占非金屬再生料比例
c_zh: 指廢機動車輛經處理後，衍生廢棄物重量占其原始車重之比例
d_zh: 指廢機動車輛回收拆解後，可用零件數量占全車零件數之比例
q_en: How is the resource recycling and reuse ratio defined?
a_en: Total weight of recycled materials produced, as a share of the volume of vehicles treated
b_en: Weight of metal recycled material, as a share of the non-metal recycled material produced
c_en: Weight of derived waste produced, as a share of the original kerb weight of the vehicles
d_en: Number of reusable parts recovered on dismantling, as a share of all parts in the vehicle
explain_zh: 第2條第6款：資源回收再利用比例，指廢機動車輛經處理後，再生料之總和重量占其處理量之比例。第5條第5款並要求該比例應符合中央主管機關公告之應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼費率規定。

law: 廢機動車輛回收貯存清除處理方法及設施標準
category: 廢機動車輛標準-分區貯存
q_zh: 廢機動車輛分區貯存之堆疊高度、分區尺寸及走道規定為何？
a_zh: 堆疊高度不得超過四公尺，固定鋼架多層貯存每層不得高於三公尺；分區寬度及長度不得超過十公尺，廢車殼區應有二公尺以上分隔走道
b_zh: 堆疊高度不得超過五公尺，固定鋼架多層貯存每層不得高於四公尺；分區寬度及長度不得超過十五公尺，廢車殼區應有三公尺分隔走道
c_zh: 堆疊高度不得超過八公尺，固定鋼架多層貯存每層不得高於六公尺；分區寬度及長度不得超過三十公尺，廢車殼區應有半公尺分隔走道
d_zh: 堆疊高度不得超過六公尺，固定鋼架多層貯存每層不得高於四．五公尺；分區寬度及長度不得超過二十公尺，廢車殼區應有一公尺以上分隔走道
q_en: What are the stacking height, zone size and aisle requirements for zoned storage?
a_en: Stacks up to 4 m, 3 m per tier on fixed racks; zones up to 10 m wide and long, with a 2 m aisle for shells
b_en: Stacks up to 5 m, 4 m per tier on fixed racks; zones up to 15 m wide and long, with a 3 m aisle for shells
c_en: Stacks up to 8 m, 6 m per tier on fixed racks; zones up to 30 m wide and long, with a 0.5 m aisle for shells
d_en: Stacks up to 6 m, 4.5 m per tier on fixed racks; zones up to 20 m wide and long, with a 1 m aisle for shells
explain_zh: 第3條第5款：分區貯存應有明顯標線或隔板，堆疊高度不得超過六公尺；採固定鋼架多層貯存者每層不得高於四．五公尺；分區貯存寬度及長度不得超過二十公尺，從事回收拆解作業者廢車殼貯存區應有一公尺以上之分隔走道，並應採繩索捆綁、護網等措施防止飛散、掉落、倒塌。

law: 廢機動車輛回收貯存清除處理方法及設施標準
category: 廢機動車輛標準-防火與冷媒
q_zh: 貯存專區周圍多少範圍內應嚴禁煙火？從事回收拆解者應具備何種設備？
a_zh: 貯存專區周圍六公尺範圍內嚴禁煙火且不得存放易燃物質；應具備冷媒回收機，並有 CFCs 及 HFCs 專用回收接頭與專用貯存鋼瓶
b_zh: 貯存專區周圍二公尺範圍內嚴禁煙火且不得存放易燃物質；應具備廢水處理機，並有酸鹼中和及沉澱過濾單元與專用貯槽
c_zh: 貯存專區周圍十公尺範圍內嚴禁煙火且不得存放易燃物質；應具備氣體偵測器，並有一氧化碳及硫化氫感測探頭與警報裝置
d_zh: 貯存專區周圍三公尺範圍內嚴禁煙火且不得存放易燃物質；應具備廢油回收機，並有汽油及柴油專用回收接頭與專用貯存油槽
q_en: What no-smoking radius applies around the storage zone, and what equipment must dismantlers have?
a_en: No fire within 6 m of the storage zone and no flammables; a refrigerant recovery unit with CFC and HFC couplers and cylinders
b_en: No fire within 2 m of the storage zone and no flammables; a wastewater unit with neutralisation and sedimentation filters
c_en: No fire within 10 m of the storage zone and no flammables; a gas detector with carbon monoxide and hydrogen sulphide sensors
d_en: No fire within 3 m of the storage zone and no flammables; a waste oil recovery unit with petrol and diesel couplers and tanks
explain_zh: 第3條第8款：貯存專區周圍六公尺之範圍內應嚴禁煙火，不可存放任何易燃性物質，並設嚴禁煙火標示。第15款：從事回收拆解者應具備冷媒回收機，並具備氟氯碳化物（CFCs）及氫氟碳化物（HFCs）之專用回收接頭與專用貯存鋼瓶，鋼瓶外並明確標示種類。

law: 廢機動車輛回收貯存清除處理方法及設施標準
category: 廢機動車輛標準-拆解作業區
q_zh: 拆解作業區之最小作業面積規定為何？同時拆解二部以上汽車時如何辦理？
a_zh: 面積至少應能容納拆解三部汽車，長度不得少於八公尺、寬度不得少於四．五公尺；同時拆解四部以上者應報請主管機關核准
b_zh: 面積至少應能容納拆解一部汽車，長度不得少於十公尺、寬度不得少於五公尺；同時拆解二部以上者僅需增設一組洩油設備
c_zh: 面積至少應能容納拆解一部汽車，長度不得少於六公尺、寬度不得少於三．五公尺；同時拆解二部以上者長度或寬度應依比例增加
d_zh: 面積至少應能容納拆解二部汽車，長度不得少於四公尺、寬度不得少於二．五公尺；同時拆解三部以上者應另設獨立作業廠房
q_en: What is the minimum dismantling work area, and what if two or more cars are dismantled at once?
a_en: Enough for three cars, at least 8 m long and 4.5 m wide; approval from the authority is needed for four or more
b_en: Enough for one car, at least 10 m long and 5 m wide; only one extra oil draining device is needed for two cars
c_en: Enough for one car, at least 6 m long and 3.5 m wide; length or width increases proportionally for two or more
d_en: Enough for two cars, at least 4 m long and 2.5 m wide; a separate workshop is required for three or more cars
explain_zh: 第3條第13款：拆解作業區之面積至少應能容納拆解一部汽車之作業面積，長度不得少於六公尺、寬度不得少於三．五公尺；同時拆解二部以上之汽車，所需作業面積之長度或寬度應依比例增加。第14款並要求拆解作業區應設置具洩油功能之設備。

law: 廢機動車輛回收貯存清除處理方法及設施標準
category: 廢機動車輛標準-處理設施
q_zh: 廢機動車輛處理之作業區鋪面及粉碎、選別設備應符合何規定？
a_zh: 作業區需為瀝青混凝土鋪面以利排水並防止揚塵擴散；粉碎設備應具減音、除濕及防鏽功能，選別設備應能分離塑膠、玻璃及橡膠等物料
b_zh: 作業區需為金屬格柵鋪面以利收集廢液並防止積水；粉碎設備應具冷卻、脫水及消毒功能，選別設備應能分離電子零件、電線及電池
c_zh: 作業區需為夯實碎石鋪面以利滲透並降低地表逕流；粉碎設備應具加壓、加熱及乾燥功能，選別設備應能分離廢油、廢液及冷媒等物質
d_zh: 作業區需為鋼筋混凝土鋪面以抗壓並防止污水油類滲入地下；粉碎設備應具減震、集塵及防爆功能，選別設備應能分離鐵金屬、非鐵金屬及非金屬
q_en: What are the paving, shredding and sorting equipment requirements for the treatment work area?
a_en: Asphalt concrete paving to drain water and limit dust; shredders with sound damping, dehumidifying and rust proofing; sorters separating plastics, glass and rubber materials
b_en: Metal grating paving to collect liquids and prevent ponding; shredders with cooling, dewatering and disinfecting; sorters separating electronic parts, wires and batteries
c_en: Compacted gravel paving to aid infiltration and cut runoff; shredders with pressurising, heating and drying functions; sorters separating waste oil, liquids and refrigerants
d_en: Reinforced concrete paving to bear load and block seepage; shredders with damping, dust collection and explosion proofing; sorters separating ferrous, non-ferrous and non-metals
explain_zh: 第4條第3款：作業區需為鋼筋混凝土鋪面，以抗壓（重）並防止污水、油類等滲入地下污染土壤或地下水體。第7款：粉碎設備應具有減震、集塵及防爆等功能。第8款：選別設備應具有分離鐵金屬、非鐵金屬、非金屬等功能。

law: 廢機動車輛回收貯存清除處理方法及設施標準
category: 廢機動車輛標準-廠區防治設施
q_zh: 廢機動車輛處理廠（場）區之防治與消防設施應符合何規定？
a_zh: 應於四周有圍籬或圍牆之廠區內進行；設置油類截流、收集及油水分離設施，其進流口前應設攔污柵；並設消防安全設備及避雷或接地設備定期檢修
b_zh: 應於距住宅五百公尺外之場地進行；設置逆滲透及消毒設施，其進流口前應設加藥槽；並設緊急照明設備及廣播設備委外定期檢修
c_zh: 應於設有門禁之封閉倉庫內進行；設置活性碳吸附及除臭設施，其出流口後應設中和池；並設空氣清淨設備及排煙設備每五年檢修一次
d_zh: 得於四周開放之露天場地進行作業；設置沉砂池及曝氣調節設施，其進流口前應設緩衝池；並設一般照明設備及防颱設施每三年檢修一次即可
q_en: What pollution control and fire safety facilities are required at the treatment plant?
a_en: Work inside a fenced or walled plant; oil interception, collection and separation units with a trash rack before the inlet; fire safety and lightning or earthing devices inspected regularly
b_en: Work at a site at least 500 m from housing; reverse osmosis and disinfection units with a dosing tank before the inlet; emergency lighting and broadcasting inspected by outside contractors
c_en: Work inside a closed access-controlled warehouse; activated carbon and deodorising units with a neutralising pond after the outlet; air cleaners and smoke extraction inspected every five years
d_en: Work may be done in an open outdoor yard; grit chambers and aeration units with a buffer pond before the inlet; general lighting and typhoon protection inspected once every three years
explain_zh: 第4條第1、2、4、5、6款：處理應在四周有圍籬或圍牆之廠（場）區內進行，作業區應具排水及污染物截流設施，廠（場）區應設置油類或液體之截流、收集、油水分離等防治設施，作業區油水分離設施進流口前應設置攔污柵，並應設消防安全設備及避雷設備或接地設備且定期檢修。

law: 廢機動車輛回收貯存清除處理方法及設施標準
category: 廢機動車輛標準-補貼資格
q_zh: 向資源回收管理基金申請廢機動車輛回收清除處理補貼者，應符合何項資格與設備規定？
a_zh: 須為經同業公會推薦之汽車修理業者，並依消防法規設置自動撒水系統、火警受信總機及專用電錶等配合稽核認證之設備
b_zh: 須為取得工廠登記證之車輛製造業者，並依土壤污染防治規定設置地下水監測井、氣體偵測器及專用瓦斯表等配合稽核設備
c_zh: 須為責任業者或向主管機關辦理登記之回收、處理業，並依稽核認證作業手冊設置秤重計量設備、攝錄影監視系統及專用電表等配合設備
d_zh: 須為經地方主管機關許可之清除機構，並依環境影響評估規定設置連續自動監測設施、水質採樣器及專用水表等配合稽核之設備
q_en: Who may apply for recycling subsidies from the Recycling Fund, and what equipment is required?
a_en: Car repair shops recommended by a trade association, with automatic sprinkler systems, fire alarm receiver panels and dedicated meters under fire safety regulations
b_en: Vehicle manufacturers holding a factory registration certificate, with groundwater monitoring wells, gas detectors and dedicated gas meters under soil pollution rules
c_en: Responsible enterprises or registered recovery and treatment operators, with weighing devices, video surveillance and dedicated electricity meters per the audit manual
d_en: Clearance institutions permitted by the local authority, with continuous automatic monitoring devices, water samplers and dedicated water meters under the EIA rules
explain_zh: 第5條第1款：申請補貼者須為依本法第十六條第四項辦法規範之責任業者，或依本法第十八條第四項辦法向主管機關辦理登記之回收、處理業。第2款：應依中央主管機關所定稽核認證作業手冊，設置用以秤重之計量設備、攝錄影監視系統、專用電表或其他配合稽核認證之設備或措施。

law: 廢機動車輛回收貯存清除處理方法及設施標準
category: 廢機動車輛標準-補貼要件
q_zh: 申請廢機動車輛回收清除處理補貼者，關於停業應變、處理報告及廢車殼之規定為何？
a_zh: 不能從事處理時應由地方主管機關代為清理並於事後向業者求償；處理業僅須提具設備清單、操作人員名冊及保險證明；廢車殼得逕行輸出國外處理
b_zh: 不能從事處理時應向法院聲請保全並停止領取補貼費；處理業應提具土地權狀、建照執照及消防查驗證明；廢車殼僅需人工分類拆除即可申請補貼
c_zh: 不能從事處理時應對未處理完竣廢棄物提具處置應變計畫並經中央主管機關核定；處理業應提具型式、設備、流程、質量平衡圖及試運轉報告；廢車殼須經粉碎分類處理
d_zh: 不能從事處理時應由同業公會指定其他業者接手處理；處理業應提具財務報表、營業計畫書及環評承諾書；廢車殼經壓縮打包後即可直接出售鋼廠
q_en: What are the rules on contingency plans, treatment reports and scrap shells for subsidy applicants?
a_en: The local authority clears the waste and recovers costs afterwards; only equipment lists, staff rosters and insurance certificates; shells may be exported directly for treatment
b_en: A court injunction is sought and subsidies suspended; land titles, building permits and fire inspection certificates; shells only need manual sorting to qualify for subsidy
c_en: A contingency plan for unfinished waste approved by the central authority; reports on type, equipment, flow, mass balance and trial runs; shells must be shredded and sorted
d_en: The trade association assigns another operator to take over; financial statements, business plans and EIA commitments; shells may be baled and sold straight to steel mills
explain_zh: 第5條第3款：於自行停業、宣告破產或其他事由致不能從事處理業務時，應對尚未處理完竣之廢棄物提具處置應變計畫，並經中央主管機關核定。第4款：處理業者應提具清除、處理之型式、設備、流程、質量平衡圖及處理設備之試運轉報告。第6款：回收拆解後之廢車殼須經粉碎分類處理。

law: 廢機動車輛回收貯存清除處理方法及設施標準
category: 廢機動車輛標準-衍生廢棄物
q_zh: 廢機動車輛回收、貯存、清除、處理後衍生之廢棄物應如何清理？其輸出應符合何規定？
a_zh: 屬事業廢棄物者應依事業廢棄物貯存清除處理方法及設施標準辦理，並符合本法第二十八條規定之清理方式；其輸出應符合本法第三十八條規定
b_zh: 屬資源回收物者應依資源回收再利用法辦理再生利用，並符合該法第十五條規定之公告項目；其輸出應符合貿易法第十三條規定
c_zh: 屬一般廢棄物者應交由執行機關統一清運處理，並符合本法第十二條規定之分類方式；其輸出僅須向海關報備並取得同意文件
d_zh: 屬事業廢棄物者應依有害事業廢棄物認定標準逕行申報，並符合本法第三十九條規定之再利用方式；其輸出應符合本法第四十一條規定
q_en: How must waste derived from scrap vehicle handling be managed, and what governs its export?
a_en: Industrial waste follows the industrial waste storage and treatment standard and Article 28 of the Act; export must comply with Article 38
b_en: Recyclables are reused under the Resource Recycling Act as items announced under its Article 15; export must comply with Article 13 of the Trade Act
c_en: General waste is cleared by the executing agency and sorted under Article 12; export only requires filing with customs and a consent paper
d_en: Industrial waste is reported under the hazardous waste identification standard and reused under Article 39; export must comply with Article 41
explain_zh: 第6條第1項：衍生廢棄物應依本標準規定辦理；其屬事業廢棄物者，除應依事業廢棄物貯存清除處理方法及設施標準辦理貯存、清除、處理外，並應符合本法第二十八條規定之清理方式。第2項：前項衍生廢棄物之輸出，應符合本法第三十八條之規定。

law: 廢機動車輛回收貯存清除處理方法及設施標準
category: 廢機動車輛標準-改善期限
q_zh: 本標準修正前已從事回收、處理之業者，應於何時完成改善？該期限內如何處罰？
a_zh: 應於本標準修正發布後一年內完成改善；回收、處理業於該改善期限內仍按次處罰
b_zh: 應於本標準修正發布後六個月內完成改善；回收、處理業於該改善期限內免予處罰
c_zh: 應於本標準修正發布後二年內完成改善；回收、處理業於該改善期限內應暫停營業
d_zh: 應於本標準修正發布後三個月內完成改善；回收、處理業於該改善期限內減半處罰
q_en: By when must existing operators complete improvements, and are penalties imposed meanwhile?
a_en: Within one year of the amendment being promulgated; penalties still apply on a per-instance basis
b_en: Within six months of the amendment being promulgated; no penalties during that improvement period
c_en: Within two years of the amendment being promulgated; operations must be suspended meanwhile
d_en: Within three months of the amendment being promulgated; penalties are halved during that period
explain_zh: 第7條第1項：本標準修正前已從事回收、處理之業者，應於本標準修正發布後六個月內完成改善。第2項：回收、處理業於前項改善期限內，免予處罰。

law: 廢機動車輛回收貯存清除處理方法及設施標準
category: 廢機動車輛標準-施行日
q_zh: 本標準之施行日期如何規定？
a_zh: 本標準自中華民國一百年一月一日施行，不溯及既往
b_zh: 本標準自發布後三個月施行，並就貯存規定另定緩衝期
c_zh: 本標準自發布日施行，未另定緩衝或分階段施行之日期
d_zh: 本標準自發布後六個月施行，其餘條文自發布日施行
q_en: When does this Standard take effect?
a_en: It takes effect on 1 January 2011 and does not apply retroactively at all
b_en: It takes effect three months after promulgation, with a grace period for storage
c_en: It takes effect on the date of promulgation, with no phased or deferred dates
d_en: It takes effect six months after promulgation, other articles on promulgation
explain_zh: 第8條：本標準自發布日施行，並未定分階段施行日期。第7條則對本標準修正前已從事回收、處理之業者，給予修正發布後六個月之改善期間，並於期限內免予處罰。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-授權依據
q_zh: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法之授權依據為何？
a_zh: 依廢棄物清理法第十六條第四項規定訂定之
b_zh: 依資源回收再利用法第十五條第四項訂定之
c_zh: 依廢棄物清理法第十八條第六項規定訂定之
d_zh: 依廢棄物清理法第十八條第三項規定訂定之
q_en: What is the legal basis of these Regulations?
a_en: Article 16, paragraph 4 of the Waste Disposal Act
b_en: Article 15, paragraph 4 of the Resource Recycling Act
c_en: Article 18, paragraph 6 of the Waste Disposal Act
d_en: Article 18, paragraph 3 of the Waste Disposal Act
explain_zh: 第1條：本辦法依據廢棄物清理法第十八條第六項規定訂定之。第22條並定本辦法自發布日施行；第4條則明定補貼費之核發管理由中央主管機關為之。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-稽核認證量
q_zh: 本辦法所稱稽核認證量與補貼費之定義分別為何？
a_zh: 稽核認證量指業者自行申報之應回收廢棄物回收總數量；補貼費指補貼費率除以稽核認證量所得之金額
b_zh: 稽核認證量指主管機關公告之年度目標回收處理數量；補貼費指稽核認證量加計回收獎勵金後之金額
c_zh: 稽核認證量指經稽核認證得領取補貼費之應回收廢棄物數量；補貼費指稽核認證量乘以補貼費率所得之金額
d_zh: 稽核認證量指處理業實際投入處理設備之廢棄物重量；補貼費指再生料市場價值扣除處理成本之金額
q_en: How are audited certified volume and subsidy fee defined?
a_en: The quantity self-reported by operators; the subsidy equals the rate divided by the audited volume
b_en: The annual target volume announced by the authority; the subsidy equals the volume plus the reward
c_en: The audited quantity eligible for subsidy; the subsidy equals that volume multiplied by the subsidy rate
d_en: The waste weight actually fed into treatment plant; the subsidy equals market value minus costs
explain_zh: 第2條第2款：稽核認證量指經稽核認證，得領取回收清除處理補貼費之應回收廢棄物數量。第3款：補貼費率指每單位稽核認證量之補貼金額。第4款：補貼費指依稽核認證量乘以補貼費率所得之金額。第15條並定中央主管機關依稽核認證量核發補貼費。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-處理效能
q_zh: 本辦法所稱處理效能及有害物質回收或去除比率之定義為何？
a_zh: 處理效能指再生料售價與處理成本之比值；後者指去除之有害物質體積占廠區排放廢水總體積之容積百分比
b_zh: 處理效能指資源回收再利用比率及有害物質回收或去除比率；後者指所回收或去除之有害物質重量占所含有害物質總量之重量百分比
c_zh: 處理效能指設備妥善率及年度稼動率之加權平均值；後者指所回收有害物質重量占全廠處理總產值之重量百分比
d_zh: 處理效能指稽核認證量占最大處理量之比率；後者指有害物質檢測合格件數占全年抽驗總件數之數量百分比
q_en: How are treatment performance and the hazardous substance recovery or removal ratio defined?
a_en: Performance is the ratio of recycled material price to treatment cost; the latter is hazardous volume removed over total wastewater discharged
b_en: Performance covers the recycling ratio and the hazardous substance ratio; the latter is hazardous weight recovered or removed over total hazardous content
c_en: Performance is the weighted average of equipment availability and utilisation; the latter is hazardous weight recovered over the plant's total output value
d_en: Performance is audited volume over maximum treatment capacity; the latter is passing test items over all items sampled during the year
explain_zh: 第2條第7款：處理效能指處理應回收廢棄物之資源回收再利用比率及有害物質回收或去除比率。第9款：有害物質回收或去除比率指經處理後所回收或去除之有害物質重量，占處理應回收廢棄物所含有害物質總量之重量百分比。第14條第1項第6款並定處理業連續一年未達規定處理效能得廢止受補貼機構。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-再生料定義
q_zh: 本辦法所稱再生料，其定義為何？
a_zh: 指應回收廢棄物經回收處理後經中央主管機關認定者，或其產出之廢棄物依本法第三十九條再利用，或經公告核准為再生資源項目者
b_zh: 指應回收廢棄物經輸出國外處理後回運國內者，或其產出之廢棄物依本法第三十八條取得輸入同意文件者
c_zh: 指應回收廢棄物經破碎分選後未達管制標準者，或其產出之廢棄物依本法第二十八條自行清理並取得地方主管機關同意者
d_zh: 指應回收廢棄物經稽核認證後領有補貼費者，或其產出之廢棄物依本法第四十一條委託清除機構清運處理完竣者
q_en: How is recycled material defined in these Regulations?
a_en: Output recognised by the central authority, or waste reused under Article 39 of the Act or announced or approved as a renewable resource item
b_en: Output exported for treatment and shipped back home, or waste holding an import consent document under Article 38
c_en: Output that fails control standards after shredding, or waste self-cleared under Article 28 of the Act with local authority consent
d_en: Output for which subsidy has been drawn after audit, or waste cleared by a contracted clearance institution under Article 41
explain_zh: 第2條第5款：再生料指應回收廢棄物經回收處理後，經中央主管機關認定者，或其產出之廢棄物符合依本法第三十九條進行再利用，或依資源回收再利用法第十五條公告或經申請核准為再生資源項目者。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-申請前提
q_zh: 責任業者及回收業、處理業須完成何種程序，始得接受稽核認證及申請補貼費？
a_zh: 應先經主管機關登記為回收業、處理業，並向中央主管機關申請成為受補貼機構後，始得接受稽核認證及申請補貼費
b_zh: 應先完成稽核認證並取得認證量證明，再向主管機關辦理回收業、處理業之登記，始得成為受補貼之機構
c_zh: 應先向同業公會報備並取得會員資格，再向地方主管機關申請補貼帳戶後，即得接受稽核認證並請領補貼費
d_zh: 應先取得工廠登記及環境影響評估通過證明，並向中央主管機關報備營運計畫，即得逕行接受稽核認證領費
q_en: What must operators complete before they may be audited and apply for subsidies?
a_en: Register with the competent authority as a recovery or treatment operator, then apply to the central authority to become a subsidised institution
b_en: Complete the audit and obtain a certified volume proof, then register with the competent authority as a recovery or treatment operator
c_en: File with the trade association for membership, then apply to the local competent authority for a subsidy account before being audited
d_en: Obtain a factory registration and an EIA approval, then file an operating plan with the central competent authority and draw subsidies
explain_zh: 第3條：責任業者及回收業、處理業應先經主管機關登記為回收業、處理業，並依本辦法向中央主管機關申請成為受補貼機構後，始得接受稽核認證及申請補貼費。第2條第1款並定受補貼機構係指依本辦法取得領取補貼資格之機構。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-主管機關
q_zh: 補貼費之核發管理由何機關為之？受補貼機構之申請又向何機關提出？
a_zh: 補貼費核發管理由目的事業主管機關為之；受補貼機構之申請由公會轉陳提出
b_zh: 補貼費核發管理由地方主管機關為之；受補貼機構之申請則向中央主管機關提出
c_zh: 補貼費核發管理由中央主管機關為之；受補貼機構之申請亦向中央主管機關提出
d_zh: 補貼費核發管理由執行機關為之；受補貼機構之申請向所在地地方主管機關提出
q_en: Which authority administers subsidy payments, and where are applications filed?
a_en: The industry regulator administers payments, and applications are relayed by trade associations
b_en: The local competent authority administers payments, while applications go to the central one
c_en: The central competent authority administers payments, and applications are also filed with it
d_en: The executing agency administers payments, and applications go to the local authority in charge
explain_zh: 第4條：補貼費之核發管理由中央主管機關為之。第3條並定回收業、處理業應依本辦法向中央主管機關申請成為受補貼機構；第11條則定中央主管機關受理申請及變更之審查期限。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-補貼費率
q_zh: 中央主管機關訂定應回收廢棄物補貼費率時，應經何程序審議？並得考慮哪些因素？
a_zh: 應經地方主管機關公聽會通過；並得考慮土地公告現值、水電費調幅、清運距離遠近、車輛油耗成本及勞工基本工資之調整幅度
b_zh: 應經資源回收費率審議委員會審議；並得考慮目標回收處理量、回收貯存清除處理成本、回收獎勵金數額、處理效能、再生料市場價值及基金財務狀況
c_zh: 應經行政院環境保護基金管理會核定；並得考慮業者資本額、員工人數、廠區面積、設備折舊年限、貸款利率高低及同業平均利潤率等因素
d_zh: 應經立法院預算委員會同意後公告；並得考慮國民所得水準、物價指數變動、進口原料關稅、匯率波動幅度及國際碳價走勢等相關因素
q_en: What process and factors govern the setting of subsidy rates?
a_en: Adoption at a local authority public hearing, considering land values, utility price changes, haul distance, fuel costs and minimum wage adjustments
b_en: Review by the Recycling Fee Rate Review Committee, considering target volumes, costs, reward amounts, treatment performance, material value and fund finances
c_en: Approval by the environmental fund management board, considering capital, headcount, plant area, depreciation, loan rates and average industry profit
d_en: Consent of the legislature's budget committee, considering national income, price indices, import tariffs, exchange rates and international carbon prices
explain_zh: 第5條：中央主管機關得考慮應回收廢棄物之目標回收處理量、回收貯存清除處理成本、回收獎勵金數額、處理效能、再生料市場價值及稽核認證作業成本、資源回收管理基金財務狀況及其他相關因素，經資源回收費率審議委員會審議後，訂定補貼費率。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-回收業申請文件
q_zh: 回收業申請受補貼機構，應檢具之文件包括下列何者？
a_zh: 土地登記謄本及使用分區證明、勞工安全衛生管理計畫、稽核認證量證明、廠區周圍一公里範圍內之空氣品質報告
b_zh: 回收項目及最大貯存量說明、分類壓縮打包方法及設施說明、緊急應變措施計畫、廠（場）區周圍二公里範圍內之相關位置圖
c_zh: 資本額查核簽證報告、員工在職證明及財產保險單、廠區周圍十公里範圍內之地下水監測井分布位置圖及檢測報告
d_zh: 處理流程及處理設備說明、處理效能及質量平衡說明、實廠運轉報告、廠（場）區周圍五公里範圍內之相關位置圖
q_en: Which documents must a recovery operator file when applying to be a subsidised institution?
a_en: Land registry transcripts and zoning certificates, an occupational safety plan, audited volume proof, and an air quality report for 1 km around the plant
b_en: Items and maximum storage capacity, sorting and baling methods and facilities, an emergency response plan, and a site map covering 2 km around the plant
c_en: Capital verification reports, employment certificates and property insurance policies, and a groundwater monitoring well map covering 10 km around the plant
d_en: Treatment flow and equipment, treatment performance and mass balance, a full-scale trial run report, and a site map covering 5 km around the plant
explain_zh: 第6條第1項各款：回收業申請受補貼機構應檢具申請表及核准設立證明、回收項目及最大貯存量說明、分類壓縮打包方法及設施說明、貯存方法及設施說明、污染防制（治）措施說明、稽核認證作業區域配置圖、緊急應變措施計畫、清理計畫及廠（場）區周圍二公里範圍內相關位置圖。第2項與登記文件內容相同者得免檢具。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-實廠運轉
q_zh: 處理業申請受補貼機構，關於實廠運轉計畫與實廠運轉報告之規定為何？
a_zh: 應依同業公會建議意見修正實廠運轉計畫，並於取得補貼費後六個月內提送實廠運轉報告
b_zh: 應依地方主管機關審查意見修正實廠運轉計畫，並於試運轉結束後三個月內補送實廠運轉報告
c_zh: 應依技師簽證意見修正實廠運轉計畫，並於每年一月底前檢送前一年度之實廠運轉報告
d_zh: 應依中央主管機關審查意見修正實廠運轉計畫，並記錄結果做成實廠運轉報告，於現場勘查前提送
q_en: What are the rules on the full-scale operation plan and report for treatment operators?
a_en: Revise the plan per trade association suggestions, and submit the report within six months of receiving the subsidy
b_en: Revise the plan per the local authority's review comments, and submit the report within three months after the trial run
c_en: Revise the plan per the licensed engineer's comments, and submit last year's report by the end of January each year
d_en: Revise the plan per the central authority's review comments, record results in a report, and submit it before the site inspection
explain_zh: 第7條第3項：處理業應依中央主管機關審查意見修正第1項第8款之實廠運轉計畫，並記錄結果做成同項第9款之實廠運轉報告，並於現場勘查前提送。第1項第8款並定實廠運轉計畫應記載作業期間及操作時數、處理項目及投入量、處理效能。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-免檢具文件
q_zh: 處理業採輸出處理，或於登記後六個月內申請受補貼機構者，有何免檢具文件之規定？
a_zh: 採輸出處理者免檢具處理流程設備、再生料種類、處理效能質量平衡、實廠運轉計畫及報告、現場勘查運轉計畫；登記後六個月內申請並經中央主管機關同意者，免檢具實廠運轉計畫及報告
b_zh: 採輸出處理者免檢具稽核認證設施說明、廠區配置圖及緊急應變計畫等文件；登記後二年內申請並經中央主管機關備查者，免檢具再生料種類及最大產出量之說明文件
c_zh: 採輸出處理者免檢具貯存方法設施、污染防制措施、緊急應變計畫、廠區配置圖及位置圖等文件；登記後一年內申請並經地方主管機關同意者，免檢具處理流程及處理設備之說明文件
d_zh: 採輸出處理者免檢具政府機關核准設立證明、處理項目及最大處理量說明等文件；登記後三個月內申請並經同業公會推薦者，免檢具稽核認證設施及其運作方式之說明文件
q_en: What documents may be omitted by exporting treatment operators, or by those applying within six months of registration?
a_en: Exporters omit treatment flow and equipment, recycled material types, performance and mass balance, full-scale plans and reports, and inspection run plans; applicants within six months, with consent, omit the full-scale plan and report
b_en: Exporters omit audit facility statements, plant layout drawings and emergency response plans; applicants within two years, recorded by the central authority, omit recycled material type and output documents
c_en: Exporters omit storage methods and facilities, pollution control measures, emergency response plans, layout drawings and location maps; applicants within one year, with local consent, omit treatment flow and equipment documents
d_en: Exporters omit government establishment certificates and statements of treatment items and maximum capacity; applicants within three months, recommended by a trade body, omit audit facility and operation documents
explain_zh: 第7條第2項：處理業採輸出處理者，免檢具第1項第3款處理流程及設備、第4款再生料及其他廢棄物種類、第6款處理效能及質量平衡、第8款實廠運轉計畫、第9款實廠運轉報告及第10款現場勘查運轉計畫等文件。第4項：處理業登記後六個月內申請受補貼機構且經中央主管機關同意者，免檢具第8款及第9款文件。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-回收業變更
q_zh: 受補貼機構之回收業辦理文件變更，各款之辦理期限規定為何？
a_zh: 核准設立證明文件變更者於變更後十五日內辦理；回收項目、貯存方法、污染防制措施等變更者於主管機關核定後十五日內辦理
b_zh: 核准設立證明文件變更者於變更後三十日內辦理；回收項目、貯存方法、污染防制措施等變更者於主管機關核定後三十日內辦理
c_zh: 核准設立證明文件變更者於變更前七日內辦理；回收項目、貯存方法、污染防制措施等變更者應於變更前先報請中央主管機關核准
d_zh: 核准設立證明文件變更者於次年度一併辦理；回收項目、貯存方法、污染防制措施等變更者於主管機關核定後六個月內辦理
q_en: What deadlines apply to document changes by a subsidised recovery operator?
a_en: Establishment certificate changes within 15 days of the change; item, storage and pollution control changes within 15 days of the authority's approval
b_en: Establishment certificate changes within 30 days of the change; item, storage and pollution control changes within 30 days of the authority's approval
c_en: Establishment certificate changes within 7 days before the change; item, storage and pollution control changes need prior central authority approval
d_en: Establishment certificate changes are handled in the following year; item, storage and pollution control changes within 6 months of approval
explain_zh: 第8條第2項：第1項第1款政府機關核准設立證明文件變更者，應於變更後十五日內檢具證明文件辦理；第2款至第5款（回收項目及最大貯存量、分類壓縮打包方法及設施、貯存方法及設施、污染防制措施）變更者，應於主管機關核定後十五日內辦理；第6款者依中央主管機關指定期限辦理。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-處理業變更
q_zh: 受補貼機構之處理業，稽核認證設施及其運作方式變更時，應於何時辦理？其他各款期限為何？
a_zh: 稽核認證設施變更應於變更後三十日內檢具文件辦理；核准設立證明變更者於變更後六十日內辦理，處理項目等變更者於核定後三十日內辦理
b_zh: 稽核認證設施變更應於變更前檢具說明文件辦理；核准設立證明變更者於變更後十五日內辦理，處理項目等變更者於主管機關核定後十五日內辦理
c_zh: 稽核認證設施變更應於變更後十五日內檢具文件辦理；核准設立證明變更者於變更前辦理，處理項目等變更者於主管機關核定前先行辦理
d_zh: 稽核認證設施變更應於每季結束後十五日內併同申報；核准設立證明變更者於年度終了時辦理，處理項目等變更者於次年一月底前辦理
q_en: When must changes to audit facilities be filed by a subsidised treatment operator, and what of other items?
a_en: Audit facility changes within 30 days after the change; establishment certificate changes within 60 days, and item changes within 30 days of approval
b_en: Audit facility changes before the change takes place; establishment certificate changes within 15 days after, and item changes within 15 days of approval
c_en: Audit facility changes within 15 days after the change; establishment certificate changes beforehand, and item changes before the authority approves them
d_en: Audit facility changes reported quarterly within 15 days; establishment certificate changes at year end, and item changes by the end of next January
explain_zh: 第9條第2項：第1項第1款政府機關核准設立證明變更者，於變更後十五日內辦理；第2款至第7款（處理項目及最大處理量、處理流程及設備、產出物種類及去化方式、貯存方法及設施、污染防制措施、廠區配置）變更者，於主管機關核定後十五日內辦理；第8款稽核認證設施及其運作方式變更者，應於變更前辦理。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-網路傳輸
q_zh: 回收業、處理業辦理申請、變更受補貼機構之方式為何？經同意以書面辦理者另有何義務？
a_zh: 應依中央主管機關規定格式以網路傳輸方式辦理；經同意以書面辦理者，應於核准登記為受補貼機構後一個月內以網路傳輸登錄核定文件
b_zh: 應依中央主管機關規定格式以掛號郵寄方式辦理；經同意以網路辦理者，應於核准登記為受補貼機構後六個月內完成系統帳號之註冊
c_zh: 應依同業公會規定格式以電子郵件方式辦理；經同意以書面辦理者，應於核准登記為受補貼機構後一年內以網路傳輸登錄相關文件
d_zh: 應依地方主管機關規定格式以書面遞送方式辦理；經同意以網路辦理者，應於核准登記為受補貼機構後三個月內補送全部紙本核定文件
q_en: How are applications and changes filed, and what extra duty applies to paper filings?
a_en: By online transmission in the central authority's format; those allowed to file on paper must upload the approved documents within one month of approval
b_en: By registered mail in the central authority's format; those allowed to file online must complete system account registration within six months
c_en: By email in the trade association's format; those allowed to file on paper must upload the relevant documents within one year of approval
d_en: By paper delivery in the local authority's format; those allowed to file online must submit full paper copies within three months of approval
explain_zh: 第10條第1項：回收業、處理業應依中央主管機關規定之格式、內容，以網路傳輸方式辦理申請、變更受補貼機構；但經中央主管機關同意以書面辦理者不在此限。第2項：以書面方式辦理者，應於核准登記為受補貼機構後一個月內，以網路傳輸方式登錄中央主管機關核定之受補貼機構文件。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-審查期限
q_zh: 中央主管機關受理受補貼機構之申請及變更，其審查期限規定為何？
a_zh: 辦理現場勘查者應於一百二十日內完成審查，未辦理現場勘查者應於九十日內完成審查並作成准駁決定，不得再行延長
b_zh: 辦理現場勘查者應於六十日內完成審查，未辦理現場勘查者應於三十日內完成審查並作成准駁決定，必要時得延長三十日
c_zh: 辦理現場勘查者應於九十日內完成審查，未辦理現場勘查者應於六十日內完成審查並作成准駁決定，必要時得延長六十日
d_zh: 辦理現場勘查者應於三十日內完成審查，未辦理現場勘查者應於十五日內完成審查並作成准駁決定，必要時得延長十五日
q_en: What review deadlines apply to applications and changes for subsidised institutions?
a_en: 120 days where a site inspection is held and 90 days where it is not, with a decision made; no extension of the period is permitted
b_en: 60 days where a site inspection is held and 30 days where it is not, with a decision made; one 30-day extension is allowed if needed
c_en: 90 days where a site inspection is held and 60 days where it is not, with a decision made; one 60-day extension is allowed if needed
d_en: 30 days where a site inspection is held and 15 days where it is not, with a decision made; one 15-day extension is allowed if needed
explain_zh: 第11條第1項：辦理現場勘查者應於六十日內完成審查，未辦理現場勘查者應於三十日內完成審查並做成准駁決定，必要時得延長審查期限三十日。第2項：文件不合法定程序及格式而可補正者，應通知限期補正，屆期未補正者駁回申請，補正日數不計入審查期限。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-現場勘查
q_zh: 中央主管機關受理受補貼機構相關案件時，何者應辦理現場勘查？
a_zh: 受理所有回收業與處理業之申請及變更一律應辦理現場勘查；僅補正文件之案件得免辦現場勘查而改採書面審查之方式辦理
b_zh: 受理其他回收業之申請應辦理現場勘查；受理處理業及廢機動車輛回收業之申請採書面審查，必要時得委託專業機構查核
c_zh: 受理處理業之變更應辦理現場勘查；受理處理業、廢機動車輛回收業之新申請案件一律採書面審查，不得另行辦理現場勘查
d_zh: 受理處理業、廢機動車輛回收業之申請應辦理現場勘查；受理其他回收業之申請及受補貼機構之變更採書面審查，必要時得辦理現場勘查
q_en: Which subsidised institution cases require an on-site inspection?
a_en: All applications and changes by recovery and treatment operators require an on-site inspection; only document correction cases may instead be handled by paper review
b_en: Applications by other recovery operators require an on-site inspection; treatment and scrap vehicle recovery applications are reviewed on paper, with outside experts if needed
c_en: Changes filed by treatment operators require an on-site inspection; new applications by treatment and scrap vehicle recovery operators are always reviewed on paper only
d_en: Applications by treatment operators and scrap vehicle recovery operators require inspection; other recovery applications and changes are reviewed on paper, with inspection if needed
explain_zh: 第11條第3項：中央主管機關受理處理業、廢機動車輛回收業受補貼機構之申請，應辦理現場勘查；受理其他回收業受補貼機構之申請及受補貼機構之變更，採書面審查，必要時得辦理現場勘查。第1項並定辦理現場勘查者審查期限為六十日。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-產出物流向
q_zh: 受補貼機構回收或處理應回收廢棄物後，其產出之其他應回收廢棄物應如何處理？
a_zh: 應由該類應回收廢棄物之受補貼機構處理業處理
b_zh: 應由原受補貼機構自行處理而不得委託他人
c_zh: 應輸出國外由合格處理業者代為處理完竣
d_zh: 應交由地方主管機關指定之執行機關清運
q_en: How must other recyclable waste produced by a subsidised institution be handled?
a_en: It must be treated by a subsidised treatment operator for that category of recyclable waste
b_en: It must be treated by the original subsidised institution itself and not contracted out
c_en: It must be exported abroad and treated to completion by a qualified operator
d_en: It must be hauled away by the executing agency designated by the local authority
explain_zh: 第12條：受補貼機構回收或處理應回收廢棄物後，其產出之其他應回收廢棄物，應由該類應回收廢棄物之受補貼機構處理業處理。第2條第5款並定再生料須經中央主管機關認定或依法再利用。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-停止補貼
q_zh: 受補貼機構有何情形，中央主管機關應停止補貼並撤銷或廢止稽核認證量及追繳已領補貼費？
a_zh: 未依規定辦理文件變更或登錄經通知限期辦理屆期仍未辦理者；涉違法領取補貼費經起訴並一審判決有罪者；違反附表所列環保法令遭主管機關處分者
b_zh: 連續三個月未申請稽核認證者；處理效能連續二年未達標準者；自行申請廢止受補貼機構者；應回收廢棄物項目經公告廢止者
c_zh: 稽核認證量證明文件保存未滿三年者；未以匯撥方式領取補貼費者；未參加中央主管機關辦理之教育訓練者；溢領補貼費未返還者
d_zh: 未於期限內檢送統一發票或收據者；匯款帳戶戶名與機構名稱不符者；未依印花稅法辦理者；信託基金帳戶餘額不敷支應補貼費者
q_en: In which cases must the central authority suspend subsidies and claw back amounts already paid?
a_en: Failure to file changes or upload documents after a deadline notice; indictment and first-instance conviction for unlawful subsidy claims; sanctions for breaching listed environmental laws
b_en: No audit application for three consecutive months; treatment performance below standard for two straight years; voluntary withdrawal; the waste item being revoked by announcement
c_en: Keeping audit certificates for under three years; not drawing subsidies by bank remittance; not attending training courses run by the central authority; failing to return overpaid subsidies
d_en: Failure to submit invoices or receipts on time; a remittance account name not matching the institution; failure to comply with stamp duty law; a trust account short of funds
explain_zh: 第13條各款：受補貼機構有第8條第1項或第9條第1項情形而未依規定辦理變更，經通知限期辦理屆期仍未辦理；未依第10條登錄文件經通知限期辦理屆期仍未辦理；涉違法領取補貼費經檢察機關起訴並經一審判決有罪；經認定不當領取補貼費；或回收清除處理違反附表之環保法令遭處分者，中央主管機關應停止補貼並撤銷或廢止稽核認證量及追繳補貼費。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-停止期間
q_zh: 受補貼機構涉違法領取補貼費經起訴並一審判決有罪者，停止補貼之期間如何計算？
a_zh: 自判決書送達日起至無涉違法定讞為止；經認定不當領取者，自不當領取日起至行政救濟確定為止
b_zh: 自主管機關通知之日起至完成改善為止；經認定不當領取者，自次一補貼期起停止核發滿三年止
c_zh: 自起訴日起至檢察官為不起訴處分為止；經認定不當領取者，自查獲日起至繳回全部補貼費為止
d_zh: 自二審判決確定日起至刑期執行完畢為止；經認定不當領取者，自處分書送達日起算滿一年為止
q_en: How is the suspension period counted for a first-instance conviction over unlawful subsidy claims?
a_en: From service of the judgment until a final ruling clears the institution; for improper claims, from the claim date until the remedy is final
b_en: From the authority's notice until improvement is complete; for improper claims, three years starting from the next subsidy period
c_en: From the indictment date until the prosecutor decides not to prosecute; for improper claims, from detection until all subsidies are repaid
d_en: From the second-instance judgment until the sentence is served; for improper claims, one year from service of the disposition notice
explain_zh: 第13條第3款：涉違法領取補貼費經檢察機關起訴並經一審判決有罪者，自判決書送達日起至無涉違法定讞為止。第4款：除前款規定外，經中央主管機關認定不當領取補貼費者，自不當領取日起至行政救濟確定為止。第14條第1項第10款並定有此二種情事者得撤銷或廢止受補貼機構。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-撤銷廢止
q_zh: 中央主管機關得撤銷或廢止受補貼機構之情形，包括下列何者？
a_zh: 申請文件字跡不清、未依規定參加講習、廠區未設置警衛人員、連續三個月以上未申報營運統計、處理業連續二年未達規定之資本額標準
b_zh: 未依規定保存文件五年、未設置專責人員、未參與公會活動、連續二季未提送季報表、處理業連續三年未達規定之再生料銷售金額
c_zh: 未於期限內繳納審查費、帳號戶名不符、未辦理公共意外責任保險、連續一年以上未辦理員工體檢、處理業連續六個月未達稽核認證量
d_zh: 申請文件虛偽不實、違反法令受勒令歇業處分、違反環保法令受停工停業處分、連續六個月以上未申請回收處理量稽核認證、處理業連續一年未達規定處理效能
q_en: Which grounds allow revocation of subsidised institution status?
a_en: Illegible application documents, missed training sessions, no plant security guards, three consecutive months without statistics filings, and two years below the capital threshold
b_en: Documents kept under five years, no dedicated personnel, no trade association activity, two quarters without reports, and three years below the sales target
c_en: Unpaid review fees, mismatched account names, no public liability insurance, a year without staff health checks, and six months below the audited volume target
d_en: False application documents, an order to cease business, suspension for environmental breaches, six consecutive months without an audit request, and a year below required performance
explain_zh: 第14條第1項各款：申請文件虛偽不實、違反法令受勒令歇業處分、違反環保法令受停工停業處分、經登記機關撤銷或廢止登記、連續六個月以上未申請回收處理量稽核認證、處理業連續一年未達規定處理效能、項目經公告廢止、自行申請廢止、依土污法認定為污染行為人，或有第13條第3款、第4款情事者，得撤銷或廢止受補貼機構。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-重新申請限制
q_zh: 受補貼機構經撤銷或廢止後，其重新申請之限制規定為何？
a_zh: 因文件虛偽不實、勒令歇業、停工停業、撤銷廢止登記或認定為污染行為人者，二年內不得於全國各地重新申請；因涉違法或不當領取而撤銷廢止者，十年內不得申請且負責人終身不得擔任受補貼機構負責人
b_zh: 因文件虛偽不實、勒令歇業、停工停業、撤銷廢止登記或認定為污染行為人者，三個月內不得於同一廠址重新申請；因涉違法或不當領取而撤銷廢止者，二年內不得申請但其負責人不受任何限制得續任負責人
c_zh: 因文件虛偽不實、勒令歇業、停工停業、撤銷廢止登記或認定為污染行為人者，一年內不得於同一廠址重新申請；因涉違法或不當領取而撤銷廢止者，三年內不得申請且負責人三年內不得擔任受補貼機構負責人
d_zh: 因文件虛偽不實、勒令歇業、停工停業、撤銷廢止登記或認定為污染行為人者，六個月內不得於同一廠址重新申請；因涉違法或不當領取而撤銷廢止者，五年內不得申請且負責人五年內不得擔任受補貼機構負責人
q_en: What restrictions apply to reapplying after revocation?
a_en: For false documents, cease-business orders, suspensions, deregistration or polluter findings, two years anywhere nationwide; for unlawful or improper claims, ten years and a lifetime bar on the responsible person
b_en: For false documents, cease-business orders, suspensions, deregistration or polluter findings, three months at the same site; for unlawful or improper claims, two years, with no restriction at all on the responsible person
c_en: For false documents, cease-business orders, suspensions, deregistration or polluter findings, one year at the same site; for unlawful or improper claims, three years for the institution and its responsible person
d_en: For false documents, cease-business orders, suspensions, deregistration or polluter findings, six months at the same site; for unlawful or improper claims, five years for the institution and its responsible person
explain_zh: 第14條第2項：有第1項第1款至第4款及第9款情形者，於六個月內不得於同一廠（場）址重新申請受補貼機構。第3項：因第1項第10款（即第13條第3款、第4款涉違法或不當領取）撤銷或廢止者，該機構於五年內不得申請受補貼機構，其負責人於五年內不得擔任受補貼機構之負責人。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-核發依據
q_zh: 中央主管機關核發補貼費之依據為何？
a_zh: 依登記之最大處理量核發補貼
b_zh: 依實際銷售再生料之金額核發
c_zh: 依稽核認證量核發補貼費
d_zh: 依業者自行申報之回收量核發
q_en: On what basis does the central authority pay subsidies?
a_en: On the maximum registered treatment capacity
b_en: On the actual sales value of recycled material
c_en: On the audited certified volume
d_en: On the volume self-reported by operators
explain_zh: 第15條：中央主管機關依稽核認證量核發補貼費。第2條第4款並定補貼費係依稽核認證量乘以補貼費率所得之金額；第16條則定受補貼機構應檢送統一發票或收據申請補貼費。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-發票收據
q_zh: 受補貼機構申請補貼費時，統一發票或收據應註明哪些事項？記載錯誤時如何處理？
a_zh: 應註明營業人統一編號、開立日期及承辦人姓名；所載項目或金額有錯誤者，中央主管機關應逕予駁回並不得再重新提出申請
b_zh: 應註明應回收廢棄物項目、稽核認證量及補貼費金額；所載稽核認證量或補貼費金額有錯誤者，中央主管機關應通知於一定期限內補正
c_zh: 應註明再生料銷售對象、單價及運費金額；所載重量或金額有錯誤者，應由稽核認證團體重新認證後始得再申請補貼費
d_zh: 應註明處理設備型號、操作時數及用電度數；所載數量或金額有錯誤者，由中央主管機關逕行更正並按更正後金額核發補貼
q_en: What must invoices or receipts state, and what happens if they contain errors?
a_en: The tax ID, issue date and handler's name; where items or amounts are wrong, the authority rejects the claim outright and no new application may be made
b_en: The waste item, the audited volume and the subsidy amount; where the volume or amount is wrong, the authority notifies the institution to correct it within a set period
c_en: The buyer of recycled material, unit price and freight; where weights or amounts are wrong, the audit body must re-certify before a new claim is allowed
d_en: Equipment model, operating hours and electricity used; where quantities or amounts are wrong, the authority corrects them itself and pays the corrected amount
explain_zh: 第16條第1項：受補貼機構應於中央主管機關規定期限內，檢送統一發票或收據申請補貼費。第2項：發票及收據應註明應回收廢棄物項目、稽核認證量及補貼費金額，所載稽核認證量或補貼費金額有錯誤者，中央主管機關應通知於一定期限內補正。第3項：未依規定辦理者，得不於當期核發補貼費。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-匯撥戶名
q_zh: 受補貼機構領取補貼費採匯撥方式者，對匯款帳戶有何要求？以收據請領者應如何辦理？
a_zh: 匯款銀行帳號之戶名應與其機構名稱相同，帳號或戶名有變更者應以書面通知中央主管機關；以收據請領補貼費者應依印花稅法規定辦理
b_zh: 匯款銀行帳號應開立於指定之公股行庫，帳號或戶名有變更者須重新申請受補貼機構登記；以收據請領補貼費者應依所得稅法規定辦理
c_zh: 匯款銀行帳號之戶名應與負責人相同，帳號或戶名有變更者應以網路傳輸方式辦理變更；以收據請領補貼費者應依商業會計法辦理
d_zh: 匯款銀行帳號之戶名得為負責人個人名義，帳號或戶名有變更者應於次期申請時併同說明；以收據請領補貼費者應依營業稅法規定辦理
q_en: What account requirements apply to remittance payments, and what governs receipt-based claims?
a_en: The bank account name must match the institution's name, and changes must be notified in writing; receipt-based claims follow the Stamp Tax Act
b_en: The account must be opened at a designated state-owned bank, and changes require reapplication; receipt-based claims follow the Income Tax Act
c_en: The account name must match the responsible person, and changes must be filed online; receipt-based claims follow the Business Accounting Act
d_en: The bank account may be in the responsible person's own name, with changes explained in the next claim; receipt claims follow the Business Tax Act
explain_zh: 第17條：受補貼機構領取補貼費採匯撥方式者，匯款銀行帳號之戶名應與其機構名稱相同；其帳號或戶名有變更者，應以書面通知中央主管機關。以收據請領補貼費者，應依印花稅法之規定辦理。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-基金不足
q_zh: 應回收廢棄物項目信託基金帳戶餘額不敷支應該項目補貼費時，中央主管機關得如何處理？
a_zh: 得逕行降低補貼費率至餘額足敷支應為止並溯及既往適用
b_zh: 得依各機構規模大小分級核發並優先給付大型處理業者
c_zh: 得延期或分期核發補貼費，但對受補貼機構不得為差別待遇
d_zh: 得暫停受理稽核認證之申請並全面停止核發各項補貼費用
q_en: What may the central authority do when the item's trust account cannot cover subsidies?
a_en: Cut the subsidy rate directly until the balance suffices, applying the cut retroactively
b_en: Pay by tiers based on institution size, giving priority to large treatment operators
c_en: Defer or pay subsidies in instalments, without any discriminatory treatment among institutions
d_en: Suspend acceptance of audit applications and stop paying all subsidies across the board
explain_zh: 第18條：應回收廢棄物項目信託基金帳戶餘額不敷支應該項目之補貼費時，中央主管機關得延期或分期核發補貼費；但延期或分期核發時，對受補貼機構不得為差別待遇。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-法院執行命令
q_zh: 中央主管機關接獲法院之執行命令時，對受補貼機構得領取之補貼費應如何處理？
a_zh: 應通知受補貼機構限期改善，屆期未改善者始得停止核發其補貼費用
b_zh: 應俟行政救濟程序確定後，再決定是否核發補貼費予該受補貼機構本人
c_zh: 應先扣除應返還之補貼費及利息後，將其餘額全數撥付予該受補貼機構
d_zh: 應依法院之執行命令，停止核發予受補貼機構或直接撥付予受補貼機構之債權人
q_en: How must the central authority treat subsidies subject to a court enforcement order?
a_en: Notify the institution to improve within a period, and stop payment only if it fails to do so
b_en: Wait until administrative remedies are final before deciding whether to pay the institution
c_en: Deduct any subsidies and interest to be returned first and pay the balance to the institution
d_en: Follow the court order and stop paying the institution, or pay its creditors directly instead
explain_zh: 第19條：中央主管機關應依法院之執行命令，將受補貼機構得領取之補貼費，停止核發予受補貼機構或直接撥付予受補貼機構之債權人。第20條第2項並定應返還之補貼費及利息，得以尚未領取之補貼費抵充。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-溢領返還
q_zh: 受補貼機構經認定溢領補貼費者，應於何時返還？利息如何計算？
a_zh: 應於接獲通知之次日起六個月內返還，並自溢領之日起至返還之日止按行政執行法所定法定利率加計三倍之懲罰性利息
b_zh: 應於接獲通知之次日起三個月內返還，並自查獲之日起至返還之日止按溢領日之郵政儲金二年期定期儲金機動利率加計利息
c_zh: 應於接獲通知之當日起十五日內返還，並自通知之日起至返還之日止按銀行基準放款利率加計二倍之違約金及其滯納利息
d_zh: 應於接獲通知之次日起一個月內返還，並自溢領之日起至返還之日止按溢領日之郵政儲金一年期定期儲金固定利率加計利息
q_en: When must overpaid subsidies be returned, and how is interest calculated?
a_en: Within six months from the day after notice, with interest from the overpayment date at three times the statutory enforcement rate
b_en: Within three months from the day after notice, with interest from the detection date at the two-year postal time deposit floating rate
c_en: Within fifteen days from the day of notice, with interest from the notice date at twice the bank base lending rate plus late charges
d_en: Within one month from the day after notice, with interest from the overpayment date at the one-year postal time deposit fixed rate on that date
explain_zh: 第20條第1項：受補貼機構經認定溢領補貼費者，應於接獲通知之次日起一個月內返還溢領之補貼費；並自溢領之日起至返還之日止，按溢領日之郵政儲金一年期定期儲金固定利率加計利息。但不可歸責於受補貼機構者，免加計利息。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-免息與抵充
q_zh: 溢領補貼費之加計利息有何例外？應返還之補貼費及利息得如何處理？
a_zh: 已自行申報溢領情形者免加計利息；應返還之補貼費及利息，得由受補貼機構申請分五年無息分期繳納返還
b_zh: 不可歸責於受補貼機構者免加計利息；應返還之補貼費及利息，中央主管機關得以其尚未領取之補貼費抵充之
c_zh: 因主管機關計算錯誤者免返還本金；應返還之補貼費及利息，得由同業公會代為墊付後再向該機構追償
d_zh: 金額未達新臺幣一萬元者免加計利息；應返還之補貼費及利息，中央主管機關應逕移送行政執行分署強制執行
q_en: What is the exception to interest on overpayments, and how may the amount be settled?
a_en: No interest where the institution reported the overpayment itself; it may repay in interest-free instalments over five years
b_en: No interest where the institution is not at fault; the authority may offset the amount against subsidies not yet paid out
c_en: No principal repayment where the authority miscalculated; the trade association may advance payment and recover it later
d_en: No interest where the amount is under NT$10,000; the authority must refer the case for compulsory administrative enforcement
explain_zh: 第20條第1項但書：不可歸責於受補貼機構者，免加計利息。第2項：受補貼機構應返還之補貼費及利息，中央主管機關得以受補貼機構尚未領取之補貼費抵充之。第13條並定不當領取者應追繳已領取之補貼費。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
category: 補貼審核辦法-文件保存
q_zh: 受補貼機構之稽核認證量證明文件及其他申請補貼費相關文件，應保存多久備查？
a_zh: 應保存十年備查
b_zh: 應保存一年備查
c_zh: 應保存三年備查
d_zh: 應保存五年備查
q_en: How long must audit certificates and subsidy claim documents be kept?
a_en: Ten years for inspection
b_en: One year for inspection
c_en: Three years for inspection
d_en: Five years for inspection
explain_zh: 第21條：受補貼機構之稽核認證量證明文件及其他申請補貼費相關文件，應保存五年備查。第16條並定申請補貼費應檢送註明項目、稽核認證量及金額之統一發票或收據。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收清除處理補貼申請審核管理辦法
q_zh: 本辦法之施行日期規定為何？
a_zh: 本辦法自中華民國一百零八年一月一日施行
b_zh: 本辦法自發布日施行，未另定分階段施行之日期
c_zh: 本辦法自發布後三個月施行，並分階段適用之
d_zh: 本辦法自發布後六個月施行，並溯及既往適用
q_en: When do these Regulations take effect?
a_en: On 1 January 2019 under a separately set date
b_en: On the date of promulgation, with no phased effective dates
c_en: Three months after promulgation, applying in phases
d_en: Six months after promulgation, applying retroactively
explain_zh: 第22條：本辦法自發布日施行。第1條並定本辦法依廢棄物清理法第十八條第六項規定訂定；第4條定補貼費之核發管理由中央主管機關為之。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法
category: 回收處理業管理-授權依據
q_zh: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法係依據何項規定訂定？
a_zh: 依廢棄物清理法第十八條第三項及第四項規定訂定之
b_zh: 依廢棄物清理法第十六條第四項及第五項規定訂定之
c_zh: 依資源回收再利用法第十五條第三項及第四項訂定之
d_zh: 依廢棄物清理法第十八條第六項及第七項規定訂定之
q_en: Which statutory provisions are the legal basis of these Regulations?
a_en: Article 18, paragraphs 3 and 4 of the Waste Disposal Act
b_en: Article 16, paragraphs 4 and 5 of the Waste Disposal Act
c_en: Article 15, paragraphs 3 and 4 of the Resource Recycling Act
d_en: Article 18, paragraphs 6 and 7 of the Waste Disposal Act
explain_zh: 第1條：本辦法依廢棄物清理法第十八條第三項及第四項規定訂定之。第5條並定回收業、處理業應向登記機關完成登記，始得從事應回收廢棄物回收、處理業務；第27條定本辦法自發布日施行。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法
category: 回收處理業管理-適用對象
q_zh: 本辦法之適用對象及其規模如何規定？
a_zh: 廢機動車輛回收業；前款以外其他應回收廢棄物回收業回收貯存廠土地面積達五百平方公尺以上；應回收廢棄物清除業
b_zh: 廢機動車輛回收業；前款以外其他應回收廢棄物回收業回收貯存廠（場）土地面積達一千平方公尺以上；應回收廢棄物處理業
c_zh: 廢電子電器回收業；前款以外其他應回收廢棄物回收業回收貯存廠土地面積達三千平方公尺以上；一般廢棄物處理業
d_zh: 廢照明光源回收業；前款以外其他應回收廢棄物回收業回收貯存廠土地面積達一萬平方公尺以上；事業廢棄物處理業
q_en: Who is covered by these Regulations, and at what scale?
a_en: Scrap vehicle recovery operators; other recovery operators with a storage yard of 500 square metres or more; and recyclable waste clearance operators
b_en: Scrap vehicle recovery operators; other recovery operators with a storage yard of 1,000 square metres or more; and recyclable waste treatment operators
c_en: Waste appliance recovery operators; other recovery operators with a storage yard of 3,000 square metres or more; and general waste treatment operators
d_en: Waste lighting recovery operators; other recovery operators with a storage yard of 10,000 square metres or more; and industrial waste treatment operators
explain_zh: 第2條：本辦法適用對象及規模為廢機動車輛回收業、前款以外其他應回收廢棄物回收業回收貯存廠（場）土地面積達一千平方公尺以上者，及應回收廢棄物處理業。第25條並定未達第2條規模之回收業得依其申請適用本辦法辦理登記及申報。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法
category: 回收處理業管理-回收業處理業定義
q_zh: 本辦法所稱回收業與處理業之定義分別為何？
a_zh: 回收業指從事回收、清運、分類、壓縮、打包或貯存且無拆解行為者，但廢機動車輛回收業得從事拆解；處理業指以物理化學等方法達純化、精煉、分離、無害化或資源化，或輸出處理者
b_zh: 回收業指從事收集、運輸並得自行拆解及破碎之業者，但廢機動車輛回收業不得拆解；處理業指僅從事分類、壓縮及打包，或將應回收廢棄物委託他人代為輸出國外處理之業者
c_zh: 回收業指從事應回收廢棄物之稽核認證及補貼申請業務者，並得兼營拆解；處理業指從事再生料銷售及市場開發，或將應回收廢棄物運送至掩埋場最終處置之業者
d_zh: 回收業指受地方主管機關委託辦理資源回收車清運之業者，不得拆解；處理業指設置焚化爐從事應回收廢棄物之熱處理，或將其轉為衍生燃料販售之業者
q_en: How are recovery operators and treatment operators defined?
a_en: Recovery covers collection, haulage, sorting, compaction, baling or storage without dismantling, except scrap vehicle operators; treatment covers purifying, refining, separating, detoxifying or recycling, or export treatment
b_en: Recovery covers collection and transport with dismantling and shredding allowed, except for scrap vehicle operators; treatment covers only sorting, compaction and baling, or contracting others to export the waste abroad
c_en: Recovery covers audit certification and subsidy claim work and may include dismantling; treatment covers recycled material sales and market development, or hauling recyclable waste to landfill for disposal
d_en: Recovery covers collection rounds contracted by local authorities without dismantling; treatment covers incineration of recyclable waste, or converting it into derived fuel for sale on the market
explain_zh: 第3條第1款：回收業指從事應回收廢棄物之回收、清運、分類、壓縮、打包或貯存業務，且無拆解行為者；但廢機動車輛回收業得從事拆解行為。第2款：處理業指以物理、化學或其他處理方法改變其物理化學特性，達純化、精煉、分離、無害化或資源化處理之行為，或輸出處理應回收廢棄物之業務者。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法
category: 回收處理業管理-處理效能定義
q_zh: 本辦法所稱資源回收再利用比率與有害物質回收或去除比率之定義為何？
a_zh: 資源回收再利用比率指實際處理量占登記最大處理量之重量百分比；有害物質回收或去除比率指去除之有害物質體積占廠內廢水排放總量之容積百分比
b_zh: 資源回收再利用比率指處理後產出再生料售價占處理總成本之金額百分比；有害物質回收或去除比率指有害物質檢測合格件數占全年抽驗件數之數量百分比
c_zh: 資源回收再利用比率指處理後產出再生料重量占處理總量之重量百分比；有害物質回收或去除比率指回收或去除之有害物質重量占所含有害物質總量之重量百分比
d_zh: 資源回收再利用比率指稽核認證量占年度目標回收量之數量百分比；有害物質回收或去除比率指有害物質貯存容器數量占全廠容器總數之數量百分比
q_en: How are the recycling ratio and the hazardous substance recovery or removal ratio defined?
a_en: Actual throughput as a percentage of the registered maximum capacity; hazardous volume removed as a percentage of total wastewater discharged from the plant
b_en: Recycled material sales value as a percentage of total treatment cost; test items passing as a percentage of all hazardous substance items sampled during the year
c_en: Recycled material weight as a percentage of total waste treated; hazardous weight recovered or removed as a percentage of the hazardous content of the waste treated
d_en: Audited certified volume as a percentage of the annual target volume; hazardous storage containers as a percentage of all containers held across the whole plant
explain_zh: 第3條第6款：資源回收再利用比率指應回收廢棄物經處理後產出之再生料重量，占處理應回收廢棄物總量之重量百分比。第7款：有害物質回收或去除比率指經處理後所回收或去除之有害物質重量，占處理應回收廢棄物所含有害物質總量之重量百分比。第5款並定處理效能即此二比率。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法
category: 回收處理業管理-登記機關
q_zh: 本辦法所稱登記機關，就回收業與處理業分別為何？
a_zh: 回收業與處理業均為中央主管機關；地方主管機關僅負責受理申報及現場稽查，不得核發或撤銷其登記證
b_zh: 回收業為貯存廠（場）所在地直轄市、縣（市）主管機關；處理業為處理廠（場）所在地直轄市、縣（市）主管機關
c_zh: 回收業為負責人戶籍所在地主管機關；處理業為其主要再生料銷售對象所在地直轄市、縣（市）主管機關
d_zh: 回收業為機構登記所在地之中央主管機關；處理業為處理廠（場）所在地之直轄市、縣（市）主管機關轉陳中央核定
q_en: Which authority is the registration authority for recovery and for treatment operators?
a_en: For both recovery and treatment operators, the central authority; local authorities only receive filings and inspect, and cannot issue or revoke licences
b_en: For recovery operators, the municipal or county authority where the storage yard lies; for treatment operators, the authority where the treatment plant lies
c_en: For recovery operators, the authority where the responsible person is domiciled; for treatment operators, where its main recycled material buyer is located
d_en: For recovery operators, the central authority where the entity is registered; for treatment operators, the local authority which refers the case to the centre
explain_zh: 第4條：登記機關就回收業為貯存廠（場）所在地直轄市、縣（市）主管機關；就處理業為處理廠（場）所在地直轄市、縣（市）主管機關。第21條並定登記機關核准申請、變更、展延或撤銷、廢止登記時應副知中央主管機關。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法
category: 回收處理業管理-登記義務
q_zh: 回收業、處理業從事應回收廢棄物回收、處理業務前，應完成何項程序？
a_zh: 應向同業公會取得會員資格，始得從事回收、處理之業務
b_zh: 應向中央主管機關報備營運計畫，即得從事回收、處理業務
c_zh: 應向目的事業主管機關取得許可，即可從事回收處理業務
d_zh: 應向登記機關完成登記，始得從事應回收廢棄物回收、處理業務
q_en: What must recovery and treatment operators complete before starting business?
a_en: They must obtain membership of the relevant trade association before operating
b_en: They must file an operating plan with the central authority before operating
c_en: They must obtain a permit from the industry regulator before starting business
d_en: They must complete registration with the registration authority before operating
explain_zh: 第5條：回收業、處理業應向登記機關完成登記，始得從事應回收廢棄物回收、處理業務。第4條並定登記機關為廠（場）所在地直轄市、縣（市）主管機關；第6條定申請、變更、展延登記及申報應以網路傳輸方式辦理。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法
category: 回收處理業管理-網路傳輸
q_zh: 回收業、處理業辦理申請、變更、展延登記及申報作業之方式為何？
a_zh: 應依同業公會規定之格式以電子郵件方式辦理，但經登記機關同意以掛號郵寄辦理者不在此限
b_zh: 應依規定之格式、內容以書面遞送方式辦理，但經地方主管機關同意以網路辦理及申報者不在此限
c_zh: 應依目的事業主管機關格式以傳真方式辦理，但經中央主管機關同意以口頭報備者不在此限
d_zh: 應依規定之格式、內容、頻率以網路傳輸方式辦理，但經中央主管機關同意以書面辦理及申報者不在此限
q_en: How must applications, changes, renewals and reporting be filed?
a_en: Email in the format set by the trade association, unless the registration authority consents to filing by registered mail
b_en: Paper delivery in the prescribed format and content, unless the local authority consents to online filing and reporting instead
c_en: Fax in the format set by the industry regulator, unless the central authority consents to reporting verbally
d_en: Online transmission in the prescribed format, content and frequency, unless the central authority consents to paper filing and reporting
explain_zh: 第6條：回收業、處理業應依規定之格式、內容、頻率，以網路傳輸方式辦理申請、變更、展延登記及申報作業；但經中央主管機關同意以書面辦理及申報者，不在此限。第23條第2項並定應於每月十五日前依第6條規定申報前一個月營運情形。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法
category: 回收處理業管理-回收業申請文件
q_zh: 回收業申請登記時，應檢具之文件包括下列何者？
a_zh: 工廠登記證及水權狀、資本額查核簽證報告、勞工安全衛生管理計畫、公共意外責任保險單、廠區周圍一公里範圍內之空氣品質檢測報告
b_zh: 土地合法使用證明文件、回收項目及最大貯存量說明、分類壓縮打包方法及設施說明、緊急應變措施計畫、廠（場）區周圍二公里範圍內之相關位置圖
c_zh: 土地合法使用證明文件、處理流程及處理設備說明、處理效能及質量平衡說明、試運轉計畫書、廠（場）區周圍五公里範圍內之相關位置圖
d_zh: 環境影響評估審查結論、土壤及地下水品質背景調查報告、專責人員合格證書、廠區周圍十公里範圍內之地下水監測井分布位置圖
q_en: Which documents must a recovery operator file when applying for registration?
a_en: Factory registration and water rights, capital verification reports, an occupational safety plan, liability insurance, and an air quality report for 1 km around
b_en: Lawful land use proof, recovery items and maximum storage capacity, sorting and baling methods and facilities, an emergency response plan, and a site map covering 2 km around
c_en: Lawful land use proof, treatment flow and equipment documents, treatment performance and mass balance, a trial run plan, and a site map covering 5 km around the plant site
d_en: EIA review conclusions, soil and groundwater background survey reports, certificates for dedicated personnel, and a monitoring well map covering 10 km around
explain_zh: 第7條各款：回收業申請登記應檢具申請表、政府機關核准設立證明、土地合法使用證明、回收項目及最大貯存量說明、分類壓縮打包方法及設施說明、貯存方法及設施說明、廢機動車輛拆解作業流程（如從事拆解）、污染防制（治）措施說明、廠（場）區配置圖、緊急應變措施計畫、清理計畫及廠（場）區周圍二公里範圍內相關位置圖。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法
category: 回收處理業管理-處理業設置
q_zh: 處理業申請登記分為哪二階段？其設置階段之審查與效果為何？
a_zh: 分為勘查及認證二階段；應先檢具申請表、技師簽證報告、專責人員名冊及保險單送目的事業主管機關核准後，始得進行處理設施建造、裝置
b_zh: 分為設置及試運轉二階段；應先檢具申請表、核准設立證明、土地合法使用證明、設置計畫書及周圍二公里位置圖送登記機關審查核准設置後，始得進行處理設施建造、裝置
c_zh: 分為登記及展延二階段；應先檢具申請表、稽核認證量證明、財務報表及再生料銷售合約送登記機關審查核准後，始得進行處理設施之建造與裝置
d_zh: 分為試運轉及正式營運二階段；應先檢具申請表、環評結論、消防查驗證明及營運計畫書送中央主管機關審查核准後，始得進行處理設施之建造與裝置作業
q_en: What two stages apply to treatment operator registration, and what does the setup stage require?
a_en: Inspection and certification; an application, engineer certification reports, personnel rosters and insurance policies must be approved by the industry regulator before construction
b_en: Setup and trial run; an application, establishment proof, lawful land use proof, a setup plan and a 2 km site map must be approved by the registration authority before construction begins
c_en: Registration and renewal; an application, audited volume proof, financial statements and material sales contracts must be approved by the registration authority before construction
d_en: Trial run and formal operation; an application, EIA conclusions, fire inspection certificates and an operating plan must be approved by the central authority before construction begins
explain_zh: 第8條：處理業申請登記分為設置及試運轉二階段；其應先檢具申請表及政府機關核准設立證明文件、土地合法使用證明文件、設置計畫書（含處理項目及最大處理量、處理流程及設備、產出物種類及去化方式、貯存方法及設施、處理效能及質量平衡、污染防制措施、廠區配置圖、緊急應變計畫、清理計畫）、廠（場）區周圍二公里範圍內相關位置圖等，送登記機關審查核准設置後，始得進行處理設施建造、裝置。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法
category: 回收處理業管理-設置有效期限
q_zh: 處理業核准設置之有效期限為何？得否申請展延？
a_zh: 核准設置之有效期限為三年；期限屆滿前得檢具展延原因說明文件申請展延設置，以一次為限，核准之有效期限以一年為限
b_zh: 核准設置之有效期限為十年；期限屆滿前得檢具展延原因說明文件申請展延設置，以三次為限，每次核准期限為五年
c_zh: 核准設置之有效期限為五年；期限屆滿前得檢具展延原因說明文件申請展延設置，以二次為限，每次核准之有效期限為三年
d_zh: 核准設置之有效期限為一年；期限屆滿前得檢具展延原因說明文件申請展延設置，不限次數，每次核准期限均為六個月
q_en: How long is the approval for a treatment plant's setup valid, and may it be extended?
a_en: Valid for three years; one extension may be sought before expiry, and the extended period is limited to one year
b_en: Valid for ten years; up to three extensions may be sought before expiry, each extended period being five years
c_en: Valid for five years; up to two extensions may be sought before expiry, each extended period being three years
d_en: Valid for one year; extensions may be sought without limit before expiry, each extended period being six months
explain_zh: 第9條：處理業核准設置之有效期限為三年；有效期限屆滿前，得檢具展延原因說明文件申請展延設置，以一次為限，其核准之有效期限以一年為限。第10條第4項並定試運轉期間以三個月為限，得申請展延一次三個月。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法
category: 回收處理業管理-試運轉申請
q_zh: 處理業於設置完成後進行試運轉前，應檢具之試運轉計畫書應包括哪些內容？
a_zh: 試運轉期間之用電度數及水量；試運轉之補貼費請領金額；產出再生料之外銷國家、報關文件及運費；廠區消防演練與疏散計畫
b_zh: 試運轉期間之營業額預估；試運轉之再生料銷售對象及單價；產出廢棄物之掩埋場地點、掩埋量及費用；員工訓練與勞工保險投保計畫
c_zh: 試運轉期間之董事會決議紀錄；試運轉之土地租賃契約；產出廢棄物之保險理賠條款、賠償額度及責任分擔；公司財務簽證報告
d_zh: 試運轉期間、方式、程序、步驟；試運轉之應回收廢棄物項目、數量；產出再生料及其他廢棄物種類、最大產出量及去化方式與合約；採樣、檢測計畫
q_en: What must a treatment operator's trial run plan contain?
a_en: Electricity and water use during the trial; the subsidy amount to be claimed; export destinations, customs papers and freight for material; and fire drill and evacuation plans
b_en: The projected turnover for the trial period; buyers and unit prices of recycled material; the landfill site, volume and fees for residues; and staff training and insurance plans
c_en: Board resolutions covering the trial period; the land lease contract; insurance clauses, indemnity limits and liability sharing for residues; and audited financial statements
d_en: The trial period, methods, procedures and steps; the waste items and volumes used; the types, maximum output and disposal routes of products with contracts; and a sampling and testing plan
explain_zh: 第10條第1項第2款：試運轉計畫書應包括試運轉期間、方式、程序、步驟；試運轉之應回收廢棄物項目、數量；試運轉後產出之再生料及其他廢棄物之種類及最大產出量說明，與其再利用、再生利用或處理方式及委託之合約或證明文件；採樣、檢測計畫。第3項並定試運轉計畫執行結果應做成試運轉報告，於登記機關准駁登記前提送。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法
category: 回收處理業管理-試運轉期限
q_zh: 非經登記機關同意，處理業之試運轉期間以多久為限？得否展延？
a_zh: 試運轉期間以一年為限；期限屆滿前得檢具原因說明文件申請展延，不限次數，每次期限均為三個月
b_zh: 試運轉期間以一個月為限；期限屆滿前得檢具原因說明文件申請展延，以三次為限，每次期限為一個月
c_zh: 試運轉期間以六個月為限；期限屆滿前得檢具原因說明文件申請展延，以二次為限，每次期限為六個月
d_zh: 試運轉期間以三個月為限；期限屆滿前得檢具原因說明文件申請展延，以一次為限，其期限以三個月為限
q_en: Unless the authority consents otherwise, how long may a trial run last, and may it be extended?
a_en: The trial run is limited to one year; extensions may be sought without limit before expiry, each of a further three months
b_en: The trial run is limited to one month; up to three extensions may be sought before expiry, each of a further one month
c_en: The trial run is limited to six months; up to two extensions may be sought before expiry, each of a further six months
d_en: The trial run is limited to three months; one extension may be sought before expiry, limited to a further three months
explain_zh: 第10條第4項：非經登記機關同意，試運轉期間以三個月為限；處理業於試運轉期限屆滿前，得檢具原因說明文件申請展延，以一次為限，其期限以三個月為限。第3項並定試運轉報告應於登記機關准駁登記前提送。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法
category: 回收處理業管理-輸出處理登記
q_zh: 處理業採輸出國外處理者，申請登記時應檢具之文件與一般處理業有何不同？
a_zh: 應檢具處理流程及處理設備說明、處理效能及質量平衡說明，並另加附輸出目的國之處理廠許可文件及國際貿易主管機關核准函
b_zh: 應檢具設置計畫書及試運轉計畫書，並免附土地合法使用證明、緊急應變措施計畫及廠（場）區周圍二公里範圍內相關位置圖
c_zh: 應檢具輸出處理項目及其最大貯存量說明、分類作業說明文件、貯存方法及設施說明，而非處理流程、處理設備及處理效能質量平衡等文件
d_zh: 應檢具稽核認證設施說明及實廠運轉報告，並免附政府機關核准設立證明文件、污染防制措施說明及廠（場）區配置圖
q_en: How do the registration documents differ for operators exporting waste for treatment?
a_en: They file treatment flow and equipment plus performance and mass balance documents, and additionally the destination country's plant permit and trade authority approval
b_en: They file a setup plan and a trial run plan instead, and are exempt from lawful land use proof, emergency response plans and the 2 km surrounding site location map
c_en: They file export items and maximum storage capacity, sorting operation documents and storage methods, rather than treatment flow, equipment and performance and mass balance documents
d_en: They file audit facility descriptions and full-scale run reports, and are exempt from government establishment certificates, pollution control statements and plant layout drawings
explain_zh: 第11條：處理業採輸出國外處理者，申請登記應檢具申請表、政府機關核准設立證明、土地合法使用證明、輸出處理項目及其最大貯存量說明、分類作業說明、貯存方法及設施說明、污染防制（治）措施說明、廠（場）區配置圖、緊急應變措施計畫、清理計畫及廠（場）區周圍二公里範圍內相關位置圖，並無處理流程、設備及處理效能質量平衡等文件。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法
category: 回收處理業管理-登記證記載
q_zh: 回收業、處理業登記證應記載之事項包括下列何者？
a_zh: 登記證字號、機構員工人數及薪資總額、廠（場）消防設備清冊、技師姓名、環評審查文號、補貼費率、廠區污水排放許可號
b_zh: 登記證字號、機構名稱及地址、廠（場）名稱及地址、負責人姓名、核准登記日期及有效日期、業別及回收處理項目、廠（場）地號
c_zh: 登記證字號、機構資本額及股東名冊、廠（場）建物樓層數、專責人員姓名、投保金額及保險期間、稽核認證量、廠區用電契約容量
d_zh: 登記證字號、機構統一編號及稅籍編號、廠（場）土地公告現值、會計師姓名、財務報表年度、再生料銷售額、廠區周圍地籍圖
q_en: What must be recorded on a recovery or treatment operator's registration certificate?
a_en: Certificate number, headcount and total payroll, fire equipment inventory, engineer's name, EIA reference number, subsidy rate, and the wastewater discharge permit number
b_en: Certificate number, entity name and address, plant name and address, responsible person, approval and expiry dates, category and items, and the plant land parcel number
c_en: Certificate number, capital and shareholder roster, number of storeys, dedicated personnel, insured amount and period, audited volume, and the contracted electricity capacity
d_en: Certificate number, tax ID and tax file number, land announced value, accountant's name, financial statement year, recycled material sales, and the cadastral map around
explain_zh: 第12條：回收業、處理業登記證應記載登記證字號、機構名稱及地址、廠（場）名稱及地址、負責人姓名、核准登記日期及有效日期、回收業或處理業業別及回收、處理項目、回收貯存廠（場）或處理廠（場）地號。第20條第1項第1款並定登記證應記載事項有虛偽不實者得撤銷、註銷或廢止其登記證。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法
category: 回收處理業管理-回收業變更
q_zh: 回收業申請變更登記，各款應於何時辦理？
a_zh: 機構名稱地址、負責人姓名及廠（場）地址地號變更者，於變更後十五日內辦理；土地面積、回收項目、分類貯存方法設施、新增拆解及污染防制措施變更者，應於變更前辦理
b_zh: 機構名稱地址、負責人姓名及廠（場）地址地號變更者，於變更後六十日內辦理；土地面積、回收項目、分類貯存方法設施、新增拆解及污染防制措施變更者，於次年度一併辦理
c_zh: 機構名稱地址、負責人姓名及廠（場）地址地號變更者，於年度終了時辦理；土地面積、回收項目、分類貯存方法設施、新增拆解及污染防制措施變更者，於變更後六個月內辦理
d_zh: 機構名稱地址、負責人姓名及廠（場）地址地號變更者，於變更前十五日辦理；土地面積、回收項目、分類貯存方法設施、新增拆解及污染防制措施變更者，於變更後三十日內辦理
q_en: When must a recovery operator apply for change registration for each item?
a_en: Entity name and address, responsible person, and plant address or parcel changes within 15 days after; land area, items, sorting and storage methods, new dismantling and pollution control changes before the change
b_en: Entity name and address, responsible person, and plant address or parcel changes within 60 days after; land area, items, sorting and storage methods, new dismantling and pollution control changes in the following year
c_en: Entity name and address, responsible person, and plant address or parcel changes at the year end; land area, items, sorting and storage methods, new dismantling and pollution control changes within six months after
d_en: Entity name and address, responsible person, and plant address or parcel changes 15 days before; land area, items, sorting and storage methods, new dismantling and pollution control changes within 30 days after
explain_zh: 第13條第2項：第1項第1款（機構名稱及地址、負責人姓名）及第2款（回收貯存廠場地址或地號）變更者，應於變更後十五日內檢具證明文件向登記機關辦理；第3款至第8款（土地面積、回收項目及最大貯存量、分類壓縮打包方法及設施、貯存方法及設施、新增從事廢機動車輛拆解、污染防制措施）變更者，應於變更前檢具相關文件辦理。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法
category: 回收處理業管理-處理業變更
q_zh: 處理業應申請變更登記之情形及辦理時點為何？
a_zh: 處理廠土地面積、處理項目最大處理量、處理流程設備、污染防制措施、產出物種類及去化方式、貯存方法設施、廠區配置變更者，均應於變更後三十日內向中央主管機關辦理
b_zh: 處理廠土地面積、處理項目最大處理量、處理流程設備、污染防制措施、產出物種類及去化方式、貯存方法設施、廠區配置變更者，均免辦理變更而僅需併入季報表申報
c_zh: 處理廠土地面積、處理項目最大處理量、處理流程設備、污染防制措施、產出物種類及去化方式、貯存方法設施、廠區配置變更者，均應於變更前檢具相關文件向登記機關辦理
d_zh: 處理廠土地面積、處理項目最大處理量、處理流程設備、污染防制措施、產出物種類及去化方式、貯存方法設施、廠區配置變更者，均應於變更後六個月內向目的事業主管機關辦理
q_en: Which treatment operator changes need registration, and when must they be filed?
a_en: Changes to plant land area, items and maximum capacity, treatment flow and equipment, pollution control, output types and routes, storage methods and plant layout must be filed centrally within 30 days
b_en: Changes to plant land area, items and maximum capacity, treatment flow and equipment, pollution control, output types and routes, storage methods and plant layout need no filing, only quarterly reporting
c_en: Changes to plant land area, items and maximum capacity, treatment flow and equipment, pollution control, output types and routes, storage methods and plant layout must all be filed before the change
d_en: Changes to plant land area, items and maximum capacity, treatment flow and equipment, pollution control, output types and routes, storage methods and plant layout must be filed within six months
explain_zh: 第14條第2項：第1項第1款（機構名稱及地址、負責人姓名）及第2款（處理廠場地址或地號）變更者，應於變更後十五日內辦理；第3款至第9款（處理廠土地面積、處理項目及最大處理量或輸出項目最大貯存量、處理流程及設備、污染防制措施、產出物種類最大產出量及去化方式、貯存方法及設施、廠場區配置）變更者，應於變更前檢具相關文件向登記機關辦理。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法
category: 回收處理業管理-登記證展延
q_zh: 回收業、處理業登記證之有效期限為何？應於何時申請展延？
a_zh: 登記證有效期限為三年；有效期限屆滿後仍繼續從事原登記項目業務者，應於屆滿前一個月至三個月內申請展延，每次展延之有效期限為三年
b_zh: 登記證有效期限為十年；有效期限屆滿後仍繼續從事原登記項目業務者，應於屆滿前六個月至一年內申請展延，每次展延之有效期限為十年
c_zh: 登記證有效期限為二年；有效期限屆滿後仍繼續從事原登記項目業務者，應於屆滿後三個月內補行申請展延，每次展延有效期限為二年
d_zh: 登記證有效期限為五年；有效期限屆滿後仍繼續從事原登記項目業務者，應於屆滿前三個月至六個月內申請展延，每次展延之有效期限為五年
q_en: How long is a registration certificate valid, and when must renewal be sought?
a_en: Valid for three years; those continuing the registered business must apply between one and three months before expiry, and each renewal runs for three years
b_en: Valid for ten years; those continuing the registered business must apply between six and twelve months before expiry, and each renewal runs for ten years
c_en: Valid for two years; those continuing the registered business may apply within three months after expiry, and each renewal runs for two years thereafter
d_en: Valid for five years; those continuing the registered business must apply between three and six months before expiry, and each renewal runs for five years
explain_zh: 第15條第1項：回收業、處理業登記證有效期限為五年；有效期限屆滿後仍繼續從事原登記項目之業務者，應於屆滿前三個月至六個月內申請展延，每次展延之有效期限為五年。第19條第6項並定登記機關受理展延應審酌其營運期間環保稽查取締紀錄及環境品質變異情形。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法
category: 回收處理業管理-未展延效果
q_zh: 回收業、處理業展延文件不符規定或未依期間申請展延者，其效果為何？
a_zh: 文件不符或補正逾期者，登記機關應通知限期改善並得延長效期；未依規定期間申請而尚未准駁者，得繼續營運至准駁作成日止；未於屆滿前申請者，登記證自動延展一年
b_zh: 文件不符或補正逾期者，登記機關應於有效期限屆滿前駁回；未依規定期間申請而尚未准駁者，應於期限屆滿日起停止營運；未於屆滿前申請展延者，登記證自屆滿日起失其效力
c_zh: 文件不符或補正逾期者，登記機關應移請中央主管機關核定；未依規定期間申請而尚未准駁者，應於准駁後三個月停止營運；未於屆滿前申請者，登記證得於屆滿後補辦展延
d_zh: 文件不符或補正逾期者，登記機關得逕行縮短其有效期限；未依規定期間申請而尚未准駁者，應暫停收受應回收廢棄物；未於屆滿前申請者，登記證由中央主管機關註銷
q_en: What follows if renewal documents are deficient or renewal is not sought in time?
a_en: Deficient or uncorrected filings trigger an improvement notice and an extended term; where a late application is undecided, operations may continue until a decision; unrenewed certificates run on for one year
b_en: Deficient or uncorrected filings are rejected before expiry; where a late application is undecided, operations must stop from the expiry date; certificates not renewed before expiry lose effect from that date
c_en: Deficient or uncorrected filings are referred to the central authority; where a late application is undecided, operations must stop three months after a decision; renewal may be sought after expiry
d_en: Deficient or uncorrected filings let the authority shorten the term directly; where a late application is undecided, waste intake must pause; unrenewed certificates are cancelled by the central authority
explain_zh: 第15條第2項：申請展延文件不符規定或補正資料未能於登記機關規定期限內補正者，登記機關應於登記證有效期限屆滿前駁回其申請；未依前項規定期間申請展延者，登記機關尚未作成准駁之決定時，應於登記證有效期限屆滿日起停止營運；未於登記證有效期限屆滿前申請展延者，於有效期限屆滿日起，其登記證失其效力。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法
category: 回收處理業管理-回收業展延文件
q_zh: 回收業申請展延登記時，應檢具之文件包括下列何者？
a_zh: 環境影響評估審查結論、水污染防治許可證、空氣污染防制設備操作許可證、廢棄物清理計畫書、土壤及地下水品質檢測報告及專責人員名冊
b_zh: 近三年財務報表及納稅證明、股東名冊、董事會議事錄、員工在職證明、公共意外責任保險單、消防安全設備檢修申報表及建築物使用執照
c_zh: 設置計畫書及試運轉計畫書、採樣檢測計畫、實廠運轉報告、稽核認證設施運作方式說明、廠（場）區周圍二公里範圍內相關位置圖及土地合法使用證明
d_zh: 回收項目及其最大貯存量說明、分類壓縮打包方法及設施說明、貯存方法及設施說明、污染防制（治）措施說明、廠（場）區配置圖、緊急應變措施計畫及清理計畫
q_en: Which documents must a recovery operator file when seeking renewal of registration?
a_en: EIA review conclusions, water pollution control permits, air pollution control equipment operating permits, waste clearance plans, soil and groundwater test reports and dedicated personnel rosters
b_en: Three years of financial statements and tax payment certificates, shareholder rosters, board minutes, employment certificates, liability insurance policies, fire inspection filings and building use permits
c_en: A setup plan and a trial run plan, sampling and testing plans, full-scale run reports, audit facility operation documents, a 2 km surrounding location map and lawful land use proof papers
d_en: Recovery items and maximum storage capacity, sorting and baling methods and facilities, storage methods and facilities, pollution control measures, layout drawings, an emergency plan and a clearance plan
explain_zh: 第16條各款：回收業申請展延登記應檢具申請表及政府機關核准設立證明、回收項目及其最大貯存量說明、分類壓縮打包方法及設施說明、貯存方法及設施說明、廢機動車輛回收業從事拆解者之拆解作業流程說明、污染防制（治）措施說明、廠（場）區配置圖及說明、緊急應變措施計畫、清理計畫及其他經中央主管機關規定之文件。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法
category: 回收處理業管理-處理業展延文件
q_zh: 處理業申請展延登記時，應檢具之文件包括下列何者？
a_zh: 近五年營運統計季報表、補貼費請領明細、再生料銷售發票、廠區土地公告現值證明、地價稅完納證明及建築物公共安全檢查簽證申報書
b_zh: 回收項目及最大貯存量說明、分類壓縮打包方法及設施說明、廢機動車輛拆解作業流程說明、貯存方法及設施說明、稽核認證作業區域配置圖及說明文件
c_zh: 處理項目及最大處理量說明、處理流程及處理設備說明、產出再生料及其他廢棄物種類最大產出量與去化合約、貯存方法及設施說明、處理效能及質量平衡說明
d_zh: 設置計畫書及核准設置文件、試運轉期間用電紀錄、試運轉採樣檢測報告、輸出目的國處理廠許可文件、國際貿易主管機關核准函及報關文件
q_en: Which documents must a treatment operator file when seeking renewal of registration?
a_en: Five years of quarterly operating statistics, subsidy claim details, recycled material sales invoices, land value certificates, land tax receipts and building safety inspection filings
b_en: Recovery items and maximum storage capacity, sorting and baling methods and facilities, scrap vehicle dismantling flow documents, storage methods and facilities, and audit area layout drawings
c_en: Treatment items and maximum capacity, treatment flow and equipment, output types and maximum output with disposal contracts, storage methods and facilities, and performance and mass balance documents
d_en: The setup plan and setup approval, electricity records during the trial run, trial sampling and test reports, the destination plant permit, trade authority approval and customs papers
explain_zh: 第17條各款：處理業申請展延登記應檢具申請表及政府機關核准設立證明、處理項目及最大處理量說明、處理流程及處理設備說明、產出再生料及其他廢棄物之種類及最大產出量說明與委託再利用、再生利用或處理之合約或證明文件、貯存方法及設施說明、處理效能及質量平衡說明、污染防制措施說明、廠（場）區配置圖、緊急應變措施計畫及清理計畫等。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法
category: 回收處理業管理-輸出展延文件
q_zh: 處理業採輸出國外處理者，申請展延登記時應檢具之文件包括下列何者？
a_zh: 處理流程及處理設備說明、處理效能及質量平衡說明、實廠運轉計畫及報告、採樣檢測計畫、稽核認證設施運作方式說明及廠區配置圖說明文件
b_zh: 土地合法使用證明及地籍圖謄本、建築物使用執照、消防安全設備檢查表、公共意外責任保險單、勞工安全衛生管理計畫及員工訓練紀錄表
c_zh: 輸出處理項目及其最大貯存量說明、分類作業說明文件、貯存方法及設施說明、污染防制（治）措施說明、廠（場）區配置圖、緊急應變措施計畫及清理計畫
d_zh: 輸出目的國之環保主管機關核准函、國際運輸業者契約、海關報單影本、再生料買賣合約、外匯結匯水單及貿易主管機關輸出許可證明
q_en: Which documents must an exporting treatment operator file when seeking renewal?
a_en: Treatment flow and equipment documents, performance and mass balance documents, full-scale run plans and reports, sampling and testing plans, audit facility documents and layout drawings
b_en: Lawful land use proof and cadastral transcripts, building use permits, fire equipment checklists, public liability insurance, occupational safety plans and staff training records
c_en: Export items and maximum storage capacity, sorting operation documents, storage methods and facilities, pollution control measures, layout drawings, an emergency plan and a clearance plan
d_en: The destination country's environmental approval letter, international carrier contracts, customs declarations, sales contracts, foreign exchange slips and trade export licences
explain_zh: 第18條各款：處理業採輸出國外處理者申請展延登記，應檢具申請表及政府機關核准設立證明、輸出處理項目及其最大貯存量說明、分類作業說明文件、貯存方法及設施說明、污染防制（治）措施說明、廠（場）區配置圖及說明、緊急應變措施計畫、清理計畫及其他經中央主管機關規定之文件。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法
category: 回收處理業管理-審查期限
q_zh: 登記機關受理回收業、處理業申請登記、變更登記及展延登記，其審查期限為何？
a_zh: 應辦理現場勘查者於六十日內完成審查，未辦理現場勘查者於三十日內完成審查並作成准駁決定；必要時或因業者正當事由得延長，延長期間以三十日為限
b_zh: 應辦理現場勘查者於一百二十日內完成審查，未辦理現場勘查者於九十日內完成審查並作成准駁決定；不得因任何事由延長其法定之審查期限
c_zh: 應辦理現場勘查者於九十日內完成審查，未辦理現場勘查者於六十日內完成審查並作成准駁決定；必要時或因業者正當事由得延長，延長期間以六十日為限
d_zh: 應辦理現場勘查者於三十日內完成審查，未辦理現場勘查者於十五日內完成審查並作成准駁決定；必要時或因業者正當事由得延長，延長期間以十五日為限
q_en: What review deadlines apply to registration, change and renewal applications?
a_en: 60 days where a site inspection is required and 30 days where it is not, with a decision made; an extension of up to 30 days is allowed where needed or on justified grounds
b_en: 120 days where a site inspection is required and 90 days where it is not, with a decision made; no extension of the statutory review period is permitted on any ground
c_en: 90 days where a site inspection is required and 60 days where it is not, with a decision made; an extension of up to 60 days is allowed where needed or on justified grounds
d_en: 30 days where a site inspection is required and 15 days where it is not, with a decision made; an extension of up to 15 days is allowed where needed or on justified grounds
explain_zh: 第19條第1項：應辦理現場勘查者應於六十日內完成審查，未辦理現場勘查者應於三十日內完成審查並做成准駁之決定。第2項：登記機關認為必要時或因業者提出正當事由，得延長審查期限，延長期間以三十日為限。第3、4項並定內容欠缺或現勘不符者應通知限期補正，屆期未補正者駁回，補正日數不算入審查期限。

law: 應回收廢棄物回收處理業管理辦法
category: 回收處理業管理-現場勘查
q_zh: 登記機關辦理現場勘查之規定為何？
a_zh: 受理回收業登記、變更、展延及處理業變更登記，必要時得辦理現場勘查；受理處理業登記及展延登記應辦理現場勘查，受補貼機構之處理業展延得免辦，但處理含有害物質者展延仍應辦理
b_zh: 受理回收業登記、變更、展延及處理業變更登記，均免辦理現場勘查；受理處理業登記及展延登記由中央主管機關統一辦理現場勘查，地方機關不得自行辦理
c_zh: 受理回收業登記、變更、展延及處理業變更登記，一律應辦理現場勘查；受理處理業登記及展延登記則採書面審查，受補貼機構之處理業展延必要時得辦理現場勘查即可
d_zh: 受理回收業登記、變更、展延及處理業變更登記，得委託同業公會辦理現場勘查；受理處理業登記及展延登記應由技師簽證代替現場勘查，不再另行辦理勘查
q_en: When must the registration authority carry out an on-site inspection?
a_en: Recovery registrations, changes and renewals and treatment changes may be inspected if needed; treatment registrations and renewals must be inspected, subsidised operators' renewals may be exempt, but hazardous ones must be inspected
b_en: Recovery registrations, changes and renewals and treatment changes need no inspection at all; treatment registrations and renewals are inspected only by the central authority and never by local ones
c_en: Recovery registrations, changes and renewals and treatment changes must always be inspected on site; treatment registrations and renewals are reviewed on paper, and subsidised operators' renewals may be inspected where needed
d_en: Recovery registrations, changes and renewals and treatment changes may be inspected by trade associations; treatment registrations and renewals use engineer certification in place of any on-site inspection
