a_en: The article is deleted but applies by analogy; the party may seek re-mediation and a stay of enforcement, and an approved mediation has only the effect of a civil contract
b_en: The article no longer applies; the party may bring a revocation suit in administrative court against the committee, and an approved mediation is only an administrative act
c_en: The article is deleted but replaced by the enforcement rules; the party may seek adjudication to overturn it, and an approved mediation has only evidentiary effect
d_en: The article no longer applies; the party may sue in the approving court to declare it void or set it aside, and an approved mediation has the effect of a final civil judgment
explain_zh: 公害糾紛處理法第32條業經刪除。現行制度下，第30條第1項規定調處經法院核定後與民事確定判決有同一之效力、不得再行起訴且得為強制執行名義；第31條規定經核定之調處有無效或得撤銷原因者，當事人得向原核定法院提起宣告調處無效或撤銷調處之訴，並應於調處書送達後三十日內提起。
explain_en: Article 32 is deleted; see Articles 30 and 31 for the current rules.

law: 公害糾紛處理法
q_zh: 當事人於何種情形下得申請裁決？申請之期限及受理機關為何？
a_zh: 公害糾紛未經調處程序者亦得逕行申請裁決；應於損害發生之日起二年內檢具申請書向行政院環境保護署提出，並由該署轉送管轄之直轄市、縣（市）調處委員會先行調處
b_zh: 調處事件經調處成立但一造不履行協議者，得就同一事件申請裁決；應於協議所定履行期限屆滿後七日內檢具申請書向原核定調處書之管轄法院提出並繳納所需之裁決費
c_zh: 調處事件經調處不成立且不論是否屬損害賠償事件者，均得就同一事件申請裁決；應於調處不成立之通知送達三十日內檢具申請書向裁決委員會逕行提出而不經原調處委員會轉送
d_zh: 調處事件經直轄市、縣（市）調處委員會調處不成立且屬因公害糾紛所生之損害賠償事件者，得就同一事件申請裁決；應於調處不成立之通知送達十四日內檢具申請書向原調處委員會提出
q_en: When may adjudication be sought, and what deadline and receiving body apply?
a_en: Even without any mediation at all; within two years of the damage, filed with the Environmental Protection Administration which forwards it to the competent local committee to mediate first
b_en: Where mediation succeeded but one side does not perform; within seven days after the agreed performance deadline, filed with the court that approved the record together with the required fee
c_en: Where mediation has failed, whether or not the case concerns damages; within thirty days of service of the failure notice, filed directly with the adjudication committee bypassing the mediation committee
d_en: Where mediation before the local committee has failed and the case is one of damages from a nuisance dispute; within fourteen days of service of the failure notice, filed with the original mediation committee
explain_zh: 第33條第1項：調處事件經直轄市、縣（市）調處委員會調處不成立，其屬於因公害糾紛所生之損害賠償事件者，當事人得就同一事件申請裁決。第2項：申請裁決應於調處不成立之通知送達十四日內，檢具申請書向原直轄市、縣（市）調處委員會提出。第3項：調處委員會應速將申請書抄本送達他方，並將卷宗連同申請書送交裁決委員會。

law: 公害糾紛處理法
q_zh: 裁決委員會之裁決應以何種方式行之？其決定門檻為何？
a_zh: 由當事人各自推薦之委員及主任委員三人合議行之；以主任委員之意見為決定
b_zh: 由主任委員一人獨任行之；必要時得徵詢其他委員意見但仍以主任委員意見為準
c_zh: 由主任委員指定委員三人或五人以合議行之；該合議以指定委員過半數之意見決定之
d_zh: 由全體委員出席合議行之；該合議須經全體委員三分之二以上之同意始得決定
q_en: How is an adjudication rendered, and what decision threshold applies?
a_en: By a panel of the chairperson and one member nominated by each party; the chairperson decides it finally
b_en: By the chairperson sitting alone; other members may be consulted but the chairperson's own view prevails
c_en: By a panel of three or five members designated by the chairperson; decided by a majority of the designated members
d_en: By all members sitting together; a decision requires the consent of at least two thirds of all the members
explain_zh: 第34條第1項：裁決委員會之裁決，由主任委員指定委員三人或五人，以合議行之。第2項：前項合議，以指定委員過半數之意見決定之。第3項另就金額意見分歧時設有特別計算方法。第10條規定裁決委員會置主任委員一人、委員七人至十一人。

law: 公害糾紛處理法
q_zh: 裁決關於金額之意見分三說以上而各不達過半數時，應如何決定？
a_zh: 以最少額之意見為裁決金額，以貫徹有疑唯利被告原則並避免過度加重賠償責任
b_zh: 以各說金額之算術平均數為裁決金額，不足新臺幣千元之部分四捨五入後計算之
c_zh: 以最多額之意見順次算入次多額之意見，至達過半數為止，即以該金額為裁決金額
d_zh: 以主任委員所持之意見為裁決金額，其他委員之意見僅供參考而不生決定效力
q_en: How is the amount decided when three or more views each fall short of a majority?
a_en: The lowest amount is taken as the award, resolving doubt in favour of the respondent and limiting liability
b_en: The arithmetic mean of the various amounts is taken as the award, rounded to the nearest thousand dollars
c_en: The highest amount is successively added to the next highest until a majority is reached, and that is the award
d_en: The chairperson's own view is taken as the award, with the other members' views serving only as reference
explain_zh: 第34條第3項：關於金額，如委員之意見分三說以上，各不達過半數時，以最多額之意見順次算入次多額之意見，至達過半數為止。此與法院評議之計算方式相同，目的在避免因意見分歧而無法作成裁決。

law: 公害糾紛處理法
q_zh: 裁決委員會於裁決前應踐行何種程序？
a_zh: 得逕依書面資料裁決而無須行詢問亦不必為任何之調查
b_zh: 應通知檢察機關到場陳述意見後始得作成裁決書並送達
c_zh: 應委由原調處委員會代為詢問後將紀錄送交裁決委員會
d_zh: 應行詢問使雙方陳述，並就事件有關事實為必要之調查
q_en: What procedure must the adjudication committee follow before rendering an award?
a_en: It may decide on the documents alone without any inquiry and without conducting any investigation at all
b_en: It must notify prosecutors to appear and state their views before it may make and serve the award on them
c_en: It must have the original mediation committee conduct the inquiry and forward the record to it afterwards
d_en: It must hold an inquiry allowing both sides to state their case and investigate the relevant facts as needed
explain_zh: 第35條：裁決委員會於裁決前應行詢問，使雙方陳述，並就事件有關事實為必要之調查。第40條規定第24條調查證據及第25條鑑定之規定於裁決程序準用之，第36條則規定裁決書之作成期限。

law: 公害糾紛處理法
q_zh: 裁決委員會應於當事人申請裁決後多久內作成裁決書？必要時得延長多久？
a_zh: 應於申請裁決後一個月內作成裁決書並送達於當事人；必要時得延長二個月
b_zh: 應於申請裁決後一年內作成裁決書並送達於當事人；必要時得延長至二年整
c_zh: 應於申請裁決後三個月內作成裁決書並送達於當事人；必要時得延長三個月
d_zh: 應於申請裁決後六個月內作成裁決書並送達於當事人；必要時得延長六個月
q_en: Within what period must the award be made, and how long may it be extended?
a_en: Within one month of the application, with the award served on the parties; extendable by two months
b_en: Within one year of the application, with the award served on the parties; extendable to two years
c_en: Within three months of the application, with the award served on the parties; extendable by three months
d_en: Within six months of the application, with the award served on the parties; extendable by six months
explain_zh: 第36條：裁決委員會應於當事人申請裁決後三個月內作成裁決書，並送達於當事人；必要時得延長三個月。第37條第2項另規定裁決書應於作成後十日內以正本送達於當事人。

law: 公害糾紛處理法
q_zh: 裁決書應記載哪些事項？並由何人簽名？
a_zh: 應記載當事人姓名住居所、主文及理由，並由管轄法院之法官簽名核可後始生裁決書之效力
b_zh: 應記載當事人姓名住居所、調處經過及不成立原因，並由原調處委員會之全體出席委員簽名
c_zh: 應記載當事人姓名住居所、鑑定結果及賠償金額，並由行政院環境保護署署長一人簽名蓋章
d_zh: 應記載當事人姓名住居所、法定或委任代理人、主文、事實、理由及年月日，並由裁決之委員簽名
q_en: What must an award contain, and who signs it?
a_en: Party names and addresses, the holding and the reasons, effective only after the judge of the competent court signs to approve it
b_en: Party names and addresses, the course of mediation and why it failed, signed by all the members who attended the mediation committee
c_en: Party names and addresses, the appraisal result and the amount of damages, signed and sealed by the Administrator of the EPA alone
d_en: Party names and addresses, statutory or appointed agents, the holding, the facts, the reasons and the date, signed by the adjudicating members
explain_zh: 第37條第1項：裁決書應記載當事人姓名、住所或居所（法人或團體者其名稱、代表人及主事務所或主營業所）；有法定代理人或委任代理人者其姓名住居所；主文；事實；理由；年、月、日，並由裁決之委員簽名。其記載體例與民事判決書相仿。

law: 公害糾紛處理法
q_zh: 裁決書作成後應於幾日內以何種方式送達當事人？其後當事人有何期間上之考量？
a_zh: 應於作成後三十日內以影本送達於當事人；當事人於裁決書影本送達後六十日內未提起民事訴訟者，視為依裁決書達成合意
b_zh: 應於作成後三日內以言詞當場宣示並記明筆錄；當事人於宣示之日起十日內未提起民事訴訟者，視為依裁決書達成合意
c_zh: 應於作成後十日內以正本送達於當事人；當事人於裁決書正本送達後二十日內未提起民事訴訟者，視為依裁決書達成合意
d_zh: 應於作成後七日內以公告方式代替送達；當事人於公告之日起十四日內未提起民事訴訟者，視為依裁決書達成合意而確定
q_en: Within how many days and in what form is the award served, and what period follows?
a_en: A copy must be served within thirty days of the award; if no civil suit is filed within sixty days of service, the parties are deemed to have agreed on the award
b_en: It must be pronounced orally within three days and minuted; if no civil suit is filed within ten days of pronouncement, the parties are deemed to agree
c_en: An original must be served within ten days of the award; if no civil suit is filed within twenty days of service, the parties are deemed to have agreed on the award
d_en: A public notice within seven days replaces service; if no civil suit is filed within fourteen days of the notice, the parties are deemed to have agreed on it
explain_zh: 第37條第2項：前項裁決書，應於作成後十日內，以正本送達於當事人。第39條第1項：當事人於裁決書正本送達後二十日內，未就同一事件向法院提起民事訴訟，或經撤回其訴者，視為雙方當事人依裁決書達成合意。
explain_en: Article 37, paragraph 2, read with Article 39, paragraph 1.

law: 公害糾紛處理法
q_zh: 裁決程序進行中雙方當事人達成協議者，裁決委員會應如何處理？其程序效果為何？
a_zh: 應作成協議書並準用第二十八條至第三十一條之規定；協議書作成後裁決程序即告終結
b_zh: 應作成裁決書並記載協議內容後送達當事人；裁決程序仍應繼續進行至期限屆滿
c_zh: 應作成調處書並移送原調處委員會依調處程序辦理；裁決程序則暫時停止而非終結
d_zh: 應報請行政院環境保護署核定該協議之內容；核定前裁決程序不受影響應續行
q_en: If the parties settle during adjudication, what must the committee do and what follows?
a_en: It must draw up a settlement record, applying Articles 28 to 31 mutatis mutandis; the adjudication ends once the record is made
b_en: It must issue an award recording the settlement terms and serve it; the adjudication proceeding continues until the deadline
c_en: It must draw up a mediation record and transfer the case back to the mediation committee; the adjudication is merely stayed
d_en: It must submit the settlement to the Environmental Protection Administration for approval; the proceeding continues meanwhile
explain_zh: 第38條：裁決程序進行中，雙方當事人達成協議者，裁決委員會應作成協議書，並準用第28條至第31條之規定；協議書作成後，裁決程序即告終結。故協議書亦須送請管轄法院審核，核定後與民事確定判決有同一效力並得為執行名義。

law: 公害糾紛處理法
q_zh: 當事人於裁決書正本送達後二十日內未提起民事訴訟或經撤回其訴者，效果為何？裁決委員會應如何處理？
a_zh: 視為裁決不成立而應重新進行調處程序；裁決委員會應於該期間屆滿後十四日內將全案退回原調處委員會，由該會依調處程序重新處理該公害糾紛之事件
b_zh: 視為雙方當事人依裁決書達成合意；裁決委員會應於該期間屆滿後七日內將裁決書送請管轄法院審核，並準用第二十八條第二項、第三項、第三十條及第三十一條規定
c_zh: 視為當事人放棄依裁決書請求之權利；裁決委員會應於該期間屆滿後三十日內將裁決書歸檔，當事人如欲主張權利應另行向管轄法院提起民事訴訟請求其賠償
d_zh: 視為當事人同意延長裁決期限三個月；裁決委員會應於該期間屆滿後十日內通知當事人到場確認其意思，當事人未到場者始視為依裁決書達成其合意
q_en: What follows if no civil suit is filed within twenty days of service of the award, and what must the committee do?
a_en: The adjudication is deemed to have failed and mediation must restart; within fourteen days the committee returns the case to the original mediation committee to handle again
b_en: The parties are deemed to have agreed on the award; within seven days after that period the committee sends the award for court review, with Articles 28(2)-(3), 30 and 31 applying
c_en: The parties are deemed to have waived their claims under the award; within thirty days the committee files the case away and any claim must be pursued by a fresh civil suit
d_en: The parties are deemed to consent to a three-month extension; within ten days the committee summons them to confirm their intent, and only non-appearance means agreement
explain_zh: 第39條第1項：當事人於裁決書正本送達後二十日內，未就同一事件向法院提起民事訴訟，或經撤回其訴者，視為雙方當事人依裁決書達成合意。第2項：裁決委員會應於前項期間屆滿後七日內，將裁決書送請管轄法院審核。第3項：第28條第2項、第3項、第30條及第31條規定於前項情形準用之。

law: 公害糾紛處理法
q_zh: 公害糾紛處理法就調處程序之哪些規定，於裁決程序準用之？
a_zh: 第十七條至第二十二條、第二十四條及第二十五條規定，即迴避、共同申請、選定當事人、特別授權、調查證據及鑑定等規定
b_zh: 第二十六條至第二十九條規定，即勸導態度、調處方案、法院審核及調處書記載等規定，均於裁決程序全部準用而無例外
c_zh: 第四十一條至第四十三條規定，即假扣押假處分、訴訟停止及收費等規定，均於裁決程序準用而不及於調處程序之規定
d_zh: 第十四條至第十六條及第二十三條規定，即申請調處、開會門檻、指定管轄及程序公開等規定，均於裁決程序全部準用之
q_en: Which mediation provisions apply mutatis mutandis to adjudication proceedings?
a_en: Articles 17 to 22, 24 and 25, that is recusal, joint application, appointed representatives, special authorization, taking evidence and appraisal
b_en: Articles 26 to 29, that is the persuasion duty, mediation proposals, court review and record contents, all applying in adjudication without exception
c_en: Articles 41 to 43, that is provisional attachment, stay of litigation and fees, applying in adjudication only and not in mediation proceedings
d_en: Articles 14 to 16 and 23, that is application, meeting quorum, designation of jurisdiction and openness of proceedings, all applying in adjudication
explain_zh: 第40條：第17條至第22條、第24條及第25條規定，於裁決程序準用之。其內容包括第17條自行迴避、第18條不合法退回與移送、第19條共同申請與第三人加入、第20條至第22條選定當事人及特別授權、第24條調查證據、第25條委託鑑定及鑑定費負擔。

law: 公害糾紛處理法
q_zh: 當事人本於調處書、協議書或裁決書之請求，欲保全強制執行時得為何種聲請？其釋明有何特別規定？
a_zh: 得於各該文書經法院核定後向法院聲請假扣押或假處分；並應依民事訴訟法規定就假扣押原因為完全之釋明，且不論以何種文書聲請均應供擔保
b_zh: 得於各該文書經法院核定前向行政執行分署聲請假扣押；並應以鑑定報告代替假扣押原因之釋明，其未提出鑑定報告者應駁回其聲請
c_zh: 得於各該文書作成前向調處委員會聲請假扣押或假處分；並得以申請書代替假扣押原因之釋明，惟均應提供請求金額三分之一之擔保金
d_zh: 得於各該文書經法院核定前向法院聲請假扣押或假處分；並得以該等文書代替假扣押或假處分原因之釋明，其以裁決書代替原因之釋明者免供擔保
q_en: What provisional relief may a party seek, and what special rule applies to prima facie showing?
a_en: Provisional attachment or injunction may be sought only after approval; the grounds must be fully shown under the Code of Civil Procedure and security is required whatever document is used
b_en: Provisional attachment may be sought from the administrative enforcement agency before approval; an appraisal report must substitute for the showing, and applications without one are dismissed
c_en: Provisional attachment or injunction may be sought from the mediation committee before the document is made; the application substitutes for the showing, but security of one third is required
d_en: Provisional attachment or injunction may be sought from the court before the document is approved; the document itself substitutes for the showing of grounds, and an award needs no security
explain_zh: 第41條第1項：當事人本於調處書、協議書或裁決書之請求，欲保全強制執行或避免損害之擴大者，得於各該文書經法院核定前，向法院聲請假扣押或假處分。第2項：前項聲請得以該等文書代替假扣押或假處分原因之釋明，其以裁決書代替原因之釋明者，免供擔保。第3項：民事訴訟法有關規定除第529條外準用之。

law: 公害糾紛處理法
q_zh: 調處書、協議書或裁決書未經法院核定者，當事人得為何種聲請？何種情形亦同？
a_zh: 得聲請法院撤銷假扣押或假處分之裁定；當事人於裁決書正本送達後二十日內就同一事件向法院提起民事訴訟或未撤回其訴者亦同
b_zh: 得聲請法院延長假扣押或假處分之期間；當事人於裁決書正本送達後三十日內就同一事件向法院提起民事訴訟者亦同並得再延長
c_zh: 得聲請法院命他造提供反擔保後撤銷保全；當事人於裁決書正本送達後六個月內未聲請強制執行者亦同並喪失執行權利
d_zh: 得聲請法院逕行核發強制執行名義；當事人於裁決書正本送達後十日內未就同一事件向法院提起民事訴訟者亦同並得聲請執行
q_en: If the document is not approved by the court, what may a party seek, and in what other case?
a_en: A ruling setting aside the provisional attachment or injunction; the same applies where a party sues on the same case within twenty days of service or does not withdraw the suit
b_en: An extension of the provisional attachment or injunction period; the same applies where a party sues on the same case within thirty days of service and it may be extended again
c_en: An order that the other side post counter-security to lift the relief; the same applies where enforcement is not sought within six months and the right is then lost
d_en: Direct issuance of an enforcement title by the court; the same applies where a party does not sue within ten days of service of the award and enforcement may be sought
explain_zh: 第41條第4項：調處書、協議書或裁決書未經法院核定者，當事人得聲請法院撤銷假扣押或假處分之裁定；當事人於裁決書正本送達後二十日內，就同一事件向法院提起民事訴訟或未撤回其訴者，亦同。此與第39條第1項視為合意之要件互為表裡。
explain_en: Article 41, paragraph 4, read with Article 39, paragraph 1.

law: 公害糾紛處理法
q_zh: 公害糾紛事件與法院訴訟程序之關係，公害糾紛處理法如何規定？
a_zh: 經第一審法院辯論終結者不得進行調處或裁決；已繫屬第一審法院並申請調處或裁決者，受訴法院於有結果前得以裁定停止訴訟程序，如調處、協議或裁決經法院核定者視為撤回其訴訟
b_zh: 經第二審法院辯論終結者始不得進行調處或裁決；已繫屬法院者，受訴法院不受影響仍應繼續審理，調處或裁決經核定者亦不影響訴訟程序之進行與判決之作成
c_zh: 不論訴訟進行至何程度均得申請調處或裁決；已繫屬第一審法院者，受訴法院應停止訴訟程序並將全案移送調處委員會處理，調處不成立時再由法院續行審理該事件之訴訟
d_zh: 經第一審法院辯論終結者仍得進行調處或裁決；已繫屬第一審法院並申請調處或裁決者，受訴法院應逕行駁回其訴，當事人並不得再就同一事件向法院提起民事訴訟請求賠償
q_en: How does the Act relate mediation and adjudication to court proceedings?
a_en: No mediation or adjudication after first instance oral argument closes; where a case is pending at first instance the court may stay proceedings, and court approval of the settlement is deemed withdrawal of the suit
b_en: Only after second instance argument closes is mediation or adjudication barred; a pending case proceeds regardless, and approval of a settlement does not affect the litigation or the judgment
c_en: Mediation or adjudication may be sought at any stage of the case; where a case is pending at first instance the court must stay and transfer the whole case to the mediation committee before it resumes the trial
d_en: Mediation or adjudication may still proceed after first instance argument closes; where a case is pending the court must dismiss the suit and the party may not sue again on the same case for damages
explain_zh: 第42條第1項：公害糾紛事件經第一審法院辯論終結者，不得進行調處或裁決。第2項：公害糾紛事件已繫屬於第一審法院，並依本法申請調處或裁決者，受訴法院於調處或裁決有結果前，得以裁定停止訴訟程序；如調處、協議或裁決經法院核定者，視為撤回其訴訟。第3項：依鄉鎮市調解條例聲請調解並申請調處或裁決者，準用前項規定。

law: 公害糾紛處理法
q_zh: 依公害糾紛處理法申請之調處及裁決，得收取哪些費用？收費辦法由何機關訂定？
a_zh: 一律不得收取任何費用而由政府編列預算支應之；僅鑑定費得由應負責任之當事人於事後返還政府支付
b_zh: 得收取調處費、裁決費、鑑定費及證據調查費用；其收費辦法由行政院環境保護署擬訂，報請行政院核定後發布之
c_zh: 得收取調處費及裁決費而不得收取鑑定費與證據調查費用；其收費辦法由直轄市、縣（市）政府分別訂定並發布
d_zh: 得收取調處費、裁決費及律師費用；其收費辦法由裁決委員會擬訂並報請行政院環境保護署核定後發布施行
q_en: What fees may be charged for mediation and adjudication, and who prescribes the fee rules?
a_en: No fees at all may be charged and the government budget covers all costs; only appraisal fees are repaid to the government by the responsible party
b_en: Mediation fees, adjudication fees, appraisal fees and evidence investigation costs; the rules are drafted by the EPA and issued after Executive Yuan approval
c_en: Only mediation and adjudication fees, with no appraisal or evidence costs at all; the rules are prescribed and issued by municipal and county governments
d_en: Mediation fees, adjudication fees and attorney fees; the rules are drafted by the adjudication committee and issued after approval by the EPA
explain_zh: 第43條第1項：依本法申請之調處及裁決，得收取調處費、裁決費、鑑定費及證據調查費用。第2項：前項收費辦法，由行政院環境保護署擬訂，報請行政院核定後發布之。第25條並規定鑑定費由政府先行支付，責任確定後由該當事人負擔並返還政府。

law: 公害糾紛處理法
q_zh: 行政院為處理重大緊急公害糾紛所設之組織及其召集人為何？
a_zh: 行政院設緊急公害糾紛處理小組；置召集人一人，由行政院副院長兼任之
b_zh: 行政院設公害糾紛督導處理小組；置召集人一人，由行政院秘書長兼任
c_zh: 行政院設公害糾紛緊急紓處小組；置召集人一人，由環保署署長兼任之
d_zh: 行政院設重大公害糾紛審議委員會；置召集人一人，由行政院院長兼任
q_en: What body does the Executive Yuan establish for major urgent nuisance disputes, and who convenes it?
a_en: An Emergency Public Nuisance Dispute Task Force; with one convener, held concurrently by the Vice Premier
b_en: A Public Nuisance Dispute Supervision Task Force; with one convener, held by the Secretary-General
c_en: An Emergency Public Nuisance Relief Task Force; with one convener, held by the EPA Administrator
d_en: A Major Public Nuisance Dispute Review Committee; with one convener, held concurrently by the Premier
explain_zh: 第44條第1項：行政院為處理重大緊急公害糾紛，維護公共利益或社會安全，設緊急公害糾紛處理小組；置召集人一人，由行政院副院長兼任之。第46條則規定行政院環境保護署得設公害糾紛督導處理小組，召集人由環保署署長兼任。

law: 公害糾紛處理法
category: 公害糾紛-地方紓處小組
q_zh: 直轄市、縣（市）政府為主動處理突發及緊急之公害糾紛事件，應設何種組織？其召集人為何？
a_zh: 應設公害糾紛緊急紓處小組；置召集人一人，於直轄市由直轄市長或其指定之適當人員兼任，於縣（市）由縣（市）長兼任
b_zh: 應設公害糾紛裁決委員會地方分會；置召集人一人，由行政院環境保護署署長指派之人員擔任並專任而不得兼任他職
c_zh: 應設公害糾紛調處委員會分組；置召集人一人，於直轄市及縣（市）均由環境保護局局長兼任並由該局人員兼辦幕僚作業
d_zh: 應設公害糾紛督導處理小組地方分組；置召集人一人，由地方議會議長兼任並由議會提供幕僚支援及必要經費補助
q_en: What body must local governments establish for sudden and urgent nuisance events, and who convenes it?
a_en: An Emergency Public Nuisance Relief Task Force; with one convener, the mayor or a person he designates in municipalities and the magistrate in counties
b_en: A local branch of the adjudication committee; with one convener, a person designated by the EPA Administrator serving full time and holding no other post
c_en: A subgroup of the mediation committee; with one convener, the head of the environmental protection bureau in both cases, with bureau staff as secretariat
d_en: A local subgroup of the supervision task force; with one convener, the speaker of the local council, with the council providing secretariat and funding
explain_zh: 第44條第2項：直轄市、縣（市）政府為主動處理突發及緊急之公害糾紛事件，應設公害糾紛緊急紓處小組，置召集人一人，於直轄市由直轄市長或其指定之適當人員兼任，於縣（市）由縣（市）長兼任。第45條第2項並規定其組成由直轄市、縣（市）政府定之。

law: 公害糾紛處理法
q_zh: 行政院緊急公害糾紛處理小組之組織規程及地方緊急紓處小組之組成，分別由何機關訂定？
a_zh: 行政院緊急公害糾紛處理小組組織規程由立法院以法律定之；地方緊急紓處小組之組成則由地方議會以自治條例訂定發布
b_zh: 行政院緊急公害糾紛處理小組組織規程由行政院定之；直轄市、縣（市）政府公害糾紛緊急紓處小組之組成由直轄市、縣（市）政府定之
c_zh: 二者均由直轄市、縣（市）政府分別訂定並報請行政院備查；行政院僅就緊急公害糾紛處理小組之召集人人選保留最終決定權
d_zh: 二者均由行政院環境保護署擬訂後報請行政院核定發布之；地方政府不得就緊急紓處小組之組成另行訂定任何規定或作業要點
q_en: Who prescribes the organizational rules of the central emergency task force and of the local relief task forces?
a_en: The central task force's regulations are prescribed by statute of the Legislative Yuan; local compositions are prescribed by local council self-government ordinances
b_en: The Executive Yuan prescribes the central task force's organizational regulations; municipal and county governments prescribe the composition of their own relief task forces
c_en: Both are prescribed by municipal and county governments and filed with the Executive Yuan; the Executive Yuan retains only the choice of the central convener
d_en: Both are drafted by the Environmental Protection Administration and issued after Executive Yuan approval; localities may not make any rules of their own on composition
explain_zh: 第45條第1項：行政院緊急公害糾紛處理小組組織規程，由行政院定之。第2項：直轄市、縣（市）政府公害糾紛緊急紓處小組之組成，由直轄市、縣（市）政府定之。第47條另規定環保署公害糾紛督導處理小組組織規程由環保署擬訂報行政院核定後發布。

law: 公害糾紛處理法
q_zh: 行政院環境保護署得設之公害糾紛督導處理小組由哪些機關指派代表組成？其任務為何？召集人為何人？
a_zh: 由環境保護、法律及醫學等領域之學者專家所組成；任務為就個案提供鑑定意見並代替調處委員會作成調處方案及裁決書；召集人由學者專家互推一人擔任並由環保署提供幕僚
b_zh: 由各級調處委員會主任委員及裁決委員會主任委員組成；任務為統一調處與裁決之法律見解並逐案審核各地調處書之內容；召集人由裁決委員會主任委員專任並綜理該小組業務
c_zh: 由行政院各部會之首長及各直轄市長、縣（市）長等人共同組成；任務為裁決重大公害糾紛損害賠償事件並監督各地方調處委員會之運作績效與人事之任免；召集人由行政院副院長兼任並每年輪替一次
d_zh: 由內政部、法務部、經濟部、交通部、行政院新聞局、行政院衛生署、行政院農業委員會、行政院勞工委員會及環保署指派代表組成；任務為協調有關機關研擬處理方法及對策並提供地方必要支援；召集人由環保署署長兼任
q_en: Who makes up the EPA's supervision task force, what are its tasks, and who convenes it?
a_en: Scholars and experts in the environmental, legal and medical fields; it gives appraisal opinions on cases and drafts mediation proposals and awards in place of the committees; convened by one elected among them with the EPA as secretariat
b_en: The chairpersons of all mediation committees and of the adjudication committee; it unifies legal views on mediation and adjudication and vets each local record; convened full time by the adjudication chairperson
c_en: The heads of all of the Executive Yuan ministries together with the mayors and magistrates; it adjudicates major damages cases and supervises the performance and personnel of local mediation committees; convened by the Vice Premier on annual rotation
d_en: Representatives designated by the Interior, Justice, Economic Affairs, Transportation, GIO, Health, Agriculture and Labor agencies and the EPA; it coordinates agencies on handling methods and supports local governments; convened by the EPA Administrator
explain_zh: 第46條第1項：行政院環境保護署得設公害糾紛督導處理小組，由內政部、法務部、經濟部、交通部、行政院新聞局、行政院衛生署、行政院農業委員會、行政院勞工委員會及行政院環境保護署指派代表組成；任務為協調有關機關研擬公害糾紛事件之處理方法及對策，並提供直轄市、縣（市）政府處理公害糾紛事件必要之支援。第2項：置召集人一人，由行政院環境保護署署長兼任之。

law: 公害糾紛處理法
category: 公害糾紛-督導組織規程
q_zh: 行政院環境保護署公害糾紛督導處理小組之組織規程，應由何機關擬訂？其發布程序為何？
a_zh: 由內政部會同環境保護署擬訂後報請立法院備查發布
b_zh: 由督導處理小組自行擬訂並報請環保署署長核定發布
c_zh: 由行政院環境保護署擬訂，報請行政院核定後發布之
d_zh: 由行政院逕行擬訂並發布之，環境保護署不參與擬訂
q_en: Who drafts the supervision task force's organizational regulations, and how are they issued?
a_en: The Interior Ministry with the Administration drafts them and files them with the Legislature
b_en: The task force itself drafts them and issues them after approval by the EPA Administrator
c_en: The Environmental Protection Administration drafts them and issues them after Executive Yuan approval
d_en: The Executive Yuan drafts and issues them directly, with no part played by the Administration
explain_zh: 第47條：行政院環境保護署公害糾紛督導處理小組組織規程，由行政院環境保護署擬訂，報請行政院核定後發布之。此與第12條裁決委員會組織規程之訂定程序相同，均為環保署擬訂、行政院核定後發布。

law: 公害糾紛處理法
q_zh: 行政院環境保護署、直轄市及縣（市）政府應置專責人員執行哪些事務？鄉（鎮、市、區）公所有何規定？
a_zh: 應置專責人員執行公害稽查取締、污染源許可證核發及罰鍰之裁處；鄉（鎮、市、區）公所應一律置專責人員辦理前開事務並受環保局之指揮監督
b_zh: 應置專責人員辦理環境監測與檢驗測定及數據申報；鄉（鎮、市、區）公所不得置專責人員以避免與環保主管機關職權產生重疊競合
c_zh: 應置專責人員擔任調處委員及裁決委員並主持調處程序；鄉（鎮、市、區）公所應置專責人員代替調處委員會辦理轄區內公害糾紛之調處事務
d_zh: 應置專責人員處理公害陳情、為處理公害陳情所必要之調查指導及建議、指導陳情人依本法程序申請調處或裁決；鄉（鎮、市、區）公所得視需要置專責人員處理前開事務
q_en: What must dedicated personnel at the EPA and local governments do, and what about township offices?
a_en: Carry out nuisance inspection and enforcement work, issue pollution source permits and impose fines; township offices must all appoint such personnel and act under the direction of the environmental bureau
b_en: Carry out environmental monitoring, testing and data reporting; township offices may not appoint such personnel so as to avoid overlapping with the environmental authority
c_en: Serve as mediation and adjudication members and preside over the proceedings; township offices must appoint such personnel to mediate disputes in place of the mediation committee
d_en: Handle nuisance petitions, conduct the investigation, guidance and advice needed for them, and guide petitioners in applying for mediation or adjudication; township offices may appoint such personnel as needed
explain_zh: 第48條第1項：行政院環境保護署、直轄市及縣（市）政府應置專責人員，執行下列各款事務：處理公害陳情；為處理公害陳情所必要之調查、指導及建議；指導陳情人依本法程序申請調處或裁決。第2項：鄉（鎮、市、區）公所得視需要置專責人員，處理前項各款事務。

law: 公害糾紛處理法
q_zh: 依公害糾紛處理法應為文書之送達者，應依何種規定辦理？
a_zh: 準用民事訴訟法有關送達之規定辦理文書之送達
b_zh: 一律以公告方式代替送達而不必個別送達當事人
c_zh: 依調處委員會自行訂定之送達要點辦理文書送達
d_zh: 準用行政程序法有關送達之規定辦理文書之送達
q_en: Which rules govern service of documents under the Act?
a_en: The service provisions of the Code of Civil Procedure apply mutatis mutandis
b_en: Public notice always replaces service, with no individual service on parties
c_en: Service follows guidelines the mediation committee prescribes for itself
d_en: The service provisions of the Administrative Procedure Act apply mutatis mutandis
explain_zh: 第49條：依本法應為文書之送達者，準用民事訴訟法有關送達之規定。第37條第2項規定裁決書應於作成後十日內以正本送達於當事人，第39條並以裁決書正本送達日起算二十日之起訴期間，均以本條之送達規定為準。

law: 公害糾紛處理法
q_zh: 公害糾紛處理法之施行細則，應由何機關擬訂？其發布程序為何？
a_zh: 由直轄市、縣（市）政府分別訂定後報請環保署備查
b_zh: 由立法院於本法中直接規定而不另訂定其施行細則
c_zh: 由行政院逕行訂定並發布之，環境保護署不參與擬訂
d_zh: 由行政院環境保護署擬訂，報請行政院核定後發布之
q_en: Who drafts the enforcement rules of the Act, and how are they issued?
a_en: Municipal and county governments prescribe their own and file them with the Administration
b_en: The Legislative Yuan sets them out in the Act itself, so no separate enforcement rules exist
c_en: The Executive Yuan prescribes and issues them directly, with no part played by the Administration
d_en: The Environmental Protection Administration drafts them and issues them after Executive Yuan approval
explain_zh: 第50條：本法施行細則，由行政院環境保護署擬訂，報請行政院核定後發布之。此與第12條裁決委員會組織規程、第43條第2項收費辦法及第47條督導處理小組組織規程之訂定程序相同。

law: 公害糾紛處理法
q_zh: 公害糾紛處理法之施行日期如何規定？中華民國九十八年六月二日修正之條文自何日施行？
a_zh: 本法施行日期由行政院另定；中華民國九十八年六月二日修正之條文亦由行政院另定之
b_zh: 本法自公布後六個月施行；中華民國九十八年六月二日修正之條文，自公布日起即生效力
c_zh: 本法自公布後一年施行；中華民國九十八年六月二日修正之條文，自九十九年一月一日施行
d_zh: 本法自公布日施行；中華民國九十八年六月二日修正之條文，自九十八年十一月二十三日施行
q_en: How does the Act state its effective dates, including the amendments of 2 June 2009?
a_en: The Executive Yuan sets the Act's effective date; it also sets the date for the 2 June 2009 amendments
b_en: The Act takes effect six months after promulgation; the 2 June 2009 amendments take effect on promulgation
c_en: The Act takes effect one year after promulgation; the 2 June 2009 amendments take effect on 1 January 2010
d_en: The Act takes effect on promulgation; the amendments of 2 June 2009 take effect on 23 November 2009
explain_zh: 第51條第1項：本法自公布日施行。第2項：本法中華民國九十八年六月二日修正之條文，自九十八年十一月二十三日施行。故該次修正條文設有緩衝期而非自公布日生效。

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 《公害糾紛處理法施行細則》之訂定法源依據為何？
a_zh: 依公害糾紛處理法第三十條第二項規定訂定
b_zh: 依公害糾紛處理法第五十條規定訂定之
c_zh: 依環境影響評估法第五十條之規定訂定之
d_zh: 依公害糾紛處理法第四十三條規定訂定之
q_en: Under which provision are these Enforcement Rules enacted?
a_en: Enacted under Article 30, paragraph 2 of the Dispute Resolution Act
b_en: Enacted under Article 50 of the Public Nuisance Dispute Resolution Act
c_en: Enacted under Article 50 of the Environmental Impact Assessment Act
d_en: Enacted under Article 43 of the Public Nuisance Dispute Resolution Act
explain_zh: 第1條：本細則依公害糾紛處理法（本法）第五十條規定訂定之。本法第四十三條為調處及裁決費用之規定（第13條第6款、第35條均與其相關），第三十條第二項則為環境保護協定之規定（第28條、第29條據以規範）。
explain_en: Article 1 cites Article 50 of the Public Nuisance Dispute Resolution Act.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 公害糾紛調處或裁決程序中，當事人之稱謂如何區分？
a_zh: 申請調處或裁決者為原告，他造為被告，原告及被告均稱為程序關係人
b_zh: 申請調處或裁決者為申請人，他造為相對人，申請人及相對人均為當事人
c_zh: 申請調處或裁決者為聲請人，他造為利害關係人，僅聲請人為程序當事人
d_zh: 申請調處或裁決者為陳情人，他造為受陳情人，兩造均稱為公害關係人
q_en: How are the parties designated in a public nuisance mediation or ruling procedure?
a_en: The applicant is the plaintiff, the other side is the defendant, and both are called procedural participants
b_en: The applicant is the party applying, the other side is the respondent, and both are the parties to the dispute
c_en: The applicant is the petitioner, the other side is an interested person, and only the petitioner is a party
d_en: The applicant is the complainant, the other side is the complained-of party, and both are nuisance-related persons
explain_zh: 第2條第1項：申請調處或裁決者，為申請人，他造為相對人。第2項：申請人及相對人，均為公害糾紛之當事人。第3條所定調處申請書應記載當事人姓名等事項，即以本條之稱謂為據。
explain_en: Article 2 designates the applicant and the respondent, both being parties to the dispute.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 調處申請書應記載之事項及委任代理人之要求為何？
a_zh: 應記載當事人之財產狀況、營業收入、納稅紀錄及保險資料等，並由代理人於申請書上按捺指印以資確認
b_zh: 應記載公害發生地之地籍圖說、環境影響評估書件及主管機關歷次稽查紀錄，並檢附鑑定機構之估價報告
c_zh: 應記載當事人與代理人資料、請求事項、公害糾紛原因事實、供調查之證據及調處委員會名稱等，並提出委任書狀
d_zh: 應記載雙方已進行協商之次數、時間、地點及未達成協議之原因，並提出經公證之協商過程逐字紀錄稿
q_en: What must a mediation application state, and what is required of an appointed agent?
a_en: The parties' financial condition, business income, tax records and insurance details, with the agent affixing a fingerprint to the application
b_en: Cadastral maps of the nuisance site, environmental impact documents and past inspection records, with an appraisal institution's valuation report
c_en: Party and agent details, the claim, the cause and facts of the dispute, evidence for investigation and the committee's name, with a power of attorney filed
d_en: The number, times and places of prior negotiations and why no agreement was reached, with a notarized verbatim transcript of the negotiations
explain_zh: 第3條第1項列舉調處申請書應記載之八款事項，包括當事人姓名性別出生年月日職業及住居所（法人則為名稱、主事務所及代表人資料）、法定或委任代理人資料、請求事項、公害糾紛原因及事實、供調查之證據、附屬文件名稱及件數、調處委員會名稱、申請年月日，並由申請人簽名。第2項：委任代理人應提出委任書狀。第3項規定於申請裁決準用之。
explain_en: Article 3 lists the eight required particulars and requires an agent to file a power of attorney.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 調處申請書之抄本提出及程式欠缺時，應如何處理？
a_zh: 應按相對人或選定當事人人數提出抄本；不合程式或有欠缺者，調處委員會得通知申請人限期補正
b_zh: 應提出抄本一份送地方法院；不合程式或有欠缺者，應由申請人於調處期日當場以言詞補充說明
c_zh: 應按主管機關指定份數提出抄本；不合程式或有欠缺者，應由調處委員會職權代為補正其內容
d_zh: 應按調處委員人數提出抄本；不合程式或有欠缺者，調處委員會應逕行駁回其申請不另通知補正
q_en: How many copies of a mediation application are filed, and what applies if it is defective?
a_en: Copies are filed according to the number of respondents or selected parties; a defective application may be ordered corrected within a set period
b_en: One copy is filed with the district court; a defective application is supplemented orally by the applicant at the mediation date itself
c_en: Copies are filed in the number designated by the competent authority; a defective application is corrected by the committee on its own motion
d_en: Copies are filed according to the number of mediation committee members; a defective application is dismissed at once with no notice to correct
explain_zh: 第4條第1項：調處申請書應按相對人或選定當事人人數，提出抄本。第2項：調處申請書不合程式或有欠缺者，調處委員會得通知申請人於一定期間內補正。第3項：第1項規定於相對人提出答辯書者，準用之。第13條第5款並規定申請書不合程式或有欠缺者，屬申請不合法之情形。
explain_en: Article 4 requires copies matching the number of respondents or selected parties, with correction ordered for defects.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 本法第5條第2項所定有關機關代表，其職務有異動時應如何處理？
a_zh: 得由各該機關重行改派代表，補足原任期
b_zh: 得由該直轄市長、縣（市）長改聘他人
c_zh: 應由主任委員逕行遴聘適當人士繼任之
d_zh: 應報請中央主管機關核准後重新聘任之
q_en: What applies when an agency representative under Article 5, paragraph 2 of the Act changes position?
a_en: The agency may reassign a representative to serve out the original term
b_en: The mayor or county magistrate may appoint another person instead
c_en: The chairperson directly appoints a suitable person as the successor
d_en: A new appointment is made after approval by the central authority
explain_zh: 第5條：本法第五條第二項所定有關機關代表，職務有異動時，得由各該機關重行改派代表，補足原任期。可對照第7條，調處委員因解聘、辭職、失蹤達一年以上或死亡而出缺者，始由該直轄市長、縣（市）長遴聘適當人士為其繼任人。
explain_en: Article 5 allows the agency to reassign a representative for the remainder of the term.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 本法第6條第2項所定調處委員會委員「出缺」，指下列何種情形？
a_zh: 依本法第七條規定解聘、辭職、失蹤達三個月以上或屆齡退休者
b_zh: 因案遭起訴、連續二次未出席調處期日或經主任委員停止職務者
c_zh: 任期屆滿未獲續聘、請假逾三十日、出國或經當事人聲請迴避者
d_zh: 依本法第七條規定解聘、辭職、失蹤達一年以上或死亡等情形之一者
q_en: What counts as a vacancy of a mediation committee member under Article 6, paragraph 2 of the Act?
a_en: Dismissal under Article 7 of the Act, resignation, disappearance for three months or more, or retirement
b_en: Being indicted, missing two consecutive mediation dates, or suspension ordered by the chairperson
c_en: Expiry of term without renewal, leave exceeding thirty days, going abroad, or a recusal request
d_en: Dismissal under Article 7 of the Act, resignation, disappearance for one year or more, or death
explain_zh: 第6條：調處委員會委員出缺，指委員有依本法第7條規定解聘、辭職、失蹤達一年以上、死亡等情形之一。第7條：調處委員有前條情形者，由該直轄市長、縣（市）長遴聘適當人士為其繼任人。第23條第2項規定第6條、第7條、第12條之規定於裁決委員準用之。
explain_en: Article 6 lists dismissal, resignation, disappearance for one year or more, and death.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 調處委員出缺時，其繼任人由何人遴聘？
a_zh: 由調處委員會主任委員遴聘適當人士為其繼任人
b_zh: 由該直轄市長、縣（市）長遴聘適當人士為其繼任人
c_zh: 由中央主管機關就推薦名單中指定其繼任之人選
d_zh: 由裁決委員會主任委員指定適當人士為其繼任人
q_en: Who appoints a successor when a mediation committee member's seat falls vacant?
a_en: The chairperson of the mediation committee appoints a suitable person as the successor member
b_en: The mayor of the special municipality or the county (city) magistrate appoints a suitable successor
c_en: The central competent authority designates the successor from a list of recommended candidates
d_en: The chairperson of the ruling committee designates a suitable person as the successor member
explain_zh: 第7條：調處委員有前條（第6條）所定解聘、辭職、失蹤達一年以上、死亡等情形之一者，由該直轄市長、縣（市）長遴聘適當人士為其繼任人。第23條第2項並規定第6條、第7條之規定於裁決委員準用之。
explain_en: Article 7 has the mayor or county (city) magistrate appoint the successor.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 調處委員名簿應記載何項事項？並應報請何機關備查？
a_zh: 應記載姓名、身分證字號、戶籍地址、財產申報資料及家庭成員；報請中央主管機關及監察機關備查後公開
b_zh: 應記載姓名性別出生年月日及出生地、學經歷、職業及現行職務、專長、任期起訖；報請所在地地方法院及裁決委員會備查
c_zh: 應記載姓名、學歷、出席紀錄、發言內容及評議結果；報請所在地檢察機關及地方議會備查後對外公布
d_zh: 應記載姓名、聘期、酬勞金額、兼職情形及利益衝突聲明；報請行政院及所在地地方法院備查並公告
q_en: What must the roster of mediation committee members record, and to whom is it filed?
a_en: Name, ID number, household address, property declarations and family members; filed with the central competent authority and the control agency and then published
b_en: Name, sex, date and place of birth, education and experience, occupation and current post, expertise and term; filed with the local district court and the ruling committee
c_en: Name, education, attendance record, statements made and review outcomes; filed with the local prosecutors office and the council and then made public
d_en: Name, term, remuneration, concurrent posts and conflict of interest declarations; filed with the Executive Yuan and the district court and announced
explain_zh: 第8條第1項：調處委員會應備置調處委員名簿，登錄調處委員並記載姓名性別出生年月日及出生地、學歷及經歷、職業及現行職務、專長、任期起訖年月日等五款事項。第2項：名簿應報請所在地地方法院及裁決委員會備查，委員變動時亦同。第4項：當事人得請求閱覽、抄錄或影印調處委員名簿。
explain_en: Article 8 lists the five recorded particulars and requires filing with the local district court and the ruling committee.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 調處委員會收到調處申請書後，應於多久內訂定調處期日？第一次調處期日通知何時送達？
a_zh: 收到調處申請書後三個月內訂定調處期日；第一次調處期日之通知應於十四日前送達當事人
b_zh: 收到調處申請書後二個月內訂定調處期日；第一次調處期日之通知得於當日送達當事人即可
c_zh: 收到調處申請書後十五日內訂定調處期日；第一次調處期日之通知應於三日前送達當事人
d_zh: 收到調處申請書後一個月內訂定調處期日；第一次調處期日之通知應於七日前送達當事人
q_en: Within what period must a mediation date be set, and when is notice of the first date served?
a_en: Set the mediation date within three months of receiving the application; notice of the first date is served fourteen days in advance
b_en: Set the mediation date within two months of receiving the application; notice of the first date may be served on the day itself
c_en: Set the mediation date within fifteen days of receiving the application; notice of the first date is served three days in advance
d_en: Set the mediation date within one month of receiving the application; notice of the first date is served seven days in advance
explain_zh: 第9條第1項：調處委員會收到調處申請書後，應於一個月內訂定調處期日，並製作調處通知，記載到場之日、時及處所，送達於當事人。第2項：第一次調處期日之通知，應於七日前送達。經調處委員面告並載明紀錄者，與送達通知有同一效力。
explain_en: Article 9 requires setting the date within one month and serving notice of the first date seven days in advance.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 當事人就調處委員之選定有何權利？未被選定之委員有何效果？
a_zh: 當事人得聲請主任委員指定委員三人合議調處；未被選定之調處委員應於期日到場列席旁聽
b_zh: 當事人得共同選定委員一人或數人逕行調處；未被選定之調處委員於調處期日得不到場調處
c_zh: 當事人不得參與委員之選定而應由主任委員指派；全體調處委員均應於調處期日到場調處
d_zh: 當事人得各自選定委員一人擔任其代理人；未被選定之調處委員仍應全體到場參與調處程序
q_en: What right do the parties have over the selection of mediation members, and what follows for others?
a_en: The parties may ask the chairperson to designate three members to decide jointly; members not selected attend the date as observers
b_en: The parties may jointly select one or more members to mediate directly; members not selected need not attend the mediation date
c_en: The parties may not take part in the selection, which the chairperson makes; all mediation members must attend the mediation date
d_en: Each party may select one member as its own representative; members not selected must still all attend and take part in the procedure
explain_zh: 第10條第1項：當事人得共同選定委員一人或數人逕行調處。第2項：前項選定後，未被選定之調處委員於調處期日，得不到場調處。可對照第11條，指定管轄事件始由裁決委員會主任委員指定委員三人或五人合議決定。
explain_en: Article 10 lets the parties jointly select members, and unselected members need not attend.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 申請指定調處委員會管轄者，應如何辦理？由何人以何種方式決定？
a_zh: 應將有關書件送交中央主管機關，由部長指定委員五人或七人，以多數決方式決定其管轄
b_zh: 應將有關書件送交行政院，由院長指定政務委員一人，以行政命令方式決定其管轄歸屬
c_zh: 應將有關書件送交裁決委員會，由主任委員指定委員三人或五人，以合議方式決定其管轄
d_zh: 應將有關書件送交所在地地方法院，由院長指定法官三人，以裁定方式決定其管轄之歸屬
q_en: How is an application to designate a competent mediation committee handled, and who decides?
a_en: The documents go to the central competent authority, whose minister designates five or seven members to decide by majority
b_en: The documents go to the Executive Yuan, whose premier designates one minister to decide by administrative order
c_en: The documents go to the ruling committee, whose chairperson designates three or five members to decide collegially
d_en: The documents go to the local district court, whose president designates three judges to decide the matter by ruling
explain_zh: 第11條第1項：依本法第十六條第一項規定申請指定調處委員會管轄者，應將有關書件送交裁決委員會，由主任委員指定委員三人或五人，以合議決定之。第2項：裁決委員會得指定直轄市或縣（市）調處委員會管轄。第3項：為指定後應即通知當事人及受指定之調處委員會。
explain_en: Article 11 sends the documents to the ruling committee, whose chairperson names three or five members to decide collegially.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 調處委員有應迴避情形而不自行迴避，或有偏頗之虞時，應如何處理？
a_zh: 主任委員應依職權或依當事人之申請，為迴避之決定
b_zh: 當事人應向所在地地方法院聲請裁定其迴避之事由
c_zh: 該調處委員應自行辭職並由市長另行遴聘繼任人選
d_zh: 應由調處委員會全體委員以無記名投票方式決議之
q_en: What applies where a mediation member does not recuse himself or may be biased?
a_en: The chairperson decides on recusal on his own initiative or on a party's application
b_en: The party applies to the local district court for a ruling ordering the recusal
c_en: The member must resign and the mayor must appoint another person as successor
d_en: All members of the mediation committee decide the matter by secret ballot vote
explain_zh: 第12條：調處委員有本法第十七條所定情形而不自行迴避，或有事實足認其執行職務有偏頗之虞者，主任委員應依職權或依當事人之申請，為迴避之決定。第23條第2項並規定本條規定於裁決委員準用之。
explain_en: Article 12 has the chairperson decide on recusal ex officio or on a party's application.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 下列何者屬本法第18條第1項所稱「申請不合法」之情形？
a_zh: 相對人已於調處期日到場，但拒絕接受申請人所提出之損害賠償金額者
b_zh: 申請人未於申請書中記載請求金額之具體計算方式及檢附鑑定報告者
c_zh: 同一事件已依本法規定受理，或已依本法第三十一條第一項規定向法院起訴者
d_zh: 申請人所主張之公害事實發生於申請日前二年以上而未曾提出陳情者
q_en: Which of the following makes an application unlawful under Article 18, paragraph 1 of the Act?
a_en: The opposing party attended the mediation date but refused to accept the compensation amount proposed by the applicant
b_en: The applicant did not state the detailed calculation of the claim amount or attach an appraisal report to the application
c_en: The same matter has already been accepted under the Act, or an action has been filed under Article 31, paragraph 1 of the Act
d_en: The public nuisance asserted by the applicant occurred more than two years before the application was filed
explain_zh: 第13條列舉申請不合法之九款情形，包括第7款同一事件已依本法規定受理或依本法第31條第1項、第39條第1項規定起訴者；另包括當事人無當事人能力、無行為能力、代理權欠缺、當事人不適格、申請書不合程式、未依第43條繳納費用、同一事件經法院核定或已取得強制執行名義等。
explain_en: Article 13, subparagraph 7 lists a matter already accepted or already brought before a court.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 調處委員會依本法第18條第3項規定為移送時，應如何辦理？
a_zh: 應將有關書件送交所在地地方法院，並由法院逕行通知兩造當事人到場說明
b_zh: 應將有關書件送交裁決委員會轉交，並於移送後三十日內公告其移送之結果
c_zh: 應將有關書件留存原委員會備查，並僅通知申請人而無庸通知相對人知悉
d_zh: 應將有關書件送交受移送之調處委員會，並即通知當事人；其有代理人者亦同
q_en: How must a mediation committee effect a transfer under Article 18, paragraph 3 of the Act?
a_en: Send the documents to the local district court, which then notifies both parties to appear and give their explanations
b_en: Send the documents through the ruling committee, and announce the outcome of the transfer within thirty days after it
c_en: Keep the documents at the original committee for record, and notify only the applicant without notifying the respondent
d_en: Send the documents to the receiving mediation committee and immediately notify the parties, and their agents where any
explain_zh: 第14條：調處委員會依本法第十八條第三項規定為移送時，應將有關書件送交受移送之調處委員會，並即通知當事人，其有代理人者，亦同。第13條並列舉本法第十八條第一項所稱申請不合法之九款情形。
explain_en: Article 14 requires sending the documents to the receiving committee and immediately notifying the parties and their agents.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 多數有共同利益之當事人就同一公害原因分別申請調處者，調處委員會得如何處理？
a_zh: 調處委員會應分別進行調處
b_zh: 調處委員會應移送裁決委員會
c_zh: 調處委員會得合併進行調處
d_zh: 調處委員會得逕行駁回其申請
q_en: What may a mediation committee do where multiple parties with a common interest apply separately over the same cause?
a_en: The mediation committee must mediate each case separately
b_en: The mediation committee must transfer them to the ruling body
c_en: The mediation committee may consolidate the mediations
d_en: The mediation committee may dismiss the applications outright
explain_zh: 第15條：多數有共同利益之公害糾紛當事人，就同一公害原因分別申請調處者，調處委員會得合併進行調處。第16條並就依本法第二十條第一項選定當事人之情形，規定調處委員會得不通知未被選定之人於調處期日到場。
explain_en: Article 15 allows consolidation of mediations arising from the same cause.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 多數有共同利益之當事人依本法第20條第1項為選定後，其效果為何？
a_zh: 調處委員會仍應通知全體當事人到場，選定之通知於作成之日起即發生效力
b_zh: 調處委員會應停止程序俟法院裁定，選定之通知須經法院核定後始發生效力
c_zh: 調處委員會得逕行駁回其選定之申請，選定之通知於公告七日後始發生效力
d_zh: 調處委員會得不通知未被選定之人到場，選定之通知於送達相對人後發生效力
q_en: What follows once parties with a common interest make a selection under Article 20, paragraph 1 of the Act?
a_en: The committee must still notify all parties to attend, and the notice of selection takes effect from the day it is made out
b_en: The committee must stay the procedure pending a court ruling, and the notice takes effect only after court approval
c_en: The committee may dismiss the selection application outright, and the notice takes effect seven days after announcement
d_en: The committee need not notify unselected persons to attend, and the notice of selection takes effect on service on the respondent
explain_zh: 第16條第1項：多數有共同利益之公害糾紛當事人依本法第二十條第一項為選定後，調處委員會得不通知未被選定之人於調處期日到場。第2項：選定之通知，於送達相對人後，發生效力。第3項：被選定之人中有喪失資格者，其他被選定之人仍得為全體申請或進行調處。第4項並得建議或協助再為選定。
explain_en: Article 16 allows omitting notice to unselected persons, with the selection notice effective on service on the respondent.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 調處程序之進行場所及保密義務規定為何？
a_zh: 應一律於調處委員會辦公處所行之；調處委員及經辦人員得就調處內容對外公開說明其經過
b_zh: 應於公害發生地之鄉鎮市區公所行之；調處委員及經辦人員應將全部內容公告於機關之網站
c_zh: 得於任一方當事人指定之場所行之；調處委員及經辦人員僅就涉及營業秘密部分負保密義務
d_zh: 得於調處委員會辦公處所或其他適當場所行之；調處委員及經辦人員除已公開事項外應保守秘密
q_en: Where may mediation be conducted, and what confidentiality duty applies?
a_en: It must always be held at the committee's office; members and staff may publicly explain the course of the mediation to outsiders
b_en: It must be held at the township or district office of the nuisance site; members and staff must post the full content on the website
c_en: It may be held at a place designated by either party; members and staff owe confidentiality only as to trade secrets involved
d_en: It may be held at the committee's office or another suitable place; members and staff keep matters confidential except those already public
explain_zh: 第17條第1項：調處程序，得於調處委員會辦公處所或其他適當之場所行之。第2項：調處委員或經辦調處事務之人，對於調處事件，除已公開之事項外，應保守秘密。第23條第1項並規定第15條至第22條之規定於裁決程序準用之。
explain_en: Article 17 allows the office or another suitable place and requires confidentiality except for matters already public.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 調處進行中有人以強暴、脅迫或詐術妨礙調處者，調處委員得如何處理？
a_zh: 調處委員得請求警察機關協助排除，並依法處理
b_zh: 調處委員得逕行對該人科處罰鍰並命其離場
c_zh: 調處委員應立即宣告調處不成立並終結其程序
d_zh: 調處委員應報請裁決委員會決定其處理方式
q_en: What may a mediation member do where someone obstructs mediation by violence, threat or deceit?
a_en: The member may request police assistance to remove the obstruction and handle it according to law
b_en: The member may directly impose an administrative fine on that person and order them to leave
c_en: The member must immediately declare the mediation failed and terminate the entire procedure
d_en: The member must report to the ruling committee for it to decide how the matter is handled
explain_zh: 第18條：調處進行中在場之人，如有以強暴、脅迫或詐術進行或妨礙調處，或為其他涉嫌犯罪之行為者，調處委員得請求警察機關協助排除，並依法處理。第24條所定調處不成立之事由，則為相對人明示拒絕調處或一造連續二次無正當理由不到場。
explain_en: Article 18 allows requesting police assistance and handling the matter according to law.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 調處委員會就證據之調查，有何權限？
a_zh: 應委由所在地地方法院代為調查證據，並以法院調查結果為準據
b_zh: 得依職權調查證據，不受當事人提出之證據及請求調查證據之拘束
c_zh: 應俟兩造當事人合意後始得調查證據，一造反對者即不得調查之
d_zh: 僅得就當事人提出之證據為調查，不得依職權另行調查其他證據
q_en: What power does the mediation committee have over the investigation of evidence?
a_en: It must have the local district court investigate the evidence and must follow the results of that court investigation
b_en: It may investigate evidence ex officio and is not bound by the evidence offered or investigation requested by the parties
c_en: It may investigate evidence only once both parties agree, and may not do so where either party objects to it
d_en: It may investigate only the evidence offered by the parties and may not investigate other evidence on its own motion
explain_zh: 第19條：調處委員會得依職權調查證據，不受當事人提出之證據及請求調查證據之拘束。第20條並列舉調查證據時得為之處置；第21條規定主任委員得於調處期日前指定委員一人先行審查申請書或調查證據。
explain_en: Article 19 allows ex officio investigation, unbound by the parties' offers or requests.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 調處委員會因調查證據之必要，得為下列何種處置？
a_zh: 命當事人先行繳納鑑定費用、指定特定鑑定機構、逕行採信一造之陳述、拒絕另一造提出證據
b_zh: 拘提無正當理由不到場之證人、對拒絕陳述者科處罰鍰、查封當事人之財產、限制當事人出境
c_zh: 請當事人或關係人提出文書表冊物件、詢問證人或鑑定人、請有關機關協助提供文書、進行勘驗或鑑定
d_zh: 搜索當事人之營業處所、扣押相關帳冊憑證、監聽當事人之通訊、命令關係人具保後始得離境
q_en: What measures may the mediation committee take when investigating evidence?
a_en: Order a party to prepay appraisal fees, designate a particular appraiser, accept one side's statement, and refuse the other's evidence
b_en: Summon absent witnesses by force, fine those refusing to state, seize the parties' property, and restrict the parties from leaving the country
c_en: Ask parties or others to produce documents and objects, question witnesses or experts, seek agency assistance, and conduct inspection or appraisal
d_en: Search the parties' business premises, impound account books and vouchers, intercept communications, and require bail before departure
explain_zh: 第20條：調處委員會因調查證據之必要，得請當事人或其他關係人提出文書、表冊及物件，聽取當事人之意見、詢問證人或鑑定人或取得其書面意見，請有關機關協助提供有關文書、表冊及物件，以及進行勘驗或鑑定等四款處置。第22條並規定當事人或代理人於調處進行中得請求閱覽、抄錄或影印有關文書表冊及物件。
explain_en: Article 20 lists production of documents, questioning of witnesses and experts, agency assistance, and inspection or appraisal.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 調處委員會主任委員於調處期日前，得為何種安排？
a_zh: 得委由公害發生地之鄉鎮市公所先行協調，並以協調結果作為調處書
b_zh: 得指定委員一人先行審查調處申請書或調查證據，並於開會時提出意見
c_zh: 得指定委員三人先行作成調處方案，並於開會時逕付表決通過後生效
d_zh: 得指定書記官先行約詢兩造當事人，並於開會時代為陳述其協商結果
q_en: What may the chairperson arrange before the mediation date?
a_en: Commission the township office of the nuisance site to mediate first and use that result as the mediation record
b_en: Designate one member to review the application or investigate evidence beforehand and present views at the meeting
c_en: Designate three members to draft a mediation proposal beforehand, to be put to a vote and take effect at the meeting
d_en: Designate a clerk to interview both parties beforehand and to state the results of their negotiation at the meeting
explain_zh: 第21條：調處委員會主任委員得於調處期日前，指定委員一人先行審查調處申請書或調查證據，於開會時提出意見。第9條第1項並規定調處委員會收到調處申請書後應於一個月內訂定調處期日。
explain_en: Article 21 allows designating one member for advance review or evidence investigation.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 當事人或代理人於調處進行中，就有關文書、表冊及物件有何權利？
a_zh: 得請求閱覽、抄錄或影印有關之文書、表冊及物件
b_zh: 僅得請求閱覽，不得抄錄或影印其文書及表冊
c_zh: 應經他造當事人書面同意後始得請求閱覽抄錄
d_zh: 應俟調處成立並經法院核定後始得請求其影印
q_en: What right do parties or agents have over documents and objects during mediation?
a_en: They may request to read, transcribe or photocopy the relevant documents, records and objects
b_en: They may only request to read them, and may not transcribe or photocopy the documents
c_en: They may request access only with the other party's written consent given in advance
d_en: They may request photocopies only after mediation succeeds and the court approves it
explain_zh: 第22條：當事人或代理人於調處進行中，得請求閱覽、抄錄或影印有關文書、表冊及物件。第8條第4項並規定當事人得向調處委員會請求閱覽、抄錄或影印調處委員名簿；第23條第1項規定本條於裁決程序準用之。
explain_en: Article 22 grants the right to read, transcribe or photocopy relevant documents and objects.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 本細則有關調處之規定，於裁決程序及裁決委員之準用範圍為何？
a_zh: 全部有關調處之規定於裁決程序一體準用；惟有關調處委員之規定均不得於裁決委員之情形準用
b_zh: 第二十四條至第二十七條之規定於裁決程序準用；第二十八條、第二十九條之規定於裁決委員準用之
c_zh: 第四條、第九條、第十五條至第二十二條之規定於裁決程序準用；第六條、第七條、第十二條之規定於裁決委員準用
d_zh: 第一條至第十條之規定於裁決程序準用；第十一條至第二十條之規定於裁決委員及其主任委員一併準用之
q_en: To what extent do the mediation provisions apply mutatis mutandis to ruling procedures and ruling members?
a_en: All mediation provisions apply wholesale to ruling procedures; none of the provisions on members apply to ruling members
b_en: Articles 24 to 27 apply to ruling procedures; Articles 28 and 29 apply to the members of the ruling committee
c_en: Articles 4, 9 and 15 to 22 apply to ruling procedures; Articles 6, 7 and 12 apply to ruling committee members
d_en: Articles 1 to 10 apply to ruling procedures; Articles 11 to 20 apply to ruling members and their chairperson alike
explain_zh: 第23條第1項：第四條、第九條、第十五條至第二十二條之規定，於裁決程序準用之。第2項：第六條、第七條、第十二條之規定，於裁決委員準用之。第3條第3項並規定調處申請書之記載事項於申請裁決準用；第8條第3項規定調處委員名簿規定於裁決委員會準用。
explain_en: Article 23 applies Articles 4, 9 and 15 to 22 to ruling procedures and Articles 6, 7 and 12 to ruling members.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 調處在何種情形下不成立或視為不成立？
a_zh: 相對人未於七日內提出答辯者調處不成立；一造無正當理由一次調處期日不到場者即視為不成立
b_zh: 相對人明示拒絕調處者調處不成立；一造無正當理由連續二次調處期日不到場者視為調處不成立
c_zh: 相對人明示拒絕調處者應另定期日；一造無正當理由連續五次調處期日不到場者視為調處不成立
d_zh: 相對人明示拒絕調處者調處不成立；一造無正當理由連續三次調處期日不到場者視為調處不成立
q_en: When does mediation fail or get deemed to have failed?
a_en: Mediation fails if the opposing party files no defence in seven days; it is deemed failed if a party misses one date without justification
b_en: Mediation fails if the opposing party expressly refuses; it is deemed failed if a party misses two consecutive dates without justification
c_en: A new date is set if the opposing party expressly refuses; it is deemed failed if a party misses five consecutive dates without justification
d_en: Mediation fails if the opposing party expressly refuses; it is deemed failed if a party misses three consecutive dates without justification
explain_zh: 第24條第1項：相對人以書面或於調處期日以言詞明示拒絕調處者，調處不成立。第2項：當事人一造無正當理由，連續二次調處期日不到場者，視為調處不成立；但調處委員會認為有成立調處之望者，得另定調處期日。第25條並規定調處不成立者應於七日內作成通知送達當事人。
explain_en: Article 24 provides for failure on express refusal and deemed failure after two consecutive unjustified absences.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 調處不成立者，調處委員會應如何通知當事人？
a_zh: 調處不成立者，調處委員會得於次一調處期日當場以言詞告知兩造當事人即可
b_zh: 調處不成立者，調處委員會應於七日內作成調處不成立之通知，送達於當事人
c_zh: 調處不成立者，調處委員會應於三十日內作成調處不成立之通知，送達於當事人
d_zh: 調處不成立者，調處委員會應於十五日內報請裁決委員會轉知兩造之當事人
q_en: How must the mediation committee notify the parties when mediation fails?
a_en: Where mediation fails, the committee may simply inform both parties orally at the next scheduled mediation date
b_en: Where mediation fails, the committee shall prepare a notice of failure within seven days and serve it on the parties
c_en: Where mediation fails, the committee shall prepare a notice of failure within thirty days and serve it on the parties
d_en: Where mediation fails, the committee shall report within fifteen days to the ruling committee to notify the parties
explain_zh: 第25條：調處不成立者，調處委員會應於七日內作成調處不成立之通知，送達當事人。第24條規定調處不成立之事由；第32條第1項並規定直轄市、縣（市）調處委員會每六個月應將前六個月辦理調處業務之概況併同法院核定之調處書，報請裁決委員會備查。
explain_en: Article 25 requires a written notice of failure within seven days, served on the parties.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 《公害糾紛處理法施行細則》第26條之現行條文內容為何？
a_zh: 該條規定管轄法院係指委員會所在地法院；其管轄之認定依第二十七條規定辦理之
b_zh: 該條規定調處不成立者應於三十日內作成通知；其送達方式並依第九條規定辦理即可
c_zh: 該條已刪除而無實質規定；調處不成立之通知期限，現依第二十五條規定於七日內作成送達
d_zh: 該條規定調處委員會應每六個月報請備查；其報請備查之內容依第三十二條規定辦理
q_en: What does Article 26 of these Enforcement Rules currently provide?
a_en: The article defines the court of jurisdiction as that of the committee's seat, a matter set by Article 27
b_en: The article requires a notice of failed mediation within thirty days, with service governed by Article 9 of the Rules
c_en: The article has been deleted and has no substantive content; the seven-day notice of failed mediation is now in Article 25
d_en: The article requires the mediation committee to report every six months, the content being set by Article 32
explain_zh: 本細則第26條現行條文僅載「（刪除）」，已無實質規定。調處不成立者，現依第25條規定，調處委員會應於七日內作成調處不成立之通知，送達當事人；第24條並規定相對人明示拒絕調處者調處不成立，一造無正當理由連續二次調處期日不到場者視為調處不成立。
explain_en: Article 26 has been deleted; the seven-day notice of failed mediation is in Article 25.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 本法第28條第1項、第39條第2項所稱之「管轄法院」，係指何者？
a_zh: 指調處委員會及裁決委員會所在地之管轄地方法院
b_zh: 指最高法院指定之專業環境事件審理管轄法院
c_zh: 指公害糾紛發生地或損害結果地之管轄地方法院
d_zh: 指相對人事業所在地或其主事務所之管轄法院
q_en: What is the court of jurisdiction under Article 28, paragraph 1 and Article 39, paragraph 2 of the Act?
a_en: The district court having jurisdiction over the seat of the mediation and ruling committees
b_en: A specialist environmental court designated for such cases by the Supreme Court
c_en: The district court having jurisdiction over the place of the nuisance or of the damage
d_en: The court having jurisdiction over the respondent enterprise or its principal office
explain_zh: 第27條：本法第二十八條第一項、第三十九條第二項所稱之管轄法院，係指調處委員會及裁決委員會所在地之管轄地方法院。第8條第2項並規定調處委員名簿應報請所在地地方法院備查。
explain_en: Article 27 defines it as the district court where the mediation and ruling committees are seated.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 本法第30條第2項所稱「所在地居民」，其定義為何？
a_zh: 指環境保護協定簽訂前一年起，設籍於同一直轄市或縣（市），並年滿二十歲之居民
b_zh: 指環境保護協定簽訂時，實際居住於事業周邊五公里範圍內，且持有房屋所有權之居民
c_zh: 指受該公害影響地區內之全體居民，不以設籍或實際居住於該地區者為其認定要件
d_zh: 指環境保護協定簽訂時，實際居住於與事業同一或相鄰行政區域，並完成戶籍登記之居民
q_en: How are local residents defined under Article 30, paragraph 2 of the Act?
a_en: Residents registered in the same municipality or county for at least one year before signing and who are at least twenty years of age
b_en: Residents who actually lived within five kilometres of the enterprise's boundary and held ownership of a house there when the agreement was signed
c_en: All residents of the area affected by the public nuisance, regardless of household registration or actual residence in that area
d_en: Residents who actually lived in the same or an adjacent administrative district as the enterprise and were household-registered when the agreement was signed
explain_zh: 第28條第2款：所在地居民係指環境保護協定簽訂時，實際居住於與事業同一或相鄰行政區域，並完成戶籍登記之居民。第1款定義環境保護協定為事業與所在地居民或地方政府基於雙方合意簽訂之書面協議；第3款定義地方政府包括直轄市政府、縣（市）政府或鄉（鎮、市）公所。第29條規定協定應載明之七項事項。
explain_en: Article 28, subparagraph 2 requires actual residence in the same or an adjacent district plus household registration at signing.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 環境保護協定應載明之事項為何？
a_zh: 簽訂協定之人、居民戶籍資料、地方政府核准文號、環境影響評估結論、監測項目及簽訂之年月日
b_zh: 簽訂協定之人、協定標的、違約金額計算方式、仲裁機構名稱、管轄法院、擔保方式及簽訂之年月日
c_zh: 簽訂協定之人、雙方資本額、環境保護支出預算、員工人數、產品項目、協定有效期間及簽訂之年月日
d_zh: 簽訂協定之人、協定標的、環境保護措施、緊急應變計畫、其他環境保護約定事項、協定有效期間及簽訂年月日
q_en: What must an environmental protection agreement state?
a_en: The signatories, residents' household registration data, the local government approval number, EIA conclusions, monitoring items and the date
b_en: The signatories, the subject matter, how penalties are calculated, the arbitration body, the competent court, the security and the signing date
c_en: The signatories, each side's registered capital, the environmental spending budget, headcount, product items, the valid period and the date of signing
d_en: The signatories, the subject matter, environmental protection measures, the emergency response plan, other agreed matters, the valid period and the signing date
explain_zh: 第29條：環境保護協定應載明簽訂協定之人、協定標的、環境保護措施、緊急應變計畫、其他有關環境保護約定事項、協定有效期間、簽訂年、月、日等七款事項，並由雙方簽名。第28條第1款並定義環境保護協定為事業與所在地居民或地方政府基於雙方合意所簽訂之書面協議。
explain_en: Article 29 lists the seven required particulars, signed by both sides.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 裁決委員會依本法第35條行詢問時，其詢問紀錄應記明何項事項？並應如何確認？
a_zh: 應記明處所與年月日、裁決委員之學經歷、事件、到場人員之聯絡電話、詢問問題編號及作答時間；並公告於機關網站供公眾查閱
b_zh: 應記明處所與年月日、裁決委員及紀錄職員姓名、事件、到場人員、程序公開與否、聲明陳述及證人鑑定結果；並向當事人朗讀或交其閱覽後簽名
c_zh: 應記明處所與年月日、當事人之財產狀況、事件、到場人員之住所、預估賠償金額、分期方式及利息；並由紀錄職員逕行歸檔無須簽名
d_zh: 應記明處所與年月日、雙方之律師費用、事件、到場人員之職稱、程序進行時數、休息次數及旁聽人數；並由主任委員一人簽名確認即可
q_en: What must a ruling committee inquiry record state, and how is it confirmed?
a_en: The place and date, the members' qualifications, the case, attendees' phone numbers, question numbers and answering times; posted on the website for public inspection
b_en: The place and date, names of members and the recording officer, the case, those attending, whether it was public, statements made and expert findings; read or shown to the parties for signature
c_en: The place and date, the parties' financial condition, the case, attendees' addresses, estimated compensation, instalments and interest; filed by the recording officer without signature
d_en: The place and date, both sides' attorney fees, the case, the titles of attendees, the hours of proceedings, breaks taken and the number of observers; signed by the chairperson alone
explain_zh: 第30條第1項：裁決委員會行詢問時，應命職員製作詢問紀錄，記明詢問之處所及年月日、裁決委員及紀錄職員姓名、公害糾紛事件、到場當事人代表人及代理人姓名、程序之公開或不公開及不公開理由、當事人所為之聲明或陳述、證人之陳述或鑑定人之鑑定結果等七款。第2項：詢問紀錄應向當事人朗讀或交其閱覽，並請其於紀錄內簽名。第3項：裁決委員及紀錄職員亦應簽名。
explain_en: Article 30 lists the seven required particulars, read or shown to the parties who sign, with members and the recorder also signing.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 裁決委員會行詢問期日，當事人一造經合法通知無正當理由不到場者，應如何處理？
a_zh: 得逕行停止裁決程序並移送調處委員會；不到場者經再通知仍不到場，即由主管機關逕為行政處分
b_zh: 得依到場當事人申請由其一造陳述而為裁決；不到場者經再通知仍不到場，並得依職權由一造陳述而為裁決
c_zh: 應延展詢問期日並重新通知兩造；不到場者經再通知仍不到場，即視為其撤回申請並終結該裁決程序
d_zh: 應逕以不到場之當事人敗訴而為裁決；不到場者經再通知仍不到場，並應移送所在地地方法院審理
q_en: What applies where a duly notified party fails to appear at the ruling inquiry without justification?
a_en: The ruling procedure is stayed and transferred to the mediation committee; on a further failure the authority issues an administrative act
b_en: A ruling may be made on the attending party's statement upon its application; on a further failure to appear it may also be made ex officio
c_en: The inquiry date is postponed and both parties re-notified; on a further failure to appear the application is deemed withdrawn and closed
d_en: A ruling is made directly against the absent party; on a further failure to appear the case is transferred to the local district court
explain_zh: 第31條第1項：裁決委員會行詢問期日，當事人一造經合法通知無正當理由不到場者，得依到場當事人申請，由其一造陳述而為裁決；不到場之當事人，經再通知而仍不到場者，並得依職權由一造陳述而為裁決。第2項：如以前已為陳述或證據調查或未到場人有書面陳述者，為裁決時應斟酌之。
explain_en: Article 31 allows a one-sided ruling on application, and ex officio after a further failure to appear.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 直轄市、縣（市）調處委員會應如何向裁決委員會報備辦理調處業務之情形？
a_zh: 每年應將前一年度辦理調處業務之概況，併同當事人之協議書，報請所在地地方法院備查
b_zh: 每三個月應將前三個月辦理調處業務之概況，併同法院核定之調處書，報請中央主管機關核備
c_zh: 每六個月應將前六個月辦理調處業務之概況，併同法院核定之調處書，報請裁決委員會備查
d_zh: 每季應將辦理調處業務之概況，併同各該裁決書，報請行政院環境保護署審查後對外公開
q_en: How must a local mediation committee report its mediation caseload to the ruling committee?
a_en: Every year report the preceding year's mediation caseload with the parties' settlement agreements to the local district court
b_en: Every three months report the preceding three months' mediation caseload with court-approved records to the central competent authority
c_en: Every six months report the preceding six months' mediation caseload with court-approved mediation records to the ruling committee
d_en: Every quarter report the mediation caseload with the ruling documents to the Environmental Protection Administration for review
explain_zh: 第32條第1項：直轄市、縣（市）調處委員會每六個月應將前六個月辦理調處業務之概況，併同法院核定之調處書，報請裁決委員會備查。第2項：關於調處及裁決事件之文書，應按一案一卷之方式編訂卷宗管理。第36條並規定公害陳情事務辦理概況應陳報上級機關層轉備查。
explain_en: Article 32, paragraph 1 requires a semi-annual report with court-approved mediation records to the ruling committee.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 本法第16條第1項、第33條第1項之申請，多數有共同利益之當事人得如何為之？
a_zh: 多數有共同利益之公害糾紛當事人僅得單獨為之
b_zh: 應先選定當事人後由被選定之人代表全體為之
c_zh: 多數有共同利益之公害糾紛當事人得單獨或共同為之
d_zh: 多數有共同利益之公害糾紛當事人僅得共同為之
q_en: How may multiple parties with a common interest make an application under Article 16 or 33 of the Act?
a_en: Parties with a common interest may make the application only individually
b_en: They must first select representatives who then apply on behalf of them all
c_en: Parties with a common interest may make the application individually or jointly
d_en: Parties with a common interest may make the application only jointly together
explain_zh: 第33條：本法第十六條第一項、第三十三條第一項之申請，多數有共同利益之公害糾紛當事人得單獨或共同為之。第11條並就本法第十六條第一項指定管轄之申請程序另有規定；第16條則就選定當事人之效果為規範。
explain_en: Article 33 allows such applications individually or jointly.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 《公害糾紛處理法施行細則》第34條之現行條文內容為何？
a_zh: 該條規定多數共同利益當事人之申請方式；其得單獨或共同為之依第三十三條辦理
b_zh: 該條規定裁決費用一律由申請人自行負擔；其繳納方式並依第十三條第六款規定辦理
c_zh: 該條已刪除而無實質規定；裁決費用之分擔，現依第三十五條得申請兩造比例分擔或相對人負擔
d_zh: 該條規定公害陳情事務之卷宗編訂管理；其陳報上級機關備查依第三十六條辦理
q_en: What does Article 34 of these Enforcement Rules currently provide?
a_en: The article governs how parties with a common interest apply, a matter now provided for in Article 33
b_en: The article makes the applicant bear all ruling fees itself, with payment governed by Article 13, subparagraph 6
c_en: The article has been deleted and has no substantive content; apportionment of ruling fees is now governed by Article 35
d_en: The article governs the filing of public nuisance complaint records, with reporting set out in Article 36
explain_zh: 本細則第34條現行條文僅載「（刪除）」，已無實質規定。當事人申請裁決時依本法第43條所繳納之費用，現依第35條規定，得申請裁決委員會裁決兩造比例分擔或由相對人負擔；第13條第6款並規定未依本法第43條繳納費用者，屬申請不合法之情形；第37條則規定移送之事件免繳調處費。
explain_en: Article 34 has been deleted; apportionment of ruling fees is in Article 35.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 當事人申請裁決時所繳納之費用，得如何處理？
a_zh: 得申請調處委員會裁定由主管機關就環保基金支應之
b_zh: 應俟裁決確定後由敗訴一造向勝訴一造全額償還之
c_zh: 應由申請人全額自行負擔，不得申請由相對人負擔之
d_zh: 得申請裁決委員會裁決由兩造比例分擔或由相對人負擔
q_en: How may the fee paid on applying for a ruling be dealt with?
a_en: The applicant may ask the mediation committee to have the authority pay it from an environmental fund
b_en: The losing party must reimburse the winning party in full once the ruling has become final and binding
c_en: The applicant must bear the whole fee itself and may not ask that the respondent bear any part of it
d_en: The applicant may ask the ruling committee to apportion it between the parties or place it on the respondent
explain_zh: 第35條：當事人申請裁決時，其依本法第四十三條規定所繳納之費用，得申請裁決委員會裁決兩造比例分擔或由相對人負擔。第13條第6款並規定未依本法第四十三條規定繳納費用者，屬申請不合法之情形；第37條則規定移送之公害糾紛事件免繳調處費。
explain_en: Article 35 allows the applicant to seek apportionment between the parties or full payment by the respondent.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 直轄市、縣（市）政府及鄉（鎮、市、區）公所辦理公害陳情事務，應如何管理及陳報？
a_zh: 應將有關資料逕行銷毀不予保存，並將辦理概況於每月月底前公告於該機關網站供民眾查閱
b_zh: 應將有關資料送交調處委員會保管，並將辦理概況陳報所在地地方法院及裁決委員會備查
c_zh: 應將有關資料編訂卷宗分類集中保管，並將辦理概況陳報上級機關層轉行政院環境保護署備查
d_zh: 應將有關資料送交陳情人自行保管，並將辦理概況於年度終了後函報所在地議會審查通過
q_en: How must local governments and township offices manage and report public nuisance complaint affairs?
a_en: Destroy the materials without retention, and publish the handling summary on the agency website by the end of each month for public access
b_en: Send the materials to the mediation committee for keeping, and report the handling summary to the district court and the ruling committee
c_en: Compile the materials into files kept centrally by category, and report the handling summary through superiors to the EPA for recordation
d_en: Return the materials to complainants for their own keeping, and submit the annual handling summary to the local council for approval
explain_zh: 第36條：直轄市、縣（市）政府及鄉（鎮、市、區）公所應將辦理公害陳情事務有關資料編訂卷宗，分類集中保管，並將辦理概況陳報上級機關層轉行政院環境保護署備查。第32條第2項並規定調處及裁決事件文書應按一案一卷之方式編訂卷宗管理。
explain_en: Article 36 requires centrally filed records and a handling summary reported through superiors to the EPA.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 本細則施行前已依其他法律由各該主管機關處理之公害糾紛事件，得如何處理？
a_zh: 得經當事人之同意，移送該管調處委員會進行調處，並免繳調處費用
b_zh: 應由原主管機關繼續處理至終結，不得移送調處委員會為調處
c_zh: 應一律移送該管調處委員會重新調處，並依規定補繳調處之費用
d_zh: 得逕行移送所在地地方法院審理，並由申請人負擔全部訴訟費用
q_en: How may public nuisance disputes already handled by other authorities before these Rules took effect be dealt with?
a_en: With the parties' consent they may be transferred to the competent mediation committee, free of mediation fees
b_en: The original competent authority must continue handling them to the end and may not transfer them for mediation
c_en: They must all be transferred to the competent mediation committee for fresh mediation, with fees paid as prescribed
d_en: They may be transferred directly to the local district court, with the applicant bearing all litigation costs
explain_zh: 第37條：本細則施行前，已依其他法律規定由各該主管機關處理之公害糾紛事件，得經當事人之同意，移送該管調處委員會進行調處，並免繳調處費。此與第35條所定裁決費用得由兩造比例分擔或由相對人負擔之規定，同屬費用負擔之特別規範。
explain_en: Article 37 allows transfer with the parties' consent, exempt from mediation fees.

law: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
q_zh: 本細則之施行日期規定為何？
a_zh: 本細則自發布後六個月施行
b_zh: 本細則自發布日施行
c_zh: 本細則自發布後三個月施行
d_zh: 本細則自發布後一年起施行
q_en: When do these Enforcement Rules take effect?
a_en: These Enforcement Rules take effect six months after promulgation
b_en: These Enforcement Rules take effect on the date of promulgation
c_en: These Enforcement Rules take effect three months after promulgation
d_en: These Enforcement Rules take effect one year after their promulgation
explain_zh: 第38條：本細則自發布日施行。本細則修正日期為民國九十三年十一月二十四日，其中第26條及第34條已刪除，其餘條文即自該發布日起施行。
explain_en: Article 38 provides that the Rules take effect on the date of promulgation.

law: 海洋污染防治法
q_zh: 制定海洋污染防治法之立法目的為何？
a_zh: 為防治海洋污染，保護海洋環境，維護海洋生態，確保國民健康及永續利用海洋資源
b_zh: 為劃定海域界線，管理海岸土地，推動海埔地開發，確保國土保安及增加財政收入
c_zh: 為整合海域執法，統一海事裁判，強化船員訓練，確保航業競爭力及國際貿易接軌
d_zh: 為開發海洋礦產，促進海運發展，維護漁業秩序，確保船舶航行安全及擴大海域使用
q_en: What is the stated legislative purpose of the Marine Pollution Control Act?
a_en: To prevent marine pollution, protect the marine environment, maintain marine ecology, safeguard public health and sustainably use marine resources
b_en: To delimit sea boundaries, administer coastal land, promote reclaimed land development, secure national territory and increase fiscal revenue
c_en: To integrate maritime enforcement, unify maritime adjudication, strengthen crew training, ensure shipping competitiveness and trade integration
d_en: To develop marine minerals, promote the shipping industry, maintain order in fisheries, ensure vessel navigation safety and expand use of sea areas
explain_zh: 第1條：為防治海洋污染，保護海洋環境，維護海洋生態，確保國民健康及永續利用海洋資源，特制定本法。第2條進一步界定本法適用之海域範圍，第3條定明主管機關為海洋委員會、執行機關為海岸巡防機關。

law: 海洋污染防治法
q_zh: 本法適用之海域範圍為何？在該範圍外排放有害物質而造成範圍內污染時如何處理？
a_zh: 僅適用於中華民國管轄之內水、領海及鄰接區；於該範圍外排放有害物質致範圍內污染者，改依國際公約處理，不適用本法之規定
b_zh: 適用於中華民國管轄之全部海域及其毗鄰陸域；於該範圍外排放有害物質者，不論是否造成範圍內污染，均一律適用本法
c_zh: 適用於中華民國管轄之潮間帶、內水及領海三者；專屬經濟海域與大陸礁層上覆水域之污染，一律改依海洋基本法之規定處理
d_zh: 適用於中華民國管轄之潮間帶、內水、領海、鄰接區、專屬經濟海域及大陸礁層上覆水域；於該範圍外排放有害物質致範圍內污染者，亦適用本法
q_en: What sea areas does the Act cover, and what if hazardous substances are discharged outside them but cause pollution inside?
a_en: Only the internal waters, the territorial sea and the contiguous zone under ROC jurisdiction; discharges outside that cause pollution inside are handled under international conventions instead
b_en: All sea areas under ROC jurisdiction and adjacent land; discharges outside are always covered whether or not they cause any pollution inside the covered area
c_en: Only the intertidal zone, internal waters and the territorial sea; pollution of the EEZ and waters above the continental shelf is handled under the Ocean Basic Act instead
d_en: The intertidal zone, internal waters, territorial sea, contiguous zone, EEZ and waters above the continental shelf under ROC jurisdiction; discharges outside that cause pollution inside are also covered
explain_zh: 第2條第1項：本法適用於中華民國管轄之潮間帶、內水、領海、鄰接區、專屬經濟海域及大陸礁層上覆水域。第2項：於前項範圍外海域排放有害物質，致造成前項範圍內污染者，亦適用本法。第14條另規定與該水域相連之陸域及地面水體，其轄管機關應採措施防止廢棄物污染海洋。

law: 海洋污染防治法
q_zh: 本法所稱主管機關、執行機關及協助執行機關分別指何者？地方主管機關之海域管轄範圍由誰劃定？
a_zh: 中央為環境部，地方為直轄市、縣（市）政府；執行機關指各地航政機關；協助執行機關指協助取締蒐證移送之警察、消防等機關；海域管轄範圍由行政院逕行劃定
b_zh: 中央為內政部，地方為直轄市、縣（市）政府；執行機關指海洋保育署；協助執行機關指協助取締蒐證移送之國防、外交等機關；海域管轄範圍由各地方政府自行劃定
c_zh: 中央為海洋委員會，地方為直轄市、縣（市）政府；執行機關指海岸巡防機關；協助執行機關指協助取締蒐證移送之軍事、海關等機關；海域管轄範圍由中央主管機關劃定
d_zh: 中央為交通部，地方為直轄市、縣（市）政府；執行機關指港口管理機關；協助執行機關指協助取締蒐證移送之漁業、水利等機關；海域管轄範圍由內政部會商劃定
q_en: Who are the competent authority, the enforcement authority and the assisting authorities, and who delimits local sea jurisdiction?
a_en: Central: the Ministry of Environment; local: municipal and county governments; enforcement: maritime administration offices; assisting: police, fire and other agencies aiding interception and referral; sea jurisdiction delimited by the Executive Yuan
b_en: Central: the Ministry of the Interior; local: municipal and county governments; enforcement: the Ocean Conservation Administration; assisting: defense, foreign affairs and other agencies aiding referral; sea jurisdiction delimited by each local government
c_en: Central: the Ocean Affairs Council; local: municipal and county governments; enforcement: the coast guard; assisting: military, customs and other agencies aiding interception, evidence-gathering and referral; sea jurisdiction delimited by the central authority
d_en: Central: the Ministry of Transportation; local: municipal and county governments; enforcement: port authorities; assisting: fisheries, water and other agencies aiding interception and referral; sea jurisdiction delimited by the Ministry of the Interior
explain_zh: 第3條：中央主管機關為海洋委員會，直轄市、縣（市）為各該政府；執行機關指海岸巡防機關；協助執行機關指協助辦理取締、蒐證、移送等事項之軍事、海關或其他相關機關；直轄市、縣（市）主管機關之海域管轄範圍，由中央主管機關劃定。第5條並定明取締、蒐證、移送由執行機關辦理。

law: 海洋污染防治法
q_zh: 本法用詞定義中，有害物質、油及海洋環境品質標準分別所指為何？
a_zh: 有害物質指依聯合國國際海事組織所定國際海運危險品章程或符合防止船舶污染國際公約附錄三所述之物質；油指原油、重油、潤滑油、輕油、煤油、揮發油或其他公告之油及含油混合物；海洋環境品質標準指基於國家整體海洋環境保護目的所定之目標值
b_zh: 有害物質指經環境部依廢棄物清理法公告之有害事業廢棄物；油指船舶燃油及其殘油，不含揮發油及輕油；海洋環境品質標準指各海域工程開發時應個別承諾之排放上限值，由目的事業主管機關逐案核定後公告
c_zh: 有害物質指經中央主管機關公告之毒性化學物質及關注化學物質；油僅指原油及重油二類，不含潤滑油、輕油、煤油與含油之混合物；海洋環境品質標準指為達成管制目的所定之分區、分階段目標值，由地方主管機關訂定並公告實施
d_zh: 有害物質指依國際海洋法公約附件所列之放射性物質及重金屬；油指經濟部公告之石化產品及其原料；海洋環境品質標準指海域環境監測站設置之數量基準與採樣分析方法，由各港口管理機關擬訂報請核定
q_en: How does the Act define hazardous substances, oil, and marine environment quality standards?
a_en: Hazardous substances: those in the IMO dangerous goods code or MARPOL Annex III; oil: crude, heavy, lubricating, light, kerosene, volatile oil and other announced oils and oily mixtures; quality standards: target values set for overall national marine protection
b_en: Hazardous substances: hazardous industrial waste announced under the Waste Disposal Act; oil: bunker fuel and its residues only, excluding volatile and light oil; quality standards: case-by-case discharge caps pledged for each marine works project
c_en: Hazardous substances: toxic and concerned chemicals announced by the central authority; oil: only crude and heavy oil, excluding lubricants, kerosene and oily mixtures; quality standards: zoned, phased target values set and announced by local authorities
d_en: Hazardous substances: radioactive materials and heavy metals listed in UNCLOS annexes; oil: petrochemical products announced by the economics ministry; quality standards: criteria for the number of monitoring stations and sampling methods
explain_zh: 第4條第1、3、4款：有害物質指依聯合國國際海事組織所定國際海運危險品章程或符合防止船舶污染國際公約附錄三所述之物質；油指原油、重油、潤滑油、輕油、煤油、揮發油或其他經中央主管機關公告之油及含油之混合物；海洋環境品質標準指基於國家整體海洋環境保護目的所定之目標值。第7款另定海洋環境管制標準指為達成品質標準所定分區、分階段之目標值，第8條為其訂定依據。

law: 海洋污染防治法
q_zh: 本法所稱海域工程、海洋設施及排洩，其定義為何？
a_zh: 海域工程指在領海範圍內從事之填海造地及港灣興建工程，不含抽砂、浚渫與養灘；海洋設施指船舶及航空器以外之一切浮動載具；排洩指以船舶運送物質至海洋傾倒或處置之行為，並包括海上焚化在內之所有海上作業行為
b_zh: 海域工程指經目的事業主管機關核准之海上風力發電工程；海洋設施指港口管理機關所設置之碼頭、防波堤及倉儲設施；排洩指自陸上污水下水道系統以放流管排入海域之連續性排放行為，不含意外洩漏
c_zh: 海域工程指在本法適用海域內從事之探勘、開採、輸送、興建、敷設、修繕、抽砂、浚渫、打撈、掩埋、填土、養灘、發電或其他工程；海洋設施指海域工程所設置之人工結構物；排洩指排放、溢出、洩漏廢（污）水、油、廢棄物或有害物質等
d_zh: 海域工程指須辦理環境影響評估之海岸開發案件；海洋設施指海域環境監測站及其附屬觀測儀器；排洩指船舶將壓艙水、洗艙水於航行中排出船外之行為，其餘物質之排出不屬排洩
q_en: How are marine works, marine facilities and discharge defined?
a_en: Marine works: only land reclamation and harbor construction works within the territorial sea, excluding exploration, sand mining, dredging, salvage and beach nourishment; marine facilities: all floating craft and vessels other than ships and aircraft; discharge: carrying substances to sea by vessel for dumping or disposal, including incineration at sea
b_en: Marine works: offshore wind power projects approved by the competent industry authority; marine facilities: wharves, breakwaters and warehouses built by port authorities; discharge: continuous release from land sewer outfalls into the sea, excluding accidental leaks
c_en: Marine works: exploration, extraction, transport, construction, laying, repair, sand mining, dredging, salvage, burial, filling, beach nourishment, power generation and other works in the covered waters; marine facilities: artificial structures built for such works; discharge: releasing, spilling or leaking wastewater, oil, waste or hazardous substances
d_en: Marine works: coastal development projects requiring environmental impact assessment; marine facilities: marine monitoring stations and their instruments; discharge: releasing ballast and tank-washing water while under way, other substances excluded
explain_zh: 第4條第2、5、6款：海域工程指在第2條第1項所定範圍內從事之探勘、開採、輸送、興建、敷設、修繕、抽砂、浚渫、打撈、掩埋、填土、養灘、發電或其他工程；海洋設施指海域工程所設置之人工結構物；排洩指排放、溢出、洩漏廢（污）水、油、廢棄物、有害物質或其他經中央主管機關公告之物質。第20條、第21條即以海洋設施之利用行為為管制對象。

law: 海洋污染防治法
q_zh: 本法所稱海難、海洋棄置、海洋廢棄物及船舶所有人，其定義為何？
a_zh: 海難指船舶於港區內發生之擱淺與碰撞事故；海洋棄置指利用海洋設施焚化油或其他物質之行為；海洋廢棄物指港區底泥及浚渫土方；船舶所有人指船長及其僱用之船員，並包括船舶代理業與貨物託運人
b_zh: 海難指造成人員傷亡之海上交通事故；海洋棄置指將船舶或人工構造物遺棄於海洋之行為；海洋廢棄物指經中央主管機關公告之甲類物質；船舶所有人指船舶保險契約之要保人及被保險人，並包括其保險代理人
c_zh: 海難指船舶因天災而發生之沉沒或擱淺，不含碰撞與失火；海洋棄置指自陸上以管線將廢棄物排入海洋之行為；海洋廢棄物指海上漂流之一切有機物與無機物；船舶所有人僅指登記名義之船舶所有權人，不含承租人、經理人與營運人
d_zh: 海難指船舶故障、沉沒、擱淺、碰撞、失火、爆炸或其他非常事故；海洋棄置指利用船舶、航空器或海洋設施運送物質至海洋傾倒、排洩或處置；海洋廢棄物指遭人為丟置或遺棄進入海洋之持久性固體；船舶所有人包括所有權人、承租人、經理人及營運人
q_en: How are maritime peril, ocean dumping, marine debris and shipowner defined?
a_en: Maritime peril: grounding and collision occurring inside port areas; ocean dumping: incinerating oil or other substances using marine facilities; marine debris: port sediment and dredged spoil; shipowner: the master and crew, plus shipping agents and cargo shippers
b_en: Maritime peril: sea traffic accidents causing casualties; ocean dumping: abandoning a vessel or artificial structure at sea; marine debris: Class A substances announced by the central authority; shipowner: the policyholder and insured of the hull insurance and their agents
c_en: Maritime peril: sinking or grounding caused by natural disasters only, excluding collision, fire and explosion; ocean dumping: piping waste from land directly into the sea; marine debris: all organic and inorganic matter drifting at sea; shipowner: only the registered owner of the ship, excluding charterers, managers and operators
d_en: Maritime peril: breakdown, sinking, grounding, collision, fire, explosion or other extraordinary incidents; ocean dumping: carrying substances to sea by ship, aircraft or marine facility for dumping or disposal; marine debris: persistent man-made solids discarded into the sea; shipowner: owner, charterer, manager and operator
explain_zh: 第4條第8至13款：海難指船舶發生故障、沉沒、擱淺、碰撞、失火、爆炸或其他有關船舶、貨載、船員或旅客之非常事故；海洋棄置指利用船舶、航空器、海洋設施或其他設施運送物質至海洋傾倒、排洩或處置；海洋廢棄物指遭人為丟置或遺棄進入海洋之任何人造或經加工之持久性固體；海上焚化指利用船舶或海洋設施焚化油或其他物質；船舶所有人指船舶所有權人、承租人、經理人及營運人。第33條即課予船長及船舶所有人海難時之通報與應變義務。

law: 海洋污染防治法
q_zh: 依本法執行取締、蒐證、移送等事項，應由何機關辦理？主管機關及執行機關可否要求他機關協助？
a_zh: 由主管機關自行辦理；主管機關就該等事項，不得要求其他任何機關協助辦理
b_zh: 由執行機關辦理；主管機關及執行機關就該等事項，得要求協助執行機關協助辦理
c_zh: 由目的事業主管機關辦理；執行機關僅得於接獲通報後提供船舶及人力支援
d_zh: 由港口管理機關辦理；主管機關就該等事項，應報請行政院指定機關協助辦理
q_en: Which agency carries out interception, evidence-gathering and case referral, and may it seek help?
a_en: The competent authority itself; it may not request any other agency to assist with those matters in any circumstance
b_en: The enforcement authority; the competent and enforcement authorities may request assisting authorities to help with those matters
c_en: The relevant industry authority; the enforcement authority may only supply vessels and manpower after being notified
d_en: The port authority; the competent authority must ask the Executive Yuan to designate agencies to assist with those matters
explain_zh: 第5條：依本法執行取締、蒐證、移送等事項，由執行機關（海岸巡防機關）辦理；主管機關及執行機關就前項所定事項，得要求協助執行機關協助辦理。第3條第3項定明協助執行機關指軍事、海關或其他相關機關。

law: 海洋污染防治法
q_zh: 主管機關、執行機關或協助執行機關進行海洋污染檢查、鑑定時之權限與受檢者義務為何？
a_zh: 應先取得法院核發之搜索票，始得登臨船舶或海洋設施檢查；受檢者於文件送達七日後始負有提供資料之義務
b_zh: 得派員攜帶證明文件進入港口、其他場所或登臨船舶、海洋設施檢查或鑑定，並命令提供有關資料；受檢者不得規避、妨礙或拒絕
c_zh: 僅得於船舶停靠港口期間進行文件審查，不得登臨船舶；受檢者得以營業秘密為由拒絕提供全部有關資料
d_zh: 得派員逕行進入港口或登臨船舶檢查，無須攜帶任何證明文件；受檢者僅於涉及軍事機密時始得拒絕提供有關資料
q_en: What powers do the authorities have when inspecting marine pollution, and what must the inspected party do?
a_en: They must first obtain a court warrant issued by a judge before entering premises or boarding ships and marine facilities; the inspected party owes a duty to produce data only seven days after service of the written documents
b_en: They may send personnel with credentials into ports and other premises or board ships and marine facilities to inspect or appraise and order production of data; the inspected party may not evade, obstruct or refuse
c_en: They may only review documents while a ship is berthed and may not board it; the inspected party may refuse to produce all data by invoking trade secrets
d_en: They may enter ports or board ships directly without carrying any credentials; the inspected party may refuse to produce data only where military secrets are involved
explain_zh: 第6條第1項：主管機關、執行機關或協助執行機關，得派員攜帶證明文件，進入港口、其他場所或登臨船舶、海洋設施，檢查或鑑定海洋污染事項，並命令提供有關資料；受檢者不得規避、妨礙或拒絕。第58條對規避、妨礙或拒絕者處新臺幣三十萬元以上一百五十萬元以下罰鍰，並得按次處罰及強制執行檢查。

law: 海洋污染防治法
q_zh: 依第六條命提供資料涉及軍事機密時應如何辦理？檢查涉及軍事事務之程序辦法由誰訂定？
a_zh: 涉及軍事機密者，應報請行政院同意後為之；涉及軍事事務之程序、方法及其他相關事項之辦法，由國防部會同外交部定之
b_zh: 涉及軍事機密者，應會同當地軍事機關為之；涉及軍事事務之程序、方法及其他相關事項之辦法，由中央主管機關會同國防部定之
c_zh: 涉及軍事機密者，得逕行免除受檢者提供義務；涉及軍事事務之程序、方法及其他相關事項之辦法，由執行機關會商港口管理機關定之
d_zh: 涉及軍事機密者，應委由協助執行機關單獨為之；涉及軍事事務之程序、方法及其他相關事項之辦法，由中央主管機關逕行公告實施
q_en: How are military secrets handled during inspections, and who sets the procedures for military-related inspections?
a_en: Where military secrets are involved, prior Executive Yuan approval must be obtained before any request; regulations on procedures and methods are set by the Ministry of National Defense together with the foreign ministry
b_en: Where military secrets are involved, it must be done jointly with the local military authority; regulations on procedures and methods are set by the central authority together with the Ministry of National Defense
c_en: Where military secrets are involved, the duty to produce data is simply waived; regulations on procedures and methods are set by the enforcement authority with port authorities
d_en: Where military secrets are involved, the task is delegated solely to assisting authorities; regulations on procedures and methods are announced by the central authority alone
explain_zh: 第6條第2項：依前項規定命提供資料時，其涉及軍事機密者，應會同當地軍事機關為之。第3項：第1項檢查或鑑定涉及軍事事務之程序、方法及其他相關事項之辦法，由中央主管機關會同國防部定之。第3條第3項亦將軍事機關列為協助執行機關之一。

law: 海洋污染防治法
q_zh: 主管機關及執行機關得如何運用外部資源辦理海洋污染防治事項？中央主管機關對白皮書負有何義務？
a_zh: 僅得委託公立研究機構辦理海洋污染監測事項，不得委託法人或民間團體；中央主管機關應每十年發布一次國家海洋污染防治白皮書，發布後不再檢討修正
b_zh: 得將取締、蒐證及裁處等公權力事項一併委託民間團體辦理；中央主管機關應發布國家海洋污染防治白皮書，並於發布前送立法院審議通過
c_zh: 得指定或委託相關機關（構）、法人或團體辦理污染處理與研究訓練事項；國家海洋污染防治白皮書應由行政院發布，中央主管機關僅負責提供基礎資料
d_zh: 得指定或委託相關機關（構）、法人或團體辦理海洋污染防治、監測、處理、環境保護及研究訓練事項；中央主管機關應發布國家海洋污染防治白皮書並定期檢討修正
q_en: How may the authorities use outside bodies, and what duty applies to the national white paper?
a_en: They may commission only public research institutes to handle monitoring work, and not juridical persons or private groups; the central authority issues a national white paper once every ten years and need not review or revise it afterwards
b_en: They may also delegate interception, evidence-gathering and penalty powers to private groups; the white paper must be sent to the Legislative Yuan for approval before issue
c_en: They may designate or commission bodies for treatment and research and training; the white paper is issued by the Executive Yuan, with the central authority merely supplying background data
d_en: They may designate or commission agencies, juridical persons or groups to handle prevention, monitoring, treatment, protection and related research and training; the central authority must issue and periodically review a national white paper
