c_en: Every five years in light of coastal conditions, with necessary changes; but review may occur at any time for important or urgent conservation measures, for preventing major or urgent disasters, or for necessary public works for public welfare or national defense
d_en: Every five years in light of coastal conditions, with necessary changes; once announced the plan may not be altered outside review periods, so even major disasters or defense needs must await the next comprehensive review
explain_zh: 第18條第1項：整體海岸管理計畫、海岸保護計畫、海岸防護計畫經公告實施後，擬訂機關應視海岸情況，每五年通盤檢討一次，並作必要之變更；但有為興辦重要或緊急保育措施、為防治重大或緊急災害、政府為促進公共福祉或興辦國防所辦理之必要性公共建設等情事之一者，得隨時檢討之。第2項：計畫之變更應依第9條、第16條及第17條程序辦理。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 整體海岸管理計畫、海岸保護計畫、海岸防護計畫公告實施後，其他相關計畫應如何配合？
a_zh: 依計畫內容應修正之開發計畫、都市計畫或區域計畫，相關主管機關得自行決定是否辦理變更，海岸相關計畫不生拘束其他計畫之效力
b_zh: 相關主管機關應於海岸計畫公告後三個月內全面停止執行原有之開發計畫、都市計畫及區域計畫，俟重新擬訂完成後始得恢復實施
c_zh: 開發計畫、事業建設計畫、都市計畫、國家公園計畫或區域計畫仍優先適用，海岸相關計畫應配合各該計畫內容修正後重新公告實施
d_zh: 依計畫內容應修正或變更之開發計畫、事業建設計畫、都市計畫、國家公園計畫或區域計畫，相關主管機關應按各計畫所定期限辦理變更作業
q_en: How must other plans respond once the coastal plans are announced and in force?
a_en: Development plans, urban plans or regional plans needing amendment may be changed at the relevant authority's discretion, since coastal plans do not bind other plans in any way
b_en: Relevant authorities must suspend all existing development, urban and regional plans within three months of announcement and may resume only after redrafting is complete
c_en: Development plans, undertaking plans, urban plans, national park plans and regional plans still prevail, so the coastal plans must instead be amended to match their content and then re-announced in full
d_en: Development plans, undertaking plans, urban plans, national park plans or regional plans that need amendment under those plans must be changed by the relevant authorities within the periods each plan sets
explain_zh: 第19條：整體海岸管理計畫、海岸保護計畫、海岸防護計畫公告實施後，依計畫內容應修正或變更之開發計畫、事業建設計畫、都市計畫、國家公園計畫或區域計畫，相關主管機關應按各計畫所定期限辦理變更作業。第27條並要求區域計畫、都市計畫主要計畫或國家公園計畫在海岸地區範圍者，於審議通過前應先徵詢主管機關之意見。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 船舶航行有影響海岸保護或肇致海洋污染之虞者，得如何處理？
a_zh: 得由中央主管機關命該船舶所有人負擔海岸復育之全部費用
b_zh: 得由中央主管機關會商航政主管機關調整航道，並公告之
c_zh: 得由航政主管機關逕行禁止該船舶進入我國領海並公告之
d_zh: 得由地方主管機關會商漁業主管機關劃定禁航區並公告之
q_en: What may be done where ship navigation may affect coastal protection or cause marine pollution?
a_en: The central competent authority may order the shipowner to bear the entire cost of coastal restoration work
b_en: The central competent authority may adjust the shipping route in consultation with the maritime authority and announce it
c_en: The maritime authority may directly bar that ship from entering ROC territorial waters and announce the prohibition
d_en: The local competent authority may delimit a no-sailing area in consultation with the fisheries authority and announce it
explain_zh: 第20條：船舶航行有影響海岸保護或肇致海洋污染之虞者，得由中央主管機關會商航政主管機關調整航道，並公告之。本法之中央主管機關依第3條為內政部；海洋污染之防治另依海洋污染防治法之規定辦理。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 為擬訂及實施海岸相關計畫，計畫擬訂或實施機關得為哪些行為？
a_zh: 派員進入公私有土地實地調查勘測；未經協議即得無償使用任何公私有土地作為臨時作業或材料放置場所；逕行拆除全部土地改良物而無須補償；直接廢止範圍內之漁業權並停止漁業行為；逕行撤銷已設定礦區或土石區之礦業權並沒入其全部設備
b_zh: 委託民間廠商進入公私有土地實地調查勘測；標購無特殊用途之公私有土地作為永久作業場所；價購有礙計畫實施之土地改良物；請求漁業主管機關全面收回轄區內漁業權；請求礦業主管機關全面停止核發新礦業權執照
c_zh: 報請上級機關派員進入公私有土地實地調查勘測；徵收無特殊用途之公私有土地作為臨時作業場所；命所有人自行拆除有礙計畫實施之土地改良物；命漁業權人自行放棄漁業權之行使；命礦業權人自行申請縮減其礦區範圍
d_zh: 派員進入公私有土地實地調查勘測；與土地所有權人、使用人或管理人協議將無特殊用途之公私有土地作為臨時作業或材料放置場所；拆遷有礙計畫實施之土地改良物；協調漁業主管機關變更廢止漁業權之核准或限制漁業行為；協調礦業或土石採取主管機關劃定禁採區
q_en: What acts may the drafting or implementing agency perform to prepare and carry out coastal plans?
a_en: Send personnel onto land to survey; use any public or private land free of charge as a temporary work or material site without any agreement; demolish all improvements without compensation; abolish fishing rights outright; and revoke mining rights in established mining areas and confiscate the equipment
b_en: Commission private contractors to enter and survey public and private land; buy land without special use at tender as a permanent work or storage site; purchase all improvements obstructing the plan; ask the fisheries authority to withdraw every fishing right in the area; and ask mining authorities to stop issuing any new mining or extraction licenses
c_en: Ask the superior agency to send personnel to survey the land; expropriate land without special use as a temporary work site; order owners to demolish obstructing improvements themselves; order fishing right holders to renounce their rights; and order mining right holders to apply to shrink their mining areas
d_en: Send personnel onto public or private land to survey; agree with owners, users or managers to use land without special use as a temporary work or material site; demolish improvements obstructing the plan; coordinate the fisheries authority to alter, revoke, suspend or restrict fishing rights; and coordinate mining authorities to delimit no-extraction areas
explain_zh: 第21條第1項：為擬訂及實施整體海岸管理計畫、海岸保護計畫或海岸防護計畫，計畫擬訂或實施機關得派員進入公私有土地實地調查、勘測；與土地所有權人、使用人或管理人協議，將無特殊用途之公私有土地作為臨時作業或材料放置場所；拆遷有礙計畫實施之土地改良物；為強化漁業資源保育或海岸保護，協調漁業主管機關依漁業法規定變更、廢止漁業權之核准、停止漁業權之行使或限制漁業行為；協調礦業或土石採取主管機關於已設定礦區或已核准之土石區依規定劃定禁採區。第3項並定明因該等行為致受損失者，應給予適當之補償。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 調查或勘測人員進入公私有土地時，應踐行哪些程序？補償金額如何決定？
a_zh: 得逕行進入而免出示任何證明文件或標誌，土地所有人、占有人、管理人或使用人不得規避、拒絕或妨礙；進入設有圍障之土地前，得於進入之當日口頭通知；補償金額或方式由中央主管機關統一訂定標準表，不因個案情形而有差異
b_zh: 應出示執行職務有關之證明文件或顯示足資辨別之標誌，土地所有人得於認有妨礙其權益時拒絕人員進入；進入設有圍障之土地前，應於三十日前通知其所有人或管理人；補償之金額或方式一律由計畫擬訂或實施機關逕行核定並通知，土地所有人不得聲明異議或提起救濟
c_zh: 應出示執行職務有關之證明文件或顯示足資辨別之標誌，土地所有人、占有人、管理人或使用人不得規避、拒絕或妨礙；進入設有圍障之土地前，應於七日前通知其所有人、占有人、管理人或使用人；補償金額或方式由雙方協議，協議不成者由計畫擬訂或實施機關報請上級主管機關核定
d_zh: 應先取得法院核發之許可裁定始得進入，土地所有人得於裁定送達後聲明異議；進入設有圍障之土地前，應於十四日前以雙掛號通知其所有人；補償金額或方式應由雙方逕行提付仲裁，不得報請上級主管機關核定
q_en: What procedure applies when survey personnel enter land, and how is compensation determined?
a_en: They may enter without showing any credentials or mark, and owners, possessors, managers or users may not evade, refuse or obstruct; enclosed land may be entered on oral notice the same day; compensation follows a uniform national schedule of amounts regardless of the circumstances of the individual case
b_en: They must show credentials or a clear identifying mark, but the owner may refuse entry where rights are thought to be prejudiced; enclosed land requires thirty days' prior notice; compensation is fixed by the agency alone and the owner may not object to it
c_en: They must show credentials or a clear identifying mark, and owners, possessors, managers or users may not evade, refuse or obstruct; enclosed land requires seven days' prior notice to them; compensation is agreed by the parties, failing which the agency reports it to the superior authority for approval
d_en: They must first obtain a court order before entering, and the owner may object once it is served; enclosed land requires fourteen days' prior notice by registered mail; compensation must be submitted to arbitration and may not be approved by a superior authority
explain_zh: 第21條第2項：調查或勘測人員進入公、私有土地調查或勘測時，應出示執行職務有關之證明文件或顯示足資辨別之標誌；土地所有人、占有人、管理人或使用人不得規避、拒絕或妨礙；於進入設有圍障之土地調查或勘測前，應於七日前通知其所有人、占有人、管理人或使用人。第4項：補償金額或方式由雙方協議之；協議不成者，由計畫擬訂或實施機關報請上級主管機關核定。第35條對規避、妨礙或拒絕調查、勘測者，處新臺幣一萬元以上五萬元以下罰鍰。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 因海岸防護計畫有關工程而受直接利益者，計畫擬訂及實施機關得為何種徵收？其徵收依據為何？
a_zh: 得於其受益限度內徵收防護工程受益費；其徵收依工程受益費徵收條例規定辦理
b_zh: 得於其受益限度內徵收海岸管理特別捐；其徵收依地方稅法通則規定辦理
c_zh: 得按其土地公告現值比例徵收海岸開發影響費；其徵收依土地稅法規定辦理
d_zh: 得依其營業額比例徵收海岸資源使用費；其徵收依規費法之規定辦理並公告
q_en: What charge may be levied on those directly benefiting from coastal defense works, and under what law?
a_en: A defense works benefit charge may be levied within the limit of the benefit received, collected under the Statute for Collection of Engineering Benefit Charges
b_en: A special coastal management levy may be imposed within the limit of the benefit received, collected under the general provisions of the Local Tax Act
c_en: A coastal development impact fee may be levied in proportion to assessed land value, collected under the provisions of the Land Tax Act
d_en: A coastal resource use fee may be levied in proportion to turnover, collected and announced under the provisions of the Charges and Fees Act
explain_zh: 第22條第1項：因海岸防護計畫有關工程而受直接利益者，計畫擬訂及實施機關得於其受益限度內，徵收防護工程受益費。第2項：防護工程受益費之徵收，依工程受益費徵收條例規定辦理。第29條並定有海岸管理基金之來源，包括政府機關循預算程序之撥款、基金孳息收入、受贈收入及其他收入。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 海岸防護設施之規劃設計手冊，應由誰訂定？訂定時應考慮哪些因素？
a_zh: 由中央主管機關委託民間工程顧問公司訂定；應考慮工程造價、施工工期、廠商施工能量、材料供應穩定度、機具調度及保固期間之維護成本等因素與影響
b_zh: 由中央水利主管機關會商相關目的事業主管機關訂定；應考慮海象、氣象、地形、地質、地盤變動、侵蝕狀態、其他海岸狀況與因波力、設施重量、水壓、土壓、風壓、地震及漂流物等因素與衝擊
c_zh: 由中央主管機關會商內政部營建署訂定；應考慮土地權屬、地價水準、開發強度、容積率、建蔽率、公共設施用地比例、交通運輸系統、地方財政負擔能力及居民意願等因素與影響
d_zh: 由各直轄市、縣（市）主管機關分別訂定；應考慮轄區人口成長、產業結構、觀光遊憩需求、漁業生產規模、聚落分布密度及地方預算編列情形等因素與衝擊
q_en: Who issues the planning and design manual for coastal defense facilities, and what must be considered?
a_en: The central competent authority, through commissioned private engineering consultants; it must consider construction cost, schedule, contractor capacity, material supply stability, equipment scheduling and warranty-period maintenance costs
b_en: The central water authority, in consultation with the relevant industry authorities; it must consider sea and weather conditions, terrain, geology, ground movement, erosion, other coastal conditions, and wave force, facility weight, water, earth and wind pressure, earthquakes and drifting objects
c_en: The central competent authority, in consultation with the construction agency; it must consider land ownership, land price levels, development intensity, floor area and building coverage ratios, public facility land ratios, transport systems and the fiscal capacity of the local government concerned
d_en: Each municipal and county competent authority separately; it must consider local population growth, industrial structure, tourism demand, fishery production scale, settlement density and the state of local budget appropriations
explain_zh: 第23條：中央水利主管機關應會商相關目的事業主管機關考慮海象、氣象、地形、地質、地盤變動、侵蝕狀態、其他海岸狀況與因波力、設施重量、水壓、土壓、風壓、地震及漂流物等因素與衝擊，訂定海岸防護設施之規劃設計手冊。第2條第3款定明海岸防護設施包括堤防、突堤、離岸堤、護岸、胸牆、滯（蓄）洪池、地下水補注設施、抽水設施及防潮閘門等。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 海岸防護設施如兼有道路、水門、起卸貨場等其他設施之效用時，應由誰實施工程並維護管理？
a_zh: 由中央主管機關委託民間機構實施該工程並委託經營維護管理
b_zh: 由該其他設施之主管機關實施該海岸防護設施之工程，並維護管理
c_zh: 由計畫擬訂機關實施該工程後，移交地方主管機關維護及管理
d_zh: 由中央水利主管機關統一實施該工程，其他設施主管機關僅負協助
q_en: Who builds and maintains a coastal defense facility that also serves as a road, water gate or loading yard?
a_en: The central competent authority commissions a private entity to build it and to operate and maintain it
b_en: The authority in charge of that other facility carries out the works and maintains and manages it
c_en: The plan drafting agency builds it and then transfers it to the local competent authority for maintenance
d_en: The central water authority carries out all such works, with the other facility's authority merely assisting
explain_zh: 第24條：海岸防護設施如兼有道路、水門、起卸貨場等其他設施之效用時，由該其他設施主管機關實施該海岸防護設施之工程，並維護管理。第14條第3項亦採類似之權責分工，就因興辦事業計畫實施所造成之海岸侵蝕，由各該興辦事業計畫之目的事業主管機關辦理防護措施。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 在一級海岸保護區以外之海岸地區特定區位內從事一定規模以上開發利用者，應踐行何種程序？
a_zh: 申請人應檢具海岸利用管理說明書，申請中央主管機關許可；未經中央主管機關許可前，各目的事業主管機關不得為開發、工程行為之許可
b_zh: 申請人應檢具開發計畫書及財務計畫，申請行政院核定；於行政院核定前，各目的事業主管機關得先行核發開發及工程行為之許可
c_zh: 申請人應檢具海岸利用管理說明書，向地方主管機關報備；地方主管機關備查後，各目的事業主管機關即得逕為開發、工程行為之許可
d_zh: 申請人應檢具環境影響說明書，申請目的事業主管機關許可；經目的事業主管機關許可後，再報請中央主管機關備查即可逕行開發施工
q_en: What procedure applies to development above a set scale in specific locations outside a first-class protection zone?
a_en: The applicant must submit a coastal use management statement and obtain the central authority's permit; until that permit is granted, no industry authority may permit the development or engineering work
b_en: The applicant must submit a development plan and financial plan for Executive Yuan approval; before that approval, industry authorities may still issue development and engineering permits
c_en: The applicant must submit a coastal use management statement to the local authority for record; once filed, the industry authorities may go ahead and permit the development or engineering work
d_en: The applicant must submit an environmental impact statement to the industry authority for permission; once permitted, filing with the central authority for record is enough to begin construction
explain_zh: 第25條第1項：在一級海岸保護區以外之海岸地區特定區位內，從事一定規模以上之開發利用、工程建設、建築或使用性質特殊者，申請人應檢具海岸利用管理說明書，申請中央主管機關許可。第2項：前項申請未經中央主管機關許可前，各目的事業主管機關不得為開發、工程行為之許可。第3項並授權中央主管機關訂定特定區位、一定規模或性質特殊之適用範圍與說明書格式等辦法。第36條對未經許可或未依許可內容逕行施工者，處新臺幣六萬元以上三十萬元以下罰鍰。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 中央主管機關審查海岸利用許可案件，應符合哪些條件始得許可？
a_zh: 符合中央目的事業主管機關之產業發展政策；符合投資金額與就業人數之門檻標準；取得金融機構出具之融資承諾書；對地方財政挹注提出具體承諾；使用自然海岸或填海造地時應優先僱用當地居民並提供技術訓練
b_zh: 符合國土計畫所定之成長管理策略；符合環境影響評估審查結論之附款；取得當地鄉鎮市區公所之同意函；對海岸交通衝擊提出改善方案；使用自然海岸或填海造地時應由申請人另行取得漁業權人與養殖業者之全體同意
c_zh: 符合區域計畫或都市計畫之土地使用分區；符合建築技術規則所定之建蔽率與容積率；取得全體毗鄰土地所有權人書面同意；對海岸景觀衝擊提出視覺模擬分析；使用自然海岸或填海造地時應繳交等額之開發回饋金予地方政府
d_zh: 符合整體海岸管理計畫利用原則；符合海岸保護計畫、海岸防護計畫管制事項；保障公共通行或具替代措施；對海岸生態環境衝擊採取避免或減輕之有效措施；使用自然海岸或填海造地時以最小需用為原則並採取彌補或復育之有效措施
q_en: What conditions must be met before the central authority may grant a coastal use permit?
a_en: Consistency with the central industry authority's development policy; meeting investment amount and employment thresholds; a financing commitment letter from a bank; a concrete pledge of local fiscal contribution; and, where natural coast or reclamation is used, priority hiring of local residents with training
b_en: Consistency with the national spatial plan's growth management strategy; compliance with environmental impact assessment conditions; a letter of consent from the local township office; a plan to ease traffic impact; and, where natural coast or reclamation is used, consent of all fishing right holders and aquaculture operators
c_en: Consistency with regional or urban plan land use zoning; compliance with building coverage and floor area ratios; written consent of all adjoining landowners; a visual simulation of landscape impact; and, where natural coast or reclamation is used, payment of an equivalent development feedback levy to the local government
d_en: Consistency with the integrated plan's use principles; consistency with protection and defense plan controls; safeguarding public passage or providing alternatives; effective measures to avoid or mitigate ecological impact; and, where natural coast or reclamation is used, minimum need plus effective offset or restoration measures
explain_zh: 第26條第1項：依第25條第1項申請許可案件，經中央主管機關審查符合下列條件者始得許可：一、符合整體海岸管理計畫利用原則。二、符合海岸保護計畫、海岸防護計畫管制事項。三、保障公共通行或具替代措施。四、對海岸生態環境衝擊採取避免或減輕之有效措施。五、因開發需使用自然海岸或填海造地時，應以最小需用為原則，並於開發區內或鄰近海岸之適當區位，採取彌補或復育所造成生態環境損失之有效措施。第2項並授權中央主管機關定其許可條件之規則。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 區域計畫、都市計畫主要計畫或國家公園計畫在海岸地區範圍者，其審議應踐行何種程序？
a_zh: 審議機關於計畫審議通過前，應先徵詢主管機關之意見
b_zh: 審議機關應將計畫送請主管機關審議核定後始得公告實施
c_zh: 審議機關得逕行審議通過，僅須於公告時副知主管機關
d_zh: 審議機關於計畫公告實施後，應將計畫函送主管機關備查
q_en: What procedure applies when a regional, urban master or national park plan falls within the coastal zone?
a_en: The reviewing body must first seek the competent authority's opinion before approving the plan
b_en: The reviewing body must send the plan to the competent authority for review and approval first
c_en: The reviewing body may approve it directly and merely copy the competent authority on announcement
d_en: The reviewing body must send the plan to the competent authority for record after announcing it
explain_zh: 第27條：區域計畫、都市計畫主要計畫或國家公園計畫在海岸地區範圍者，區域計畫、都市計畫主要計畫或國家公園計畫審議機關於計畫審議通過前，應先徵詢主管機關之意見。第19條並要求該等計畫依海岸相關計畫內容應修正或變更者，相關主管機關應按各計畫所定期限辦理變更作業。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 中央主管機關對於具有公共利益之哪些海岸事項得予適當獎勵及表揚？
a_zh: 海岸漁業、養殖生產、魚苗放流、漁港建設、漁業推廣與行銷通路事項
b_zh: 海岸開發、填海造地、港埠興建、產業投資、觀光招商與土地開發事項
c_zh: 海岸巡防、查緝走私、取締違規、蒐證移送、通報聯繫與勤務支援事項
d_zh: 海岸保護、復育、防護、教育、宣導、研發、創作、捐贈、認養與管理事項
q_en: For which coastal matters of public interest may the central authority give appropriate awards and commendations?
a_en: Coastal fisheries, aquaculture production, fry release, fishing port construction, fishery extension and marketing channels
b_en: Coastal development, land reclamation, port construction, industrial investment, tourism promotion and land development
c_en: Coastal patrol, smuggling interdiction, enforcement against violations, evidence-gathering and referral, and duty support
d_en: Coastal protection, restoration, defense, education, promotion, research, creative work, donation, adoption and management
explain_zh: 第28條：中央主管機關對於具有公共利益之海岸保護、復育、防護、教育、宣導、研發、創作、捐贈、認養與管理事項，得予適當獎勵及表揚。第30條並定明海岸管理基金之用途包括海岸保育及復育補助、海岸保育及復育獎勵、海岸環境教育解說創作及推廣等。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 主管機關為擴大參與及執行海岸保育相關事項所成立之海岸管理基金，其來源為何？
a_zh: 海岸利用許可規費收入、防護工程受益費收入、受贈收入及其他收入
b_zh: 依本法所處罰鍰之全部收入、基金孳息收入、受贈收入及其他收入
c_zh: 政府機關循預算程序之撥款、基金孳息收入、受贈收入及其他收入
d_zh: 開發業者繳交之回饋金收入、土地租金收入、受贈收入及其他收入
q_en: What are the sources of the coastal management fund?
a_en: Coastal use permit fee revenue, defense works benefit charge revenue, donations received and other miscellaneous income
b_en: All revenue from fines imposed under this Act, interest earned on the fund, donations received and other miscellaneous income
c_en: Appropriations made by government agencies through the budget process, interest on the fund, donations received and other income
d_en: Feedback levies paid by developers, land rental income, donations received and other miscellaneous sources of income
explain_zh: 第29條：主管機關為擴大參與及執行海岸保育相關事項，得成立海岸管理基金，其來源如下：一、政府機關循預算程序之撥款。二、基金孳息收入。三、受贈收入。四、其他收入。第30條並明定基金用途以海岸研究調查規劃監測、環境清理維護、保育復育補助與獎勵、環境教育推廣、國際交流合作等為限。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 海岸管理基金之用途限定於下列哪些項目？
a_zh: 海岸主管機關之人事與辦公費用；海岸行政大樓之興建與修繕；海岸業務委外補助；海岸績效考核獎金；海岸公務人員教育、訓練、進修及考察；海岸行政國際參訪交流合作
b_zh: 海岸之研究、調查、勘定、規劃、監測相關費用；海岸環境清理與維護；海岸保育及復育補助；海岸保育及復育獎勵；海岸環境教育、解說、創作及推廣；海岸保育國際交流合作
c_zh: 海岸巡防勤務之裝備與人力費用；海岸監控設施之建置與維護；海岸違規查報補助；海岸檢舉人獎金；海岸治安宣導、講習、演練及推廣；海岸執法國際情報交流合作
d_zh: 海岸土地之徵收與地價補償費用；海岸開發工程之興建與監造；海岸產業投資補助；海岸招商引資獎勵；海岸觀光行銷、廣告、活動及推廣；海岸產業國際貿易拓銷合作
q_en: To which items is the coastal management fund limited?
a_en: Personnel and office costs of the coastal authority; construction and repair of its administrative buildings; subsidies for outsourced coastal work; performance bonuses; education, training, further study and inspection visits for civil servants; and international administrative exchange visits
b_en: Costs of coastal research, survey, demarcation, planning and monitoring; coastal environmental cleanup and maintenance; subsidies for coastal conservation and restoration; awards for conservation and restoration; coastal environmental education, interpretation, creative work and outreach; and international conservation exchanges
c_en: Equipment and manpower costs of coast guard duties; installation and upkeep of coastal surveillance facilities; subsidies for reporting violations; rewards for informants; coastal security publicity, briefings, drills and outreach; and international law enforcement intelligence exchanges
d_en: Coastal land expropriation costs and land price compensation; construction and supervision of coastal development works; subsidies for coastal industrial investment; awards for attracting investment; coastal tourism marketing, advertising, events and outreach; and international trade promotion and marketing cooperation
explain_zh: 第30條：海岸管理基金用途限定如下：一、海岸之研究、調查、勘定、規劃、監測相關費用。二、海岸環境清理與維護。三、海岸保育及復育補助。四、海岸保育及復育獎勵。五、海岸環境教育、解說、創作及推廣。六、海岸保育國際交流合作。七、其他經主管機關核准有關海岸保育、防護及管理之費用。第28條並就具公共利益之海岸保護、復育、教育、認養與管理事項定有獎勵及表揚規定。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 為保障公共通行及公共水域之使用，近岸海域及公有自然沙灘有何限制？其例外為何？
a_zh: 不得為獨占性使用，並禁止一切人員進入活動；但為國土保安、國家安全、公共運輸、環境保護、學術研究之必要而經行政院專案核准者，或原住民族基於傳統文化需要者，不在此限
b_zh: 不得為獨占性使用，並禁止設置人為設施；但經當地鄉鎮市區公所同意並繳納使用費者，或為漁業養殖、觀光遊憩、餐飲營業及水上活動經營之必要而向地方主管機關報備者，不在此限
c_zh: 不得為獨占性使用，並禁止設置人為設施；但符合整體海岸管理計畫並依其他法律規定允許使用設置者，或為國土保安、國家安全、公共運輸、環境保護、學術研究及公共福祉之必要而專案向主管機關申請許可者，不在此限
d_zh: 得為獨占性使用但不得設置永久性人為設施；但符合整體海岸管理計畫並經目的事業主管機關書面同意者，或為國土保安、國家安全、環境保護及公共運輸之必要而向中央主管機關報請備查者，不在此限
q_en: What restrictions protect public passage in nearshore waters and public natural beaches, and what exceptions apply?
a_en: Exclusive use is prohibited and all entry by persons is banned; except where the Executive Yuan specially approves territorial security, national security, public transport, environmental protection or academic research needs, or for indigenous traditional culture
b_en: Exclusive use is prohibited and artificial facilities may not be installed; except with the consent of the local township office and payment of a use fee, or where aquaculture, tourism, catering or water activity operations are filed with the local authority
c_en: Exclusive use is prohibited and artificial facilities may not be installed; except where use or installation is allowed under other laws consistently with the integrated plan, or where a special permit is sought for territorial security, national security, public transport, environmental protection, academic research or public welfare
d_en: Exclusive use is allowed but permanent artificial facilities are not permitted; except where the relevant industry authority consents in writing consistently with the integrated coastal management plan, or where territorial security, national security, environmental protection or public transport needs are filed with the central competent authority
explain_zh: 第31條第1項：為保障公共通行及公共水域之使用，近岸海域及公有自然沙灘不得為獨占性使用，並禁止設置人為設施；但符合整體海岸管理計畫，並依其他法律規定允許使用、設置者，或為國土保安、國家安全、公共運輸、環境保護、學術研究及公共福祉之必要，專案向主管機關申請許可者，不在此限。第2項並授權中央主管機關訂定專案申請許可之程序、應具備文件、許可條件及廢止等辦法。第37條對違反者定有罰則。

law: 海岸管理法
category: 海管法-一級保護區罰則
q_zh: 在一級海岸保護區內違反規定改變資源條件使用或違反保護計畫禁止使用者，其法律責任為何？
a_zh: 處新臺幣一萬元以上五萬元以下罰鍰；因該行為毀壞保護標的者，處二年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣十萬元以下罰金；因該行為致釀成災害者，處六月以上三年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣二十萬元以下罰金
b_zh: 處新臺幣六萬元以上三十萬元以下罰鍰；因該行為毀壞保護標的者，處六月以上五年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣四十萬元以下罰金；因該行為致釀成災害者，處三年以上十年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣六十萬元以下罰金
c_zh: 處新臺幣三萬元以上十五萬元以下罰鍰；因該行為毀壞保護標的者，處五年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣三十萬元以下罰金；因該行為致釀成災害者，處一年以上七年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣五十萬元以下罰金
d_zh: 處新臺幣二萬元以上十萬元以下罰鍰；因該行為毀壞保護標的者，處三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或科或併科新臺幣二十萬元以下罰金；因該行為致釀成災害者，處六月以上五年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣四十萬元以下罰金
q_en: What liability attaches to changing resource conditions or breaching prohibited uses in a first-class protection zone?
a_en: A fine of NT$10,000 to NT$50,000; where the act destroys the protection target, up to two years' imprisonment with a fine up to NT$100,000; where it causes a disaster, six months to three years with a fine up to NT$200,000
b_en: A fine of NT$60,000 to NT$300,000; where the act destroys the protection target, six months to five years' imprisonment with a fine up to NT$400,000; where it causes a disaster, three to ten years' imprisonment with a fine up to NT$600,000
c_en: A fine of NT$30,000 to NT$150,000; where the act destroys the protection target, up to five years' imprisonment with a fine up to NT$300,000; where it causes a disaster, one to seven years' imprisonment with a fine up to NT$500,000
d_en: A fine of NT$20,000 to NT$100,000; where the act destroys the protection target, up to three years' imprisonment or detention with a fine up to NT$200,000; where it causes a disaster, six months to five years with a fine up to NT$400,000
explain_zh: 第32條：在一級海岸保護區內，違反第12條第2項改變其資源條件使用或違反第13條第1項第3款海岸保護計畫所定禁止之使用者，處新臺幣六萬元以上三十萬元以下罰鍰；因前項行為毀壞保護標的者，處六月以上五年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣四十萬元以下罰金；因第1項行為致釀成災害者，處三年以上十年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣六十萬元以下罰金。第38條並定明除罰鍰外應即令其停止使用或施工。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 主管機關對於一級保護區、防護區或二級保護區之違規使用行為，除處以罰鍰外尚應為何種處分？
a_zh: 應即撤銷其一切開發許可；並由主管機關代為回復原狀及拆除設施，所生費用由海岸管理基金全額支應負擔
b_zh: 應即令其停止使用或施工；並視情形令其限期回復原狀、拆除設施或增建安全設施，屆期未遵從者，得按次處罰
c_zh: 應即移送司法機關偵辦；並由檢察官逕行命其限期回復原狀或拆除設施，屆期未遵從者，由法院裁定強制執行
d_zh: 得視情形令其限期改善；屆期未遵從者，僅得加倍處以罰鍰，不得命其停止使用、回復原狀或拆除相關設施
q_en: Besides a fine, what must the authority order for unlawful uses in protection or defense zones?
a_en: It must at once revoke every development permit, carry out restoration and demolition itself, and have the whole cost met by the coastal management fund
b_en: It must at once order the use or construction to stop, and as appropriate order restoration, demolition of facilities or added safety works within a time limit, with repeat penalties if not complied with
c_en: It must at once refer the case for prosecution, with the prosecutor ordering restoration or demolition of the facilities within a time limit and the court ordering compulsory execution if not complied with
d_en: It may order improvement within a time limit, and if not complied with may only double the fine, having no power to order a stop, restoration or demolition of the facilities
explain_zh: 第38條：主管機關對第32條第1項、第33條第1項或第34條第1項規定行為，除處以罰鍰外，應即令其停止使用或施工；並視情形令其限期回復原狀、拆除設施或增建安全設施，屆期未遵從者，得按次處罰。第41條並定明因該等行為所生或所得之物及所用之物得沒入之，第42條就犯本法之罪者定明沒收。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 在海岸防護區內違反海岸防護計畫所定禁止之使用者，其法律責任為何？
a_zh: 處新臺幣六萬元以上三十萬元以下罰鍰；因該行為毀壞海岸防護設施者，處六月以上五年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣四十萬元以下罰金；因該行為致釀成災害者，處三年以上十年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣六十萬元以下罰金
b_zh: 處新臺幣一萬元以上五萬元以下罰鍰；因該行為毀壞海岸防護設施者，處二年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣十五萬元以下罰金；因該行為致釀成災害者，處六月以上三年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣三十萬元以下罰金
c_zh: 處新臺幣三萬元以上十五萬元以下罰鍰；因該行為毀壞海岸防護設施者，處五年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣三十萬元以下罰金；因該行為致釀成災害者，處一年以上七年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣五十萬元以下罰金
d_zh: 處新臺幣二萬元以上十萬元以下罰鍰；因該行為毀壞海岸防護設施者，處三年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣二十萬元以下罰金；因該行為致釀成災害者，處六月以上五年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣四十萬元以下罰金
q_en: What liability attaches to breaching prohibited uses under a coastal defense plan inside a defense zone?
a_en: A fine of NT$60,000 to NT$300,000; where the act destroys a defense facility, six months to five years' imprisonment with a fine up to NT$400,000; where it causes a disaster, three to ten years' imprisonment with a fine up to NT$600,000
b_en: A fine of NT$10,000 to NT$50,000; where the act destroys a defense facility, up to two years' imprisonment with a fine up to NT$150,000; where it causes a disaster, six months to three years' imprisonment with a fine up to NT$300,000
c_en: A fine of NT$30,000 to NT$150,000; where the act destroys a defense facility, up to five years' imprisonment with a fine up to NT$300,000; where it causes a disaster, one to seven years' imprisonment with a fine up to NT$500,000
d_en: A fine of NT$20,000 to NT$100,000; where the act destroys a defense facility, up to three years' imprisonment with a fine up to NT$200,000; where it causes a disaster, six months to five years' imprisonment with a fine up to NT$400,000
explain_zh: 第33條：在海岸防護區內違反第15條第1項第4款海岸防護計畫所定禁止之使用者，處新臺幣三萬元以上十五萬元以下罰鍰；因前項行為毀壞海岸防護設施者，處五年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣三十萬元以下罰金；因第1項行為致釀成災害者，處一年以上七年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣五十萬元以下罰金。第40條並定明於第一審言詞辯論終結前已作有效回復或補救者得減輕其刑。

law: 海岸管理法
category: 海管法-二級保護區罰則
q_zh: 在二級海岸保護區內違反海岸保護計畫所定禁止之使用者，其法律責任為何？
a_zh: 處新臺幣六萬元以上三十萬元以下罰鍰；因該行為毀壞保護標的者，處六月以上五年以下有期徒刑、拘役或科或併科新臺幣四十萬元以下罰金；因該行為致釀成災害者，處三年以上十年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣六十萬元以下罰金
b_zh: 處新臺幣一萬元以上五萬元以下罰鍰；因該行為毀壞保護標的者，處二年以下有期徒刑、拘役或科或併科新臺幣十萬元以下罰金；因該行為致釀成災害者，處六月以上三年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣二十萬元以下罰金
c_zh: 處新臺幣三萬元以上十五萬元以下罰鍰；因該行為毀壞保護標的者，處五年以下有期徒刑、拘役或科或併科新臺幣三十萬元以下罰金；因該行為致釀成災害者，處一年以上七年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣五十萬元以下罰金
d_zh: 處新臺幣二萬元以上十萬元以下罰鍰；因該行為毀壞保護標的者，處三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或科或併科新臺幣二十萬元以下罰金；因該行為致釀成災害者，處六月以上五年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣四十萬元以下罰金
q_en: What liability attaches to breaching prohibited uses under a protection plan inside a second-class protection zone?
a_en: A fine of NT$60,000 to NT$300,000; where the act destroys the protection target, six months to five years' imprisonment or detention with a fine up to NT$400,000; where it causes a disaster, three to ten years' imprisonment with a fine up to NT$600,000
b_en: A fine of NT$10,000 to NT$50,000; where the act destroys the protection target, up to two years' imprisonment or detention with a fine up to NT$100,000; where it causes a disaster, six months to three years' imprisonment with a fine up to NT$200,000
c_en: A fine of NT$30,000 to NT$150,000; where the act destroys the protection target, up to five years' imprisonment or detention with a fine up to NT$300,000; where it causes a disaster, one to seven years' imprisonment with a fine up to NT$500,000
d_en: A fine of NT$20,000 to NT$100,000; where the act destroys the protection target, up to three years' imprisonment or detention with a fine up to NT$200,000; where it causes a disaster, six months to five years' imprisonment with a fine up to NT$400,000
explain_zh: 第34條：在二級海岸保護區內違反第13條第1項第3款海岸保護計畫所定禁止之使用者，處新臺幣二萬元以上十萬元以下罰鍰；因前項行為毀壞保護標的者，處三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或科或併科新臺幣二十萬元以下罰金；因第1項行為致釀成災害者，處六月以上五年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣四十萬元以下罰金。第12條第1項後段定明一級保護區以外有保護必要之地區得劃設為二級海岸保護區。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 規避、妨礙或拒絕計畫擬訂或實施機關派員進入公私有土地實地調查、勘測者，應如何處罰？
a_zh: 處新臺幣六萬元以上三十萬元以下之罰鍰，並得限期令其回復原狀
b_zh: 處新臺幣三千元以上一萬五千元以下之罰鍰，但不得按次處罰或強制檢查
c_zh: 處新臺幣二萬元以上十萬元以下之罰鍰，並得按次處罰及命其停工
d_zh: 處新臺幣一萬元以上五萬元以下之罰鍰，並得按次處罰及強制檢查
q_en: How is evading, obstructing or refusing an on-site survey by the planning or implementing agency penalized?
a_en: A fine of NT$60,000 to NT$300,000, with an order to restore within a time limit
b_en: A fine of NT$3,000 to NT$15,000, but with no repeat penalty or compulsory inspection
c_en: A fine of NT$20,000 to NT$100,000, with repeat penalties and a stop-work order
d_en: A fine of NT$10,000 to NT$50,000, with repeat penalties and compulsory inspection
explain_zh: 第35條：規避、妨礙或拒絕第21條第1項第1款之調查、勘測者，處新臺幣一萬元以上五萬元以下之罰鍰，並得按次處罰及強制檢查。第21條第2項規定調查或勘測人員應出示證明文件或顯示足資辨別之標誌，土地所有人、占有人、管理人或使用人不得規避、拒絕或妨礙，並應於進入設有圍障之土地前七日通知。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 違反第二十五條第一項規定，未經主管機關許可或未依許可內容逕行施工者，應如何處罰？
a_zh: 處新臺幣二萬元以上十萬元以下罰鍰，並得撤銷其開發許可，屆期未回復原狀者，得代為執行並求償
b_zh: 處新臺幣六萬元以上三十萬元以下罰鍰，並令其限期改善或回復原狀，屆期未遵從者，得按次處罰
c_zh: 處新臺幣三萬元以上十五萬元以下罰鍰，並令其立即停工，屆期未遵從者，得處以三年以下有期徒刑
d_zh: 處新臺幣一萬元以上五萬元以下罰鍰，並令其限期改善或回復原狀，屆期未遵從者，得移送司法機關
q_en: How is construction without a permit or contrary to a permit under Article 25(1) penalized?
a_en: A fine of NT$20,000 to NT$100,000, with revocation of the development permit and substitute execution with cost recovery if not restored
b_en: A fine of NT$60,000 to NT$300,000, with an order to improve or restore within a time limit and repeat penalties if not complied with
c_en: A fine of NT$30,000 to NT$150,000, with an immediate stop-work order and up to three years' imprisonment if not complied with
d_en: A fine of NT$10,000 to NT$50,000, with an order to improve or restore within a time limit and referral for prosecution if not complied with
explain_zh: 第36條：違反第25條第1項規定，未經主管機關許可或未依許可內容逕行施工者，處新臺幣六萬元以上三十萬元以下罰鍰，並令其限期改善或回復原狀，屆期未遵從者，得按次處罰。第25條第1項規定於一級海岸保護區以外之海岸地區特定區位內從事一定規模以上開發利用者，應檢具海岸利用管理說明書申請中央主管機關許可；第26條並定其許可條件。

law: 海岸管理法
category: 海管法-獨占性使用罰則
q_zh: 在近岸海域及公有自然沙灘為獨占性使用或設置人為設施者，主管機關應如何處理？
a_zh: 經主管機關制止後即應自行拆除，未拆除者處新臺幣十萬元以上五十萬元以下罰鍰，並得沒入其設施設備
b_zh: 經主管機關制止並令其限期恢復原狀，屆期未遵從者，處新臺幣一萬元以上五萬元以下罰鍰，並得按次處罰
c_zh: 經主管機關制止並令其限期恢復原狀，屆期未遵從者，處三年以下有期徒刑，得併科新臺幣二十萬元以下罰金
d_zh: 逕行處新臺幣六萬元以上三十萬元以下罰鍰，並令其限期恢復原狀，屆期未遵從者，得移送司法機關偵辦
q_en: How does the authority deal with exclusive use or artificial facilities on nearshore waters and public natural beaches?
a_en: The person must dismantle it once stopped, and failing that a fine of NT$100,000 to NT$500,000 applies with confiscation of the facilities and equipment
b_en: The authority stops the act and orders restoration within a time limit; if not complied with, a fine of NT$10,000 to NT$50,000 applies with repeat penalties
c_en: The authority stops the act and orders restoration within a time limit; if not complied with, up to three years' imprisonment with a fine up to NT$200,000 applies
d_en: A fine of NT$60,000 to NT$300,000 is imposed directly with an order to restore within a time limit, and referral for prosecution if not complied with
explain_zh: 第37條：違反第31條第1項規定，在近岸海域及公有自然沙灘為獨占性使用或設置人為設施者，經主管機關制止並令其限期恢復原狀，屆期未遵從者，處新臺幣一萬元以上五萬元以下罰鍰，並得按次處罰。第31條第1項旨在保障公共通行及公共水域之使用，並就依其他法律允許使用或專案申請許可者設有但書。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 主管機關對於保護區或防護區之違規行為，除罰鍰外應命行為人為哪些作為？
a_zh: 應即令其停止使用或施工，並視情形令其限期回復原狀、拆除設施或增建安全設施
b_zh: 應即令其接受環境教育講習課程，並視情形令其限期提出生態補償替代方案
c_zh: 應即令其停止使用或施工，並一律令其於三十日內拆除全部設施且不得回復使用
d_zh: 應即令其繳交等額之環境復育保證金，並由主管機關代為回復原狀及拆除設施
q_en: Besides fines, what must the authority order for violations in protection or defense zones?
a_en: It must at once order the use or construction to stop, and as appropriate order restoration, demolition of facilities or added safety works within a time limit
b_en: It must at once order attendance at environmental education classes, and as appropriate order an ecological offset alternative within a time limit
c_en: It must at once order the use or construction to stop, and always order all facilities demolished within thirty days with no resumption of use permitted
d_en: It must at once order payment of an equivalent environmental restoration deposit, with the authority itself carrying out restoration and demolition
explain_zh: 第38條：主管機關對第32條第1項、第33條第1項或第34條第1項規定行為，除處以罰鍰外，應即令其停止使用或施工；並視情形令其限期回復原狀、拆除設施或增建安全設施，屆期未遵從者，得按次處罰。第32條至第34條分別就一級海岸保護區、海岸防護區及二級海岸保護區之違規使用定有罰鍰及刑罰。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 法人之代表人、代理人、受雇人或其他從業人員因執行業務犯本法之罪者，法人或自然人之責任為何？
a_zh: 僅對該法人或自然人科以罰金，實際行為人得免除刑事責任
b_zh: 應由該法人或自然人與行為人負連帶賠償責任，但不科罰金
c_zh: 僅處罰實際行為人，該法人或自然人不另負擔任何刑事責任
d_zh: 除處罰其行為人外，對該法人或自然人亦科以各該條之罰金
q_en: Where a representative, agent or employee commits an offense under this Act in the course of business, what is the entity's liability?
a_en: Only the juridical or natural person is fined, and the actual offender is exempted from criminal liability
b_en: The juridical or natural person is jointly liable in damages with the offender, but no fine is imposed
c_en: Only the actual offender is punished, and the juridical or natural person bears no further criminal liability
d_en: Besides punishing the actual offender, the juridical or natural person is also fined under the relevant article
explain_zh: 第39條：法人之代表人、法人或自然人之代理人、受雇人或其他從業人員，因執行業務犯本法之罪者，除處罰其行為人外，對該法人或自然人亦科以各該條之罰金。本法所定之罪包括第32條至第34條因違規使用而毀壞保護標的、毀壞海岸防護設施或致釀成災害之情形。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 犯第三十二條至第三十四條之罪者，於何種情形下得減輕其刑？
a_zh: 於第一審言詞辯論終結前已作有效回復或補救者，得減輕其刑
b_zh: 於偵查中自白並繳交罰金者，得減輕其刑至二分之一
c_zh: 於第二審判決前與主管機關成立和解者，得免除其刑
d_zh: 於犯罪後六個月內自首並提出復育計畫者，應免除其刑
q_en: In what circumstance may the sentence for an Article 32-34 offense be reduced?
a_en: Where effective restoration or remedial action has been made before the close of oral argument at first instance
b_en: Where the offender confesses during investigation and pays the fine, allowing a reduction of up to one half
c_en: Where the offender settles with the competent authority before the second instance judgment, remitting the sentence
d_en: Where the offender surrenders within six months of the offense and submits a restoration plan, remitting the sentence
explain_zh: 第40條：犯第32條至第34條之罪，於第一審言詞辯論終結前已作有效回復或補救者，得減輕其刑。第32條至第34條分別規定在一級海岸保護區、海岸防護區及二級海岸保護區內違規使用而毀壞保護標的、毀壞海岸防護設施或致釀成災害之刑責；第38條並定明主管機關應令其限期回復原狀或拆除設施。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 因第三十二條第一項、第三十三條第一項或第三十四條第一項之行為所生或所得之物及所用之物，應如何處理？
a_zh: 應發還原所有人
b_zh: 得沒入之
c_zh: 應拍賣並繳庫
d_zh: 應沒收之
q_en: How are objects produced by, obtained from or used in acts under Articles 32(1), 33(1) or 34(1) treated?
a_en: They must be returned to their owner
b_en: They may be administratively confiscated
c_en: They must be auctioned and paid to the treasury
d_en: They must be criminally confiscated
explain_zh: 第41條：因第32條第1項、第33條第1項或第34條第1項之行為所生或所得之物及所用之物，得沒入之。此為行政罰之沒入規定；第42條另定明犯本法之罪者，其所生或所得之物及所用之物沒收之，屬刑事沒收規定，二者適用之程序與要件不同。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 犯本法之罪者，其所生或所得之物及所用之物應如何處理？
a_zh: 得沒入之
b_zh: 應予估價變賣
c_zh: 得酌予發還
d_zh: 沒收之
q_en: How are objects produced by, obtained from or used in a criminal offense under this Act treated?
a_en: They may be administratively seized
b_en: They must be appraised and sold off
c_en: They may be returned at discretion
d_en: They are criminally confiscated
explain_zh: 第42條：犯本法之罪，其所生或所得之物及所用之物，沒收之。相較之下，第41條係就第32條第1項、第33條第1項或第34條第1項之行政違規行為，規定其所生、所得及所用之物「得沒入之」，屬行政罰性質，二者規範層次不同。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 整體海岸管理計畫及海岸保護計畫、海岸防護計畫涉及相關機關執行有疑義時，應如何處理？
a_zh: 應由計畫擬訂機關函請立法院解釋；相關機關應依解釋內容辦理
b_zh: 應由行政院逕行指定主辦機關；主管機關不得介入協調相關爭議
c_zh: 得由目的事業主管機關逕行決定；相關機關均應受該決定之拘束
d_zh: 得由主管機關協調；協調不成，由主管機關報請上級機關決定之
q_en: How are doubts among agencies over implementing the coastal plans resolved?
a_en: The drafting agency asks the Legislative Yuan for an interpretation, which the relevant agencies must then follow
b_en: The Executive Yuan designates a lead agency directly, and the competent authority may not coordinate
c_en: The relevant industry authority decides directly, and all other agencies are bound by that decision
d_en: The competent authority may coordinate; failing agreement, it reports the matter to the superior agency for decision
explain_zh: 第43條：整體海岸管理計畫及海岸保護計畫、海岸防護計畫涉及相關機關執行有疑義時，得由主管機關協調；協調不成，由主管機關報請上級機關決定之。第10條第1項亦就保護區、防護區等級及計畫擬訂機關認定有疑義者，定有由中央主管機關協調指定或逕行擬訂之機制。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 中央主管機關應於何時公告實施整體海岸管理計畫？
a_zh: 應於本法施行後一年內公告實施
b_zh: 應於本法施行後五年內公告實施
c_zh: 應於本法施行後六個月內公告實施
d_zh: 應於本法施行後二年內公告實施
q_en: By when must the central authority announce and implement the integrated coastal zone management plan?
a_en: Within one year after this Act takes effect
b_en: Within five years after this Act takes effect
c_en: Within six months after this Act takes effect
d_en: Within two years after this Act takes effect
explain_zh: 第44條：中央主管機關應於本法施行後二年內，公告實施整體海岸管理計畫。第5條另規定中央主管機關應於本法施行後六個月內劃定海岸地區範圍後公告之；第18條並要求計畫公告實施後每五年通盤檢討一次。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 本法施行細則之訂定機關為何？
a_zh: 由各直轄市、縣（市）主管機關定之
b_zh: 由中央主管機關定之
c_zh: 由行政院會商中央主管機關定之
d_zh: 由中央主管機關報請立法院審議
q_en: Which authority prescribes the enforcement rules of this Act?
a_en: Each municipal and county competent authority
b_en: The central competent authority
c_en: The Executive Yuan with the central authority
d_en: The central authority, subject to legislative review
explain_zh: 第45條：本法施行細則，由中央主管機關定之。依第3條，本法之中央主管機關為內政部。本法另授權中央主管機關訂定之辦法包括第12條第4項不合保護計畫之認定與補償辦法、第25條第3項海岸利用管理說明書辦法及第31條第2項專案申請許可辦法等。

law: 海岸管理法
q_zh: 本法之施行日期如何規定？
a_zh: 自公布後一年施行
b_zh: 自公布後六個月施行
c_zh: 由行政院定之
d_zh: 自公布日施行
q_en: How is the effective date of this Act provided?
a_en: It takes effect one year after promulgation
b_en: It takes effect six months after promulgation
c_en: It takes effect on a date set by the Executive Yuan
d_en: It takes effect on the date of promulgation
explain_zh: 第46條：本法自公布日施行。第44條另定中央主管機關應於本法施行後二年內公告實施整體海岸管理計畫，第5條則要求於施行後六個月內劃定公告海岸地區範圍，二者均以本法施行日為起算基準。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 制定海洋保育法之立法目的為何？
a_zh: 為防治海洋污染行為，管制陸源污染排放，合理徵收海洋污染防治費，協調並促進海域監測站之設置及管理，推動污染防治教育
b_zh: 為開發海洋生物資源，培育海洋養殖產業，擴大遠洋漁業作業範圍，協調並促進漁業專用區之劃設及經營，推動漁業經濟教育
c_zh: 為保護海洋生態環境，保育海洋生物多樣性，合理利用海洋生物資源，協調並促進海洋保護區之規劃及執行，推動海洋保育教育
d_zh: 為管理海岸土地使用，確保自然海岸零損失，合理配置海岸防護設施，協調並促進海岸保護區之劃設及執行，推動海岸管理教育
q_en: What is the stated legislative purpose of the Marine Conservation Act?
a_en: To prevent acts of marine pollution, control discharges from land-based sources, levy marine pollution control fees, coordinate and promote the installation and management of sea monitoring stations, and advance pollution control education
b_en: To develop marine biological resources, foster the marine aquaculture industry, expand distant-water fishing operations, coordinate and promote the designation and operation of fishery zones, and advance fishery economics education
c_en: To protect the marine ecological environment, conserve marine biodiversity, make rational use of marine biological resources, coordinate and promote the planning and implementation of marine protected areas, and advance marine conservation education
d_en: To manage coastal land use, ensure zero loss of natural coastline, allocate coastal defense facilities rationally, coordinate and promote the designation and implementation of coastal protection zones, and advance coastal management education
explain_zh: 第1條：為保護海洋生態環境，保育海洋生物多樣性，合理利用海洋生物資源，協調並促進海洋保護區之規劃及執行，推動海洋保育教育，特制定本法。第4條並要求主管機關為達成海洋生物多樣性之目標，應採取各種海洋保育措施，以保護海洋生物棲息環境，協調並促進海洋保護區之整合規劃及執行。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 本法所稱主管機關為何？地方主管機關之管轄範圍如何決定？
a_zh: 中央為內政部，直轄市為直轄市政府，縣（市）為縣（市）政府；地方主管機關之管轄範圍，由中央目的事業主管機關公告
b_zh: 中央為海洋委員會，直轄市為直轄市政府，縣（市）為縣（市）政府；地方主管機關之管轄範圍，由中央主管機關公告之
c_zh: 中央為農業部，直轄市為直轄市政府，縣（市）為縣（市）政府；地方主管機關之管轄範圍，由各該地方政府自行公告之
d_zh: 中央為環境部，直轄市為直轄市政府，縣（市）為縣（市）政府；地方主管機關之管轄範圍，由行政院逕行劃定並公告之
q_en: Who are the competent authorities, and how is local jurisdiction determined?
a_en: Central: the Ministry of the Interior; municipal: the municipal governments; county: the county or city governments; local jurisdiction is announced by the central industry authority
b_en: Central: the Ocean Affairs Council; municipal: the municipal governments; county: the county or city governments; local jurisdiction is announced by the central competent authority
c_en: Central: the Ministry of Agriculture; municipal: the municipal governments; county: the county or city governments; local jurisdiction is announced by each local government itself
d_en: Central: the Ministry of Environment; municipal: the municipal governments; county: the county or city governments; local jurisdiction is delimited and announced by the Executive Yuan
explain_zh: 第2條第1項：本法所稱主管機關，在中央為海洋委員會；在直轄市為直轄市政府；在縣（市）為縣（市）政府。第2項：直轄市、縣（市）主管機關之管轄範圍，由中央主管機關公告之。海洋污染防治法第3條就其主管機關亦採相同之中央機關設計。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 本法所稱海洋生物多樣性、保育及海洋保護區，其定義為何？
a_zh: 海洋生物多樣性指經中央主管機關公告之保育類海洋物種名錄總數；保育指禁止一切人為利用海洋生物資源之行為，並包括禁止學術研究採樣在內；海洋保護區指僅依本法所劃定之海洋庇護區，並不包括依其他法律規定劃設之各類保護區域及其毗連陸域在內
b_zh: 海洋生物多樣性指海域內漁獲量與魚種數量之統計指標；保育指基於漁業永續經營原則，對經濟性魚種所為之放流、增殖及配額管理行為；海洋保護區指經漁業主管機關劃定之水產動植物繁殖保育區，其餘區域均不屬之
c_zh: 海洋生物多樣性指所有海洋範圍內活的生物體中之變異性，包括物種內、物種之間及生態系統之多樣性；保育指基於海洋生物多樣性及自然生態平衡之原則，對海洋生物所為保護、復育、管理之行為；海洋保護區指依本法或其他法律所劃定進行保護之海域或其毗連陸域
d_zh: 海洋生物多樣性指海洋生態系統之碳匯能力與固碳總量；保育指基於氣候變遷調適原則，對藍碳生態系所為之復育及碳權管理行為；海洋保護區指依海洋基本法所劃定之重要海洋生態區位，並以陸域緩衝帶為其範圍
q_en: How are marine biodiversity, conservation and marine protected areas defined?
a_en: Marine biodiversity means the total number of conserved marine species appearing on the list announced by the central competent authority; conservation means banning all human use of marine biological resources, including sampling carried out for academic research; a marine protected area means only a marine sanctuary designated under this Act, excluding any protected areas designated under other laws
b_en: Marine biodiversity means statistical indicators of catch volume and the number of fish species in an area; conservation means release, propagation and quota management of commercial species on principles of sustainable fisheries; a marine protected area means only an aquatic breeding and conservation area designated by fisheries authorities
c_en: Marine biodiversity means variability among living organisms within all marine areas, including diversity within species, between species and of ecosystems; conservation means protecting, restoring and managing marine organisms on principles of biodiversity and natural ecological balance; a marine protected area is a sea area or its adjoining land designated for protection under this or another law
d_en: Marine biodiversity means the carbon sink capacity and total carbon storage of marine ecosystems; conservation means restoration and carbon credit management of blue carbon ecosystems on climate adaptation principles; a marine protected area means an important ecological location designated under the Ocean Basic Act with a landward buffer
explain_zh: 第3條第2至4款：海洋生物多樣性指所有海洋範圍內活的生物體中之變異性，包括物種內、物種之間及生態系統之多樣性；保育指基於海洋生物多樣性及自然生態平衡之原則，對於海洋生物所為保護、復育、管理之行為；海洋保護區指一處海域或該海域與其毗連之陸域具有生物多樣性、特殊自然景觀、文化資產或永續利用之生態資源等，依本法或其他法律所劃定進行保護之區域。第6條並列舉海洋保護區之十一種類型。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 海洋庇護區之核心區、緩衝區及永續利用區，其定義為何？
a_zh: 核心區指為長期保護海洋生物所劃定並全面禁止學術研究之區域；緩衝區指鄰接核心區而容許一切開發利用行為所劃定之區域；永續利用區指於核心區與緩衝區之間，僅供軍事訓練、海域巡防及國防設施使用所劃定之區域，並禁止一般民眾與漁民進入其中
b_zh: 核心區指為長期保護海洋生物、生態環境、生物多樣性並提供學術研究，應嚴格保護且限制人員進入及所有開發利用行為所劃定之區域；緩衝區指鄰接或環繞於核心區，針對人為活動進行管理、限制以保護核心區，可作為研究發展所劃定之區域；永續利用區指於核心區、緩衝區之外圍，在無礙海洋自然生態平衡前提下容許資源利用之區域
c_zh: 核心區指依其他法律已劃設保護區而納入庇護區管理所劃定之區域；緩衝區指鄰接原住民族傳統海域，專供原住民族傳統採捕使用之區域；永續利用區指於庇護區外圍海域，供中央主管機關辦理海洋保育觀察及監測任務所劃定使用之專屬區域
d_zh: 核心區指位於海洋庇護區之最外圍、供一般民眾自由進出並從事各類遊憩活動所劃定公告之區域；緩衝區指鄰接或環繞於永續利用區，專供漁業作業、水產養殖及採捕海洋生物使用所劃定之區域；永續利用區指位於海洋庇護區之最中心處，應嚴格保護並限制人員進入及所有開發利用行為所劃定公告之核心保護區域
q_en: How are the core, buffer and sustainable use zones of a marine sanctuary defined?
a_en: The core zone is designated for the long-term protection of marine life, the marine environment and biodiversity, with academic research entirely prohibited inside it; the buffer zone adjoins the core zone and permits all forms of development and resource use without restriction; the sustainable use zone lies between the core and buffer zones and serves only military training, maritime patrol and national defense installations, with the general public and fishers barred from entry
b_en: The core zone is designated for long-term protection of marine life, environment and biodiversity and for academic research, strictly protected with entry and all development restricted; the buffer zone adjoins or surrounds the core zone, managing and restricting human activity to protect it and available for research and development; the sustainable use zone lies outside both and permits resource use where the natural ecological balance is not impaired
c_en: The core zone is an area already designated under other laws and brought into sanctuary management; the buffer zone adjoins traditional indigenous waters and is reserved for traditional indigenous harvesting; the sustainable use zone lies in the outer waters and is reserved for the central authority's observation and monitoring tasks
d_en: The core zone lies on the outermost edge of the sanctuary and is designated for free public entry and recreation; the buffer zone adjoins or surrounds the sustainable use zone and is designated for fishing operations and aquaculture; the sustainable use zone lies at the sanctuary's center and is strictly protected with entry and all development restricted
explain_zh: 第3條第6至8款：核心區指為長期保護海洋生物、生態環境、生物多樣性，並提供學術研究，應嚴格保護，且限制人員進入及所有開發利用行為所劃定之區域；緩衝區指鄰接或環繞於核心區，針對人為活動進行管理、限制以保護核心區，可作為研究發展所劃定之區域；永續利用區指於核心區、緩衝區之外圍，在無礙海洋自然生態平衡之前提下，容許海洋生物、生態環境、生物多樣性及天然資源之利用之區域。第10條至第12條分別定其管制內容。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 為達成海洋生物多樣性之目標，主管機關應採取何種作為？
a_zh: 應採取各種海洋保育措施，以保護海洋生物棲息環境，協調並促進海洋保護區之整合規劃及執行
b_zh: 應採取各種漁業管理措施，以提高海洋生物產量，協調並促進漁業專用區之整合規劃及開發
c_zh: 應採取各種污染防治措施，以降低海域污染負荷，協調並促進海域監測站之整合設置及維護
d_zh: 應採取各種土地管制措施，以限制毗連陸域開發，協調並促進海岸防護區之整合劃設及施工
q_en: What must the competent authorities do to achieve marine biodiversity goals?
a_en: Take various marine conservation measures to protect marine habitats, and coordinate and promote the integrated planning and implementation of marine protected areas
b_en: Take various fishery management measures to raise marine biological output, and coordinate and promote the integrated planning and development of dedicated fishery zones
c_en: Take various pollution control measures to reduce the pollution load of sea areas, and coordinate and promote the integrated installation and upkeep of monitoring stations
d_en: Take various land control measures to limit development of adjoining land, and coordinate and promote the integrated designation and construction of coastal defense zones
explain_zh: 第4條：為達成海洋生物多樣性之目標，主管機關應採取各種海洋保育措施，以保護海洋生物棲息環境，協調並促進海洋保護區之整合規劃及執行。第7條並要求中央主管機關會同各中央目的事業主管機關訂定整體海洋保護區管理政策方針，報請行政院核定後實施。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 海洋庇護區之劃定、變更、廢止及保育計畫擬訂前，涉及原住民族土地及海域者應如何辦理？
a_zh: 中央主管機關得逕行劃定並於公告後通知中央原住民族主管機關，無須事前會同或依其他法律辦理
b_zh: 應報請行政院核定後由地方主管機關辦理，並依土地徵收條例規定給予原住民族適當之補償
c_zh: 中央主管機關應會同中央原住民族主管機關，並依原住民族基本法及海洋基本法之規定辦理
d_zh: 應由中央原住民族主管機關單獨劃定該區域，中央主管機關僅負責後續之保育計畫執行及管理
q_en: What applies where designating, altering or abolishing a marine sanctuary involves indigenous land or waters?
a_en: The central competent authority may designate directly and merely notify the central indigenous peoples authority afterwards, with no prior joint action or other law applying
b_en: The matter must go to the Executive Yuan for approval and be handled by local authorities, with compensation to indigenous peoples under the Land Expropriation Act
c_en: The central competent authority must act jointly with the central indigenous peoples authority and in accordance with the Indigenous Peoples Basic Act and the Ocean Basic Act
d_en: The central indigenous peoples authority alone designates that area, with the central competent authority only implementing and managing the conservation plan afterwards
explain_zh: 第5條：海洋庇護區之劃定、變更或廢止及海洋庇護區保育計畫之擬訂前，涉及原住民族土地及海域部分，中央主管機關應會同中央原住民族主管機關，並依原住民族基本法及海洋基本法之規定辦理。第8條第2項並要求審議會中原住民及漁民團體之代表總人數不得少於委員總人數三分之一；第26條第2項並定明海洋保育講習課程應包含原住民族知識及生物多樣性課程。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 本法所定海洋保護區之類型，包括下列哪些地區之海域或其毗連陸域？
a_zh: 野生動物保護區；海岸保護區與海岸防護區；國家公園及國家自然公園；國家風景特定區陸域遊憩區；水產動植物養殖區；軍事管制區；自然保留區；地質公園；水源保護區；海洋庇護區；依其他法律規定劃設之保安林地
b_zh: 野生動物保護區；野生動物重要棲息環境；國家公園及國家自然公園；商港區與工業專用港區；漁港區及遊艇港區；水下文化資產保護區；自然保留區；地質公園；重要濕地；海埔地開發區；依其他法律規定劃設之產業園區
c_zh: 野生動物保護區；野生動物重要棲息環境；國家公園及國家自然公園；國家風景特定區海域資源保護區；水產動植物繁殖保育區；水下文化資產保護區；自然保留區；地質公園；重要濕地；海洋庇護區；依其他法律規定劃設之保護區
d_zh: 野生動物重要棲息環境；離島綜合建設區；國家公園及國家自然公園；國家風景特定區海域資源保護區；水產動植物繁殖保育區；礦業保留區；自然保留區；地質公園；重要濕地；人工魚礁區；依其他法律規定劃設之禁採區
q_en: Which areas' waters, or waters plus adjoining land, count as marine protected areas under this Act?
a_en: Wildlife refuges; coastal protection and defense zones; national parks and national nature parks; land recreation areas of national scenic areas; aquaculture zones; military control areas; nature reserves; geoparks; water source protection areas; marine sanctuaries; and protection forests designated under other laws
b_en: Wildlife refuges; major wildlife habitats; national parks and national nature parks; commercial and industrial port zones; fishing and yacht harbor zones; underwater cultural heritage zones; nature reserves; geoparks; important wetlands; reclaimed land development zones; and industrial parks designated under other laws
c_en: Wildlife refuges; major wildlife habitats; national parks and national nature parks; marine resource protection areas of national scenic areas; aquatic breeding and conservation areas; underwater cultural heritage zones; nature reserves; geoparks; important wetlands; marine sanctuaries; and protected areas designated under other laws
d_en: Major wildlife habitats; offshore island development zones; national parks and national nature parks; marine resource protection areas of national scenic areas; aquatic breeding and conservation areas; mining reserve areas; nature reserves; geoparks; important wetlands; artificial reef zones; and no-extraction areas designated under other laws
explain_zh: 第6條第1項：本法所定海洋保護區之類型，包括野生動物保護區、野生動物重要棲息環境、國家公園及國家自然公園、國家風景特定區海域資源保護區、水產動植物繁殖保育區、水下文化資產保護區、自然保留區、地質公園、重要濕地、海洋庇護區及依其他法律規定劃設之保護區等地區之海域或該海域與其毗連之陸域。第2項並定明中央主管機關得認定海洋保護區以外其他有效保育措施之區域。

law: 海洋保育法
category: 海保法-其他有效保育措施
q_zh: 海洋保護區以外之區域，中央主管機關得為何種認定？其認定標準由誰訂定？
a_zh: 得認定為其他有效保育措施之區域；其認定標準，由中央主管機關定之
b_zh: 得認定為國家級重要濕地；其認定標準，由內政部會商中央主管機關定之
c_zh: 得認定為漁業資源保育區；其認定標準，由中央漁業主管機關會商地方定之
d_zh: 得認定為海洋庇護區之核心區；其認定標準，由行政院會商有關機關定之
q_en: What may the central authority recognize outside marine protected areas, and who sets the criteria?
a_en: It may recognize areas with other effective conservation measures; the recognition criteria are set by the central competent authority
b_en: It may recognize them as nationally important wetlands; the criteria are set by the Ministry of the Interior with the central authority
c_en: It may recognize them as fishery resource conservation areas; the criteria are set by the central fisheries authority with local authorities
d_en: It may recognize them as core zones of a marine sanctuary; the recognition criteria are set by the Executive Yuan with relevant agencies
explain_zh: 第6條第2項：中央主管機關得認定海洋保護區以外其他有效保育措施之區域；其認定標準，由中央主管機關定之。第7條並要求依其他法律規定劃設之海洋保護區，其保護區名稱、內容、劃設程序、辦理機關及管理事項從其規定，納入整體海洋保護區管理政策方針之一部。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 整體海洋保護區管理政策方針應由誰訂定？其內容應包括哪些事項？
a_zh: 由各中央目的事業主管機關分別訂定其主管保護區之方針，報中央主管機關備查；內容應包括政策目標、海洋保護區之漁獲配額、海洋保護區之養殖許可、海洋保護區之遊憩收費、海洋保護區之觀光行銷
b_zh: 由行政院會同中央原住民族主管機關訂定，交由地方主管機關分別實施；內容應包括政策目標、海洋保護區之分類及分級、海洋保護區之巡防勤務、海洋保護區之罰鍰額度、海洋保護區之檢舉獎金基準
c_zh: 由中央主管機關會同各中央目的事業主管機關訂定，報請立法院審議後實施；內容應包括政策目標、海洋保護區之土地權屬、海洋保護區之徵收補償、海洋保護區之招商、海洋保護區之開發利益回饋比率
d_zh: 由中央主管機關會同各中央目的事業主管機關訂定，報請行政院核定後實施；內容應包括政策目標、海洋保護區之分類及分級、海洋保護區之規劃及管理、海洋保護區之監測、海洋保護區之檢討及成效評估
q_en: Who sets the overall marine protected area management policy guidelines, and what must they cover?
a_en: Each central industry authority for the areas it administers, filed with the central authority for record; they must cover policy objectives, catch quotas, aquaculture permits, recreation charges, and tourism marketing in protected areas
b_en: The Executive Yuan together with the central indigenous peoples authority, implemented separately by local authorities; they must cover policy objectives, classification and grading, patrol duties, fine levels, and criteria for informant rewards
c_en: The central authority together with the central industry authorities, effective after Legislative Yuan review; they must cover policy objectives, land ownership in protected areas, expropriation compensation, investment attraction, and development benefit feedback ratios in those areas
d_en: The central authority together with the central industry authorities, effective after Executive Yuan approval; they must cover policy objectives, classification and grading of protected areas, their planning and management, their monitoring, and their review and effectiveness assessment
explain_zh: 第7條第1項：中央主管機關應會同各中央目的事業主管機關訂定整體海洋保護區管理政策方針，報請行政院核定後實施；其變更時亦同。第2項：內容應包括政策目標、海洋保護區之分類及分級、海洋保護區之規劃及管理、海洋保護區之監測、海洋保護區之檢討及成效評估及其他與海洋保護區管理有關之事項。第3項並要求實施後每五年至少檢討一次。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 整體海洋保護區管理政策方針實施後應多久檢討一次？涉及相關機關執行有疑義時如何處理？
a_zh: 中央主管機關應每十年至少檢討一次；涉及相關機關執行有疑義時，得由各中央目的事業主管機關逕行決定，中央主管機關不得介入
b_zh: 中央主管機關應每三年至少檢討一次；涉及相關機關執行有疑義時，應由立法院作成決議後辦理，行政院不得逕行決定其執行方式
c_zh: 中央主管機關得視需要決定是否檢討；涉及相關機關執行有疑義時，應由地方主管機關協調，協調不成者報請中央主管機關核定
d_zh: 中央主管機關應每五年至少檢討一次；涉及相關機關執行有疑義時，得由中央主管機關協調，協調不成者報請行政院決定之
q_en: How often must the policy guidelines be reviewed, and how are inter-agency doubts resolved?
a_en: The central authority must review them at least once every ten years; where agencies have doubts over implementation, each central industry authority decides directly and the central authority may not intervene
b_en: The central authority must review them at least once every three years; where agencies have doubts over implementation, the Legislative Yuan must resolve the matter and the Executive Yuan may not decide
c_en: The central authority may decide whether to review them at all; where agencies have doubts, local authorities coordinate and, failing agreement, report to the central authority for approval
d_en: The central authority must review them at least once every five years; where agencies have doubts over implementation, the central authority may coordinate, and failing agreement report to the Executive Yuan for decision
explain_zh: 第7條第3項：整體海洋保護區管理政策方針實施後，中央主管機關應每五年至少檢討一次。第5項：整體海洋保護區管理政策方針涉及相關機關執行有疑義時，得由中央主管機關協調；協調不成者，報請行政院決定之。第4項並定明依其他法律規定劃設之海洋保護區從其規定，納入該方針之一部。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 中央主管機關於何種情形得劃定海洋庇護區？核心區劃定致特別犧牲損失者如何處理？
a_zh: 得就任何具觀光遊憩潛力之海域，不論是否已由其他主管機關劃設為海洋保護區，均劃定為海洋庇護區；核心區劃定致既有使用人遭受損失者，應由該使用人自行承擔而不予補償
b_zh: 得就已由其他主管機關劃設為海洋保護區之海域，重複劃定為海洋庇護區以加強保護；核心區劃定致既有使用人遭受特別犧牲之損失者，應由地方主管機關編列預算全額補償
c_zh: 得就經漁業主管機關同意釋出之漁業權海域，劃定為海洋庇護區；核心區劃定致既有使用人遭受特別犧牲之損失者，應由後續進入該區域之開發業者負擔全部補償費用
d_zh: 得就海洋生態系統有特別保護必要，且未經其他主管機關劃設為海洋保護區者，劃定為海洋庇護區；海洋庇護區之核心區劃定致該區域之既有使用人遭受特別犧牲之損失者，應予補償
q_en: When may the central authority designate a marine sanctuary, and what if core zone designation causes special sacrifice?
a_en: It may designate any waters with tourism potential as a marine sanctuary whether or not another authority has designated them a protected area; where core zone designation causes existing users loss, the users bear it themselves without compensation
b_en: It may redesignate waters already designated as marine protected areas by another competent authority as marine sanctuaries to strengthen their protection; where core zone designation causes special sacrifice, the local competent authority must budget for full compensation
c_en: It may designate as a marine sanctuary any waters whose fishing rights the fisheries authority agrees to release; where core zone designation causes special sacrifice, developers later entering the area bear the entire compensation cost
d_en: It may designate a marine sanctuary where a marine ecosystem specially needs protection and has not been designated a protected area by another authority; where core zone designation causes existing users to suffer a loss amounting to special sacrifice, compensation must be paid
explain_zh: 第8條第1項：中央主管機關得就海洋生態系統有特別保護必要，且未經其他主管機關劃設為海洋保護區者，劃定為海洋庇護區。第4項：海洋庇護區之核心區劃定，致該區域之既有使用人遭受特別犧牲之損失者，應予補償。第5項並授權中央主管機關訂定劃定基準、變更廢止程序、審議會設置及補償條件基準等辦法。第29條另就既有合法權利設有過渡規定。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 中央主管機關為辦理海洋庇護區劃定業務所設審議會，其組成及決議門檻為何？
a_zh: 由中央主管機關首長指定之機關代表及其遴聘之專家學者組成，不具官方身分之代表人數不得多於委員總人數二分之一，原住民及漁民團體之代表總人數不得多於三分之一；決議以全體委員三分之二以上同意行之
b_zh: 由專家學者、原住民、漁民團體、保育團體等民間團體及有關機關代表組成，不具官方身分之代表人數不得少於委員總人數三分之一，原住民及漁民團體之代表總人數不得少於四分之一；決議以委員三分之一之出席，出席委員過半數同意行之
c_zh: 由各中央目的事業主管機關代表組成，並得邀請專家學者列席陳述意見但無表決權，原住民及漁民團體之代表僅得旁聽；決議以委員過半數之出席，出席委員過半數同意行之，可否同數時取決於主席
d_zh: 由專家學者、原住民、漁民團體、保育團體等民間團體及有關機關代表組成，不具官方身分之代表人數不得少於委員總人數二分之一，原住民及漁民團體之代表總人數不得少於三分之一；決議以委員過半數之出席，出席委員超過三分之二同意行之
q_en: How is the review committee for marine sanctuary designation composed, and what is its voting threshold?
a_en: It comprises agency representatives designated by the head of the central authority plus scholars it appoints, with non-official representatives not more than one half of all members and indigenous and fishers' group representatives not more than one third; resolutions require the consent of two thirds of all members
b_en: It comprises scholars, indigenous persons, fishers' groups, conservation groups and other civil groups plus agency representatives, with non-official representatives not fewer than one third and indigenous and fishers' group representatives not fewer than one quarter; resolutions require one third of all members present and a simple majority of those present in favor
c_en: It comprises representatives of the central industry authorities, with scholars invited to attend and state opinions but without voting rights and indigenous and fishers' groups only observing; resolutions require a majority present and a majority of those present in favor, the chair casting the deciding vote
d_en: It comprises scholars, indigenous persons, fishers' groups, conservation groups and other civil groups plus agency representatives, with non-official representatives not fewer than one half of all members and indigenous and fishers' group representatives not fewer than one third; resolutions require a majority present and more than two thirds of those present in favor
explain_zh: 第8條第2項：中央主管機關為辦理海洋庇護區劃定業務，應設審議會，由專家學者、原住民、漁民團體、保育團體等民間團體及有關機關代表組成，其中不具官方身分之代表人數不得少於委員總人數二分之一，原住民及漁民團體之代表總人數，不得少於委員總人數三分之一。第3項：審議會之決議，以委員過半數之出席，出席委員超過三分之二同意行之。第14條第2項並定明中央主管機關辦理公告業務時準用第8條第2項規定。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 中央主管機關劃定海洋庇護區後，應如何擬訂並公開其保育計畫？
a_zh: 應委由學術研究機構擬訂海洋庇護區保育計畫，免經公開展覽及公聽程序即得公告實施；公告實施後應將計畫登載於政府公報、新聞紙或以其他適當方法廣泛周知並副知有關機關
b_zh: 應會商有關機關擬訂海洋庇護區保育計畫，並公開展覽三十日及舉行公聽會，其變更或廢止時亦同；公告實施後應將計畫登載於政府公報、新聞紙、網際網路或以其他適當方法廣泛周知
c_zh: 應會商有關機關擬訂海洋庇護區保育計畫，並公開展覽十五日及舉行說明會，其變更或廢止時免再辦理；公告實施後僅須將計畫函送當地地方主管機關及鄉鎮市區公所備查即可
d_zh: 應由地方主管機關擬訂海洋庇護區保育計畫報中央核定，並公開展覽六十日及舉行聽證，其變更或廢止時亦同；公告實施後應將計畫送請立法院審查並登載於政府公報周知
q_en: After designating a marine sanctuary, how must the central authority draft and publicize the conservation plan?
a_en: Academic institutions may be commissioned to draft the plan, which may be announced without any display or hearing procedure; after announcement it must be published in the gazette, newspapers or by other suitable means and copied to relevant agencies
b_en: It must draft the plan in consultation with relevant agencies, display it publicly for thirty days and hold a public hearing, doing likewise for changes or repeal; after announcement the plan must be published in the gazette, newspapers, online or by other suitable means
c_en: It must draft the plan in consultation with relevant agencies, display it for fifteen days and hold a briefing, with no further procedure for changes or repeal; after announcement it need only be filed with the local governments and township offices for record purposes
d_en: Local authorities must draft the plan for central approval, display it for sixty days and hold a hearing, doing likewise for changes or repeal; after announcement the plan must be sent to the Legislative Yuan for review and published in the gazette
explain_zh: 第9條第1項：中央主管機關劃定海洋庇護區後，應會商有關機關，擬訂海洋庇護區保育計畫，並公開展覽三十日及舉行公聽會；其變更或廢止時亦同。第2項：公開展覽與公聽會之日期及地點，應登載於政府公報、新聞紙、網際網路或以其他適當方法廣泛周知；人民、法人或團體得於公開展覽期間內以書面載明姓名或名稱及地址向中央主管機關提出意見。第3項：公告實施後應將計畫登載周知。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 任何人及海陸域交通工具進入海洋庇護區核心區之禁止規定，有哪些例外？
a_zh: 國家安全或軍事目的；海域巡防、犯罪查緝、漁業巡護、污染防治、海難救助等公務目的；船舶於核心區內下錨停泊補給並從事船員休憩活動；經地方主管機關書面同意之商業性漁撈作業、水產養殖經營或潛水遊憩等各類營利性活動行為
b_zh: 國家安全或軍事目的；海域巡防、犯罪查緝、漁業巡護、污染防治、海難救助、航路標識設置管理、海洋保育、水下文化資產之保存或管理等公務目的；船舶連續不停迅速通過且未從事航行以外之活動；經中央主管機關同意之科學研究、監測或調查等活動
c_zh: 國家安全或軍事目的；海洋觀光、遊艇停泊、水上活動經營、海釣船作業等遊憩目的；船舶連續不停迅速通過且未從事航行以外之活動；經目的事業主管機關備查之探礦、採礦或海底電纜鋪設等開發活動
d_zh: 公務機關辦理任何業務之目的；海域巡防、犯罪查緝、漁業巡護、污染防治等公務目的；船舶於核心區內從事拖網或流刺網作業；經中央主管機關公告之一定種類、數量、方式或期間內之採捕海洋生物行為
q_en: What exceptions apply to the ban on entering the core zone of a marine sanctuary?
a_en: National security or military purposes; official purposes such as maritime patrol, crime investigation, fishery patrol, pollution control, sea rescue and the routine collection of oceanographic data and weather observations; ships anchoring inside the core zone to take on fuel and supplies and to let the crew rest and recreate on board; and commercial fishing, aquaculture or dive tourism activities consented to in writing by the local competent authority concerned
b_en: National security or military purposes; official purposes such as maritime patrol, crime investigation, fishery patrol, pollution control, sea rescue, navigation aid installation and management, marine conservation, and preservation or management of underwater cultural heritage; continuous and expeditious passage of a ship engaged in no activity other than navigation; and scientific research, monitoring or surveys consented to by the central authority
c_en: National security or military purposes; recreational purposes such as marine tourism, yacht mooring, water activity operations and sport fishing boat operations; continuous and expeditious passage of a ship engaged in no activity other than navigation; and mineral exploration, mining or submarine cable laying filed with the relevant industry authority
d_en: The purposes of any business handled by a public agency; official purposes such as maritime patrol, crime investigation, fishery patrol and pollution control; ships carrying out trawling or drift gillnet operations inside the core zone; and taking marine organisms within the types, quantities, methods or periods announced by the central authority
explain_zh: 第10條第1項：任何人及海陸域交通工具禁止進入海洋庇護區之核心區，但有下列情形之一者不在此限：一、國家安全或軍事目的。二、海域巡防、犯罪查緝、漁業巡護、污染防治、海難救助、航路標識設置管理、海洋保育、水下文化資產之保存或管理等公務目的。三、船舶連續不停迅速通過，且未從事航行以外之活動。四、經中央主管機關同意之科學研究、監測或調查等活動。第2項並授權中央主管機關會商有關機關訂定第4款申請同意之辦法。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 違反規定進入海洋庇護區核心區者應如何處罰？誤入者之處理為何？
a_zh: 處行為人、海陸域交通工具駕駛人或船長新臺幣五萬元以上五十萬元以下罰鍰；誤入核心區經勸導駛離者不罰，但其為最近二年內經勸導又再違反者，不在此限
b_zh: 處行為人、海陸域交通工具駕駛人或船長新臺幣三萬元以上三十萬元以下罰鍰；誤入核心區經勸導駛離者不罰，但其為最近一年內經勸導又再違反者，不在此限
c_zh: 處行為人、海陸域交通工具駕駛人或船長新臺幣二萬元以上十萬元以下罰鍰；誤入核心區經勸導駛離者仍應處以最低額罰鍰，並令其接受海洋保育講習課程
d_zh: 處行為人、海陸域交通工具駕駛人或船長新臺幣一萬元以上十五萬元以下罰鍰；誤入核心區者一律不罰，縱使最近二年內曾經勸導又再違反者，仍不予處罰
q_en: How is unlawful entry into a sanctuary core zone penalized, and what applies to accidental entry?
a_en: The actor, the vehicle or vessel operator or the master is fined NT$50,000 to NT$500,000; accidental entry is not punished where the person leaves after advice, unless they were advised and offended again within the past two years
b_en: The actor, the vehicle or vessel operator or the master is fined NT$30,000 to NT$300,000; accidental entry is not punished where the person leaves after advice, unless they were advised and offended again within the past one year
c_en: The actor, the vehicle or vessel operator or the master is fined NT$20,000 to NT$100,000; accidental entry still attracts the minimum fine even after leaving on advice, plus an order to attend conservation classes
d_en: The actor, the vehicle or vessel operator or the master is fined NT$10,000 to NT$150,000; accidental entry is never punished, even where the person was advised and offended again within the past two years
explain_zh: 第21條第1項：違反第10條第1項規定，進入海洋庇護區之核心區者，處行為人、海陸域交通工具駕駛人或船長新臺幣五萬元以上五十萬元以下罰鍰。第2項：誤入海洋庇護區之核心區，經勸導駛離者，不罰；但其為最近二年內經勸導又再違反者，不在此限。第26條第1項並定明違反第10條第1項者，主管機關應令其接受二小時以上十二小時以下之海洋保育講習課程。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 海洋庇護區之緩衝區內，非經中央主管機關許可禁止從事哪些行為？何種情形免申請許可？
a_zh: 禁止水產養殖、採捕海洋生物、開挖濬深航道或施作海洋工程、鋪設電纜管道設施或結構、從事探礦或採礦；其中水產養殖及採捕海洋生物符合中央主管機關公告之一定種類、數量、方式、範圍或期間等條件者，免申請許可
b_zh: 禁止水產養殖、採捕海洋生物、船舶通過、潛水活動、海洋科學研究；其中船舶通過及潛水活動符合中央主管機關公告之一定種類、數量、方式、範圍或期間等條件者，得改向地方主管機關申請核准後為之
c_zh: 禁止開挖濬深航道或施作海洋工程、鋪設電纜管道設施或結構、從事探礦或採礦；其中開挖濬深航道及施作海洋工程符合中央主管機關公告之一定規模、方式或期間等條件者，免申請許可而僅須報請備查
d_zh: 禁止水產養殖、採捕海洋生物、開挖濬深航道或施作海洋工程、鋪設電纜管道設施或結構、從事探礦或採礦；上述行為一律不得申請許可，僅原住民基於傳統文化祭儀生活所需者不受限制
q_en: What is prohibited without permit in a sanctuary buffer zone, and when is no permit needed?
a_en: Aquaculture, taking marine organisms, excavating or deepening channels or building marine works, laying cables, pipelines, facilities or structures, and prospecting or mining are prohibited; aquaculture and taking marine organisms need no permit where they meet the types, quantities, methods, scope or periods announced by the central authority
b_en: Aquaculture, taking marine organisms, ship passage, diving activities and marine scientific research are prohibited; ship passage and diving may instead be approved by the local competent authority where they meet the types, quantities, methods, scope or periods announced by the central authority
c_en: Excavating or deepening channels or building marine works, laying cables, pipelines, facilities or structures, and prospecting or mining are prohibited; channel excavation and marine works need no permit but only filing where they meet the scale, methods or periods announced by the central authority
d_en: Aquaculture, taking marine organisms, excavating or deepening channels or building marine works, laying cables, pipelines, facilities or structures, and prospecting or mining are prohibited; no permit may ever be sought or granted for any of these, and only indigenous traditional cultural, ritual and livelihood needs are exempt from the prohibition
explain_zh: 第11條第1項：海洋庇護區之緩衝區內，非經中央主管機關許可，禁止從事水產養殖、採捕海洋生物、開挖或濬深航道或施作海洋工程、鋪設電纜管道設施或結構、從事探礦或採礦等行為；但符合第10條第1項但書第1款或第2款情形者，不在此限。第2項：從事水產養殖或採捕海洋生物，符合中央主管機關公告之一定種類、數量、方式、範圍或期間等條件者，免申請許可。第13條並授權中央主管機關訂定申請許可辦法。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 於海洋庇護區之緩衝區內未經許可從事禁止行為者，應如何處罰？有無除外規定？
a_zh: 處新臺幣五萬元以上五十萬元以下罰鍰；但原住民基於傳統文化、祭儀、生活所需之利用的行為，不在此限
b_zh: 處新臺幣二萬元以上十萬元以下罰鍰；但經地方主管機關事先同意之營利性採捕行為，得減半處以罰鍰
c_zh: 處新臺幣一萬元以上十五萬元以下罰鍰；原住民基於傳統文化、祭儀或生活所需之行為，仍應依規定處罰
d_zh: 處新臺幣三萬元以上三十萬元以下罰鍰；但原住民基於傳統文化、祭儀、生活所需之利用的行為，不在此限
q_en: How is unpermitted prohibited activity in a buffer zone penalized, and is there any exemption?
a_en: A fine of NT$50,000 to NT$500,000; but indigenous use for traditional cultural, ritual or livelihood needs is exempt from the prohibition
b_en: A fine of NT$20,000 to NT$100,000; but commercial harvesting consented to in advance by the local authority attracts only half the fine
c_en: A fine of NT$10,000 to NT$150,000; indigenous acts for traditional cultural, ritual or livelihood needs are still penalized under the rules
d_en: A fine of NT$30,000 to NT$300,000; but indigenous use for traditional cultural, ritual or livelihood needs is exempt from the prohibition
explain_zh: 第22條：違反第11條第1項規定，於海洋庇護區之緩衝區內，未經許可從事該項所定禁止行為者，處新臺幣三萬元以上三十萬元以下罰鍰；但原住民基於傳統文化、祭儀、生活所需之利用的行為，不在此限。第26條第1項並定明違反第11條第1項者，主管機關應令其接受二小時以上十二小時以下之海洋保育講習課程。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 海洋庇護區之永續利用區內，非經中央主管機關許可禁止從事哪些行為？
a_zh: 開挖或濬深航道或施作海洋工程；鋪設電纜、管道、設施或結構；從事探礦或採礦
b_zh: 水產養殖；採捕海洋生物；開挖或濬深航道或施作海洋工程；鋪設電纜或管道
c_zh: 任何人員及海陸域交通工具之進入；船舶航行或停泊；水產養殖及採捕海洋生物
d_zh: 海洋科學研究；監測或調查活動；海洋生物復育措施之投放；人工魚礁之設置
q_en: What is prohibited without permit in the sustainable use zone of a marine sanctuary?
a_en: Excavating or deepening channels or building marine works; laying cables, pipelines, facilities or structures; and prospecting or mining
b_en: Aquaculture; taking marine organisms; excavating or deepening channels or building marine works; and laying cables or pipelines
c_en: Entry by any person or land or sea vehicle; navigation or anchoring of ships; and aquaculture and the taking of marine organisms
d_en: Marine scientific research; monitoring or survey activities; placement of marine restoration installations; and setting artificial reefs
explain_zh: 第12條：海洋庇護區之永續利用區內，非經中央主管機關許可，禁止從事開挖、濬深航道或施作海洋工程、鋪設電纜管道設施或結構、從事探礦或採礦等行為；但符合第10條第1項但書第1款或第2款情形者，不在此限。相較之下，第11條就緩衝區另增列水產養殖及採捕海洋生物二項禁止行為。第23條第1款對違反第12條者，處新臺幣一萬元以上十五萬元以下罰鍰。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 緩衝區及永續利用區申請許可之條件、作業程序及廢止許可等事項，應由誰訂定？
a_zh: 由中央漁業主管機關會同中央主管機關定之
b_zh: 由中央主管機關定之
c_zh: 由各直轄市、縣（市）主管機關定之
d_zh: 由行政院會商中央主管機關定之
q_en: Who prescribes the conditions, procedures and revocation rules for permits in buffer and sustainable use zones?
a_en: The central fisheries authority with the central authority
b_en: The central competent authority
c_en: Each municipal and county competent authority
d_en: The Executive Yuan with the central authority
explain_zh: 第13條：第11條及第12條申請許可之條件、作業程序、廢止許可及其他相關事項之辦法，由中央主管機關定之。第11條就緩衝區禁止水產養殖、採捕海洋生物、開挖濬深航道或施作海洋工程、鋪設電纜管道及探礦採礦；第12條就永續利用區禁止後三類行為。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 為保育海洋生物，中央主管機關應會商其他目的事業主管機關公告哪些事項？
a_zh: 海洋保護區之分類分級與劃設程序；海洋庇護區審議會之組成與決議門檻；海洋保育觀察員之資格取得與訓練管理；其他與海洋保護區管理有關之監測、檢討及成效評估等應遵行事項
b_zh: 海洋污染防治費之徵收費率與繳納期限；船舶責任保險之投保額度與擔保方式；海洋棄置物質之甲乙丙分類基準；其他與海洋污染防治有關之許可、申報或紀錄保存等應遵行事項
c_zh: 海洋遊憩或休閒活動之限制、禁止或其他應遵行事項；船舶海上航行、活動或作業之限制、禁止或其他應遵行事項；於海洋使用採捕器具之限制、禁止或其他應遵行事項；其他與保育海洋生物有關之人為活動之限制、禁止或應遵行事項
d_zh: 海洋遊憩或休閒活動之收費標準與業者資格條件；船舶海上航行之航路指定與領港作業規定；於海洋使用採捕器具之進口關稅與貨物稅率；其他與海洋產業發展有關之投資獎勵、租稅減免或補助款核發等應遵行事項
q_en: To conserve marine life, what matters must the central authority announce after consulting other industry authorities?
a_en: The classification, grading and designation procedure for marine protected areas; the composition and voting threshold of the sanctuary review committee; the qualification and training of marine conservation observers; and monitoring, review and effectiveness assessment requirements
b_en: The rates and payment deadlines of the marine pollution control fee; insurance limits and forms of security for ships; the Class A, B and C criteria for substances dumped at sea; and permit, reporting or record retention requirements for pollution control
c_en: Restrictions, prohibitions or other requirements on marine recreation or leisure activities; on ship navigation, activities or operations at sea; on the use of harvesting gear in the sea; and on other human activities relating to the conservation of marine organisms
d_en: Fee standards and operator qualifications for marine recreation or leisure activities; route designation and pilotage rules for ship navigation; import duties and commodity tax rates on harvesting gear; and investment incentives, tax relief or subsidies for marine industry development
explain_zh: 第14條第1項：為保育海洋生物，中央主管機關應會商其他目的事業主管機關，公告海洋遊憩或休閒活動之限制、禁止或其他應遵行事項，船舶海上航行、活動或作業之限制、禁止或其他應遵行事項，於海洋使用採捕器具之限制、禁止或其他應遵行事項，及其他與保育海洋生物有關之人為活動之限制、禁止或其他應遵行事項。第23條第2款對違反該公告事項者，處新臺幣一萬元以上十五萬元以下罰鍰。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 中央主管機關辦理第十四條第一項公告業務時，應準用哪一條規定？其意義為何？
a_zh: 準用第八條第三項規定，即決議應以委員過半數之出席、出席委員超過三分之二同意行之，但不必另行組成審議會，得由中央主管機關之內部單位以會簽方式作成決定後公告實施
b_zh: 準用第七條第一項規定，即應會同各中央目的事業主管機關擬訂後報請行政院核定，並於核定後始得公告，其審議程序由行政院逕行指定機關及委員名單辦理
c_zh: 準用第八條第二項規定，即應設審議會，由專家學者、原住民、漁民團體、保育團體等民間團體及有關機關代表組成，不具官方身分之代表不得少於二分之一，原住民及漁民團體代表不得少於三分之一
d_zh: 準用第九條第一項規定，即應會商有關機關擬訂公告草案，並公開展覽三十日及舉行公聽會後始得公告，無須組成任何審議會或遴聘民間團體代表參與審議程序
q_en: Which provision applies mutatis mutandis when the central authority makes Article 14(1) announcements, and what does it mean?
a_en: Article 8, paragraph 3 applies, so resolutions require a majority present and more than two thirds of those present in favor, though no committee need be formed and the central authority's internal units may decide by circulation and then announce
b_en: Article 7, paragraph 1 applies, so the matter must be drafted jointly with the central industry authorities and submitted for Executive Yuan approval before announcement, with the Executive Yuan designating the reviewing agency and members
c_en: Article 8, paragraph 2 applies, so a review committee must be set up comprising scholars, indigenous persons, fishers' groups, conservation groups and agency representatives, with non-official representatives not fewer than one half and indigenous and fishers' group representatives not fewer than one third
d_en: Article 9, paragraph 1 applies, so the draft announcement must be prepared in consultation with the relevant agencies, displayed publicly for thirty days and put to a public hearing before announcement, with no review committee formed and no civil group or indigenous peoples representatives appointed
explain_zh: 第14條第2項：中央主管機關辦理前項業務，準用第8條第2項規定。第8條第2項規定中央主管機關應設審議會，由專家學者、原住民、漁民團體、保育團體等民間團體及有關機關代表組成，其中不具官方身分之代表人數不得少於委員總人數二分之一，原住民及漁民團體之代表總人數不得少於委員總人數三分之一。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 為執行海洋生物資源調查或海洋庇護區保育計畫，主管機關得為何種行為？相對人有何義務？
a_zh: 主管機關或受託機關（構）、法人、團體得派員出示證明文件，進入公、私有土地、處所或海域進行調查及實施保育措施，涉及軍事機密者應會同該管軍事機關為之；公、私有土地、處所或海域之所有人、使用人或管理人不得規避、妨礙或拒絕
b_zh: 主管機關得派員逕行進入公、私有土地、處所或海域進行調查，無須出示任何證明文件，涉及軍事機密者亦得單獨為之；公、私有土地、處所或海域之所有人、使用人或管理人得於認有妨礙其權益之情形時拒絕調查人員進入
c_zh: 主管機關應先取得法院核發之許可裁定，始得進入公、私有土地、處所或海域進行調查，涉及軍事機密者應報請行政院核准；公、私有土地、處所或海域之所有人、使用人或管理人得聲明異議並停止調查
d_zh: 主管機關僅得委託學術研究機構進入公、私有土地、處所或海域進行調查，不得自行派員辦理，涉及軍事機密者一律不得進入；公、私有土地、處所或海域之所有人、使用人或管理人有協助提供交通工具之義務
q_en: What may the authority do to carry out resource surveys or sanctuary conservation plans, and what must the other party do?
a_en: The authority or a commissioned agency, juridical person or group may send personnel showing credentials to enter public or private land, premises or waters to survey and carry out conservation measures, acting jointly with the military authority where military secrets are involved; owners, users or managers may not evade, obstruct or refuse
b_en: The authority or a commissioned body may send personnel to enter public or private land, premises or waters to survey and carry out measures without showing any credentials, and may act alone even where military secrets are involved; owners, users or managers may refuse entry wherever they consider that their own rights would be prejudiced
c_en: The authority must first obtain a court order before entering public or private land, premises or waters to survey, and must obtain Executive Yuan approval where military secrets are involved; owners, users or managers may object and thereby halt the survey
d_en: The authority may only commission academic institutions to enter public or private land, premises or waters to survey and may not send its own staff, and may never enter where military secrets are involved; owners, users or managers must help provide transport
explain_zh: 第15條第1項：為執行海洋生物資源調查或海洋庇護區保育計畫，主管機關或受託機關（構）、法人、團體得派員出示證明文件，進入公、私有土地、處所或海域進行調查及實施保育措施；其涉及軍事機密者，應會同該管軍事機關為之。第2項：公、私有土地、處所或海域之所有人、使用人或管理人不得規避、妨礙或拒絕。第24條第1款對無正當理由規避、妨礙或拒絕者，處新臺幣二萬元以上十萬元以下罰鍰。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 進行海洋生物資源調查或實施保育措施時，應踐行哪些程序？造成特別犧牲損失者如何處理？
a_zh: 遇設有圍障之土地或實施保育措施時，主管機關得逕行破除圍障進入而免事先通知，事後亦無須公告；調查人員得依業務需要公開受檢之工商軍事秘密；致所有人、使用人遭受特別犧牲之損失者，由其自行承擔而不予補償
b_zh: 遇設有圍障之土地或實施保育措施時，主管機關應事先通知所有人、使用人或管理人，通知未能送達時得以公告方式為之；應恪遵正當法律程序，以符合比例原則之方式為之，對受檢之工商軍事秘密應予保密；致所有人、使用人遭受特別犧牲之損失者，應予補償
c_zh: 遇設有圍障之土地或實施保育措施時，主管機關應取得所有人書面同意始得進入，未獲同意者不得調查；調查人員得就受檢之工商秘密提供學術研究使用；致所有人、使用人遭受特別犧牲之損失者，得申請減免其應納稅捐
d_zh: 遇設有圍障之土地或實施保育措施時，主管機關應於三十日前以雙掛號通知所有人，通知未能送達時應停止調查；應恪遵正當法律程序，對受檢之工商軍事秘密應予保密；致所有人或使用人遭受任何損失者，一律按當期公告地價加倍計算補償金額
q_en: What procedures apply to surveys and conservation measures, and what if special sacrifice results?
a_en: For enclosed land or when carrying out measures, the authority may break through the enclosure without prior notice and need not give public notice afterwards; surveyors may disclose business and military secrets as their work requires; owners or users suffering a loss amounting to special sacrifice must bear it themselves without any compensation
b_en: For enclosed land or when carrying out measures, the authority must notify the owner, user or manager in advance, using public notice where service fails; it must observe due process and proportionality and keep business and military secrets confidential; where owners or users suffer a loss amounting to special sacrifice, compensation must be paid
c_en: For enclosed land or when carrying out measures, the authority must obtain the owner's written consent before entry and may not survey without it; surveyors may release business secrets for academic research; owners or users suffering special sacrifice may apply for a reduction of their taxes
d_en: For enclosed land or when carrying out measures, the authority must give thirty days' notice by registered mail and must halt the survey where service fails; it must observe due process and keep business and military secrets confidential; any loss to owners is compensated at double the assessed land value
explain_zh: 第15條第3項：進行調查或實施各項保育措施，遇設有圍障之土地或實施各項保育措施時，主管機關應事先通知所有人、使用人或管理人；通知未能送達時，得以公告方式為之。第4項：調查機關（構）、法人、團體或保育人員應恪遵正當法律程序，以符合比例原則之方式為之，對於受檢之工商軍事秘密應予保密。第5項：致所有人、使用人遭受特別犧牲之損失者，應予補償。第6項並授權中央主管機關訂定方式、通知及補償條件基準之辦法。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 主管機關指派之海洋保育觀察員，其任務及相對人義務為何？
a_zh: 得在船舶、海洋設施、海域工程或其周圍從事觀察、監測及蒐集資料等任務，但須事先取得所有人書面同意；船舶、海洋設施或海域工程之所有人、使用人或管理人得隨時要求其離開現場
b_zh: 得在船舶、海洋設施、海域工程或其周圍從事觀察、監測及蒐集資料等任務，必要時得請求海岸巡防機關或警察機關協助；船舶、海洋設施或海域工程之所有人、使用人或管理人不得規避、妨礙或拒絕
c_zh: 僅得於船舶停靠港口期間進行文件審查及紀錄查核，不得隨船出海執行任務；船舶、海洋設施或海域工程之所有人、使用人或管理人僅須配合提供文件，得拒絕其進入作業區域
d_zh: 得在船舶、海洋設施、海域工程或其周圍從事取締、蒐證及裁處罰鍰等任務，必要時得逕行扣押相關設備；船舶、海洋設施或海域工程之所有人、使用人或管理人得於作業期間拒絕其登臨
q_en: What are the tasks of marine conservation observers, and what duty falls on the other party?
a_en: They may observe, monitor and collect data on or around ships, marine facilities and marine works, but only with the owner's prior written consent; owners, users or managers may require them to leave the site at any time
b_en: They may observe, monitor and collect data on or around ships, marine facilities and marine works, and may request assistance from the coast guard or police where necessary; owners, users or managers of ships, facilities or works may not evade, obstruct or refuse
c_en: They may only review documents and audit records while a ship is berthed in port and may not go to sea aboard it; owners, users or managers need only supply documents and may refuse them entry to the operating area
d_en: They may carry out interception, evidence-gathering and the imposition of fines on or around ships, marine facilities and marine works, and may seize equipment directly where necessary; owners, users or managers may refuse to let them board during operations
explain_zh: 第16條第1項：主管機關得指派海洋保育觀察員，在船舶、海洋設施、海域工程或其周圍，從事觀察、監測及蒐集資料等任務；必要時，得請求海岸巡防機關或警察機關協助。第2項：船舶、海洋設施或海域工程之所有人、使用人或管理人，不得規避、妨礙或拒絕。第24條第2款對無正當理由規避、妨礙或拒絕者，處新臺幣二萬元以上十萬元以下罰鍰。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 海洋保育觀察員執行任務時之交通及其資格管理事項，本法如何規定？
a_zh: 執行觀察、監測及蒐集資料等任務時，得由船舶、海洋設施或海域工程之所有人、使用人或管理人提供往返交通工具；其資格取得、訓練、管理、廢止資格及其他相關事項之辦法，由中央主管機關定之
b_zh: 執行任務時之往返交通費用應由觀察員自行負擔並檢據報支；其資格取得、訓練、管理及廢止資格等事項，由各直轄市、縣（市）主管機關分別訂定自治規則並報中央備查
c_zh: 執行任務時之往返交通工具應由主管機關自行提供，不得要求業者提供；其資格取得、訓練、管理及廢止資格等事項之辦法，由中央主管機關會商交通部及航政機關共同訂定後公告實施
d_zh: 執行任務時得逕行徵用民間船舶作為往返交通工具而不予補償；其資格取得、訓練、管理及廢止資格等事項之辦法，由海岸巡防機關會同警察機關擬訂後報請行政院核定
q_en: How does the Act deal with observers' transport and their qualification management?
a_en: When observing, monitoring and collecting data they may be provided transport to and from the site by the owner, user or manager of the ship, facility or works; the rules on qualification, training, management and revocation are set by the central authority
b_en: Travel costs to and from the site must be borne by the observers and claimed against receipts; qualification, training, management and revocation are governed by self-government rules made by each local authority and filed centrally
c_en: Transport to and from the site must be provided by the authority itself and may not be demanded of operators; the rules on qualification, training, management and revocation are set by the central authority with the transport ministry and maritime agencies
d_en: Private vessels may be requisitioned as transport without any compensation; the rules on qualification, training, management and revocation are drafted by the coast guard with the police for Executive Yuan approval
explain_zh: 第16條第3項：海洋保育觀察員執行觀察、監測及蒐集資料等任務時，得由船舶、海洋設施或海域工程之所有人、使用人或管理人提供往返交通工具。第4項：海洋保育觀察員之資格取得、訓練、管理、廢止資格及其他相關事項之辦法，由中央主管機關定之。第2項並定明所有人、使用人或管理人不得規避、妨礙或拒絕。

law: 海洋保育法
q_zh: 執法人員、民眾、法人或團體主動參與或協助取締、舉發違法事件者，主管機關應如何處理？
a_zh: 主管機關得予獎勵，但應將其身分資料送交司法機關備查；獎勵之對象、基準及範圍，由行政院逐案核定後發給
b_zh: 主管機關得予獎勵，並對其身分應予保密；獎勵之對象、基準、範圍及其他相關事項之辦法，由中央主管機關定之
c_zh: 主管機關應發給定額獎金，但無保密義務；獎勵之對象、基準及範圍等事項之辦法，由地方主管機關分別訂定
d_zh: 主管機關僅對執法人員予以獎勵，民眾及團體不予獎勵；執法人員之獎勵基準依公務人員考績法之規定辦理
q_en: How must the authority treat those who help intercept or report violations under this Act?
a_en: The authority may reward them but must send their identity data to judicial authorities for record; eligibility, criteria and scope are approved case by case by the Executive Yuan
b_en: The authority may reward them and must keep their identity confidential; the rules on eligible persons, criteria and scope of rewards are set by the central competent authority
c_en: The authority must pay a fixed reward but owes no duty of confidentiality; the rules on eligible persons, criteria and scope are set separately by local authorities
